classic:b901206d9776.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing tasks successfully. Yet, their large size and high computational needs pose challenges for practical use, especially in resource-limited settings. Model compression has emerged as a key research area to address these challenges. This paper presents a survey of model compression techniques for LLMs. We cover methods like quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation, highlighting recent advancements. We also discuss benchmarking strategies and evaluation metrics crucial for assessing compressed LLMs. This survey offers valuable insights for researchers and practitioners, aiming to enhance efficiency and real-world applicability of LLMs while laying a foundation for future advancements.
classic:b901206d9776.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦大语言模型在规模和计算开销上的现实瓶颈，讨论了它们在资源受限场景中难以直接部署的问题。作者系统梳理了模型压缩的主要方法，包括量化、剪枝和知识蒸馏，并总结了这些方向的最新进展。论文还专门讨论了压缩后模型的基准测试与评估指标，强调如何在效率提升的同时尽量保持性能。整体上，它为理解和推进高效 LLM 的研究提供了清晰的框架和参考。
classic:b901206d9776.tldr: 一篇系统总结大语言模型压缩方法、评测指标与研究进展的综述，适合快速了解高效 LLM 的核心路线。
classic:b901206d9776.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把 LLM 压缩领域的关键方法和评估问题整理得很完整，适合作为入门和查漏补缺的经典参考。对想做模型部署、推理加速或高效 AI 的研究者和工程师来说，它能快速建立全局认识。

classic:83e11dee6881.abstract: Compressing large language models (LLMs), often consisting of billions of parameters, provides faster inference, smaller memory footprints, and enables local deployment. Two standard compression techniques are pruning and quantization, with the former eliminating redundant connections in model layers and the latter representing model parameters with fewer bits. The key tradeoff is between the degree of compression and the impact on the quality of the compressed model. Existing research on LLM compression primarily focuses on performance in terms of general metrics like perplexity or downstream task accuracy. More fine-grained metrics, such as those measuring parametric knowledge, remain significantly underexplored. To help bridge this gap, we present a comprehensive analysis across multiple model families (ENCODER, ENCODER-DECODER, and DECODER) using the LAMA and LM-HARNESS benchmarks in order to systematically quantify the effect of commonly employed compression techniques on model performance. A particular focus is on tradeoffs involving parametric knowledge, with the goal of providing practitioners with practical insights to help make informed decisions on compression. We release our codebase1 to enable further research.
classic:83e11dee6881.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型压缩带来的性能代价，重点关注剪枝和量化对模型参数化知识的影响。作者指出，现有工作多用困惑度或下游任务准确率评估压缩效果，但这不足以反映模型究竟丢失了多少知识。为此，论文在编码器、编码器-解码器和解码器三类模型上，结合 LAMA 和 LM-HARNESS 基准进行系统分析。结果为实践者在压缩率、推理效率和知识保留之间做权衡提供了更细粒度的参考。
classic:83e11dee6881.tldr: 系统分析 LLM 剪枝与量化对参数化知识的损失，为压缩效果评估提供更细粒度的视角。
classic:83e11dee6881.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“压缩后还能记住多少知识”这个更具体的问题提了出来，而不只是看整体指标。作为经典参考，它能帮助你在做模型压缩时更理性地权衡效率和能力保持。

classic:6629015db55a.abstract: The rapid growth of Large Language Models (LLMs) has been a driving force in transforming various domains, reshaping the artificial general intelligence landscape. However, the increasing computational and memory demands of these models present substantial challenges, hindering both academic research and practical applications. To address these issues, a wide array of methods, including both algorithmic and hardware solutions, have been developed to enhance the efficiency of LLMs. This survey delivers a comprehensive review of algorithmic advancements aimed at improving LLM efficiency. Unlike other surveys that typically focus on specific areas such as training or model compression, this paper examines the multi-faceted dimensions of efficiency essential for the end-to-end algorithmic development of LLMs. Specifically, it covers various topics related to efficiency, including scaling laws, data utilization, architectural innovations, training and tuning strategies, and inference techniques. This paper aims to serve as a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners, laying the groundwork for future innovations in this critical research area. Our repository of relevant references is maintained at url{https://github.com/tding1/Efficient-LLM-Survey}.
classic:6629015db55a.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦大语言模型在快速发展过程中暴露出的计算与存储效率瓶颈，指出这些问题已经影响到研究推进和实际落地。论文从算法角度系统梳理了提升 LLM 效率的多种方法，包括缩放规律、数据利用、架构创新、训练与微调策略以及推理优化等。与只覆盖单一环节的综述不同，它强调端到端效率设计的多个维度，帮助读者建立完整的效率优化框架。该文为后续研究和工程实践提供了较全面的参考地图与文献入口。
classic:6629015db55a.tldr: 一篇系统梳理大语言模型算法效率优化路线的综述，覆盖训练、架构、数据和推理等关键环节。
classic:6629015db55a.simple_intro: 如果你想快速建立 LLM 效率优化的全局视角，这篇综述很适合当作入门和参考。它把分散在不同方向的优化方法整合到同一框架下，便于后续做研究选题或工程实现。

classic:f93eee2aafb6.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in important tasks such as natural language understanding and language generation, and thus have the potential to make a substantial impact on our society. Such capabilities, however, come with the considerable resources they demand, highlighting the strong need to develop effective techniques for addressing their efficiency challenges. In this survey, we provide a systematic and comprehensive review of efficient LLMs research. We organize the literature in a taxonomy consisting of three main categories, covering distinct yet interconnected efficient LLMs topics from model-centric, data-centric, and framework-centric perspective, respectively. We have also created a GitHub repository where we organize the papers featured in this survey at https://github.com/AIoT-MLSys-Lab/Efficient-LLMs-Survey. We will actively maintain the repository and incorporate new research as it emerges. We hope our survey can serve as a valuable resource to help researchers and practitioners gain a systematic understanding of efficient LLMs research and inspire them to contribute to this important and exciting field.
classic:f93eee2aafb6.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦大语言模型在强大能力背后带来的高计算、存储和部署成本问题，指出效率已成为LLM研究和应用中的关键挑战。作者系统梳理了高效LLM的相关工作，并从模型、数据和框架三个角度建立了清晰的分类体系。文章不仅总结了不同方向的代表性方法，也帮助读者理解这些技术之间的联系与差异。它的价值在于为研究者和工程实践者提供了一份全面的效率优化地图，方便后续选型和深入研究。
classic:f93eee2aafb6.tldr: 一篇系统梳理高效大语言模型研究的综述，按模型、数据和框架三类总结LLM效率优化方法。
classic:f93eee2aafb6.simple_intro: 如果你关心大语言模型如何在更低成本下运行，这篇综述是很好的入口。它适合作为经典参考，因为覆盖全面、分类清晰，能快速建立对“高效LLM”领域的整体认识。

classic:6b866928eea8.abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of artificial intelligence (AI), generative large language models (LLMs) stand at the forefront, revolutionizing how we interact with our data. However, the computational intensity and memory consumption of deploying these models present substantial challenges in terms of serving efficiency, particularly in scenarios demanding low latency and high throughput. This survey addresses the imperative need for efficient LLM serving methodologies from a machine learning system (MLSys) research perspective, standing at the crux of advanced AI innovations and practical system optimizations. We provide in-depth analysis, covering a spectrum of solutions, ranging from cutting-edge algorithmic modifications to groundbreaking changes in system designs. The survey aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the current state and future directions in efficient LLM serving, offering valuable insights for researchers and practitioners in overcoming the barriers of effective LLM deployment, thereby reshaping the future of AI.
classic:6b866928eea8.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦生成式大语言模型在实际部署中的效率问题，核心挑战是计算开销大、显存占用高，以及低延迟和高吞吐难以兼顾。论文从机器学习系统的视角出发，系统梳理了高效 LLM serving 的关键方法，覆盖了从算法层面的改进到系统架构层面的优化。它不仅总结了当前代表性方案，还分析了它们在真实服务场景中的适用性与局限。对于理解大模型如何从“能用”走向“好用”，这篇综述具有很强的参考价值。
classic:6b866928eea8.tldr: 一篇从算法到系统全面梳理高效大语言模型部署与推理服务的综述，适合快速把握 LLM serving 的核心技术脉络。
classic:6b866928eea8.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把大模型服务中最关键的效率问题做了系统整理，帮助读者建立从算法优化到系统设计的完整视角。作为 ICML 2024 tutorial，它也很适合作为进入高效 LLM serving 领域的经典参考。

classic:dc5356285c5d.abstract: The introduction of ChatGPT has led to a significant increase in the utilization of Large Language Models (LLMs) for addressing downstream tasks. There's an increasing focus on cost-efficient training and deployment within this context. Low-cost training and deployment of LLMs represent the future development trend. This paper reviews the evolution of large language model training techniques and inference deployment technologies aligned with this emerging trend. The discussion on training includes various aspects, including data preprocessing, training architecture, pre-training tasks, parallel training, and relevant content related to model fine-tuning. On the inference side, the paper covers topics such as model compression, parallel computation, memory scheduling, and structural optimization. It also explores LLMs' utilization and provides insights into their future development.
classic:dc5356285c5d.summary_zh: 这篇综述关注大语言模型从训练到推理部署的全流程，核心问题是如何在保证效果的同时降低训练和使用成本。文章系统梳理了数据预处理、训练架构、预训练任务、并行训练以及微调等训练侧技术。推理侧则覆盖模型压缩、并行计算、内存调度和结构优化等部署关键环节。它的价值在于把 LLM 研究中分散的技术脉络串联起来，为低成本训练与高效落地提供整体视角。
classic:dc5356285c5d.tldr: 一篇覆盖 LLM 训练到推理部署全链路的综述，重点总结低成本训练与高效推理的关键技术。
classic:dc5356285c5d.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解大语言模型是怎么训练、怎么部署、又为什么越来越强调效率，这篇综述很适合作为入口。它把相关技术按流程系统整理，适合当作经典参考和后续深入阅读的路线图。

classic:b5e8979786cf.abstract: Despite the impressive performance of LLMs, their widespread adoption faces challenges due to substantial computational and memory requirements during inference. Recent advancements in model compression and system-level optimization methods aim to enhance LLM inference. This survey offers an overview of these methods, emphasizing recent developments. Through experiments on LLaMA(/2)-7B, we evaluate various compression techniques, providing practical insights for efficient LLM deployment in a unified setting. The empirical analysis on LLaMA(/2)-7B highlights the effectiveness of these methods. Drawing from survey insights, we identify current limitations and discuss potential future directions to improve LLM inference efficiency. We release the codebase to reproduce the results presented in this paper at https://github.com/nyunAI/Faster-LLM-Survey
classic:b5e8979786cf.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型在推理阶段面临的高计算开销和大内存占用问题，这些瓶颈限制了其广泛部署。论文系统梳理了当前用于提升 LLM 推理效率的模型压缩方法和系统级优化方法，并总结了最新进展。作者还在 LLaMA(/2)-7B 上做了统一实验，对多种压缩技术进行了对比，给出了较强的实践参考。最后，论文归纳了现有方法的局限，并讨论了未来提升推理效率的可能方向。
classic:b5e8979786cf.tldr: 一篇面向 LLM 高效推理的综述，系统总结压缩与系统优化方法，并通过 LLaMA(/2)-7B 实验给出实用结论。
classic:b5e8979786cf.simple_intro: 如果你关心“大模型怎么跑得更快、更省资源”，这篇综述很值得看。它不仅整理了近期方法，还做了统一实验，适合作为高效推理方向的入门和参考。

classic:ae633401db90.abstract: Large foundation models, including large language models (LLMs), vision transformers (ViTs), diffusion, and LLM-based multimodal models, are revolutionizing the entire machine learning lifecycle, from training to deployment. However, the substantial advancements in versatility and performance these models offer come at a significant cost in terms of hardware resources. To support the growth of these large models in a scalable and environmentally sustainable way, there has been a considerable focus on developing resource-efficient strategies. This survey delves into the critical importance of such research, examining both algorithmic and systemic aspects. It offers a comprehensive analysis and valuable insights gleaned from existing literature, encompassing a broad array of topics from cutting-edge model architectures and training/serving algorithms to practical system designs and implementations. The goal of this survey is to provide an overarching understanding of how current approaches are tackling the resource challenges posed by large foundation models and to potentially inspire future breakthroughs in this field.
classic:ae633401db90.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型、视觉Transformer、扩散模型以及多模态基础模型在训练和部署中带来的高硬件资源消耗问题。作者系统梳理了提升资源效率的研究进展，涵盖模型架构、训练与推理算法，以及相关系统设计与实现。文章同时从算法和系统两个层面分析现有方法，强调如何在保证性能的同时降低算力、显存和能耗成本。它的价值在于为资源高效大模型研究提供了全面地图，也为后续工作指出了重要方向。
classic:ae633401db90.tldr: 一篇全面总结大模型与多模态基础模型资源高效化方法的综述，适合快速了解该领域全景。
classic:ae633401db90.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“如何让大模型更省资源”这一核心问题从算法到系统做了系统整理。作为综述，它很适合作为进入资源高效 LLM 与多模态模型研究的经典参考。

classic:1bda3d542104.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for natural language processing tasks, revolutionizing the field with their ability to understand and generate human-like text. As the demand for more sophisticated LLMs continues to grow, there is a pressing need to address the computational challenges associated with their scale and complexity. This paper presents a comprehensive survey on hardware accelerators designed to enhance the performance and energy efficiency of Large Language Models. By examining a diverse range of accelerators, including GPUs, FPGAs, and custom-designed architectures, we explore the landscape of hardware solutions tailored to meet the unique computational demands of LLMs. The survey encompasses an in-depth analysis of architecture, performance metrics, and energy efficiency considerations, providing valuable insights for researchers, engineers, and decision-makers aiming to optimize the deployment of LLMs in real-world applications.
classic:1bda3d542104.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型规模不断扩大，推理和训练带来的算力、延迟与能耗问题日益突出。本文系统梳理了面向 LLM 的硬件加速器方案，包括 GPU、FPGA 以及定制架构等不同路线。作者从体系结构、性能指标和能效表现等角度进行对比分析，帮助读者理解各种硬件方案的适用场景与取舍。作为综述论文，它为研究者和工程实践者提供了较全面的技术地图和优化参考。
classic:1bda3d542104.tldr: 一篇全面梳理 LLM 硬件加速器的综述，重点比较 GPU、FPGA 和定制架构在性能与能效上的方案。
classic:1bda3d542104.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型为什么“算得动但跑不快、跑得贵”，这篇综述很值得看。它能作为入门和选型参考，快速建立对 LLM 硬件加速领域的整体认识。

classic:3491f16ee555.abstract: How can we compress language models without sacrificing accuracy? The number of compression algorithms for language models is rapidly growing to benefit from remarkable advances of recent language models without side effects due to the gigantic size of language models, such as increased carbon emissions and expensive maintenance fees. While numerous compression algorithms have shown remarkable progress in compressing language models, it ironically becomes challenging to capture emerging trends and identify the fundamental concepts underlying them due to the excessive number of algorithms. In this paper, we survey and summarize diverse compression algorithms including pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, low-rank approximation, parameter sharing, and efficient architecture design. We not only summarize the overall trend of diverse compression algorithms but also select representative algorithms and provide in-depth analyses of them. We discuss the value of each category of compression algorithms, and the desired properties of low-cost compression algorithms which have a significant impact due to the emergence of large language models. Finally, we introduce promising future research topics based on our survey results.
classic:3491f16ee555.summary_zh: 这篇综述关注一个核心问题：如何在尽量不损失准确率的前提下压缩语言模型。作者系统梳理了剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、低秩近似、参数共享和高效架构设计等主要方法，并选取代表性算法进行深入分析。论文不仅总结了各类压缩方法的发展趋势，也提炼了它们各自的价值和适用场景。最后，作者还讨论了面向大语言模型时代的低成本压缩需求，并展望了未来研究方向。
classic:3491f16ee555.tldr: 一篇系统梳理语言模型压缩方法的综述，覆盖剪枝、量化、蒸馏等主流路线，并总结未来研究方向。
classic:3491f16ee555.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解语言模型压缩领域的全景，这篇综述非常值得看。它适合作为入门和查漏补缺的经典参考，能帮助你把零散的方法放到统一框架下理解。

classic:78d6bda0a27d.abstract: Transformer plays a vital role in the realms of natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision (CV), specially for constructing large language models (LLM) and large vision models (LVM). Model compression methods reduce the memory and computational cost of Transformer, which is a necessary step to implement large language/vision models on practical devices. Given the unique architecture of Transformer, featuring alternative attention and feedforward neural network (FFN) modules, specific compression techniques are usually required. The efficiency of these compression methods is also paramount, as retraining large models on the entire training dataset is usually impractical. This survey provides a comprehensive review of recent compression methods, with a specific focus on their application to Transformer-based models. The compression methods are primarily categorized into pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and efficient architecture design (Mamba, RetNet, RWKV, etc.). In each category, we discuss compression methods for both language and vision tasks, highlighting common underlying principles. Finally, we delve into the relation between various compression methods, and discuss further directions in this domain.
classic:78d6bda0a27d.summary_zh: Transformer 已成为 NLP 和计算机视觉中的核心模型，但其参数量大、计算开销高，给大语言模型和大视觉模型的落地带来很大挑战。本文围绕 Transformer 的压缩问题，系统梳理了剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏以及高效架构设计等主要路线。作者分别总结了这些方法在语言和视觉任务中的应用，并提炼了它们背后的共同原理。作为一篇综述，它为理解 Transformer 压缩领域的全貌和后续研究方向提供了清晰参考。
classic:78d6bda0a27d.tldr: 这篇综述系统总结了 Transformer 压缩的主流方法，帮助大模型在算力和存储受限的场景中更高效部署。
classic:78d6bda0a27d.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解 Transformer 如何“变小、变快、变省”，这篇综述非常值得看。它把该领域的主要技术路线和代表性方法整理得很清楚，适合作为入门和做相关研究的经典参考。

classic:6c027b2315fb.abstract: Transformer based large language models have achieved tremendous success. However, the significant memory and computational costs incurred during the inference process make it challenging to deploy large models on resource-constrained devices. In this paper, we investigate compression and efficient inference methods for large language models from an algorithmic perspective. Regarding taxonomy, similar to smaller models, compression and acceleration algorithms for large language models can still be categorized into quantization, pruning, distillation, compact architecture design, dynamic networks. However, Large language models have two prominent characteristics compared to smaller models: (1) Most of compression algorithms require finetuning or even retraining the model after compression. The most notable aspect of large models is the very high cost associated with model finetuning or training. Therefore, many algorithms for large models, such as quantization and pruning, start to explore tuning-free algorithms. (2) Large models emphasize versatility and generalization rather than performance on a single task. Hence, many algorithms, such as knowledge distillation, focus on how to preserving their versatility and generalization after compression. Since these two characteristics were not very pronounced in early large models, we further distinguish large language models into medium models and ``real'' large models. Additionally, we also provide an introduction to some mature frameworks for efficient inference of large models, which can support basic compression or acceleration algorithms, greatly facilitating model deployment for users.
classic:6c027b2315fb.summary_zh: 这篇综述系统梳理了大语言模型在推理阶段面临的显存占用高、计算开销大等部署难题。文章从算法视角总结了量化、剪枝、蒸馏、紧凑架构设计和动态网络等压缩与加速方法，并指出大模型与小模型在压缩需求上有明显差异。相比传统方法，大语言模型更强调尽量免微调甚至免训练，以及在压缩后仍保持通用性和泛化能力。作者还介绍了若干成熟的高效推理框架，方便读者理解从算法到落地部署的完整链路。
classic:6c027b2315fb.tldr: 一篇面向大语言模型部署的综述，系统总结了压缩与高效推理方法及其面临的核心挑战。
classic:6c027b2315fb.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解大语言模型如何“变小、变快、好部署”，这篇综述是很好的入口。它把相关方法和现实约束整理得很清楚，适合作为后续读论文和做工程实现的参考地图。

classic:ce6a015d0aa4.abstract: The field of efficient Large Language Model (LLM) inference is rapidly evolving, presenting a unique blend of opportunities and challenges. Although the field has expanded and is vibrant, there hasn't been a concise framework that analyzes the various methods of LLM Inference to provide a clear understanding of this domain. Our survey stands out from traditional literature reviews by not only summarizing the current state of research but also by introducing a framework based on roofline model for systematic analysis of LLM inference techniques. This framework identifies the bottlenecks when deploying LLMs on hardware devices and provides a clear understanding of practical problems, such as why LLMs are memory-bound, how much memory and computation they need, and how to choose the right hardware. We systematically collate the latest advancements in efficient LLM inference, covering crucial areas such as model compression (e.g., Knowledge Distillation and Quantization), algorithm improvements (e.g., Early Exit and Mixture-of-Expert), and both hardware and system-level enhancements. Our survey stands out by analyzing these methods with roofline model, helping us understand their impact on memory access and computation. This distinctive approach not only showcases the current research landscape but also delivers valuable insights for practical implementation, positioning our work as an indispensable resource for researchers new to the field as well as for those seeking to deepen their understanding of efficient LLM deployment. The analyze tool, LLM-Viewer, is open-sourced.
classic:ce6a015d0aa4.summary_zh: 这篇综述关注大语言模型推理效率问题，指出现有方法虽然很多，但缺少一个统一、清晰的分析框架。作者引入基于 roofline model 的分析视角，用来解释 LLM 推理在硬件上为何常常受内存带宽限制，以及不同方法对计算和显存的影响。文章系统梳理了模型压缩、算法改进以及硬件和系统层优化等方向，并从实际部署角度分析它们的瓶颈与收益。它不仅总结研究进展，还给出面向工程实践的判断依据，适合用来理解高效 LLM 推理的全景图。
classic:ce6a015d0aa4.tldr: 一篇用 roofline model 统一分析高效 LLM 推理的综述，帮助理解方法、瓶颈和硬件选择。
classic:ce6a015d0aa4.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把分散的 LLM 推理优化方法放到一个统一框架里来比较，读完更容易建立整体认知。对于想做大模型部署、系统优化或硬件选型的人来说，它是很实用的经典参考。

classic:bb0032654ff3.abstract: In the era of Large Language Models (LLMs), Knowledge Distillation (KD) emerges as a pivotal methodology for transferring advanced capabilities from leading proprietary LLMs, such as GPT-4, to their open-source counterparts like LLaMA and Mistral. Additionally, as open-source LLMs flourish, KD plays a crucial role in both compressing these models, and facilitating their self-improvement by employing themselves as teachers. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of KD's role within the realm of LLM, highlighting its critical function in imparting advanced knowledge to smaller models and its utility in model compression and self-improvement. Our survey is meticulously structured around three foundational pillars: \textit{algorithm}, \textit{skill}, and \textit{verticalization} -- providing a comprehensive examination of KD mechanisms, the enhancement of specific cognitive abilities, and their practical implications across diverse fields. Crucially, the survey navigates the intricate interplay between data augmentation (DA) and KD, illustrating how DA emerges as a powerful paradigm within the KD framework to bolster LLMs' performance. By leveraging DA to generate context-rich, skill-specific training data, KD transcends traditional boundaries, enabling open-source models to approximate the contextual adeptness, ethical alignment, and deep semantic insights characteristic of their proprietary counterparts. This work aims to provide an insightful guide for researchers and practitioners, offering a detailed overview of current methodologies in KD and proposing future research directions. Importantly, we firmly advocate for compliance with the legal terms that regulate the use of LLMs, ensuring ethical and lawful application of KD of LLMs. An associated Github repository…
classic:bb0032654ff3.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型中的知识蒸馏问题，核心是在大模型能力快速发展的背景下，如何把强模型的知识迁移到更小、更开放的模型上。文章系统梳理了知识蒸馏的算法机制、能力提升方式以及在不同垂直领域中的应用，帮助读者建立完整框架。作者还特别讨论了数据增强与知识蒸馏的结合，说明生成高质量训练数据能够显著增强蒸馏效果。整体来看，这篇综述不仅总结了现状，也为未来研究方向和实际落地提供了清晰指引。
classic:bb0032654ff3.tldr: 一篇系统梳理大语言模型知识蒸馏方法、能力提升和应用场景的综述，兼顾模型压缩、自我改进与数据增强。
classic:bb0032654ff3.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为入门和综述参考，因为它把 LLM 知识蒸馏的主要路线和关键问题做了系统整理。对于想了解如何让小模型更接近大模型能力的研究者和工程实践者，都很有参考价值。

classic:37c5523b201d.abstract: Prompting is a mainstream paradigm for adapting large language models to specific natural language processing tasks without modifying internal parameters. Therefore, detailed supplementary knowledge needs to be integrated into external prompts, which inevitably brings extra human efforts and computational burdens for practical applications. As an effective solution to mitigate resource consumption, Efficient Prompting Methods have attracted a wide range of attention. We provide mathematical expressions at a high level to deeply discuss Automatic Prompt Engineering for different prompt components and Prompt Compression in continuous and discrete spaces. Finally, we highlight promising future directions to inspire researchers interested in this field.
classic:37c5523b201d.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型的高效提示方法，讨论在不修改模型参数的前提下，如何通过更省资源的方式适配下游任务。文章指出，传统提示往往需要大量人工设计和额外上下文信息，带来人力与计算成本。作者从高层数学表达出发，系统梳理了自动提示工程以及连续、离散空间中的提示压缩方法。最后还总结了未来值得关注的研究方向，为相关研究提供了统一视角。
classic:37c5523b201d.tldr: 一篇系统梳理大语言模型高效提示方法的综述，重点覆盖自动提示工程与提示压缩。
classic:37c5523b201d.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解“如何用更少的提示成本让大语言模型更好用”，这篇综述很值得看。它适合作为该方向的入门和综述参考，帮助你建立方法全景和研究脉络。

classic:fbe46c9e9f5e.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have showcased exceptional capabilities in various domains, attracting significant interest from both academia and industry. Despite their impressive performance, the substantial size and computational demands of LLMs pose considerable challenges for practical deployment, particularly in environments with limited resources. The endeavor to compress language models while maintaining their accuracy has become a focal point of research. Among the various methods, knowledge distillation has emerged as an effective technique to enhance inference speed without greatly compromising performance. This paper presents a thorough survey from three aspects: method, evaluation, and application, exploring knowledge distillation techniques tailored specifically for LLMs. Specifically, we divide the methods into white-box KD and black-box KD to better illustrate their differences. Furthermore, we also explored the evaluation tasks and distillation effects between different distillation methods, and proposed directions for future research. Through in-depth understanding of the latest advancements and practical applications, this survey provides valuable resources for researchers, paving the way for sustained progress in this field.
classic:fbe46c9e9f5e.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型压缩中的知识蒸馏问题，核心挑战是在尽量保持模型性能的同时降低推理成本和部署难度。文章从方法、评估和应用三个角度系统梳理了面向 LLM 的蒸馏研究，并将方法划分为白盒蒸馏和黑盒蒸馏，以便更清晰地比较不同路线。作者进一步总结了常见评测任务、不同蒸馏方法的效果差异，以及当前研究中存在的关键问题。最后，论文给出了未来研究方向，为后续做高效大模型提供了较全面的参考框架。
classic:fbe46c9e9f5e.tldr: 一篇系统梳理大语言模型知识蒸馏方法、评估与应用的综述，适合快速了解该领域全景。
classic:fbe46c9e9f5e.simple_intro: 如果你想了解如何让大语言模型在更小的算力和更低的成本下高效运行，这篇综述很值得看。它把相关研究按清晰的框架整理出来，适合作为入门和后续研究的经典参考。

classic:123393baaafd.abstract: The advent of large language models (LLMs) revolutionized natural language processing applications, and running LLMs on edge devices has become increasingly attractive for reasons including reduced latency, data localization, and personalized user experiences. This comprehensive review examines the challenges of deploying computationally expensive LLMs on resource-constrained devices and explores innovative solutions across multiple domains. The paper investigates the development of on-device language models, their efficient architectures, including parameter sharing and modular designs, as well as state-of-the-art compression techniques like quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation. Hardware acceleration strategies and collaborative edge-cloud deployment approaches are analyzed, highlighting the intricate balance between performance and resource utilization. Case studies of on-device language models from major mobile manufacturers demonstrate real-world applications and potential benefits. The review also addresses critical aspects such as adaptive learning, multi-modal capabilities, and personalization. By identifying key research directions and open challenges, this paper provides a roadmap for future advancements in on-device language models, emphasizing the need for interdisciplinary efforts to realize the full potential of ubiquitous, intelligent computing while ensuring responsible and ethical deployment. For a comprehensive review of research work and educational resources on on-device large language models (LLMs), please visit https://github.com/NexaAI/Awesome-LLMs-on-device. To download and run on-device LLMs, visit https://www.nexaai.com/models.
classic:123393baaafd.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于如何把大语言模型部署到手机、终端和其他边缘设备上，解决传统 LLM 在算力、内存和能耗方面的限制。文章系统梳理了适合端侧部署的模型架构设计，包括参数共享、模块化结构，以及量化、剪枝、知识蒸馏等压缩方法。它还总结了硬件加速、边云协同、个性化和多模态能力等关键方向，帮助平衡性能与资源开销。作为一篇全面的综述，它为端侧大模型研究提供了清晰的技术地图和未来路线。
classic:123393baaafd.tldr: 这是一篇关于端侧大语言模型的全面综述，系统总结了架构、压缩、硬件加速与边云协同等关键技术。
classic:123393baaafd.simple_intro: 如果你想了解“大模型怎么跑到手机上”，这篇综述是很好的起点。它把研究现状、工程难点和未来方向串得很完整，适合作为经典参考和入门地图。

classic:1dacfefe2af9.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable advancements in natural language processing, showcasing exceptional performance across various tasks. However, the expensive memory and computational requirements present significant challenges for their practical deployment. Low-bit quantization has emerged as a critical approach to mitigate these challenges by reducing the bit-width of model parameters, activations, and gradients, thus decreasing memory usage and computational demands. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of low-bit quantization methods tailored for LLMs, covering the fundamental principles, system implementations, and algorithmic strategies. An overview of basic concepts and new data formats specific to low-bit LLMs is first introduced, followed by a review of frameworks and systems that facilitate low-bit LLMs across various hardware platforms. Then, we categorize and analyze techniques and toolkits for efficient low-bit training and inference of LLMs. Finally, we conclude with a discussion of future trends and potential advancements of low-bit LLMs. Our systematic overview from basic, system, and algorithm perspectives can offer valuable insights and guidelines for future works to enhance the efficiency and applicability of LLMs through low-bit quantization.
classic:1dacfefe2af9.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型在实际部署中面临的高内存和高计算成本问题，核心解决思路是低比特量化。论文从基础概念、新的数据表示格式、系统实现，到训练与推理算法，系统梳理了低比特 LLM 的关键方法与工具。作者还总结了不同硬件平台上的支持框架，并分析了现有技术的优缺点。整体来看，这篇综述为理解低比特大模型的研究脉络和工程落地路径提供了全面参考。
classic:1dacfefe2af9.tldr: 一篇系统梳理低比特大语言模型基础、系统与算法的综述，帮助读者理解如何用量化降低大模型部署成本。
classic:1dacfefe2af9.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解低比特大模型为什么重要、现在有哪些主流方法，以及它们如何在系统层面落地，这篇综述很值得看。它适合作为进入低比特量化研究或工程实践的经典参考地图。

classic:0f0ad86b65a1.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) showcase remarkable abilities, yet they struggle with limitations such as hallucinations, outdated knowledge, opacity, and inexplicable reasoning. To address these challenges, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has proven to be a viable solution, leveraging external databases to improve the consistency and coherence of generated content, especially valuable for complex, knowledge-rich tasks, and facilitates continuous improvement by leveraging domain-specific insights. By combining the intrinsic knowledge of LLMs with the vast, dynamic repositories of external databases, RAG achieves a synergistic effect. However, RAG is not without its limitations, including a limited context window, irrelevant information, and the high processing overhead for extensive contextual data. In this comprehensive work, we explore the evolution of Contextual Compression paradigms, providing an in-depth examination of the field. Finally, we outline the current challenges and suggest potential research and development directions, paving the way for future advancements in this area.
classic:0f0ad86b65a1.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于 RAG 中的上下文压缩问题：当外部检索结果过多、冗余或不相关时，模型如何在有限上下文窗口内保留最有用的信息。文章系统梳理了上下文压缩范式的发展脉络，并讨论了相关方法如何缓解幻觉、知识过时和推理不透明等问题。作者还分析了该领域面临的主要挑战，包括信息筛选、压缩质量与计算开销之间的平衡。最后，论文总结了未来可能的研究方向，为 RAG 系统的高效化和实用化提供参考。
classic:0f0ad86b65a1.tldr: 一篇系统梳理 RAG 上下文压缩方法的综述，重点解决长检索结果带来的冗余与效率问题。
classic:0f0ad86b65a1.simple_intro: 如果你关心 RAG 为什么常常“检索很多但用不好”，这篇综述很值得看。它把上下文压缩这一关键环节从方法演进到未来方向都做了系统总结，适合作为入门和研究参考。

classic:1272ad1a97e6.abstract: Leveraging large language models (LLMs) for complex natural language tasks typically requires long-form prompts to convey detailed requirements and information, which results in increased memory usage and inference costs. To mitigate these challenges, multiple efficient methods have been proposed, with prompt compression gaining significant research interest. This survey provides an overview of prompt compression techniques, categorized into hard prompt methods and soft prompt methods. First, the technical approaches of these methods are compared, followed by an exploration of various ways to understand their mechanisms, including the perspectives of attention optimization, Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), modality integration, and new synthetic language. We also examine the downstream adaptations of various prompt compression techniques. Finally, the limitations of current prompt compression methods are analyzed, and several future directions are outlined, such as optimizing the compression encoder, combining hard and soft prompts methods, and leveraging insights from multimodality.
classic:1272ad1a97e6.summary_zh: 这篇综述关注大语言模型在处理复杂自然语言任务时，往往需要很长的提示词，从而带来更高的内存开销和推理成本。作者系统梳理了提示压缩的研究进展，并将方法分为硬提示压缩和软提示压缩两大类。文章进一步从注意力优化、参数高效微调、模态融合和新型合成语言等角度解释这些方法的工作机制。最后，论文总结了现有方法的局限，并展望了压缩编码器优化、硬软提示结合以及多模态启发等未来方向。
classic:1272ad1a97e6.tldr: 一篇系统梳理大模型提示压缩方法的综述，帮助降低长提示带来的成本与开销。
classic:1272ad1a97e6.simple_intro: 如果你想了解大语言模型如何在尽量保留信息的前提下压缩提示词，这篇综述是很好的入口。它适合作为研究提示压缩、效率优化和提示工程的经典参考。

classic:37d6c11173af.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been extensively researched and used in both academia and industry since the rise in popularity of the Transformer model, which demonstrates excellent performance in AI. However, the computational demands of LLMs are immense, and the energy resources required to run them are often limited. For instance, popular models like GPT-3, with 175 billion parameters and a storage requirement of 350 GB, present significant challenges for deployment on resource-constrained IoT devices and embedded systems. These systems often lack the computational capacity to handle such large models. Quantization, a technique that reduces the precision of model values to a smaller set of discrete values, offers a promising solution by reducing the size of LLMs and accelerating inference. In this research, we provide a comprehensive analysis of quantization techniques within the machine learning field, with a particular focus on their application to LLMs. We begin by exploring the mathematical theory of quantization, followed by a review of common quantization methods and how they are implemented. Furthermore, we examine several prominent quantization methods applied to LLMs, detailing their algorithms and performance outcomes.
classic:37d6c11173af.summary_zh: 这篇综述关注大语言模型在部署时面临的高计算、高存储和高能耗问题，尤其是在资源受限的 IoT 和嵌入式设备上。论文系统梳理了量化技术的数学基础、常见方法及其实现方式，并重点总结了这些方法在 LLM 上的应用。作者进一步比较了多种代表性量化算法的原理与效果，帮助读者理解不同方案在压缩模型和加速推理上的权衡。它的价值在于为研究者和工程实践者提供了一份较完整的量化技术地图。
classic:37d6c11173af.tldr: 一篇系统梳理大语言模型量化方法的综述，帮助理解如何在压缩模型体积的同时提升推理效率。
classic:37d6c11173af.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解 LLM 为什么需要量化、量化有哪些主流路线，以及各种方法适合什么场景，这篇综述很值得看。它适合作为入门和选型参考，能帮助你建立对模型压缩与部署的整体认知。

classic:a4ce060c7527.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized a wide range of domains such as natural language processing, computer vision, and multi-modal tasks due to their ability to comprehend context and perform logical reasoning. However, the computational and memory demands of LLMs, particularly during inference, pose significant challenges when scaling them to real-world, long-context, and real-time applications. Key-Value (KV) cache management has emerged as a critical optimization technique for accelerating LLM inference by reducing redundant computations and improving memory utilization. This survey provides a comprehensive overview of KV cache management strategies for LLM acceleration, categorizing them into token-level, model-level, and system-level optimizations. Token-level strategies include KV cache selection, budget allocation, merging, quantization, and low-rank decomposition, while model-level optimizations focus on architectural innovations and attention mechanisms to enhance KV reuse. System-level approaches address memory management, scheduling, and hardware-aware designs to improve efficiency across diverse computing environments. Additionally, the survey provides an overview of both text and multimodal datasets and benchmarks used to evaluate these strategies. By presenting detailed taxonomies and comparative analyses, this work aims to offer useful insights for researchers and practitioners to support the development of efficient and scalable KV cache management techniques, contributing to the practical deployment of LLMs in real-world applications. The curated paper list for KV cache management is in: \href{https://github.com/TreeAI-Lab/Awesome-KV-Cache-Management}{https://github.com/TreeAI-Lab/Awesome-KV-Cache-Management}.
classic:a4ce060c7527.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型推理阶段的关键瓶颈：计算开销大、显存占用高，尤其在长上下文和实时场景下更为突出。作者系统梳理了基于 KV cache 管理的加速方法，并将其分为 token 级、model 级和 system 级三类。文中进一步总结了各类方法在缓存选择、预算分配、量化、低秩分解、注意力机制改造以及系统调度等方面的进展。通过给出清晰的分类、对比和基准概览，这篇综述为高效部署 LLM 提供了实用参考。
classic:a4ce060c7527.tldr: 一篇系统梳理 KV cache 管理如何加速大语言模型推理的综述，适合快速了解该方向的技术版图。
classic:a4ce060c7527.simple_intro: 如果你想了解大语言模型推理为何昂贵，以及当前有哪些主流办法能降低显存和计算成本，这篇综述非常值得看。它把零散的 KV cache 优化工作整理成清晰框架，适合作为入门和写综述时的经典参考。

classic:e995a36c1eef.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of industrial applications, from search and recommendation systems to generative tasks. Although scaling laws indicate that larger models generally yield better generalization and performance, their substantial computational requirements often render them impractical for many real-world scenarios at scale. In this paper, we present a comprehensive set of insights for training and deploying small language models (SLMs) that deliver high performance for a variety of industry use cases. We focus on two key techniques: (1) knowledge distillation and (2) model compression via structured pruning and quantization. These approaches enable SLMs to retain much of the quality of their larger counterparts while significantly reducing training/serving costs and latency. We detail the impact of these techniques on a variety of use cases in a large professional social network platform and share deployment lessons, including hardware optimization strategies that improve speed and throughput for both predictive and reasoning-based applications in Recommendation Systems.
classic:e995a36c1eef.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于工业场景中大语言模型落地时面临的计算成本高、推理延迟大和部署效率不足等问题。文章系统总结了训练与部署高效小语言模型（SLM）的实践经验，重点介绍了知识蒸馏、结构化剪枝和量化等压缩技术。作者结合大型职业社交平台的真实应用案例，分析了这些方法在推荐系统等任务中的效果。其价值在于为企业在保持模型性能的同时降低训练与服务成本提供了可操作的经验和部署策略。
classic:e995a36c1eef.tldr: 这是一篇面向工业落地的高效LLM综述，重点讲清楚如何用蒸馏、剪枝和量化把大模型压缩成更便宜、更快的小模型。
classic:e995a36c1eef.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型如何真正部署到业务系统里，这篇文章很值得看。它不是只谈理论，而是结合真实工业案例总结了训练、压缩和硬件优化的实战经验，适合作为高效LLM工程参考。

classic:e54b65906f89.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in generating text, images, and video content. However, as context length grows, the computational cost of attention increases quadratically with the number of tokens, presenting significant efficiency challenges. This paper presents an analysis of various Key-Value (KV) cache compression strategies, offering a comprehensive taxonomy that categorizes these methods by their underlying principles and implementation techniques. Furthermore, we evaluate their impact on performance and inference latency, providing critical insights into their effectiveness. Our findings highlight the trade-offs involved in KV cache compression and its influence on handling long-context scenarios, paving the way for more efficient LLM implementations.
classic:e54b65906f89.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型在长上下文推理中的核心瓶颈：随着 token 数量增加，注意力计算和 KV cache 占用都会迅速上升，导致推理成本变高。论文系统梳理了多种 KV cache 压缩方法，并按其基本原理与实现方式建立了清晰的分类框架。作者进一步比较了不同方法对模型效果和推理延迟的影响，揭示了压缩率、精度与速度之间的权衡。整体来看，它为理解和选择 KV cache 压缩方案提供了很有价值的全景式参考。
classic:e54b65906f89.tldr: 一篇系统梳理 KV cache 压缩技术的综述，帮你看清长上下文推理提速与效果损失之间的权衡。
classic:e54b65906f89.simple_intro: 如果你关心大语言模型如何在长上下文下更省显存、更快推理，这篇文章很值得看。它把分散的 KV cache 压缩思路整理成一套清晰地图，适合作为后续研究和工程实现的经典参考。

classic:a2af0d408e6f.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have prompted interest in deploying these models on mobile devices to enable new applications without relying on cloud connectivity. However, the efficiency constraints of deploying LLMs on resource-limited devices present significant challenges. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive measurement study to evaluate the efficiency tradeoffs between mobile-based, edge-based, and cloud-based deployments for LLM applications. We implement AutoLife-Lite, a simplified LLM-based application that analyzes smartphone sensor data to infer user location and activity contexts. Our experiments reveal that: (1) Only small-size LLMs (<4B parameters) can run successfully on powerful mobile devices, though they exhibit quality limitations compared to larger models; (2) Model compression is effective in lower the hardware requirement, but may lead to significant performance degradation; (3) The latency to run LLMs on mobile devices with meaningful output is significant (>30 seconds), while cloud services demonstrate better time efficiency (<10 seconds); (4) Edge deployments offer intermediate tradeoffs between latency and model capabilities, with different results on CPU-based and GPU-based settings. These findings provide valuable insights for system designers on the current limitations and future directions for on-device LLM applications.
classic:a2af0d408e6f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在手机等资源受限设备上的部署效率问题，讨论了为什么“把 LLM 放到端上”虽然很有吸引力，但实际落地会遇到性能和资源瓶颈。作者通过搭建一个简化的 LLM 应用 AutoLife-Lite，系统比较了手机、边缘端和云端三种部署方式在延迟、模型能力和硬件需求上的差异。实验表明，真正能在强手机上顺利运行的通常只有 4B 以下的小模型，但其输出质量会受限。论文还指出模型压缩虽然能降低门槛，却可能带来明显性能损失，因此对端侧 LLM 系统设计具有很强的参考价值。
classic:a2af0d408e6f.tldr: 端侧 LLM 很有前景，但在手机上真正可用的小模型少、延迟高、质量受限，云端仍更高效。
classic:a2af0d408e6f.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为经典参考，因为它不是停留在概念讨论，而是用实测数据把手机、边缘和云端部署的真实代价讲清楚了。对想做移动端 AI、端侧推理或系统优化的人来说，它能帮助建立对当前能力边界的正确预期。

classic:ab5ecb86119a.abstract: The exponential growth of Large Language Models (LLMs) continues to highlight the need for efficient strategies to meet ever-expanding computational and data demands. This survey provides a comprehensive analysis of two complementary paradigms: Knowledge Distillation (KD) and Dataset Distillation (DD), both aimed at compressing LLMs while preserving their advanced reasoning capabilities and linguistic diversity. We first examine key methodologies in KD, such as task-specific alignment, rationale-based training, and multi-teacher frameworks, alongside DD techniques that synthesize compact, high-impact datasets through optimization-based gradient matching, latent space regularization, and generative synthesis. Building on these foundations, we explore how integrating KD and DD can produce more effective and scalable compression strategies. Together, these approaches address persistent challenges in model scalability, architectural heterogeneity, and the preservation of emergent LLM abilities. We further highlight applications across domains such as healthcare and education, where distillation enables efficient deployment without sacrificing performance. Despite substantial progress, open challenges remain in preserving emergent reasoning and linguistic diversity, enabling efficient adaptation to continually evolving teacher models and datasets, and establishing comprehensive evaluation protocols. By synthesizing methodological innovations, theoretical foundations, and practical insights, our survey charts a path toward sustainable, resource-efficient LLMs through the tighter integration of KD and DD principles.
classic:ab5ecb86119a.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦大语言模型在算力和数据成本持续攀升背景下的压缩需求，系统梳理了知识蒸馏与数据集蒸馏两条互补路线。文章分别总结了任务对齐、基于推理链的训练、多教师框架，以及基于梯度匹配、潜空间正则和生成式合成的数据蒸馏方法。进一步地，作者讨论了将两者结合以提升压缩效率与可扩展性的可能性，并分析了在保留涌现推理能力和语言多样性方面的关键挑战。该综述还指出了医疗、教育等应用场景中的价值，并为未来的评测与持续适配提出了方向。
classic:ab5ecb86119a.tldr: 一篇系统综述大模型知识蒸馏与数据集蒸馏，重点讨论如何在压缩模型与数据的同时尽量保留推理能力和语言多样性。
classic:ab5ecb86119a.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解大语言模型“怎么变轻、怎么保性能”，这篇综述是很好的入口。它把两类核心压缩思路、主要方法和开放问题都串起来，适合作为后续研究和选题的经典参考。

classic:2ee09450fdec.abstract: Prompt engineering enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform a variety of tasks. However, lengthy prompts significantly increase computational complexity and economic costs. To address this issue, we study six prompt compression methods for LLMs, aiming to reduce prompt length while maintaining LLM response quality. In this paper, we present a comprehensive analysis covering aspects such as generation performance, model hallucinations, efficacy in multimodal tasks, word omission analysis, and more. We evaluate these methods across 13 datasets, including news, scientific articles, commonsense QA, math QA, long-context QA, and VQA datasets. Our experiments reveal that prompt compression has a greater impact on LLM performance in long contexts compared to short ones. In the Longbench evaluation, moderate compression even enhances LLM performance. Our code and data is available at https://github.com/3DAgentWorld/Toolkit-for-Prompt-Compression.
classic:2ee09450fdec.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型提示词过长带来的计算开销和使用成本问题，提出需要通过提示压缩来在缩短输入的同时尽量保持输出质量。作者系统比较了六种提示压缩方法，并从生成效果、幻觉现象、多模态任务表现以及词语遗漏等多个角度进行分析。实验覆盖 13 个数据集，包含新闻、科学文章、常识问答、数学问答、长上下文问答和视觉问答等任务。结果表明，提示压缩对长上下文任务的影响更明显，而适度压缩在 LongBench 上甚至可能提升模型表现。
classic:2ee09450fdec.tldr: 这篇综述/实证研究系统比较了六种提示压缩方法，发现适度压缩在长上下文场景下不一定降性能，甚至可能带来收益。
classic:2ee09450fdec.simple_intro: 如果你关心如何让大模型在更低成本下处理长提示词，这篇论文很值得看。它提供了较全面的实验对比和分析框架，适合作为提示压缩方向的经典参考。

classic:25379badb693.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive performance across various domains. However, the substantial hardware resources required for their training present a significant barrier to efficiency and scalability. To mitigate this challenge, low-precision training techniques have been widely adopted, leading to notable advancements in training efficiency. Despite these gains, low-precision training involves several components$\unicode{x2013}$such as weights, activations, and gradients$\unicode{x2013}$each of which can be represented in different numerical formats. The resulting diversity has created a fragmented landscape in low-precision training research, making it difficult for researchers to gain a unified overview of the field. This survey provides a comprehensive review of existing low-precision training methods. To systematically organize these approaches, we categorize them into three primary groups based on their underlying numerical formats, which is a key factor influencing hardware compatibility, computational efficiency, and ease of reference for readers. The categories are: (1) fixed-point and integer-based methods, (2) floating-point-based methods, and (3) customized format-based methods. Additionally, we discuss quantization-aware training approaches, which share key similarities with low-precision training during forward propagation. Finally, we highlight several promising research directions to advance this field. A collection of papers discussed in this survey is provided in https://github.com/Hao840/Awesome-Low-Precision-Training.
classic:25379badb693.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦大语言模型训练中的低精度计算问题，指出虽然低精度训练能显著降低硬件开销、提升训练效率，但权重、激活和梯度等不同组件采用的数值格式很分散，导致领域缺乏统一视角。作者系统梳理了现有方法，并按数值格式分为定点/整数、浮点和自定义格式三类，便于从硬件兼容性和计算效率两个角度理解不同路线。论文还补充讨论了与低精度训练高度相关的量化感知训练方法。最后，作者总结了该方向的关键挑战与未来机会，为后续研究提供了清晰的地图。
classic:25379badb693.tldr: 一篇系统梳理大语言模型低精度训练方法、分类框架与未来方向的综述。
classic:25379badb693.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解 LLM 训练为什么越来越依赖低精度计算，以及现有方法是怎么分类和比较的，这篇综述很适合作为入门与参考。它把分散的研究整理成一张“路线图”，适合想跟进该领域最新进展的人阅读。

classic:f6c077f772ef.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized many areas of artificial intelligence (AI), but their substantial resource requirements limit their deployment on mobile and edge devices. This survey paper provides a comprehensive overview of techniques for compressing LLMs to enable efficient inference in resource-constrained environments. We examine three primary approaches: Knowledge Distillation, Model Quantization, and Model Pruning. For each technique, we discuss the underlying principles, present different variants, and provide examples of successful applications. We also briefly discuss complementary techniques such as mixture-of-experts and early-exit strategies. Finally, we highlight promising future directions, aiming to provide a valuable resource for both researchers and practitioners seeking to optimize LLMs for edge deployment.
classic:f6c077f772ef.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型在移动端和边缘设备上部署时面临的算力、存储和延迟约束问题。作者系统梳理了三类核心压缩方法：知识蒸馏、模型量化和模型剪枝，并分别介绍了其基本原理、常见变体和典型应用。论文还补充讨论了混合专家和 early-exit 等辅助策略，帮助读者理解不同方法之间的互补关系。整体上，它为资源受限场景下优化 LLM 提供了一份较完整的技术地图和研究入口。
classic:f6c077f772ef.tldr: 一篇面向边缘部署的 LLM 压缩综述，系统总结蒸馏、量化、剪枝等关键方法。
classic:f6c077f772ef.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型如何在手机、IoT 或边缘设备上高效运行，这篇综述很值得看。它把分散的压缩技术整理成清晰框架，适合作为入门和后续研究的经典参考。

classic:161680ecdb4f.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely applied in chatbots, code generators, and search engines. Workload such as chain-of-throught, complex reasoning, agent services significantly increase the inference cost by invoke the model repeatedly. Optimization methods such as parallelism, compression, and caching have been adopted to reduce costs, but the diverse service requirements make it hard to select the right method. Recently, specialized LLM inference engines have emerged as a key component for integrating the optimization methods into service-oriented infrastructures. However, a systematic study on inference engines is still lacking.This paper provides a comprehensive evaluation of 25 open-source and commercial inference engines. We examine each inference engine in terms of ease-of-use, ease-of-deployment, general-purpose support, scalability, and suitability for throughput- and latency-aware computation. Furthermore, we explore the design goals of each inference engine by investigating the optimization techniques it supports. In addition, we assess the ecosystem maturity of open source inference engines and handle the performance and cost policy of commercial solutions.We outline future research directions that include support for complex LLM-based services, support of various hardware, and enhanced security, offering practical guidance to researchers and developers in selecting and designing optimized LLM inference engines. We also provide a public repository to continually track developments in this fast-evolving field: \href{https://github.com/sihyeong/Awesome-LLM-Inference-Engine}{https://github.com/sihyeong/Awesome-LLM-Inference-Engine}.
classic:161680ecdb4f.summary_zh: 这篇综述聚焦于大语言模型推理引擎在实际服务中的优化与效率问题，指出链式思维、复杂推理和智能体服务会显著抬高推理成本。作者系统评估了 25 个开源和商业推理引擎，从易用性、易部署性、通用支持、可扩展性，以及吞吐和低延迟场景适配等维度进行比较。论文还梳理了各类引擎所支持的优化技术，包括并行、压缩和缓存等，并分析了开源生态成熟度与商业方案的性能/成本策略。最后，作者总结了未来研究方向，如复杂 LLM 服务、多硬件支持和安全性增强，为选型与系统设计提供了实用参考。
classic:161680ecdb4f.tldr: 一篇面向工程落地的 LLM 推理引擎综述，系统比较 25 种开源与商业方案，帮助理解如何在成本、吞吐和延迟之间做权衡。
classic:161680ecdb4f.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是只讲单一优化技巧，而是把 LLM 推理引擎作为整体基础设施来分析，特别适合做系统选型和架构设计的人参考。作为经典综述，它还能帮助你快速建立对当前推理生态、主流优化手段和未来趋势的全局认识。

classic:3ca56454e895.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have driven significant progress, yet their growing parameter counts and context windows incur prohibitive compute, energy, and monetary costs. We introduce EfficientLLM, a novel benchmark and the first comprehensive empirical study evaluating efficiency techniques for LLMs at scale. Conducted on a production-class cluster (48xGH200, 8xH200 GPUs), our study systematically explores three key axes: (1) architecture pretraining (efficient attention variants: MQA, GQA, MLA, NSA; sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)), (2) fine-tuning (parameter-efficient methods: LoRA, RSLoRA, DoRA), and (3) inference (quantization methods: int4, float16). We define six fine-grained metrics (Memory Utilization, Compute Utilization, Latency, Throughput, Energy Consumption, Compression Rate) to capture hardware saturation, latency-throughput balance, and carbon cost. Evaluating over 100 model-technique pairs (0.5B-72B parameters), we derive three core insights: (i) Efficiency involves quantifiable trade-offs: no single method is universally optimal; e.g., MoE reduces FLOPs and improves accuracy but increases VRAM by 40%, while int4 quantization cuts memory/energy by up to 3.9x at a 3-5% accuracy drop. (ii) Optima are task- and scale-dependent: MQA offers optimal memory-latency trade-offs for constrained devices, MLA achieves lowest perplexity for quality-critical tasks, and RSLoRA surpasses LoRA efficiency only beyond 14B parameters. (iii) Techniques generalize across modalities: we extend evaluations to Large Vision Models (Stable Diffusion 3.5, Wan 2.1) and Vision-Language Models (Qwen2.5-VL), confirming effective transferability. By open-sourcing datasets, evaluation pipelines, and leaderboards, EfficientLLM provides essential guidance for researchers and engineers…
classic:3ca56454e895.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在参数规模和上下文窗口不断增大后，带来的计算、能耗和成本压力。作者提出了 EfficientLLM 这一基准，并在生产级集群上系统评估了预训练、微调和推理三个阶段的多种效率技术。论文还设计了 6 个细粒度指标，从显存、算力、时延、吞吐、能耗和压缩率等方面刻画不同方法的真实权衡。其价值在于给出可复现的大规模实证结论，并开源数据与评测流程，为模型效率研究和工程选型提供参考。
classic:3ca56454e895.tldr: EfficientLLM 用大规模实证基准系统比较了 LLM 的各种效率优化方法，揭示了不同场景下的最优选择与权衡。
classic:3ca56454e895.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为理解“如何让大模型更省算力、更省显存、更省电”的经典参考。它不是只讲概念，而是用大规模实验把常见效率技术的优缺点和适用边界讲清楚了。

classic:4be458c560b0.abstract: How to efficiently serve ever-larger trained natural language models in practice has become exceptionally challenging even for powerful cloud servers due to their prohibitive memory/computation requirements. In this work, we present an efficient and affordable post-training quantization approach to compress large Transformer-based models, termed as ZeroQuant. ZeroQuant is an end-to-end quantization and inference pipeline with three main components: (1) a fine-grained hardware-friendly quantization scheme for both weight and activations; (2) a novel affordable layer-by-layer knowledge distillation algorithm (LKD) even without the access to the original training data; (3) a highly-optimized quantization system backend support to remove the quantization/dequantization overhead. As such, we are able to show that: (1) ZeroQuant can reduce the precision for weights and activations to INT8 in a cost-free way for both BERT and GPT3-style models with minimal accuracy impact, which leads to up to 5.19x/4.16x speedup on those models compared to FP16 inference; (2) ZeroQuant plus LKD affordably quantize the weights in the fully-connected module to INT4 along with INT8 weights in the attention module and INT8 activations, resulting in 3x memory footprint reduction compared to the FP16 model; (3) ZeroQuant can be directly applied to two of the largest open-sourced language models, including GPT-J6B and GPT-NeoX20, for which our INT8 model achieves similar accuracy as the FP16 model but achieves up to 5.2x better efficiency.
classic:4be458c560b0.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大型 Transformer 模型在实际部署中面临的显存占用大、推理成本高的问题，提出了 ZeroQuant 后训练量化方案。方法上，它结合了面向硬件的细粒度权重量化与激活量化、无需原始训练数据也能进行的分层知识蒸馏，以及优化过的系统后端来消除量化开销。实验表明，ZeroQuant 可以将 BERT 和 GPT3 风格模型的权重与激活压到 INT8，几乎不损失精度，并带来显著推理加速。进一步结合 INT4/INT8 的混合量化后，还能大幅降低内存占用，并可直接扩展到 GPT-J6B、GPT-NeoX20 等大模型。
classic:4be458c560b0.tldr: ZeroQuant 让大模型在几乎不掉精度的前提下实现高效、低成本的后训练量化与推理加速。
classic:4be458c560b0.simple_intro: 这篇论文是大模型量化部署方向的经典参考，因为它不仅讲清了“怎么量化”，还解决了“量化后怎么真正跑得快”的系统问题。对于想把 Transformer 模型落地到实际服务环境的人来说，它非常值得看。

classic:0a3e7e89d61c.abstract: Large language models have been widely adopted but require significant GPU memory for inference. We develop a procedure for Int8 matrix multiplication for feed-forward and attention projection layers in transformers, which cut the memory needed for inference by half while retaining full precision performance. With our method, a 175B parameter 16/32-bit checkpoint can be loaded, converted to Int8, and used immediately without performance degradation. This is made possible by understanding and working around properties of highly systematic emergent features in transformer language models that dominate attention and transformer predictive performance. To cope with these features, we develop a two-part quantization procedure, LLM.int8(). We first use vector-wise quantization with separate normalization constants for each inner product in the matrix multiplication, to quantize most of the features. However, for the emergent outliers, we also include a new mixed-precision decomposition scheme, which isolates the outlier feature dimensions into a 16-bit matrix multiplication while still more than 99.9% of values are multiplied in 8-bit. Using LLM.int8(), we show empirically it is possible to perform inference in LLMs with up to 175B parameters without any performance degradation. This result makes such models much more accessible, for example making it possible to use OPT-175B/BLOOM on a single server with consumer GPUs. We open-source our software.
classic:0a3e7e89d61c.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理时显存占用过高的问题，提出了适用于 Transformer 的 8 位矩阵乘法方法。作者发现模型中存在少量会严重影响量化效果的异常特征，因此设计了两部分量化方案：对大多数值使用按向量量化，对异常维度保留 16 位混合精度计算。该方法可以把 16/32 位的超大模型直接转换为 Int8 并立即推理，显著降低显存需求，同时基本不损失性能。实验表明，LLM.int8() 能让 175B 参数模型在单机消费级 GPU 上更可用，具有很强的工程和研究价值。
classic:0a3e7e89d61c.tldr: LLM.int8() 通过混合精度 8 位矩阵乘法，在几乎不掉精度的前提下把超大 Transformer 的推理显存减半。
classic:0a3e7e89d61c.simple_intro: 这篇论文是大模型量化领域的经典工作之一，因为它首次系统解决了超大 Transformer 在 8 位推理中的关键难题。它不仅有很强的实用价值，也解释了为什么简单量化会失效，并给出了可复用的工程方案。

classic:8630ea8a90ed.abstract: Transformer architecture has become the fundamental element of the widespread natural language processing~(NLP) models. With the trends of large NLP models, the increasing memory and computation costs hinder their efficient deployment on resource-limited devices. Therefore, transformer quantization attracts wide research interest. Recent work recognizes that structured outliers are the critical bottleneck for quantization performance. However, their proposed methods increase the computation overhead and still leave the outliers there. To fundamentally address this problem, this paper delves into the inherent inducement and importance of the outliers. We discover that $\boldsymbol \gamma$ in LayerNorm (LN) acts as a sinful amplifier for the outliers, and the importance of outliers varies greatly where some outliers provided by a few tokens cover a large area but can be clipped sharply without negative impacts. Motivated by these findings, we propose an outlier suppression framework including two components: Gamma Migration and Token-Wise Clipping. The Gamma Migration migrates the outlier amplifier to subsequent modules in an equivalent transformation, contributing to a more quantization-friendly model without any extra burden. The Token-Wise Clipping takes advantage of the large variance of token range and designs a token-wise coarse-to-fine pipeline, obtaining a clipping range with minimal final quantization loss in an efficient way. This framework effectively suppresses the outliers and can be used in a plug-and-play mode. Extensive experiments prove that our framework surpasses the existing works and, for the first time, pushes the 6-bit post-training BERT quantization to the full-precision (FP) level. Our code is available at https://github.com/wimh966/outlier_suppr…
classic:8630ea8a90ed.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了 Transformer 低比特量化中的核心难点：结构化异常值会显著放大量化误差，限制模型在低资源设备上的部署。作者进一步分析发现，LayerNorm 中的 gamma 会起到“放大器”作用，而不同 token 的异常值重要性差异很大，并非都需要同等对待。基于这些观察，论文提出了由 Gamma Migration 和 Token-Wise Clipping 组成的异常值抑制框架，在不增加额外计算负担的前提下提升量化友好性。实验表明该方法优于已有工作，并首次将 6-bit 的 BERT 后训练量化推进到接近全精度水平。
classic:8630ea8a90ed.tldr: 提出一种无需额外开销的异常值抑制框架，显著提升 Transformer 低比特量化效果，首次把 6-bit BERT 后训练量化做到接近全精度。
classic:8630ea8a90ed.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接抓住了 Transformer 量化中的关键瓶颈——异常值，并给出了机制层面的解释。它不仅有方法设计，也有很强的工程实用性，适合作为低比特量化方向的经典参考。

classic:1d3b953023b6.abstract: Recent advances in self-supervised learning and the Transformer architecture have significantly improved natural language processing (NLP), achieving remarkably low perplexity. However, the growing size of NLP models introduces a memory wall problem during the generation phase. To mitigate this issue, recent efforts have focused on quantizing model weights to sub-4-bit precision while preserving full precision for activations, resulting in practical speed-ups during inference on a single GPU. However, these improvements primarily stem from reduced memory movement, which necessitates a resource-intensive dequantization process rather than actual computational reduction. In this paper, we introduce LUT-GEMM, an efficient kernel for quantized matrix multiplication, which not only eliminates the resource-intensive dequantization process but also reduces computational costs compared to previous kernels for weight-only quantization. Furthermore, we proposed group-wise quantization to offer a flexible trade-off between compression ratio and accuracy. The impact of LUT-GEMM is facilitated by implementing high compression ratios through low-bit quantization and efficient LUT-based operations. We show experimentally that when applied to the OPT-175B model with 3-bit quantization, LUT-GEMM substantially accelerates token generation latency, achieving a remarkable 2.1$\times$ improvement on a single GPU when compared to OPTQ, which relies on the costly dequantization process.
classic:1d3b953023b6.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大规模生成式语言模型在推理阶段的“内存墙”问题，关注权重低比特量化后如何真正提升计算效率。作者提出了 LUT-GEMM，一种基于查找表的量化矩阵乘法内核，能够避免传统方法中代价高昂的反量化步骤，并直接降低计算开销。论文还引入了分组量化，在压缩率和精度之间提供更灵活的权衡。实验表明，该方法在 OPT-175B 的 3-bit 量化设置下可显著加速单 GPU 上的生成延迟。
classic:1d3b953023b6.tldr: LUT-GEMM 用查找表实现高效量化矩阵乘法，避免反量化开销，在大模型推理中获得明显加速。
classic:1d3b953023b6.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不只是把模型“压小”，而是进一步解决了量化推理里真正的计算瓶颈。作为经典参考，它展示了如何把低比特量化从存储优化推进到实际可用的高效推理内核设计。

classic:2a3f3209c3b0.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show excellent performance but are compute- and memory-intensive. Quantization can reduce memory and accelerate inference. However, existing methods cannot maintain accuracy and hardware efficiency at the same time. We propose SmoothQuant, a training-free, accuracy-preserving, and general-purpose post-training quantization (PTQ) solution to enable 8-bit weight, 8-bit activation (W8A8) quantization for LLMs. Based on the fact that weights are easy to quantize while activations are not, SmoothQuant smooths the activation outliers by offline migrating the quantization difficulty from activations to weights with a mathematically equivalent transformation. SmoothQuant enables an INT8 quantization of both weights and activations for all the matrix multiplications in LLMs, including OPT, BLOOM, GLM, MT-NLG, Llama-1/2, Falcon, Mistral, and Mixtral models. We demonstrate up to 1.56x speedup and 2x memory reduction for LLMs with negligible loss in accuracy. SmoothQuant enables serving 530B LLM within a single node. Our work offers a turn-key solution that reduces hardware costs and democratizes LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/smoothquant.
classic:2a3f3209c3b0.summary_zh: 大语言模型虽然效果强，但推理时计算和显存开销都很高，量化是降低成本的重要手段，不过传统方法往往难以同时兼顾精度和硬件效率。SmoothQuant 提出一种无需训练的后训练量化方法，通过一个数学等价变换，把原本难以量化的激活值“平滑”到权重上，从而显著降低激活离群值带来的难度。它能够实现 LLM 的 W8A8 INT8 量化，适用于 OPT、BLOOM、Llama、Falcon、Mistral 等多种模型。实验表明，该方法几乎不损失精度，同时可带来最高 1.56 倍加速和 2 倍显存节省。
classic:2a3f3209c3b0.tldr: SmoothQuant 通过把激活量化难点转移到权重上，实现了几乎无损的 LLM 8-bit 权重/激活量化。
classic:2a3f3209c3b0.simple_intro: 这篇论文是 LLM 推理量化领域的经典工作，核心贡献是给出了一个简单、通用且工程上很实用的 PTQ 方案。它非常值得看，因为它直接面向真实部署场景，解决了“大模型太大、太慢、太贵”的关键问题。

classic:2dee1c87a001.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has been gaining popularity for the deployment of deep neural networks on resource-limited devices since unlike quantization-aware training, neither a full training dataset nor end-to-end training is required at all. As PTQ schemes based on reconstructing each layer or block output turn out to be effective to enhance quantized model performance, recent works have developed algorithms to devise and learn a new weight-rounding scheme so as to better reconstruct each layer or block output. In this work, we propose a simple yet effective new weight-rounding mechanism for PTQ, coined \emph{FlexRound}, based on element-wise division instead of typical element-wise addition such that FlexRound enables jointly learning a common quantization grid size as well as a different scale for each pre-trained weight. Thanks to the reciprocal rule of derivatives induced by element-wise division, FlexRound is inherently able to exploit pre-trained weights when updating their corresponding scales, and thus, flexibly quantize pre-trained weights depending on their magnitudes. We empirically validate the efficacy of FlexRound on a wide range of models and tasks. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to carry out comprehensive experiments on not only image classification and natural language understanding but also natural language generation. Moreover, we demonstrate, for the first time, that large language models can be efficiently quantized, with only a negligible impact on performance compared to half-precision baselines, achieved by reconstructing the output in a block-by-block manner. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/onliwad101/FlexRound_LRQ}.
classic:2dee1c87a001.summary_zh: 这是一篇发表于ICML 2023的Quantization方向经典论文，适合作为该主题的代表性参考。 论文主要围绕“FlexRound: Learnable Rounding based on Element-wise Division for Post-Training Quantization”展开。 原文摘要可帮助你快速定位方法与实验设定。
classic:2dee1c87a001.tldr: Quantization方向代表工作，发表于ICML 2023，适合快速建立该主题的经典论文地图。
classic:2dee1c87a001.simple_intro: 这是一篇发表于ICML 2023的Quantization方向经典论文，适合作为该主题的代表性参考。

classic:085a57efd5a2.abstract: Improving the deployment efficiency of transformer-based language models has been challenging given their high computation and memory cost. While INT8 quantization has recently been shown to be effective in reducing both the memory cost and latency while preserving model accuracy, it remains unclear whether we can leverage INT4 (which doubles peak hardware throughput) to achieve further latency improvement. In this study, we explore the feasibility of employing INT4 weight and activation (W4A4) quantization for language models. Our findings indicate that W4A4 quantization introduces no to negligible accuracy degradation for encoder-only and encoder-decoder models, but causes a significant accuracy drop for decoder-only models. To materialize the performance gain using W4A4, we develop a highly optimized end-to-end W4A4 encoder inference pipeline supporting different quantization strategies. Our INT4 pipeline is $8.5\times$ faster for latency-oriented scenarios and up to $3\times$ for throughput-oriented scenarios compared to the inference of FP16, and improves the SOTA BERT INT8 performance from FasterTransformer by up to $1.7\times$. We provide insights into the failure cases when applying W4A4 to decoder-only models, and further explore the compatibility of INT4 quantization with other compression methods, like pruning and layer reduction.
classic:085a57efd5a2.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了 Transformer 模型能否从 INT8 进一步走向 INT4 量化，以获得更低的延迟和更高的硬件吞吐。作者系统评估了 W4A4（权重和激活都用 4bit）在不同架构上的效果，发现它对 encoder-only 和 encoder-decoder 模型几乎不损失精度，但对 decoder-only 模型会带来明显退化。为真正释放 INT4 的性能潜力，论文还实现了一个高度优化的端到端 W4A4 编码器推理流程。实验表明，该方案在延迟场景下可比 FP16 快 8.5 倍，在吞吐场景下最高可达 3 倍，并优于现有 BERT INT8 推理实现。
classic:085a57efd5a2.tldr: 这篇论文证明了 INT4 量化能显著加速 Transformer 编码器推理，但对 decoder-only 模型存在明显失效风险。
classic:085a57efd5a2.simple_intro: 这篇文章值得看，因为它不仅回答了“INT4 能不能用”这个关键问题，还给出了实际可落地的高性能推理方案。作为经典参考，它特别适合用来理解低比特量化在不同 Transformer 架构上的适用边界与失败原因。

classic:75b587ab6db5.abstract: The case for 4-bit precision: k-bit Inference Scaling LawsTim Dettmers, Luke ZettlemoyerQuantization methods reduce the number of bits required to repre...
classic:75b587ab6db5.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大模型推理时使用低比特量化的效果，重点分析了不同位宽下推理性能与模型规模之间的关系。作者提出了 k-bit 推理缩放规律，说明在合适条件下，4-bit 精度可以在大幅降低显存和计算开销的同时，尽量保持模型效果。论文还讨论了量化误差、模型大小和任务表现之间的权衡，为低成本部署大模型提供了理论与实践依据。它的价值在于把“4-bit 推理是否可行”从经验问题推进到可分析、可预测的规律层面。
classic:75b587ab6db5.tldr: 提出 k-bit 推理缩放规律，论证了 4-bit 精度是大模型低成本推理的关键选择。
classic:75b587ab6db5.simple_intro: 这篇论文是量化推理领域的经典参考，因为它不仅展示了 4-bit 推理的实用性，还给出了理解其性能边界的方法。对于关注大模型部署、显存优化和高效推理的人来说，它很值得一看。

classic:0a587607a13a.abstract: Generative Pre-trained Transformer models, known as GPT or OPT, set themselves apart through breakthrough performance across complex language modelling tasks, but also by their extremely high computational and storage costs. Specifically, due to their massive size, even inference for large, highly-accurate GPT models may require multiple performant GPUs, which limits the usability of such models. While there is emerging work on relieving this pressure via model compression, the applicability and performance of existing compression techniques is limited by the scale and complexity of GPT models. In this paper, we address this challenge, and propose GPTQ, a new one-shot weight quantization method based on approximate second-order information, that is both highly-accurate and highly-efficient. Specifically, GPTQ can quantize GPT models with 175 billion parameters in approximately four GPU hours, reducing the bitwidth down to 3 or 4 bits per weight, with negligible accuracy degradation relative to the uncompressed baseline. Our method more than doubles the compression gains relative to previously-proposed one-shot quantization methods, preserving accuracy, allowing us for the first time to execute an 175 billion-parameter model inside a single GPU for generative inference. Moreover, we also show that our method can still provide reasonable accuracy in the extreme quantization regime, in which weights are quantized to 2-bit or even ternary quantization levels. We show experimentally that these improvements can be leveraged for end-to-end inference speedups over FP16, of around 3.25x when using high-end GPUs (NVIDIA A100) and 4.5x when using more cost-effective ones (NVIDIA A6000). The implementation is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/gptq.
classic:0a587607a13a.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对 GPT 类大模型推理成本高、存储占用大的问题，提出了一种后训练量化方法 GPTQ。它利用近似二阶信息进行一次性权重量化，能够把百亿到千亿参数模型压到 3 或 4 bit，同时几乎不损失精度。作者在 1750 亿参数模型上验证了方法的有效性，量化过程仅需少量 GPU 时间，就能让原本需要多卡运行的模型在单卡上完成生成推理。实验还表明，该方法在 2 bit 甚至三值量化下也能保持可用精度，并带来显著推理加速。
classic:0a587607a13a.tldr: GPTQ 用近似二阶信息实现高精度一次性后训练量化，让超大 GPT 模型以极低比特运行且几乎不掉点。
classic:0a587607a13a.simple_intro: 这篇论文很值得看，因为它把“超大模型如何低成本部署”这个现实问题，做成了一个效果强、实现快、可落地的经典方案。它也是大模型量化方向里最常被引用的代表工作之一，适合作为入门和进一步研究的基础参考。

classic:808250c834a6.abstract: While transformer-based pre-trained language models (PLMs) have dominated a number of NLP applications, these models are heavy to deploy and expensive to use. Therefore, effectively compressing large-scale PLMs becomes an increasingly important problem. Quantization, which represents high-precision tensors with low-bit fix-point format, is a viable solution. However, most existing quantization methods are task-specific, requiring customized training and quantization with a large number of trainable parameters on each individual task. Inspired by the observation that the over-parameterization nature of PLMs makes it possible to freeze most of the parameters during the fine-tuning stage, in this work, we propose a novel ``quantize before fine-tuning'' framework, PreQuant, that differs from both quantization-aware training and post-training quantization. PreQuant is compatible with various quantization strategies, with outlier-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning incorporated to correct the induced quantization error. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PreQuant on the GLUE benchmark using BERT, RoBERTa, and T5. We also provide an empirical investigation into the workflow of PreQuant, which sheds light on its efficacy.
classic:808250c834a6.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注预训练语言模型部署成本高、体积大，难以在实际场景中高效使用的问题。作者提出 PreQuant，一种“先量化、后微调”的通用框架，不同于常见的量化感知训练和训练后量化。该方法结合多种量化策略，并引入面向异常值的参数高效微调来补偿量化误差。实验在 BERT、RoBERTa 和 T5 上的 GLUE 任务中验证了其有效性，也展示了其作为任务无关压缩方案的价值。
classic:808250c834a6.tldr: PreQuant 提出先量化再微调的通用框架，用更少任务定制成本实现预训练语言模型的高效压缩。
classic:808250c834a6.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“量化”和“微调”的顺序重新设计了，提供了一种更通用、更省参数的压缩思路。对于想了解大模型如何在不牺牲太多性能的前提下更易部署的人来说，它是很好的经典参考。

classic:5c0f4c062738.abstract: Chong Yu, Tao Chen, Zhongxue Gan. Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2023. 2023.
classic:5c0f4c062738.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注如何在不明显牺牲效果的前提下，让基于 Transformer 的语言模型更适合 GPU 部署。作者结合了稀疏化与量化两类压缩手段，并特别考虑了 GPU 友好的计算模式，以提升推理效率。论文的重点不只是压缩模型大小，还强调在真实硬件上获得更好的吞吐和延迟表现。它为大模型在资源受限或高并发场景中的落地提供了实用思路。
classic:5c0f4c062738.tldr: 把稀疏化和量化做成更适合 GPU 的形式，让 Transformer 语言模型更快、更省资源。
classic:5c0f4c062738.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不只讨论“怎么压缩模型”，还关注“压缩后能不能在 GPU 上真正跑得快”。作为 ACL 2023 的工作，它适合用来了解大模型高效部署中的经典优化思路。

classic:0ad973fd70b1.abstract: We present QLoRA, an efficient finetuning approach that reduces memory usage enough to finetune a 65B parameter model on a single 48GB GPU while preserving full 16-bit finetuning task performance. QLoRA backpropagates gradients through a frozen, 4-bit quantized pretrained language model into Low Rank Adapters~(LoRA). Our best model family, which we name Guanaco, outperforms all previous openly released models on the Vicuna benchmark, reaching 99.3% of the performance level of ChatGPT while only requiring 24 hours of finetuning on a single GPU. QLoRA introduces a number of innovations to save memory without sacrificing performance: (a) 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4), a new data type that is information theoretically optimal for normally distributed weights (b) double quantization to reduce the average memory footprint by quantizing the quantization constants, and (c) paged optimziers to manage memory spikes. We use QLoRA to finetune more than 1,000 models, providing a detailed analysis of instruction following and chatbot performance across 8 instruction datasets, multiple model types (LLaMA, T5), and model scales that would be infeasible to run with regular finetuning (e.g. 33B and 65B parameter models). Our results show that QLoRA finetuning on a small high-quality dataset leads to state-of-the-art results, even when using smaller models than the previous SoTA. We provide a detailed analysis of chatbot performance based on both human and GPT-4 evaluations showing that GPT-4 evaluations are a cheap and reasonable alternative to human evaluation. Furthermore, we find that current chatbot benchmarks are not trustworthy to accurately evaluate the performance levels of chatbots. A lemon-picked analysis demonstrates where Guanaco fails compared to ChatGPT. We release all of our mo…
classic:0ad973fd70b1.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出了 QLoRA，一种面向大语言模型的高效量化微调方法，目标是在尽量不损失性能的前提下大幅降低显存占用。它将冻结的 4 位量化预训练模型与 LoRA 适配器结合，并引入 NF4、双重量化和分页优化器等技术，使得在单张 48GB GPU 上微调 65B 参数模型成为可能。作者还系统微调了上千个模型，验证了该方法在指令微调和聊天模型任务上的有效性。论文的重要价值在于，它把“能训练超大模型”从昂贵的工程问题变成了更可实践的方案。
classic:0ad973fd70b1.tldr: QLoRA 通过 4 位量化 + LoRA，把大模型微调的显存门槛大幅降低，同时保持接近全精度微调的效果。
classic:0ad973fd70b1.simple_intro: 这篇论文之所以值得看，是因为它几乎定义了“低成本微调大模型”的标准做法，后续很多训练实践都会参考它。它不仅给出方法，还系统分析了量化、数据集和评估方式，适合作为量化微调领域的经典入门与参考。

classic:c2b14f5ac8cb.abstract: We propose the Quantization Model of neural scaling laws, explaining both the observed power law dropoff of loss with model and data size, and also the sudden emergence of new capabilities with scale. We derive this model from what we call the Quantization Hypothesis, where network knowledge and skills are "quantized" into discrete chunks ($\textbf{quanta}$). We show that when quanta are learned in order of decreasing use frequency, then a power law in use frequencies explains observed power law scaling of loss. We validate this prediction on toy datasets, then study how scaling curves decompose for large language models. Using language model gradients, we automatically decompose model behavior into a diverse set of skills (quanta). We tentatively find that the frequency at which these quanta are used in the training distribution roughly follows a power law corresponding with the empirical scaling exponent for language models, a prediction of our theory.
classic:c2b14f5ac8cb.summary_zh: 这篇论文试图解释神经网络规模扩展中两个常见现象：损失随模型和数据规模增大而呈幂律下降，以及能力在某些规模点上突然涌现。作者提出“量化模型”和“量化假说”，认为网络中的知识与技能可以分解为离散的“量子”单元，并按使用频率从高到低被学习。基于这一设定，论文推导出频率幂律可以对应观察到的缩放幂律，并在玩具数据集和大语言模型上进行验证。论文还利用语言模型梯度自动拆分出多种技能成分，为理解大模型 scaling law 提供了一个新的机制解释。
classic:c2b14f5ac8cb.tldr: 提出用“离散技能量子”来解释神经网络的幂律缩放和能力涌现现象。
classic:c2b14f5ac8cb.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不仅描述了 scaling law 的经验规律，还尝试给出一个统一的机制解释。对于想理解大模型为什么会随着规模增长表现出幂律下降和突然涌现的人来说，这是一个很有参考价值的经典思路。

classic:8c70f6711e55.abstract: Communication-reduction techniques are a popular way to improve scalability in data-parallel training of deep neural networks (DNNs). The recent emergence of large language models such as GPT has created the need for new approaches to exploit data-parallelism. Among these, fully-sharded data parallel (FSDP) training is highly popular, yet it still encounters scalability bottlenecks. One reason is that applying compression techniques to FSDP is challenging: as the vast majority of the communication involves the model's weights, direct compression alters convergence and leads to accuracy loss. We present QSDP, a variant of FSDP which supports both gradient and weight quantization with theoretical guarantees, is simple to implement and has essentially no overheads. To derive QSDP we prove that a natural modification of SGD achieves convergence even when we only maintain quantized weights, and thus the domain over which we train consists of quantized points and is, therefore, highly non-convex. We validate this approach by training GPT-family models with up to 1.3 billion parameters on a multi-node cluster. Experiments show that QSDP preserves model accuracy, while completely removing the communication bottlenecks of FSDP, providing end-to-end speedups of up to 2.2x.
classic:8c70f6711e55.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大模型数据并行训练中的通信瓶颈，尤其是 FSDP 在训练 GPT 类模型时仍然面临的扩展性问题。作者提出了 QSDP，一种支持梯度与权重量化的 FSDP 变体，并给出了收敛性理论保证。论文的关键贡献在于证明了即使只维护量化后的权重，也可以通过对 SGD 的自然修改实现稳定收敛。实验在多机集群上训练最多 13 亿参数的 GPT 家族模型，结果表明它在几乎不损失精度的情况下显著减少通信开销并获得最高 2.2x 的端到端加速。
classic:8c70f6711e55.tldr: QSDP 让 FSDP 也能安全地做权重和梯度量化，在保持精度的同时大幅降低通信成本并加速大模型训练。
classic:8c70f6711e55.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“压缩通信”和“训练收敛保证”这两件通常难以兼顾的事情结合起来了。它是理解大模型分布式训练如何进一步降通信、提吞吐的一个很有代表性的经典参考。

classic:dffa6516f5a2.abstract: Large-scale language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance, but their deployment presents challenges due to their significant memory usage. This issue can be alleviated through quantization. In this paper, we identify that the challenge in quantizing activations in LLMs arises from varying ranges across channels, rather than solely the presence of outliers. To address this challenge, we introduce a quantization method called RPTQ, which utilizes a reorder-based approach. By rearranging the channels and quantizing them in clusters, RPTQ effectively mitigates the impact of range differences between channels. To minimize the overhead of the reorder operation, we fuse it into the layer norm operation and weights in linear layers. In our experiments, RPTQ achieved a significant breakthrough by utilizing 3-bit activation in LLMs for the first time, resulting in a substantial reduction in memory usage. For instance, quantizing OPT-175b can lead to a memory consumption reduction of up to 80%.
classic:dffa6516f5a2.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型部署时的内存压力，核心问题是激活量化在不同通道之间存在范围差异，导致直接量化效果不佳。作者提出了 RPTQ，一种基于重排的后训练量化方法，通过将通道重新排列并按簇量化，来减轻通道间范围差异带来的影响。为了降低重排带来的额外开销，方法还将重排操作融合进层归一化和线性层权重中。实验表明，RPTQ 首次实现了 LLM 的 3-bit 激活量化，并且能显著降低显存占用，例如对 OPT-175B 的内存需求最高可减少 80%。
classic:dffa6516f5a2.tldr: RPTQ 通过通道重排和簇量化缓解激活量化难题，首次让大语言模型实现 3-bit 激活并大幅降内存。
classic:dffa6516f5a2.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对大模型落地最关键的瓶颈之一——显存占用，给出了一个简单但有效的后训练量化方案。作为经典参考，它很好地说明了“通道范围差异”比“离群值”更关键这一量化视角。

classic:c69adcdc80ba.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising technique for mitigating memory consumption and computational costs in large language models (LLMs). However, a systematic examination of various quantization schemes, model families, and quantization bit precision has been absent from the literature. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of these factors by investigating the effects of PTQ on weight-only, activation-only, and weight-and-activation quantization using diverse methods such as round-to-nearest (RTN), GPTQ, ZeroQuant, and their variants. We apply these methods to two distinct model families with parameters ranging from 125M to 176B.
