However, prevalent quantization schemes (e.g., 8-bit weight-activation quantization) cannot fully leverage the capabilities of modern GPUs, such as 4-bit integer operators, resulting in sub-optimal performance. To maximize LLMs' serving throughput, we introduce Atom, a low-bit quantization method that achieves high throughput improvements with negligible accuracy loss. Atom significantly boosts serving throughput by using low-bit operators and considerably reduces memory consumption via low-bit quantization. It attains high accuracy by applying a novel mixed-precision and fine-grained quantization process. We evaluate Atom on 4-bit weight-activation quantization in the serving context. Atom improves end-to-end throughput (token/s) by up to $7.7\times$ compared to the FP16 and by $2.5\times$ compared to INT8 quantization, while maintaining the same latency target.
classic:7317580b64ec.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在线服务中的吞吐量和显存开销问题，尤其是在多请求批处理场景下如何更高效地利用 GPU。作者指出，常见的 8-bit 量化方案无法充分发挥现代 GPU 的 4-bit 整数算子能力，因此提出了 Atom 低比特量化方法。Atom 通过混合精度和细粒度量化设计，在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著降低内存占用并提升推理吞吐。实验表明，它在服务场景中可带来最高 7.7 倍于 FP16 的端到端吞吐提升。
classic:7317580b64ec.tldr: Atom 用 4-bit 低比特量化和混合精度设计，在几乎不掉精度的情况下大幅提升 LLM 在线服务吞吐量。
classic:7317580b64ec.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接面向 LLM 部署最现实的瓶颈：算力、显存和服务吞吐。作为经典参考，它展示了如何把量化方法真正落到高性能推理系统中。

classic:8c4f9bfa30c0.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer a general solution to the high inference costs of large language models (LLMs) via sparse routing, bringing faster and more accurate models, at the cost of massive parameter counts. For example, the SwitchTransformer-c2048 model has 1.6 trillion parameters, requiring 3.2TB of accelerator memory to run efficiently, which makes practical deployment challenging and expensive. In this paper, we present a solution to this memory problem, in form of a new compression and execution framework called QMoE. Specifically, QMoE consists of a scalable algorithm which accurately compresses trillion-parameter MoEs to less than 1 bit per parameter, in a custom format co-designed with bespoke GPU decoding kernels to facilitate efficient end-to-end compressed inference, with minor runtime overheads relative to uncompressed execution. Concretely, QMoE can compress the 1.6 trillion parameter SwitchTransformer-c2048 model to less than 160GB (20x compression, 0.8 bits per parameter) at only minor accuracy loss, in less than a day on a single GPU. This enables, for the first time, the execution of a trillion-parameter model on affordable commodity hardware, like a single server with 4x NVIDIA A6000 or 8x NVIDIA 3090 GPUs, at less than 5% runtime overhead relative to ideal uncompressed inference. The source code and compressed models are available at github.com/IST-DASLab/qmoe.
classic:8c4f9bfa30c0.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对 MoE 大模型参数量极大、推理部署内存开销高的问题，提出了 QMoE 压缩与执行框架。作者设计了一种可扩展的压缩算法，并配合定制的 GPU 解码内核，将万亿参数 MoE 模型压缩到低于每参数 1 bit。以 1.6 万亿参数的 SwitchTransformer-c2048 为例，模型可压缩到 160GB 以下，且只带来较小精度损失和很低的运行时开销。它的价值在于首次让万亿参数模型有机会在相对普通的服务器硬件上实际运行。
classic:8c4f9bfa30c0.tldr: QMoE 把万亿参数 MoE 模型压到不足 1 bit/参数，让大模型能在普通服务器上更可行地部署。
classic:8c4f9bfa30c0.simple_intro: 这篇论文很值得看，因为它直接解决了超大 MoE 模型“能训练但难部署”的核心瓶颈。作为经典参考，它展示了压缩算法和 GPU 执行系统协同设计，如何把看似不可落地的模型变成可实际运行的方案。

classic:7e11c98ec973.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have seen great advance in both academia and industry, and their popularity results in numerous open-source frameworks and techniques in accelerating LLM pre-training, fine-tuning, and inference. Training and deploying LLMs are expensive as it requires considerable computing resources and memory, hence many efficient approaches have been developed for improving system pipelines as well as operators. However, the runtime performance can vary significantly across hardware and software stacks, which makes it difficult to choose the best configuration. In this work, we aim to benchmark the performance from both macro and micro perspectives. First, we benchmark the end-to-end performance of pre-training, fine-tuning, and serving LLMs in different sizes , i.e., 7, 13, and 70 billion parameters (7B, 13B, and 70B) on three 8-GPU platforms with and without individual optimization techniques, including ZeRO, quantization, recomputation, FlashAttention. Then, we dive deeper to provide a detailed runtime analysis of the sub-modules, including computing and communication operators in LLMs. For end users, our benchmark and findings help better understand different optimization techniques, training and inference frameworks, together with hardware platforms in choosing configurations for deploying LLMs. For researchers, our in-depth module-wise analyses discover potential opportunities for future work to further optimize the runtime performance of LLMs.
classic:7e11c98ec973.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在预训练、微调和推理阶段的运行时性能问题，指出不同硬件与软件栈下的表现差异很大，导致配置选择并不容易。作者在 7B、13B 和 70B 模型上，系统比较了三种 8-GPU 平台上的端到端性能，并评估了 ZeRO、量化、重计算、FlashAttention 等优化技术的影响。除了宏观基准测试，论文还进一步分析了计算与通信等子模块的耗时，找出性能瓶颈所在。它的价值在于为实际部署提供了配置参考，也为后续系统优化研究提供了细粒度的分析依据。
classic:7e11c98ec973.tldr: 系统评测大模型训练、微调和推理的运行时性能，帮助选择最合适的硬件与优化配置。
classic:7e11c98ec973.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为经典参考，因为它不是只看单一技巧，而是把大模型在不同阶段、不同平台、不同优化组合下的真实运行表现系统拆开分析。对于想做 LLM 系统优化、量化或部署的人来说，它能帮助快速理解性能瓶颈和常见加速手段的实际效果。

classic:733bc4ff02ab.abstract: Quantization and pruning form the foundation of compression for neural networks, enabling efficient inference for large language models (LLMs). Recently, various quantization and pruning techniques have demonstrated remarkable performance in a post-training setting. They rely upon calibration data, a small set of unlabeled examples that are used to generate layer activations. However, no prior work has systematically investigated how the calibration data impacts the effectiveness of model compression methods. In this paper, we present the first extensive empirical study on the effect of calibration data upon LLM performance. We trial a variety of quantization and pruning methods, datasets, tasks, and models. Surprisingly, we find substantial variations in downstream task performance, contrasting existing work that suggests a greater level of robustness to the calibration data. Finally, we make a series of recommendations for the effective use of calibration data in LLM quantization and pruning.
classic:733bc4ff02ab.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在后训练量化和剪枝中，校准数据如何影响压缩效果。作者系统比较了多种量化与剪枝方法、数据集、任务和模型，发现不同校准数据会显著改变下游性能。结果表明，现有方法并没有想象中那么稳健，校准数据的选择对压缩结果非常关键。论文最后给出了关于如何更有效使用校准数据的实践建议。
classic:733bc4ff02ab.tldr: 系统研究发现：LLM 后训练量化和剪枝的效果对校准数据非常敏感。
classic:733bc4ff02ab.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为经典参考，因为它补上了一个常被忽略但很关键的问题：校准数据到底会如何影响模型压缩。对于做量化、剪枝和部署优化的人来说，它能帮助理解方法为什么有效、又为什么会失效。

classic:d69c11da8754.abstract: The large language model era urges faster and less costly inference. Prior model compression works on LLMs tend to undertake a software-centric approach primarily focused on the simulated quantization performance. By neglecting the feasibility of deployment, these approaches are typically disabled in real practice. They used to drastically push down the quantization bit range for a reduced computation which might not be supported by the mainstream hardware, or involve sophisticated algorithms that introduce extra computation or memory access overhead. We argue that pursuing a hardware-centric approach in the construction of quantization algorithms is crucial. In this regard, we are driven to build our compression method on top of hardware awareness, eliminating impractical algorithm choices while maximizing the benefit of hardware acceleration. Our method, OdysseyLLM, comes with a novel W4A8 kernel implementation called FastGEMM and a combined recipe of quantization strategies. Extensive experiments manifest the superiority of our W4A8 method which brings the actual speed boosting up to \textbf{4$\times$} compared to Hugging Face FP16 inference and \textbf{2.23$\times$} vs. the state-of-the-art inference engine TensorRT-LLM in FP16, and \textbf{1.45$\times$} vs. TensorRT-LLM in INT8, yet without substantially harming the performance.
classic:d69c11da8754.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化后“能不能真正部署、能不能真的加速”的问题，而不是只看模拟精度。作者指出，许多既有量化方法过于偏软件视角，要么压到硬件不支持的比特宽度，要么引入额外计算和内存开销，导致实际场景中难以落地。为此，论文提出以硬件感知为核心的量化方案 OdysseyLLM，并配套实现了 W4A8 的 FastGEMM kernel 和一组量化策略。实验表明，该方法在几乎不明显损失效果的前提下，能够带来显著的真实推理加速。
classic:d69c11da8754.tldr: OdysseyLLM 以硬件为导向设计可部署量化方案，在不显著掉点的情况下实现了 LLM 的真实加速。
classic:d69c11da8754.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“量化是否能真正跑快”放在了第一位，补足了很多只追求离线指标的工作。对于关心 LLM 工程落地、推理部署和硬件加速的人来说，它是很有代表性的经典参考。

classic:26638a3ebece.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive abilities in various domains while the inference cost is expensive. Many previous studies exploit quantization methods to reduce LLM inference cost by reducing latency and memory consumption. Applying 2-bit single-precision weight quantization brings >3% accuracy loss, so the state-of-the-art methods use mixed-precision methods for LLMs (e.g. Llama2-7b, etc.) to improve the accuracy. However, challenges still exist: (1) Uneven distribution in weight matrix. (2) Large speed degradation by adding sparse outliers. (3) Time-consuming dequantization operations on GPUs. To tackle these challenges and enable fast and efficient LLM inference on GPUs, we propose the following techniques in this paper. (1) Intra-weight mixed-precision quantization. (2) Exclusive 2-bit sparse outlier with minimum speed degradation. (3) Asynchronous dequantization. We conduct extensive experiments on different model families (e.g. Llama3, etc.) and model sizes. We achieve 2.91-bit for each weight considering all scales/zeros for different models with negligible loss. As a result, with our 2/4/16 mixed-precision quantization for each weight matrix and asynchronous dequantization during inference, our design achieves an end-to-end speedup for Llama2-7b is 1.74x over the original model, and we reduce both runtime cost and total cost by up to 2.53x and 2.29x with less GPU requirements.
classic:26638a3ebece.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在GPU上的低比特量化推理加速问题，目标是在尽量不损失精度的前提下降低显存占用和推理延迟。作者指出，直接做2-bit量化会带来明显精度下降，而混合精度、稀疏异常值以及反量化开销又会影响实际速度。为此，论文提出了层内混合精度量化、专门处理2-bit稀疏异常值以及异步反量化等方法，以更好适应GPU执行。实验表明，该方案在多种模型上能实现接近无损的压缩效果，并显著提升端到端推理速度。
classic:26638a3ebece.tldr: 通过混合精度、稀疏异常值处理和异步反量化，论文把2-bit LLM量化真正做到了又快又省。
classic:26638a3ebece.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不仅讨论“怎么把模型压到更低比特”，还直接解决了GPU上真正跑得快的问题。对于研究大模型推理优化、量化部署和低成本服务的人来说，这是一个很实用的经典参考。

classic:f403e53bc06b.abstract: Transformer models have been widely adopted in various domains over the last years, and especially large language models have advanced the field of AI significantly. Due to their size, the capability of these networks has increased tremendously, but this has come at the cost of a significant increase in necessary compute. Quantization is one of the most effective ways to reduce the computational time and memory consumption of neural networks. Many studies have shown, however, that modern transformer models tend to learn strong outliers in their activations, making them difficult to quantize. To retain acceptable performance, the existence of these outliers requires activations to be in higher bitwidth or the use of different numeric formats, extra fine-tuning, or other workarounds. We show that strong outliers are related to very specific behavior of attention heads that try to learn a "no-op" or just a partial update of the residual. To achieve the exact zeros needed in the attention matrix for a no-update, the input to the softmax is pushed to be larger and larger during training, causing outliers in other parts of the network. Based on these observations, we propose two simple (independent) modifications to the attention mechanism - clipped softmax and gated attention. We empirically show that models pre-trained using our methods learn significantly smaller outliers while maintaining and sometimes even improving the floating-point task performance. This enables us to quantize transformers to full INT8 quantization of the activations without any additional effort. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods on both language models (BERT, OPT) and vision transformers.
classic:f403e53bc06b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注 Transformer 在量化时常见的“异常值”问题：模型激活中少量极大值会显著增加低比特量化的难度。作者发现，这些异常值与注意力头试图学习“什么都不做”或只做部分残差更新的行为有关，为了逼近精确的零更新，softmax 输入会在训练中不断变大。基于这一机制，论文提出了 clipped softmax 和 gated attention 两种简单且相互独立的改动，帮助注意力头更容易实现近似无更新。实验表明，这些方法能显著减小异常值，同时保持甚至提升浮点性能，并使 Transformer 的激活可以直接进行 INT8 量化。
classic:f403e53bc06b.tldr: 通过让注意力头更容易“什么都不做”，这篇论文消除了 Transformer 的异常值障碍，从而实现更友好的 INT8 量化。
classic:f403e53bc06b.simple_intro: 这篇工作值得看，因为它不仅解决了一个非常实际的量化难题，还给出了清晰的机制解释：异常值不是随机出现的，而是注意力头行为的副作用。它也是经典参考，因为方法简单、适用面广，并且在语言模型和视觉 Transformer 上都验证了效果。

classic:fa1293807689.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance and tremendous potential across a wide range of tasks. However, deploying these models has been challenging due to the astronomical amount of model parameters, which requires a demand for large memory capacity and high memory bandwidth. In this paper, we propose an effective approach that can make the deployment of LLMs more efficiently. We support an automatic INT4 weight-only quantization flow and design a special LLM runtime with highly-optimized kernels to accelerate the LLM inference on CPUs. We demonstrate the general applicability of our approach on popular LLMs including Llama2, Llama, GPT-NeoX, and showcase the extreme inference efficiency on CPUs. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/intel/intel-extension-for-transformers.
classic:fa1293807689.summary_zh: 大语言模型虽然效果出色，但参数规模巨大，导致在CPU等通用设备上部署时面临显存/内存占用高和带宽压力大的问题。本文提出了一套面向CPU的高效推理方案，核心是自动化的 INT4 仅权重量化流程。与此同时，作者设计了专门的LLM运行时和高度优化的算子内核，以进一步提升推理速度。实验表明，该方法可广泛适用于 Llama2、Llama、GPT-NeoX 等主流模型，并能显著提高CPU上的推理效率。
classic:fa1293807689.tldr: 本文提出自动 INT4 仅权重量化与优化运行时，让大语言模型能在 CPU 上更高效地推理。
classic:fa1293807689.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它聚焦于一个非常实际的问题：如何把大模型从“能跑”变成“跑得快、跑得省”。作为经典参考，它展示了量化与系统优化如何结合，提升 LLM 在普通 CPU 上的部署可行性。

classic:f53a74cc7d38.abstract: Quantization is a promising approach for reducing memory overhead and accelerating inference, especially in large pre-trained language model (PLM) scenarios. While having no access to original training data due to security and privacy concerns has emerged the demand for zero-shot quantization. Most of the cutting-edge zero-shot quantization methods primarily 1) apply to computer vision tasks, and 2) neglect of overfitting problem in the generative adversarial learning process, leading to sub-optimal performance. Motivated by this, we propose a novel zero-shot sharpness-aware quantization (ZSAQ) framework for the zero-shot quantization of various PLMs. The key algorithm in solving ZSAQ is the SAM-SGA optimization, which aims to improve the quantization accuracy and model generalization via optimizing a minimax problem. We theoretically prove the convergence rate for the minimax optimization problem and this result can be applied to other nonconvex-PL minimax optimization frameworks. Extensive experiments on 11 tasks demonstrate that our method brings consistent and significant performance gains on both discriminative and generative PLMs, i.e., up to +6.98 average score. Furthermore, we empirically validate that our method can effectively improve the model generalization.
classic:f53a74cc7d38.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对预训练语言模型在零样本量化场景下的性能退化问题，关注在没有原始训练数据时如何仍然实现高质量压缩。作者提出了零样本锐度感知量化框架 ZSAQ，并通过 SAM-SGA 优化来同时提升量化精度与模型泛化能力。论文还从理论上给出了该极小极大优化问题的收敛分析，补充了方法的可解释性与可靠性。实验覆盖 11 个任务，结果显示该方法在判别式和生成式 PLM 上都能稳定带来显著收益。
classic:f53a74cc7d38.tldr: ZSAQ 通过锐度感知的零样本量化方法，在没有原始数据的情况下也能明显提升预训练语言模型的量化效果。
classic:f53a74cc7d38.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了大模型压缩里很现实的“没数据可用”问题，而且还兼顾了理论和实验。作为零样本量化方向的经典参考，它对后来研究 PLM 压缩与泛化都很有启发。

classic:46d0a18974e9.abstract: The inference of Large language models (LLMs) requires immense computation and memory resources. To curtail these costs, quantisation has merged as a promising solution, but existing LLM quantisation mainly focuses on 8-bit. In this work, we explore the statistical and learning properties of the LLM layer and attribute the bottleneck of LLM quantisation to numerical scaling offsets. To address this, we adapt block quantisations for LLMs, a family of methods that share scaling factors across packed numbers. Block quantisations efficiently reduce the numerical scaling offsets solely from an arithmetic perspective, without additional treatments in the computational path. Our nearly-lossless quantised 6-bit LLMs achieve a $19\times$ higher arithmetic density and $5\times$ memory density than the float32 baseline, surpassing the prior art 8-bit quantisation by $2.5\times$ in arithmetic density and $1.2\times$ in memory density, without requiring any data calibration or re-training. We also share our insights into sub-8-bit LLM quantisation, including the mismatch between activation and weight distributions, optimal fine-tuning strategies, and a lower quantisation granularity inherent in the statistical properties of LLMs. The latter two tricks enable nearly-lossless 4-bit LLMs on downstream tasks. Our code is open-sourced.
classic:46d0a18974e9.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型推理中的低比特量化问题，指出现有方法在 8-bit 以下精度下降的关键瓶颈主要来自数值缩放偏移。作者将块量化（block quantisation）引入 LLM，通过在一组数之间共享缩放因子，从算术层面有效减小这种偏移。该方法无需数据校准或重新训练，就能实现几乎无损的 6-bit 量化，并在算术密度和内存密度上显著优于传统 8-bit 方法。论文还进一步讨论了激活与权重分布不匹配、微调策略和更低量化粒度等问题，为 4-bit LLM 推理提供了重要经验。
classic:46d0a18974e9.tldr: 通过块量化减少数值缩放偏移，作者实现了无需校准的几乎无损 6-bit/4-bit LLM 推理。
classic:46d0a18974e9.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为低比特 LLM 量化的经典参考，因为它不仅给出了一种实用的量化方法，还解释了为什么 8-bit 以下会变难。对于想理解“真正影响 sub-8-bit 推理效果的是什么”的读者，它提供了很有价值的分析框架和工程结论。

classic:1caac3e1d65d.abstract: Post-training quantization~(PTQ) of transformer language models faces significant challenges due to the existence of detrimental outliers in activations. We observe that these outliers are concentrated in specific channels and are asymmetric across channels. To address this issue, we propose the Outlier Suppression+~(OS+) framework, which contains the channel-wise shifting for asymmetry and channel-wise scaling for concentration. We show that these operations can be seamlessly migrated into subsequent modules while maintaining equivalence. Second, we propose a fast and stable scheme to calculate effective shifting and scaling values. The channel-wise shifting aligns the center of each channel for removal of outlier asymmetry. The channel-wise scaling quantitatively evaluates changes brought by migration and quantization for better quantization burden balance. We validate our OS+ under both standard and fine-grained quantization settings with models including BERT, OPT, BLOOM, BLOOMZ, and LLaMA. Comprehensive results across various tasks demonstrate the superiority of our approach. Especially, with standard quantization, OS+ can achieve near-floating-point performance on both small models and large language models on 8-bit and 6-bit. Besides, we establish a new state-of-the-art for 4-bit BERT with 15.5\% improvement. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/ModelTC/Outlier_Suppression_Plus}.
classic:1caac3e1d65d.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型后训练量化中的一个核心难题：激活值里存在少量但破坏性很强的异常值，会显著拉低低比特量化精度。作者观察到这些异常值往往集中在特定通道，并且在通道之间还存在不对称性，因此提出 Outlier Suppression+（OS+）框架，通过按通道的平移来消除不对称、按通道的缩放来缓解集中问题。更重要的是，这些操作可以等价地迁移到后续模块中，从而在不改变模型功能的前提下改善量化效果。实验表明，OS+ 在 BERT、OPT、BLOOM、BLOOMZ 和 LLaMA 等模型上都能稳定提升量化精度，尤其在 8-bit、6-bit 以及 4-bit 场景下表现突出。
classic:1caac3e1d65d.tldr: OS+ 通过通道级平移与缩放抑制异常值，让大语言模型在低比特量化下仍能保持接近浮点的精度。
classic:1caac3e1d65d.simple_intro: 这篇论文很值得看，因为它抓住了 LLM 量化里最常见也最棘手的“异常值”问题，并给出了简单、可迁移、效果稳定的解决思路。作为经典参考，它对理解“为什么量化会掉点”以及“如何在不改模型结构的情况下修正量化误差”很有帮助。

classic:055195c1cf85.abstract: Abuse of large language models reveals high risks as large language models are being deployed at an astonishing speed. It is important to protect the model weights to avoid malicious usage that violates licenses of open-source large language models. This paper proposes a novel watermarking strategy that plants watermarks in the quantization process of large language models without pre-defined triggers during inference. The watermark works when the model is used in the fp32 mode and remains hidden when the model is quantized to int8, in this way, the users can only inference the model without further supervised fine-tuning of the model. We successfully plant the watermark into open-source large language model weights including GPT-Neo and LLaMA. We hope our proposed method can provide a potential direction for protecting model weights in the era of large language model applications.
classic:055195c1cf85.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型被滥用、以及开源模型权重在部署后如何防止被恶意使用的问题。作者提出了一种基于权重量化过程的水印方法，把水印“植入”模型参数中，而不是依赖推理时的预设触发器。该水印在 fp32 模式下可检测，在量化到 int8 后会保持隐蔽，从而限制用户对模型进行进一步的监督微调。实验表明，该方法可成功应用于 GPT-Neo 和 LLaMA 等开源大模型，具有较强的实际保护价值。
classic:055195c1cf85.tldr: 在量化过程中给大语言模型权重植入隐蔽水印，用于保护开源模型权重并抑制滥用。
classic:055195c1cf85.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“模型保护”问题和量化技术结合起来，给出了一个不依赖推理触发器的水印思路。作为经典参考，它展示了如何在大模型分发与使用场景中兼顾可用性和版权/安全保护。

classic:33e527813b77.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are proficient in natural language processing tasks, but their deployment is often restricted by extensive parameter sizes and computational demands. This paper focuses on post-training quantization (PTQ) in LLMs, specifically 4-bit weight and 8-bit activation (W4A8) quantization, to enhance computational efficiency -- a topic less explored compared to weight-only quantization. We present two innovative techniques: activation-quantization-aware scaling (AQAS) and sequence-length-aware calibration (SLAC) to enhance PTQ by considering the combined effects on weights and activations and aligning calibration sequence lengths to target tasks. Moreover, we introduce dINT, a hybrid data format combining integer and denormal representations, to address the underflow issue in W4A8 quantization, where small values are rounded to zero. Through rigorous evaluations of LLMs, including OPT and LLaMA, we demonstrate that our techniques significantly boost task accuracies to levels comparable with full-precision models. By developing arithmetic units compatible with dINT, we further confirm that our methods yield a 2$\times$ hardware efficiency improvement compared to 8-bit integer MAC unit.
classic:33e527813b77.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦大语言模型部署时的高计算与存储开销问题，研究后训练量化中的 4 位权重和 8 位激活（W4A8）方案。作者提出了激活量化感知缩放（AQAS）和序列长度感知校准（SLAC），以同时兼顾权重与激活的量化误差，并让校准过程更贴近目标任务。论文还提出 dINT 混合数据格式来缓解小数值下溢为 0 的问题，从而提高 W4A8 的稳定性。实验表明，这些方法能在显著降低计算成本的同时，把模型精度提升到接近全精度水平，并带来约 2 倍的硬件效率提升。
classic:33e527813b77.tldr: 提出面向大语言模型的 W4A8 后训练量化方法，通过 AQAS、SLAC 和 dINT 在保持精度的同时显著提升推理效率。
classic:33e527813b77.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接面向大模型落地时最实际的效率问题，给出了可操作的量化方案和硬件友好的设计。作为经典参考，它能帮助理解权重与激活联合量化在 LLM 部署中的关键挑战。

classic:a7181cc46f80.abstract: We propose LLM-FP4 for quantizing both weights and activations in large language models (LLMs) down to 4-bit floating-point values, in a post-training manner. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) solutions are primarily integer-based and struggle with bit widths below 8 bits. Compared to integer quantization, floating-point (FP) quantization is more flexible and can better handle long-tail or bell-shaped distributions, and it has emerged as a default choice in many hardware platforms. One characteristic of FP quantization is that its performance largely depends on the choice of exponent bits and clipping range. In this regard, we construct a strong FP-PTQ baseline by searching for the optimal quantization parameters. Furthermore, we observe a high inter-channel variance and low intra-channel variance pattern in activation distributions, which adds activation quantization difficulty. We recognize this pattern to be consistent across a spectrum of transformer models designed for diverse tasks, such as LLMs, BERT, and Vision Transformer models. To tackle this, we propose per-channel activation quantization and show that these additional scaling factors can be reparameterized as exponential biases of weights, incurring a negligible cost. Our method, for the first time, can quantize both weights and activations in the LLaMA-13B to only 4-bit and achieves an average score of 63.1 on the common sense zero-shot reasoning tasks, which is only 5.8 lower than the full-precision model, significantly outperforming the previous state-of-the-art by 12.7 points. Code is available at: https://github.com/nbasyl/LLM-FP4.
classic:a7181cc46f80.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在后训练量化中如何进一步压缩到 4 bit，尤其是同时量化权重和激活值时的精度保持问题。作者指出，现有方法大多基于整数量化，在低于 8 bit 时效果受限，而浮点量化更适合处理长尾或类钟形分布，也更贴近硬件支持趋势。为此，论文先通过搜索最优量化参数构建了一个强基线，再针对激活分布中“跨通道方差大、通道内方差小”的现象提出逐通道激活量化，并可将额外缩放重参数化为权重的指数偏置，几乎不增加开销。实验表明，该方法首次实现了 LLaMA-13B 的权重和激活同时 4-bit 量化，并在常识推理任务上取得显著优于此前方法的结果。
classic:a7181cc46f80.tldr: LLM-FP4 证明了 4-bit 浮点后训练量化可以同时压缩大模型的权重和激活，并在几乎不增加代价的情况下大幅保留性能。
classic:a7181cc46f80.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型压缩、低比特量化或推理加速，这篇论文是理解 4-bit 浮点量化的重要经典参考。它不仅给出有效方法，也揭示了激活分布的关键规律，对后续量化研究很有启发。

classic:c532a05df56a.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) stand out for their impressive performance in intricate language modeling tasks. However, their demanding computational and memory needs pose obstacles for broad use on edge devices. Quantization is then introduced to boost LLMs' on-device efficiency. Recent works show that 8-bit or lower weight quantization is feasible with minimal impact on end-to-end task performance, while the activation is still not quantized. On the other hand, mainstream commodity edge devices still struggle to execute these sub-8-bit quantized networks effectively. In this paper, we propose Agile-Quant, an activation-guided quantization framework for popular Large Language Models (LLMs), and implement an end-to-end accelerator on multiple edge devices for faster inference. Considering the hardware profiling and activation analysis, we first introduce a basic activation quantization strategy to balance the trade-off of task performance and real inference speed. Then we leverage the activation-aware token pruning technique to reduce the outliers and the adverse impact on attentivity. Ultimately, we utilize the SIMD-based 4-bit multiplier and our efficient TRIP matrix multiplication to implement the accelerator for LLMs on the edge. We apply our framework on different scales of LLMs including LLaMA, OPT, and BLOOM with 4-bit or 8-bit for the activation and 4-bit for the weight quantization. Experiments show that Agile-Quant achieves simultaneous quantization of model weights and activations while maintaining task performance comparable to existing weight-only quantization methods. Moreover, in the 8- and 4-bit scenario, Agile-Quant achieves an on-device speedup of up to 2.55x compared to its FP16 counterparts across multiple edge devices, marking a pioneering advanceme…
classic:c532a05df56a.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大语言模型在边缘设备上推理慢、占用内存大的问题，提出了 Agile-Quant 量化框架。它不仅量化权重，还进一步对激活进行量化，并结合硬件性能分析与激活统计，设计出更适合真实设备的量化策略。为了减少量化带来的精度损失，作者还引入了激活感知的 token pruning 来抑制异常值和注意力退化。实验表明，该方法在保持接近现有仅权重量化方法任务表现的同时，可在多种边缘设备上实现最高 2.55 倍的推理加速。
classic:c532a05df56a.tldr: Agile-Quant 面向边缘端 LLM 推理，首次把激活量化、token pruning 和硬件加速结合起来，在尽量保留精度的前提下显著提速。
classic:c532a05df56a.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决的是 LLM 真正落地到边缘设备时最关键的“又慢又重”问题。它不仅有算法设计，还考虑了真实硬件实现，适合作为量化与端侧推理加速的经典参考。

classic:ea400e8884cb.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in various tasks. However their huge model size and the consequent demand for computational and memory resources also pose challenges to model deployment. Currently, 4-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) has achieved some success in LLMs, reducing the memory footprint by approximately 75% compared to FP16 models, albeit with some accuracy loss. In this paper, we propose SmoothQuant+, an accurate and efficient 4-bit weight-only PTQ that requires no additional training, which enables lossless in accuracy for LLMs for the first time. Based on the fact that the loss of weight quantization is amplified by the activation outliers, SmoothQuant+ smoothes the activation outliers by channel before quantization, while adjusting the corresponding weights for mathematical equivalence, and then performs group-wise 4-bit weight quantization for linear layers. We have integrated SmoothQuant+ into the vLLM framework, an advanced high-throughput inference engine specially developed for LLMs, and equipped it with an efficient W4A16 CUDA kernels, so that vLLM can seamlessly support SmoothQuant+ 4-bit weight quantization. Our results show that, with SmoothQuant+, the Code Llama-34B model can be quantized and deployed on a A100 40GB GPU, achieving lossless accuracy and a throughput increase of 1.9 to 4.0 times compared to the FP16 model deployed on two A100 40GB GPUs. Moreover, the latency per token is only 68% of the FP16 model deployed on two A100 40GB GPUs. This is the state-of-the-art 4-bit weight quantization for LLMs as we know.
classic:ea400e8884cb.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型部署时的显存和算力压力，尤其是 4-bit 后训练量化在压缩模型后带来的精度损失问题。作者提出 SmoothQuant+，通过按通道平滑激活中的异常值，并相应调整权重，再进行组内 4-bit 权重量化，从而在无需额外训练的情况下实现更高精度。论文还将该方法集成到 vLLM 和高效 CUDA kernel 中，提升了推理吞吐并降低延迟。实验表明，它可以把大模型压缩到单张 GPU 上部署，并在多项设置下达到接近无损的效果。
classic:ea400e8884cb.tldr: SmoothQuant+ 让 LLM 的 4-bit 权重量化在几乎不掉点的前提下更快、更省显存。
classic:ea400e8884cb.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了 LLM 低比特量化中最核心的难题之一：如何在大幅压缩模型的同时尽量保持精度。它也很适合作为经典参考，了解 4-bit PTQ 从算法到系统落地的一体化思路。

classic:aebba06b649e.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has played a key role in compressing large language models (LLMs) with ultra-low costs. However, existing PTQ methods only focus on handling the outliers within one layer or one block, which ignores the dependency of blocks and leads to severe performance degradation in low-bit settings. In this paper, we propose CBQ, a cross-block reconstruction-based PTQ method for LLMs. CBQ employs a cross-block dependency using a homologous reconstruction scheme, establishing long-range dependencies across multiple blocks to minimize error accumulation. Furthermore, CBQ incorporates a coarse-to-fine preprocessing (CFP) strategy for suppressing weight and activation outliers, coupled with an adaptive LoRA-Rounding technique for precise weight quantization. These innovations enable CBQ to not only handle extreme outliers effectively but also improve overall quantization accuracy. Extensive experiments show that CBQ achieves superior low-bit quantization (W4A4, W4A8, W2A16) and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods across various LLMs and datasets. Notably, CBQ quantizes the 4-bit LLAMA1-65B model within only 4.3 hours on a single GPU, achieving a commendable tradeoff between performance and quantization efficiency.
classic:aebba06b649e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在后训练量化中的低比特精度下降问题，指出现有方法多只处理单层或单块内的离群值，忽略了块与块之间的依赖关系。作者提出 CBQ，一种基于跨块重构的量化方法，通过在多个块之间建立长距离依赖来减少误差累积。CBQ 还结合了粗到细预处理（CFP）来抑制权重和激活离群值，并用自适应 LoRA-Rounding 提升权重量化精度。实验表明，CBQ 在 W4A4、W4A8、W2A16 等低比特设置下表现优于多种先进方法，同时量化效率也较高。
classic:aebba06b649e.tldr: CBQ 通过跨块重构打破只看单层的量化思路，在低比特 LLM 量化中同时提升精度与效率。
classic:aebba06b649e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直面 LLM 低比特量化里最棘手的误差累积问题，并给出了一个很有代表性的跨块建模思路。作为经典参考，它能帮助理解后训练量化从“局部修补”走向“全局协同”的设计方向。

classic:adbcdcfa99cd.abstract: This study examines 4-bit quantization methods like GPTQ in large language models (LLMs), highlighting GPTQ's overfitting and limited enhancement in Zero-Shot tasks. While prior works merely focusing on zero-shot measurement, we extend task scope to more generative categories such as code generation and abstractive summarization, in which we found that INT4 quantization can significantly underperform. However, simply shifting to higher precision formats like FP6 has been particularly challenging, thus overlooked, due to poor performance caused by the lack of sophisticated integration and system acceleration strategies on current AI hardware. Our results show that FP6, even with a coarse-grain quantization scheme, performs robustly across various algorithms and tasks, demonstrating its superiority in accuracy and versatility. Notably, with the FP6 quantization, \codestar-15B model performs comparably to its FP16 counterpart in code generation, and for smaller models like the 406M it closely matches their baselines in summarization. Neither can be achieved by INT4. To better accommodate various AI hardware and achieve the best system performance, we propose a novel 4+2 design for FP6 to achieve similar latency to the state-of-the-art INT4 fine-grain quantization. With our design, FP6 can become a promising solution to the current 4-bit quantization methods used in LLMs.
classic:adbcdcfa99cd.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化在不同生成任务中的真实表现，指出以 GPTQ 为代表的 4-bit 方法虽然在零样本评测中表现不错，但在代码生成和摘要等生成式任务上可能明显退化。作者进一步比较了 INT4 与 FP6 等更高精度格式，发现 FP6 在多种算法和任务上更稳定、更通用，尤其在生成质量上更接近原始 FP16 模型。为了解决 FP6 在硬件和系统层面的落地难题，论文提出了面向 FP6 的 4+2 设计，使其在延迟上接近先进的 INT4 细粒度量化。整体上，这项工作重新定义了 LLM 量化的评估视角，强调不能只看零样本指标，还要考虑多样生成任务中的实际可用性。
classic:adbcdcfa99cd.tldr: ZeroQuant(4+2) 提出面向 FP6 的量化方案，证明在代码生成和摘要等任务上 FP6 比 INT4 更稳、更接近原模型。
classic:adbcdcfa99cd.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把 LLM 量化的评测范围从零样本扩展到更贴近真实应用的生成任务，揭示了很多 4-bit 方法的局限。作为经典参考，它也提供了一个兼顾精度、通用性和硬件效率的 FP6 量化思路。

classic:7e6f0eb02c2e.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了如何将大语言模型压缩到极低比特宽度，重点是 2-bit 量化下仍尽量保持模型性能。作者提出了 QuIP 方法，利用更有理论保证的量化设计来降低信息损失，并提升极低比特场景下的稳定性。相比常见的后训练量化方法，QuIP 更强调在压缩率、误差控制和可证明性质之间取得平衡。它为大模型在受限存储和部署环境中的高效推理提供了重要参考。
classic:7e6f0eb02c2e.tldr: QuIP 提出带理论保证的 2-bit 量化方法，让大语言模型在极低比特压缩下尽量保持可用性能。
classic:7e6f0eb02c2e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“大模型能不能压到 2-bit 还尽量不掉太多效果”这个难题，做成了一个兼顾理论与实践的经典方案。对于关注模型压缩、端侧部署和高效推理的人来说，它是很有代表性的参考工作。

classic:51c8583d4345.abstract: This paper explores the feasibility and performance of on-device large language model (LLM) inference on various Apple iPhone models. Amidst the rapid evolution of generative AI, on-device LLMs offer solutions to privacy, security, and connectivity challenges inherent in cloud-based models. Leveraging existing literature on running multi-billion parameter LLMs on resource-limited devices, our study examines the thermal effects and interaction speeds of a high-performing LLM across different smartphone generations. We present real-world performance results, providing insights into on-device inference capabilities.
classic:51c8583d4345.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是在智能手机上直接运行量化后的大语言模型是否可行，以及不同机型上的推理性能差异。作者以苹果 iPhone 为主要测试平台，评估了多代手机在实际运行中的交互速度和热效应表现。研究结合了已有的端侧大模型工作，强调了在隐私、安全和离线可用性方面的应用价值。整体上，它为判断大模型能否真正落地到移动设备提供了有参考意义的实测结果。
classic:51c8583d4345.tldr: 评估量化大语言模型在多款 iPhone 上的端侧推理速度与发热表现，给出真实可用性参考。
classic:51c8583d4345.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是只谈模型压缩理论，而是直接测了手机上跑大模型的真实体验。对于关注端侧 AI、移动部署和量化效果的人来说，它是很实用的经典参考。

classic:c47ee1d3d57d.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) greatly improves model quality for downstream tasks. However, serving many fine-tuned LLMs concurrently is challenging due to the sporadic, bursty, and varying request patterns of different LLMs. To bridge this gap, we present DeltaZip, an LLM serving system that efficiently serves multiple full-parameter fine-tuned models concurrently by aggressively compressing model deltas by up to 10x while maintaining high model quality. The key insight behind this design is that fine-tuning results in small-magnitude changes to the pre-trained model. By co-designing the serving system with the compression algorithm, DeltaZip achieves 2x to 12x improvement in throughput compared to the state-of-the-art systems.
classic:c47ee1d3d57d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是多租户环境下同时服务多个微调后的大语言模型时，如何缓解显存和吞吐压力。作者指出，微调通常只会在预训练模型上产生幅度较小的参数变化，因此可以把这些模型差异表示为“delta”并进行高效压缩。基于这一观察，DeltaZip 通过系统与压缩算法协同设计，将模型 delta 压缩最高达 10 倍，同时尽量保持模型质量。实验结果表明，相比现有方法，它能带来 2 倍到 12 倍的吞吐提升，适合高并发、多模型服务场景。
classic:c47ee1d3d57d.tldr: DeltaZip 用 delta 压缩把多个微调 LLM 的服务成本大幅降下来，并显著提升多租户吞吐。
classic:c47ee1d3d57d.simple_intro: 这篇论文很值得看，因为它抓住了“微调只改变模型少量参数”这一关键事实，把模型服务问题转化为压缩问题来解决。对于需要同时部署多个定制化大模型的场景，它提供了一个很有代表性的经典系统方案。

classic:e040d0cd0ad9.abstract: Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) have made a significant impact on various domains. However, LLMs' efficiency suffers from both heavy computation and memory overheads. Compression techniques like sparsification and quantization are commonly used to mitigate the gap between LLM's computation/memory overheads and hardware capacity. However, existing GPU and transformer-based accelerators cannot efficiently process compressed LLMs, due to the following unresolved challenges: low computational efficiency, underutilized memory bandwidth, and large compilation overheads. This paper proposes FlightLLM, enabling efficient LLMs inference with a complete mapping flow on FPGAs. In FlightLLM, we highlight an innovative solution that the computation and memory overhead of LLMs can be solved by utilizing FPGA-specific resources (e.g., DSP48 and heterogeneous memory hierarchy). We propose a configurable sparse DSP chain to support different sparsity patterns with high computation efficiency. Second, we propose an always-on-chip decode scheme to boost memory bandwidth with mixed-precision support. Finally, to make FlightLLM available for real-world LLMs, we propose a length adaptive compilation method to reduce the compilation overhead. Implemented on the Xilinx Alveo U280 FPGA, FlightLLM achieves 6.0$\times$ higher energy efficiency and 1.8$\times$ better cost efficiency against commercial GPUs (e.g., NVIDIA V100S) on modern LLMs (e.g., LLaMA2-7B) using vLLM and SmoothQuant under the batch size of one. FlightLLM beats NVIDIA A100 GPU with 1.2$\times$ higher throughput using the latest Versal VHK158 FPGA.
classic:e040d0cd0ad9.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大语言模型推理中计算量大、显存开销高，以及压缩后模型在现有GPU和加速器上难以高效运行的问题展开研究。作者提出 FlightLLM，在 FPGA 上构建了一套完整的映射流程，结合可配置稀疏 DSP 链、常驻片上解码机制和长度自适应编译方法，提升稀疏与量化模型的执行效率。该方法充分利用 FPGA 的专用硬件资源和异构存储层次，缓解了带宽利用率低和编译开销大的瓶颈。实验表明，它在能效、成本效率和吞吐量上都优于多种商用 GPU 方案，具有很强的工程参考价值。
classic:e040d0cd0ad9.tldr: FlightLLM 把稀疏和量化的大语言模型推理完整搬到 FPGA 上，实现了更高能效、更好带宽利用和更低编译开销。
classic:e040d0cd0ad9.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于，它不仅提出了一个针对 LLM 压缩推理的 FPGA 加速方案，还把从计算、存储到编译的整条链路都打通了。对于想了解“经典硬件如何承接大模型推理”的读者，它是很好的参考案例。

classic:efee7494b74d.abstract: The emergence of accurate open large language models (LLMs) has led to a race towards performant quantization techniques which can enable their execution on end-user devices. In this paper, we revisit the problem of "extreme" LLM compression-defined as targeting extremely low bit counts, such as 2 to 3 bits per parameter-from the point of view of classic methods in Multi-Codebook Quantization (MCQ). Our algorithm, called AQLM, generalizes the classic Additive Quantization (AQ) approach for information retrieval to advance the state-of-the-art in LLM compression, via two innovations: 1) learned additive quantization of weight matrices in input-adaptive fashion, and 2) joint optimization of codebook parameters across each transformer blocks. Broadly, AQLM is the first scheme that is Pareto optimal in terms of accuracy-vs-model-size when compressing to less than 3 bits per parameter, and significantly improves upon all known schemes in the extreme compression (2bit) regime. In addition, AQLM is practical: we provide fast GPU and CPU implementations of AQLM for token generation, which enable us to match or outperform optimized FP16 implementations for speed, while executing in a much smaller memory footprint.
classic:efee7494b74d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是大语言模型的“极限压缩”问题，即把模型权重压到每参数 2 到 3 比特，同时尽量保持生成质量。作者从经典的多码本量化方法出发，提出了 AQLM，将加性量化扩展到面向 LLM 的输入自适应权重量化，并对各个 Transformer block 的码本参数进行联合优化。实验表明，AQLM 在低于 3 比特时能在精度与模型大小之间取得很强的帕累托最优表现，尤其在 2 比特场景显著优于已有方法。论文还给出了可运行的 GPU 和 CPU 推理实现，使极低比特压缩不仅有效，而且具备实际部署价值。
classic:efee7494b74d.tldr: AQLM 把经典加性量化用于大语言模型极限压缩，在 2–3 比特下实现了更好的精度-体积权衡，并支持实用推理。
classic:efee7494b74d.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型如何在手机或边缘设备上运行，这篇论文是研究“超低比特量化”的经典参考。它既有方法上的新意，也展示了极限压缩在真实推理中的可行性。

classic:7a18c2dfa98d.abstract: Finetuning large language models (LLMs) has been empirically effective on a variety of downstream tasks. Existing approaches to finetuning an LLM either focus on parameter-efficient finetuning, which only updates a small number of trainable parameters, or attempt to reduce the memory footprint during the training phase of the finetuning. Typically, the memory footprint during finetuning stems from three contributors: model weights, optimizer states, and intermediate activations. However, existing works still require considerable memory and none can simultaneously mitigate memory footprint for all three sources. In this paper, we present Quantized Side Tuing (QST), which enables memory-efficient and fast finetuning of LLMs by operating through a dual-stage process. First, QST quantizes an LLM's model weights into 4-bit to reduce the memory footprint of the LLM's original weights; QST also introduces a side network separated from the LLM, which utilizes the hidden states of the LLM to make task-specific predictions. Using a separate side network avoids performing backpropagation through the LLM, thus reducing the memory requirement of the intermediate activations. Furthermore, QST leverages several low-rank adaptors and gradient-free downsample modules to significantly reduce the trainable parameters, so as to save the memory footprint of the optimizer states. Experiments show that QST can reduce the total memory footprint by up to 2.3 $\times$ and speed up the finetuning process by up to 3 $\times$ while achieving competent performance compared with the state-of-the-art. When it comes to full finetuning, QST can reduce the total memory footprint up to 7 $\times$.
classic:7a18c2dfa98d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型微调时显存开销过大的问题，指出模型权重、优化器状态和中间激活三部分都会带来很高的内存负担。作者提出 Quantized Side Tuning（QST），通过将主模型权重量化到 4-bit，并引入独立的侧网络来利用隐藏状态完成任务预测，从而避免对大模型主体反向传播。与此同时，QST 结合低秩适配器和无梯度下采样模块，进一步减少可训练参数和优化器状态开销。实验表明，它能在保持有竞争力性能的同时显著降低显存并加速微调。
classic:7a18c2dfa98d.tldr: QST 通过 4-bit 量化加侧网络微调，大幅降低 LLM 微调的显存和时间成本。
classic:7a18c2dfa98d.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为量化微调方向的经典参考，因为它把“低比特权重”和“侧网络微调”结合起来，系统性地解决了大模型训练中的多种内存瓶颈。它不仅思路清晰，而且实验结果直接展示了效率提升与性能折中。

classic:916b8cce0325.abstract: We present Inferflow, an efficient and highly configurable inference engine for large language models (LLMs). With Inferflow, users can serve most of the common transformer models by simply modifying some lines in corresponding configuration files, without writing a single line of source code. Compared with most existing inference engines, Inferflow has some key features. First, by implementing a modular framework of atomic build-blocks and technologies, Inferflow is compositionally generalizable to new models. Second, 3.5-bit quantization is introduced in Inferflow as a tradeoff between 3-bit and 4-bit quantization. Third, hybrid model partitioning for multi-GPU inference is introduced in Inferflow to better balance inference speed and throughput than the existing partition-by-layer and partition-by-tensor strategies.
classic:916b8cce0325.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出了 Inferflow，一个面向大语言模型的高效、可高度配置的推理引擎，目标是降低部署和适配不同 Transformer 模型的门槛。作者通过模块化的原子构建块设计，让系统能够通过配置文件快速支持多种常见模型，而不必改源码。论文还提出了 3.5-bit 量化，作为 3-bit 和 4-bit 量化之间的折中方案，以兼顾精度和效率。针对多 GPU 推理，作者设计了混合式模型切分策略，在速度和吞吐之间取得更好的平衡。
classic:916b8cce0325.tldr: Inferflow 用模块化设计、3.5-bit 量化和混合切分策略，让大模型推理更高效、更易配置。
classic:916b8cce0325.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它把“推理引擎怎么更灵活地适配大模型”这个工程问题讲得很完整。对于关注大模型部署、量化和多卡推理优化的人来说，它是一个很实用的经典参考。

classic:b21d529d399d.abstract: Six-bit quantization (FP6) can effectively reduce the size of large language models (LLMs) and preserve the model quality consistently across varied applications. However, existing systems do not provide Tensor Core support for FP6 quantization and struggle to achieve practical performance improvements during LLM inference. It is challenging to support FP6 quantization on GPUs due to (1) unfriendly memory access of model weights with irregular bit-width and (2) high runtime overhead of weight de-quantization. To address these problems, we propose TC-FPx, the first full-stack GPU kernel design scheme with unified Tensor Core support of float-point weights for various quantization bit-width. We integrate TC-FPx kernel into an existing inference system, providing new end-to-end support (called FP6-LLM) for quantized LLM inference, where better trade-offs between inference cost and model quality are achieved. Experiments show that FP6-LLM enables the inference of LLaMA-70b using only a single GPU, achieving 1.69x-2.65x higher normalized inference throughput than the FP16 baseline. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/usyd-fsalab/fp6_llm.
classic:b21d529d399d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理中的显存占用和吞吐效率问题，特别是六比特浮点量化（FP6）虽然能显著压缩模型并尽量保持精度，但现有系统缺少对 FP6 的高效硬件支持。作者提出了 TC-FPx，一种面向多种浮点量化位宽的统一 Tensor Core 内核设计，用来解决不规则位宽带来的访存困难和运行时反量化开销。基于该内核，论文进一步构建了 FP6-LLM 端到端推理系统，使量化推理在性能与模型质量之间取得更实用的平衡。实验表明，该方案可让 LLaMA-70B 在单张 GPU 上运行，并相比 FP16 基线获得 1.69x 到 2.65x 的归一化吞吐提升。
classic:b21d529d399d.tldr: FP6-LLM 通过面向 FP6 的算法-系统协同设计，让大模型推理在更少显存下实现更高吞吐。
classic:b21d529d399d.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它不只是讨论“把模型量化到 6 bit”，而是把量化算法和 GPU 系统实现一起打通，给出了可落地的高效推理方案。它是研究大模型低比特推理、Tensor Core 利用和软硬件协同优化时很好的经典参考。

classic:695ee5e0c14e.abstract: LLMs are seeing growing use for applications which require large context windows, and with these large context windows KV cache activations surface as the dominant contributor to memory consumption during inference. Quantization is a promising approach for compressing KV cache activations; however, existing solutions fail to represent activations accurately in sub-4-bit precision. Our work, KVQuant, facilitates low precision KV cache quantization by incorporating several novel methods: (i) Per-Channel Key Quantization, where we adjust the dimension along which we quantize the Key activations to better match the distribution; (ii) Pre-RoPE Key Quantization, where we quantize Key activations before the rotary positional embedding to mitigate its impact on quantization; (iii) Non-Uniform KV Cache Quantization, where we derive per-layer sensitivity-weighted non-uniform datatypes that better represent the distributions; and (iv) Per-Vector Dense-and-Sparse Quantization, where we isolate outliers separately for each vector to minimize skews in quantization ranges. By applying our method to the LLaMA, Llama-2, Llama-3, and Mistral models, we achieve < 0.1 perplexity degradation with 3-bit quantization on both Wikitext-2 and C4, outperforming existing approaches. Our method enables serving LLaMA-7B with a context length of up to 1 million on a single A100-80GB GPU and up to 10 million on an 8-GPU system. We develop custom CUDA kernels for KVQuant, showing that we can achieve up to ~1.7x speedups, compared to baseline fp16 matrix-vector multiplications, for the LLaMA-7B model.
classic:695ee5e0c14e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在长上下文推理时的核心瓶颈：KV cache 占用内存过大，限制了上下文长度和部署效率。作者提出 KVQuant，通过按通道量化、RoPE 前量化、非均匀数据类型设计以及向量级稠密/稀疏分离等方法，提高了 KV cache 在低比特下的表示精度。实验表明，该方法在 3-bit 量化下几乎不损失困惑度，并能显著扩展单卡和多卡系统可支持的上下文长度。论文还配套了自定义 CUDA kernel，在性能上也带来了实际加速，具有很强的工程落地价值。
classic:695ee5e0c14e.tldr: KVQuant 通过一组针对 KV cache 分布特性的低比特量化技巧，让大模型长上下文推理更省显存、更可部署。
classic:695ee5e0c14e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了长上下文 LLM 部署中的关键内存瓶颈，而且方法设计非常贴近实际推理场景。作为 KV cache 量化方向的代表工作，它对后续做长上下文压缩和高效推理很有参考价值。

classic:af2ef31764ce.abstract: A growing trend has emerged in designing high-quality Small Language Models (SLMs) with a few million parameters. This trend is driven by the increasing concerns over cloud costs, privacy, and latency. Considering that full parameter training is feasible for SLMs on mobile devices, Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) is employed to improve efficiency by reducing computational overhead and memory footprint. However, previous QAT works adopt fine-grained quantization methods to compress models with billions of parameters on GPUs, incompatible with current commodity hardware, such as mobile and edge devices, which relies on Single Instruction Multiple Data (SIMD) instructions. Thus, the generalization of these methods to SLMs on mobile devices is limited. In this paper, we propose Squat method, an effective QAT framework with deployable quantization for SLMs on mobile devices. Specifically, we propose entropy-guided and distribution-aligned distillation to mitigate the distortion of attention information from quantization. Besides, we employ sub-8-bit token adaptive quantization, assigning varying bit widths to different tokens based on their importance. Furthermore, we develop a SIMD-based Multi-Kernel Mixed-Precision (MKMP) multiplier to support sub-8-bit mixed-precision MAC on mobile devices. Our extensive experiments verify the substantial improvements of our method compared to other QAT methods across various datasets. Furthermore, we achieve an on-device speedup of up to 2.37x compared with its FP16 counterparts, signaling a great advancement. Code: https://github.com/shawnricecake/squant
classic:af2ef31764ce.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是如何把轻量级大语言模型在边缘设备和手机上做更高效的量化训练与部署。作者指出，现有很多 QAT 方法主要面向 GPU 和超大模型，难以直接适配依赖 SIMD 指令的移动端硬件。为此，论文提出了结合熵指导与分布对齐的蒸馏方法来减轻量化对注意力信息的破坏，并采用按 token 自适应的低于 8 bit 混合精度量化。实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上效果优于已有 QAT 方法，同时在端侧推理上最高可实现 2.37 倍加速。
classic:af2ef31764ce.tldr: 面向手机和边缘设备的轻量 LLM 量化训练方法，通过蒸馏、token 自适应低比特量化和 SIMD 友好的乘法器实现更快更省的端侧部署。
classic:af2ef31764ce.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它把“能训练”和“能落地”同时考虑进来了，不只是追求压缩率，还关注移动端真实硬件上的可部署性。对于想把小语言模型部署到手机、边缘设备或低功耗场景的人来说，它是很有参考价值的经典工作。

classic:66f3cda31430.abstract: Recently, considerable efforts have been directed towards compressing Large Language Models (LLMs), which showcase groundbreaking capabilities across diverse applications but entail significant deployment costs due to their large sizes. Meanwhile, much less attention has been given to mitigating the costs associated with deploying multiple LLMs of varying sizes despite its practical significance. Thus, this paper introduces \emph{any-precision LLM}, extending the concept of any-precision DNN to LLMs. Addressing challenges in any-precision LLM, we propose a lightweight method for any-precision quantization of LLMs, leveraging a post-training quantization framework, and develop a specialized software engine for its efficient serving. As a result, our solution significantly reduces the high costs of deploying multiple, different-sized LLMs by overlaying LLMs quantized to varying bit-widths, such as 3, 4, ..., $n$ bits, into a memory footprint comparable to a single $n$-bit LLM. All the supported LLMs with varying bit-widths demonstrate state-of-the-art model quality and inference throughput, proving itself to be a compelling option for deployment of multiple, different-sized LLMs. Our code is open-sourced and available online.
classic:66f3cda31430.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是一个很实用但常被忽视的问题：如何低成本部署多个不同尺寸的LLM，而不是只压缩单个模型。作者提出了 any-precision LLM，把“任意精度”思想扩展到大语言模型上，并给出一种基于后训练量化的轻量方法。通过将不同比特宽度的模型叠加存储在同一份参数空间里，系统可以用接近单个高比特模型的内存开销，支持多个不同精度的LLM。论文还设计了专门的软件引擎来提升服务效率，在模型质量和推理吞吐上都表现出较强竞争力。
classic:66f3cda31430.tldr: Any-Precision LLM 让多个不同精度、不同尺寸的LLM可以用接近单个模型的内存成本一起部署。
classic:66f3cda31430.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决的是落地部署中非常现实的“多模型同时服务”成本问题。它把量化从单模型压缩推进到可灵活切换的多精度部署方案，是量化与系统结合的一个经典参考。

classic:50d1d95d8510.abstract: Post-training quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is challenging. In this work, we introduce Low-rank Quantization Error Reduction (LQER), which combines quantization and low-rank approximation to recover the model capability. LQER leverages an activation-induced scale matrix to drive the singular value distribution of quantization error towards a desirable distribution, which enables nearly-lossless W4A8 quantization on various LLMs and downstream tasks without the need for knowledge distillation, grid search, or gradient-base iterative optimization. Unlike existing methods, the computation pattern of LQER eliminates the need for specialized Scatter and Gather processes to collect high-precision weights from irregular memory locations. Our W4A8 LLMs achieve near-lossless performance on six popular downstream tasks, while using 1.36$\times$ fewer hardware resources than the leading state-of-the-art method. We open-source our framework at https://github.com/ChengZhang-98/lqer
classic:50d1d95d8510.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在后训练量化时精度容易下降的问题，目标是在尽量低比特的条件下保留模型能力。作者提出 LQER，将量化与低秩近似结合，并利用由激活驱动的尺度矩阵来调整量化误差的奇异值分布，从而更有效地恢复性能。该方法可以在不依赖知识蒸馏、网格搜索或梯度迭代优化的情况下，实现多种 LLM 的近乎无损 W4A8 量化。实验表明，它在多个下游任务上表现接近原模型，同时还比现有先进方法更节省硬件资源。
classic:50d1d95d8510.tldr: LQER 用“量化 + 低秩修复”把 LLM 的 W4A8 后训练量化做到近乎无损。
classic:50d1d95d8510.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合想了解 LLM 量化前沿的人阅读，因为它不仅提升了量化精度，还尽量避免了复杂的搜索和迭代过程。作为经典参考，它展示了如何用低秩结构来补偿量化误差，思路简洁且工程实用。

classic:7155ee6fc130.abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) exhibit exceptional general language processing capabilities but come with significant demands on memory and computational resources. As a powerful compression technology, binarization can extremely reduce model weights to a mere 1 bit, lowering the expensive computation and memory requirements. However, existing quantization techniques fall short of maintaining LLM performance under ultra-low bit-widths. In response to this challenge, we present BiLLM, a groundbreaking 1-bit post-training quantization scheme tailored for pretrained LLMs. Based on the weight distribution of LLMs, BiLLM first identifies and structurally selects salient weights, and minimizes the compression loss through an effective binary residual approximation strategy. Moreover, considering the bell-shaped distribution of the non-salient weights, we propose an optimal splitting search to group and binarize them accurately. BiLLM achieving for the first time high-accuracy inference (e.g. 8.41 perplexity on LLaMA2-70B) with only 1.08-bit weights across various LLMs families and evaluation metrics, outperforms SOTA quantization methods of LLM by significant margins. Moreover, BiLLM enables the binarization process of the LLM with 7 billion weights within 0.5 hours on a single GPU, demonstrating satisfactory time efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/Aaronhuang-778/BiLLM.
classic:7155ee6fc130.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型在后训练量化中如何进一步压缩到接近 1 bit 的极限，同时尽量保持推理性能。作者指出，现有超低比特量化方法在 LLM 上往往会带来明显精度损失，因此提出了 BiLLM 这一 1-bit 后训练量化方案。该方法先根据权重分布筛选并结构化保留重要权重，再用二进制残差近似降低压缩误差，并对非重要权重进行最优分组与二值化。实验表明，BiLLM 在多个 LLM 家族上取得了领先的低比特性能和较高的效率，证明了极限量化的可行性。
classic:7155ee6fc130.tldr: BiLLM 把 LLM 后训练量化推进到接近 1 bit，在大幅压缩的同时仍能保持较好的推理精度。
classic:7155ee6fc130.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，是因为它把“大模型能压到多低”这个问题推进到了 1-bit 量化的前沿。作为经典参考，它展示了如何结合权重分布分析、结构化选择和残差近似来缓解极低比特带来的性能损失。

classic:b19e9f90a9ca.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory footprint of LLMs by quantizing their weights to low-precision. In this work, we introduce QuIP#, a weight-only PTQ method that achieves state-of-the-art results in extreme compression regimes ($\le$ 4 bits per weight) using three novel techniques. First, QuIP# improves QuIP's (Chee et al., 2023) incoherence processing by using the randomized Hadamard transform, which is faster and has better theoretical properties. Second, QuIP# uses vector quantization to take advantage of the ball-shaped sub-Gaussian distribution that incoherent weights possess: specifically, we introduce a set of hardware-efficient codebooks based on the highly symmetric $E_8$ lattice, which achieves the optimal 8-dimension unit ball packing. Third, QuIP# uses fine-tuning to improve fidelity to the original model. Our experiments show that QuIP# outperforms existing PTQ methods, enables new behaviors in PTQ scaling, and supports fast inference. Our code can be found at https://github.com/Cornell-RelaxML/quip-sharp.
classic:b19e9f90a9ca.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型在极低比特权重压缩下的后训练量化问题，目标是在尽量不损失模型能力的前提下降低存储和推理成本。作者提出 QuIP#，把随机 Hadamard 变换用于更高效的去相关处理，并结合基于 E8 晶格的向量量化码本来更好地匹配量化后权重的分布。与此同时，方法还加入微调步骤进一步恢复模型精度。实验表明，QuIP# 在 4 bit 及更低比特场景下优于现有 PTQ 方法，并且兼顾了高压缩率和快速推理。
classic:b19e9f90a9ca.tldr: QuIP# 通过随机 Hadamard 去相关、E8 晶格码本和微调，把 LLM 后训练量化推进到更低比特且保持更高精度。
classic:b19e9f90a9ca.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它针对的是 LLM 部署里最现实的瓶颈之一：模型太大、太难压缩。它把理论上的去相关、几何化码本设计和工程上可用的推理速度结合起来，是极低比特量化方向很有代表性的经典工作。

classic:cae333ca6ff0.abstract: Due to the high memory and computational costs associated with large language models (LLMs), model compression techniques such as quantization, which reduces inference costs, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which reduce training costs, have gained significant popularity. This trend has spurred active research into quantization-aware PEFT techniques, aimed at maintaining model accuracy while minimizing memory overhead during both inference and training. Previous quantization-aware PEFT methods typically apply post-training quantization (PTQ) to pre-trained LLMs, followed by PEFT to recover accuracy loss. Meanwhile, this approach has limitations in recovering the accuracy loss. In this paper, we propose L4Q, a method that integrates Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) with LoRA. By employing a memory-optimized layer design, L4Q significantly reduces QAT's memory overhead, making its training cost comparable to LoRA, while preserving the advantage of QAT in producing fully quantized LLMs with high accuracy. Our experiments demonstrate that this combined approach to quantization and fine-tuning achieves superior accuracy compared to decoupled fine-tuning schemes, particularly in 4-bit and 3-bit quantization, positioning L4Q as an efficient QAT solution. Using the LLaMA and Mistral models with instructional datasets, we showcase L4Q's capabilities in language tasks and few-shot learning.
classic:cae333ca6ff0.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在训练和推理中的高显存、高算力问题，目标是在尽量减少额外开销的同时保持量化后的精度。作者提出 L4Q，将量化感知训练（QAT）与 LoRA 结合，并通过内存优化的层设计显著降低训练时的资源消耗，使其成本接近普通 LoRA 微调。与先量化再微调的分离式方案相比，L4Q 更能恢复并保持模型精度，尤其在 4-bit 和 3-bit 量化下表现更好。实验表明，该方法适用于 LLaMA 和 Mistral 等模型，在语言任务和小样本学习中都具有较强实用价值。
classic:cae333ca6ff0.tldr: L4Q 把 QAT 和 LoRA 结合起来，在几乎不增加训练成本的前提下提升低比特量化大模型的精度。
classic:cae333ca6ff0.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了“低成本训练”和“高精度量化”难以兼顾的问题，并给出了一个实用的工程化方案。对于研究大模型压缩、低比特部署或参数高效微调的人来说，它是一个很有参考价值的经典思路。

classic:928a95368b99.abstract: In this paper, we present a novel method that reduces model inference latency during distributed deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). Our contribution is an optimized inference deployment scheme that address the current limitations of state-of-the-art quantization kernels when used in conjunction with Tensor Parallel (TP). Our method preserves data locality in GPU memory access patterns and exploits a priori knowledge of TP to reduce global communication. We demonstrate an up to 1.81x speedup over existing methods for Llama-70B and up to 1.78x speedup for IBM WatsonX's Granite-20B MLP layer problem sizes on A100 and H100 NVIDIA DGX Systems for a variety of TP settings.
classic:928a95368b99.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在分布式部署时的推理延迟问题，尤其是量化算子与 Tensor Parallel（TP）结合后带来的性能瓶颈。作者提出了一种 TP-aware 的反量化优化方案，利用对 TP 拓扑和计算模式的先验知识，改进 GPU 内存访问的局部性。该方法减少了全局通信开销，并提升了量化推理内核的执行效率。实验表明，在 Llama-70B 和 Granite-20B 等场景下可获得最高约 1.81 倍加速，具有很强的工程实用价值。
classic:928a95368b99.tldr: 面向 Tensor Parallel 部署的量化反量化优化方法，显著降低大模型分布式推理延迟。
classic:928a95368b99.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了大模型量化后在多 GPU 推理中的实际性能痛点，而不是只停留在算法压缩层面。对于关注高效部署、推理加速和系统优化的读者，它是一个很有代表性的经典参考。

classic:def61713897a.abstract: Memory-efficient finetuning of large language models (LLMs) has recently attracted huge attention with the increasing size of LLMs, primarily due to the constraints posed by GPU memory limitations and the effectiveness of these methods compared to full finetuning. Despite the advancements, current strategies for memory-efficient finetuning, such as QLoRA, exhibit inconsistent performance across diverse bit-width quantizations and multifaceted tasks. This inconsistency largely stems from the detrimental impact of the quantization process on preserved knowledge, leading to catastrophic forgetting and undermining the utilization of pretrained models for finetuning purposes. In this work, we introduce a novel quantization framework, ApiQ, designed to restore the lost information from quantization by concurrently initializing the LoRA components and quantizing the weights of LLMs. This approach ensures the maintenance of the original LLM's activation precision while mitigating the error propagation from shallower into deeper layers. Through comprehensive evaluations conducted on a spectrum of language tasks with various LLMs, ApiQ demonstrably minimizes activation error during quantization. Consequently, it consistently achieves superior finetuning results across various bit-widths.
classic:def61713897a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是大语言模型在低比特量化后进行高效微调时，性能在不同量化位宽和任务上不稳定的问题。作者指出，量化会破坏模型中保留的知识，进而带来灾难性遗忘，影响预训练模型在微调中的利用效果。为此，论文提出 ApiQ 框架，在量化权重的同时协同初始化 LoRA 模块，以尽量恢复量化丢失的信息。实验表明，ApiQ 能有效降低量化引起的激活误差，并在多种位宽和任务上取得更稳定、更优的微调结果。
classic:def61713897a.tldr: ApiQ 通过协同量化与 LoRA 初始化，缓解 2-bit 量化带来的知识损失，实现更稳定的低比特微调。
classic:def61713897a.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对低比特量化微调中“效果不稳定”这个核心痛点，给出了一个实用且系统的解决方案。作为量化方向的经典参考，它有助于理解如何在极低显存开销下尽量保住模型能力。

classic:8725d29afbf9.abstract: The LoRA-finetuning quantization of LLMs has been extensively studied to obtain accurate yet compact LLMs for deployment on resource-constrained hardware. However, existing methods cause the quantized LLM to severely degrade and even fail to benefit from the finetuning of LoRA. This paper proposes a novel IR-QLoRA for pushing quantized LLMs with LoRA to be highly accurate through information retention. The proposed IR-QLoRA mainly relies on two technologies derived from the perspective of unified information: (1) statistics-based Information Calibration Quantization allows the quantized parameters of LLM to retain original information accurately; (2) finetuning-based Information Elastic Connection makes LoRA utilizes elastic representation transformation with diverse information. Comprehensive experiments show that IR-QLoRA can significantly improve accuracy across LLaMA and LLaMA2 families under 2-4 bit-widths, e.g., 4- bit LLaMA-7B achieves 1.4% improvement on MMLU compared with the state-of-the-art methods. The significant performance gain requires only a tiny 0.31% additional time consumption, revealing the satisfactory efficiency of our IR-QLoRA. We highlight that IR-QLoRA enjoys excellent versatility, compatible with various frameworks (e.g., NormalFloat and Integer quantization) and brings general accuracy gains. The code is available at https://github.com/htqin/ir-qlora.
classic:8725d29afbf9.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在低比特量化后，结合 LoRA 微调时容易出现精度明显下降、甚至无法有效受益的问题。作者提出 IR-QLoRA，从“信息保留”的角度设计了两项关键技术：基于统计的信息校准量化，以及基于微调的信息弹性连接。前者尽量让量化后的参数保留原始信息，后者让 LoRA 在更灵活的表示变换中利用多样信息。实验表明，该方法在 LLaMA 和 LLaMA2 上的 2 到 4 bit 量化场景都能显著提升准确率，同时额外开销很小。
classic:8725d29afbf9.tldr: IR-QLoRA 通过“信息保留”思路显著提升了低比特量化大模型的 LoRA 微调精度，且额外开销极低。
classic:8725d29afbf9.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了量化和微调结合时常见的精度崩塌问题，而且给出了一个通用、有效的改进框架。对于想把大模型部署到资源受限设备上、又不想牺牲太多性能的人来说，这是很有参考价值的经典工作。

classic:aa16d921b014.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are typically trained in two phases: pre-training on large internet-scale datasets, and fine-tuning for downstream tasks. Given the higher computational demand of pre-training, it's intuitive to assume that fine-tuning adds less new information to the model, and is thus more compressible. We explore this assumption by decomposing the weights of fine-tuned models into their pre-trained components and an additional delta. We introduce a simple method, BitDelta, which successfully quantizes this delta down to 1 bit without compromising performance. This interesting finding not only highlights the potential redundancy of information added during fine-tuning, but also has significant implications for the multi-tenant serving and multi-tenant storage of fine-tuned models. By enabling the use of a single high-precision base model accompanied by multiple 1-bit deltas, BitDelta dramatically reduces GPU memory requirements by more than 10x, which can also be translated to enhanced generation latency in multi-tenant settings. We validate BitDelta through experiments across Llama-2 and Mistral model families, and on models up to 70B parameters, showcasing minimal performance degradation over all tested settings.
classic:aa16d921b014.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在预训练之后的微调增量是否真的需要高精度保存。作者将微调后的权重分解为基础模型和增量部分，并提出 BitDelta 方法，把这个增量量化到 1 bit 仍能保持几乎不变的效果。实验覆盖 Llama-2 和 Mistral 等模型族，且模型规模最高到 70B，结果表明性能损失很小。该工作说明微调信息可能高度冗余，对多租户部署和模型存储节省具有直接价值。
classic:aa16d921b014.tldr: BitDelta 证明了很多微调增量只用 1 bit 保存，也能基本不掉性能。
classic:aa16d921b014.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它挑战了“微调一定很占空间”的直觉，并给出一个非常实用的压缩方案。对于需要同时存储和服务多个微调模型的场景，它是很有参考价值的经典工作。

classic:3bf32d42483d.abstract: Finetuning large language models requires huge GPU memory, restricting the choice to acquire Larger models. While the quantized version of the Low-Rank Adaptation technique, named QLoRA, significantly alleviates this issue, finding the efficient LoRA rank is still challenging. Moreover, QLoRA is trained on a pre-defined rank and, therefore, cannot be reconfigured for its lower ranks without requiring further fine-tuning steps. This paper proposes QDyLoRA -Quantized Dynamic Low-Rank Adaptation-, as an efficient quantization approach for dynamic low-rank adaptation. Motivated by Dynamic LoRA, QDyLoRA is able to efficiently finetune LLMs on a set of pre-defined LoRA ranks. QDyLoRA enables fine-tuning Falcon-40b for ranks 1 to 64 on a single 32 GB V100-GPU through one round of fine-tuning. Experimental results show that QDyLoRA is competitive to QLoRA and outperforms when employing its optimal rank.
classic:3bf32d42483d.summary_zh: 大语言模型微调通常需要大量显存，这限制了可用模型规模；QLoRA 虽然缓解了这一问题，但仍然依赖预先设定的 LoRA 秩，且难以在不同秩之间灵活切换。本文提出 QDyLoRA，将量化与动态低秩适配结合起来，使模型能够在一轮训练中同时适配一组预定义的 LoRA 秩。该方法可以在单张 32GB V100 上完成 Falcon-40B 从秩 1 到 64 的微调。实验表明，QDyLoRA 与 QLoRA 具有竞争力，并在选择最优秩时表现更好。
classic:3bf32d42483d.tldr: QDyLoRA 让量化微调支持动态 LoRA 秩选择，一次训练就能适配多个秩，更省显存也更灵活。
classic:3bf32d42483d.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了“量化微调已经省显存，但 LoRA 秩还不够灵活”的实际问题。对于需要在有限 GPU 资源下高效调参和部署大模型的人来说，它是一个很实用的经典参考。

classic:f26678a1e758.abstract: The upscaling of Large Language Models (LLMs) has yielded impressive advances in natural language processing, yet it also poses significant deployment challenges. Weight quantization has emerged as a widely embraced solution to reduce memory and computational demands. This paper introduces BitDistiller, a framework that synergizes Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) with Knowledge Distillation (KD) to boost the performance of LLMs at ultra-low precisions (sub-4-bit). Specifically, BitDistiller first incorporates a tailored asymmetric quantization and clipping technique to maximally preserve the fidelity of quantized weights, and then proposes a novel Confidence-Aware Kullback-Leibler Divergence (CAKLD) objective, which is employed in a self-distillation manner to enable faster convergence and superior model performance. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that BitDistiller significantly surpasses existing methods in both 3-bit and 2-bit configurations on general language understanding and complex reasoning benchmarks. Notably, BitDistiller is shown to be more cost-effective, demanding fewer data and training resources. The code is available at https://github.com/DD-DuDa/BitDistiller.
classic:f26678a1e758.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时面临的显存和计算开销问题，提出用超低比特量化来压缩模型。作者将量化感知训练与知识蒸馏结合起来，设计了更适合低比特权重的非对称量化和裁剪策略，并引入置信度感知的 KL 散度目标进行自蒸馏。这样做可以在 3-bit 和 2-bit 场景下更好地保留模型性能，同时加快收敛。实验表明，BitDistiller 在通用语言理解和复杂推理任务上都优于现有方法，且训练成本更低。
classic:f26678a1e758.tldr: BitDistiller 通过量化感知训练 + 自蒸馏，让 3-bit/2-bit LLM 也能尽量保持高性能。
classic:f26678a1e758.simple_intro: 这是一篇研究超低比特大模型压缩的经典工作，适合想了解 LLM 量化前沿方法的人阅读。它不仅提升了低比特量化的效果，也提供了兼顾性能和训练成本的实用思路。

classic:d8c5cd1a43ce.abstract: Model quantification uses low bit-width values to represent the weight matrices of existing models to be quantized, which is a promising approach to reduce both storage and computational overheads of deploying highly anticipated LLMs. However, current quantization methods suffer severe performance degradation when the bit-width is extremely reduced, and thus focus on utilizing 4-bit or 8-bit values to quantize models. This paper boldly quantizes the weight matrices of LLMs to 1-bit, paving the way for the extremely low bit-width deployment of LLMs. For this target, we introduce a 1-bit model compressing framework named OneBit, including a novel 1-bit parameter representation method to better quantize LLMs as well as an effective parameter initialization method based on matrix decomposition to improve the convergence speed of the quantization framework. Sufficient experimental results indicate that OneBit achieves good performance (at least 81% of the non-quantized performance on LLaMA models) with robust training processes when only using 1-bit weight matrices.
classic:d8c5cd1a43ce.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时的存储和计算开销问题，目标是把模型权重量化到极低比特。不同于常见的 4-bit 或 8-bit 方法，作者提出 OneBit 框架，尝试将 LLM 权重压缩到 1-bit。为提升可训练性和收敛速度，论文设计了新的 1-bit 参数表示方法，并结合矩阵分解进行有效初始化。实验表明，该方法在仅用 1-bit 权重时仍能保持较强性能，具备很高的部署价值。
classic:d8c5cd1a43ce.tldr: OneBit 把大语言模型权重量化到 1-bit，在极低比特下仍能保持较好性能，推进了超轻量部署。
classic:d8c5cd1a43ce.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把量化研究推进到了更激进的 1-bit 场景，挑战了低比特部署的极限。作为经典参考，它能帮助理解极低比特量化的核心难点、建模思路和训练稳定性设计。

classic:480a0597ae4e.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced the field of natural language processing, while the expensive memory and computation consumption impede their practical deployment. Quantization emerges as one of the most effective methods for improving the computational efficiency of LLMs. However, existing ultra-low-bit quantization always causes severe accuracy drops. In this paper, we empirically relieve the micro and macro characteristics of ultra-low bit quantization and present a novel Dual-Binarization method for LLMs, namely DB-LLM. For the micro-level, we take both the accuracy advantage of 2-bit-width and the efficiency advantage of binarization into account, introducing Flexible Dual Binarization (FDB). By splitting 2-bit quantized weights into two independent sets of binaries, FDB ensures the accuracy of representations and introduces flexibility, utilizing the efficient bitwise operations of binarization while retaining the inherent high sparsity of ultra-low bit quantization. For the macro-level, we find the distortion that exists in the prediction of LLM after quantization, which is specified as the deviations related to the ambiguity of samples. We propose the Deviation-Aware Distillation (DAD) method, enabling the model to focus differently on various samples. Comprehensive experiments show that our DB-LLM not only significantly surpasses the current State-of-The-Art (SoTA) in ultra-low bit quantization (eg, perplexity decreased from 9.64 to 7.23), but also achieves an additional 20\% reduction in computational consumption compared to the SOTA method under the same bit-width. Our code will be released soon.
classic:480a0597ae4e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在超低比特量化时容易出现精度大幅下降的问题，目标是在尽量降低计算和存储开销的同时保持模型效果。作者提出了 DB-LLM，一种双二值化方法：在微观层面用 Flexible Dual Binarization 将 2-bit 权重拆成两组二值表示，在保证表示能力的同时保留二值运算的高效率。 在宏观层面，作者发现量化后预测会出现与样本歧义相关的偏差，并提出 Deviation-Aware Distillation 来让模型对不同样本进行差异化学习。实验表明，该方法在超低比特量化上明显优于已有方法，同时还能进一步降低计算消耗。
classic:480a0597ae4e.tldr: DB-LLM 通过“灵活双二值化 + 偏差感知蒸馏”提升了超低比特 LLM 量化的精度与效率。
classic:480a0597ae4e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它直接解决了 LLM 超低比特量化中最棘手的精度损失问题，而且方法设计同时兼顾了表示能力和运算效率。作为量化方向的经典参考，它很好地展示了如何从微观权重表示和宏观训练策略两层一起优化压缩模型。

classic:d792da3f8523.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) face significant deployment challenges due to their substantial memory requirements and the computational demands of auto-regressive text generation process. This paper addresses these challenges by focusing on the quantization of LLMs, a technique that reduces memory consumption by converting model parameters and activations into low-bit integers. We critically analyze the existing quantization approaches, identifying their limitations in balancing the accuracy and efficiency of the quantized LLMs. To advance beyond these limitations, we propose WKVQuant, a PTQ framework especially designed for quantizing weights and the key/value (KV) cache of LLMs. Specifically, we incorporates past-only quantization to improve the computation of attention. Additionally, we introduce two-dimensional quantization strategy to handle the distribution of KV cache, along with a cross-block reconstruction regularization for parameter optimization. Experiments show that WKVQuant achieves almost comparable memory savings to weight-activation quantization, while also approaching the performance of weight-only quantization.
classic:d792da3f8523.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型部署时的核心瓶颈：模型权重和自回归生成过程中不断增长的 KV cache 会带来很高的显存与计算开销。作者分析了现有量化方法在精度和效率之间的权衡问题，并提出了一个面向权重与 KV cache 的后训练量化框架 WKVQuant。该方法结合过去信息优先的量化策略、针对 KV 分布的二维量化，以及跨块重建正则化来提升注意力计算和参数优化效果。实验表明，WKVQuant 在节省内存方面接近权重-激活量化，同时性能又接近仅量化权重的方法。
classic:d792da3f8523.tldr: WKVQuant 提出一种同时量化权重和 KV cache 的后训练量化框架，在显存节省与模型性能之间取得了更好的平衡。
classic:d792da3f8523.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型推理时的显存优化，这篇文章很值得看，因为它直接针对最难压缩的 KV cache 给出了专门设计。作为经典参考，它展示了如何在不大幅牺牲效果的前提下，把量化做得更贴近真实部署需求。

classic:e54c5a5d22b0.abstract: In this work we show that the size versus accuracy trade-off of neural network quantization can be significantly improved by increasing the quantization dimensionality. We propose the GPTVQ method, a new fast method for post-training vector quantization (VQ) that scales well to Large Language Models (LLMs). Our method interleaves quantization of one or more columns with updates to the remaining unquantized weights, using information from the Hessian of the per-layer output reconstruction MSE. Quantization codebooks are initialized using an efficient data-aware version of the EM algorithm. The codebooks are then updated, and further compressed by using integer quantization and SVD-based compression. GPTVQ establishes a new state-of-the art in the size vs accuracy trade-offs on a wide range of LLMs such as Llama-v2 and Mistral. Furthermore, our method is efficient: on a single H100 it takes between 3 and 11 hours to process a Llamav2-70B model, depending on quantization setting. Lastly, with on-device timings for VQ decompression on a mobile CPU we show that VQ leads to improved latency compared to using a 4-bit integer format.
classic:e54c5a5d22b0.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型量化中的“尺寸-精度”权衡问题，指出通过提高量化维度可以显著改善压缩效果。作者提出了 GPTVQ，一种适用于 LLM 的快速后训练向量量化方法，它利用每层输出重建误差的 Hessian 信息，交替量化部分权重并更新剩余权重，以减少精度损失。方法还采用了数据感知的 EM 初始化、码本更新以及整数量化和基于 SVD 的压缩，使其在 Llama-v2、Mistral 等模型上取得了新的最优结果。实验表明，GPTVQ 不仅压缩性能强，而且在单卡 H100 上处理大模型的速度也较高，并且在移动端解压延迟上优于 4-bit 整数格式。
classic:e54c5a5d22b0.tldr: GPTVQ 通过提高量化维度，让 LLM 压缩在大小和精度之间取得更好的平衡。
classic:e54c5a5d22b0.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它给出了一个实用且高效的 LLM 后训练量化方案，并在多个主流模型上验证了效果。对于想了解向量量化如何在真实大模型上超越传统 4-bit 量化的人来说，它是很好的参考。

classic:b739f8311e31.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have greatly advanced the natural language processing paradigm. However, the high computational load and huge model sizes pose a grand challenge for deployment on edge devices. To this end, we propose APTQ (Attention-aware Post-Training Mixed-Precision Quantization) for LLMs, which considers not only the second-order information of each layer's weights, but also, for the first time, the nonlinear effect of attention outputs on the entire model. We leverage the Hessian trace as a sensitivity metric for mixed-precision quantization, ensuring an informed precision reduction that retains model performance. Experiments show APTQ surpasses previous quantization methods, achieving an average of 4 bit width a 5.22 perplexity nearly equivalent to full precision in the C4 dataset. In addition, APTQ attains state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracy of 68.24\% and 70.48\% at an average bitwidth of 3.8 in LLaMa-7B and LLaMa-13B, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness to produce high-quality quantized LLMs.
classic:b739f8311e31.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大语言模型参数规模大、推理计算重的问题，研究如何在尽量不损失精度的前提下进行后训练量化。作者提出 APTQ，一种注意力感知的后训练混合精度量化方法，不仅考虑各层权重的二阶信息，还首次引入注意力输出对整体模型的非线性影响。方法中使用 Hessian trace 作为敏感度指标来分配不同层的量化比特宽度，从而更有针对性地降低精度。实验表明，APTQ 在多个 LLM 上取得了接近全精度的性能，并优于此前量化方法，具有较强的部署价值。
classic:b739f8311e31.tldr: APTQ 通过注意力感知的混合精度后训练量化，让大语言模型在低比特下仍能保持接近全精度的表现。
classic:b739f8311e31.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，是因为它把 LLM 量化从“只看权重”推进到“同时看注意力影响”，更贴近模型真实敏感性。作为经典参考，它展示了如何用更精细的敏感度分析来做高质量的混合精度量化。

classic:f513a89b640f.abstract: Increasing the number of parameters in large language models (LLMs) usually improves performance in downstream tasks but raises compute and memory costs, making deployment difficult in resource-limited settings. Quantization techniques, which reduce the bits needed for model weights or activations with minimal performance loss, have become popular due to the rise of LLMs. However, most quantization studies use pre-trained LLMs, and the impact of quantization on instruction-tuned LLMs and the relationship between perplexity and benchmark performance of quantized LLMs are not well understood. Evaluation of quantized LLMs is often limited to language modeling and a few classification tasks, leaving their performance on other benchmarks unclear. To address these gaps, we propose a structured evaluation framework consisting of three critical dimensions: (1) knowledge \& capacity, (2) alignment, and (3) efficiency, and conduct extensive experiments across ten diverse benchmarks. Our experimental results indicate that LLMs with 4-bit quantization can retain performance comparable to their non-quantized counterparts, and perplexity can serve as a proxy metric for quantized LLMs on most benchmarks. Furthermore, quantized LLMs with larger parameter scales can outperform smaller LLMs. Despite the memory savings achieved through quantization, it can also slow down the inference speed of LLMs. Consequently, substantial engineering efforts and hardware support are imperative to achieve a balanced optimization of decoding speed and memory consumption in the context of quantized LLMs.
classic:f513a89b640f.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦大语言模型量化在真实部署中的效果与代价，针对以往研究多只看预训练模型、评测维度单一的问题展开系统分析。作者提出了一个三维评测框架，分别从知识与能力、对齐性和效率三个角度考察量化模型，并在十个不同基准上进行实验。结果表明，4-bit 量化通常可以保持与未量化模型相近的性能，而且困惑度在多数任务上可作为量化模型的近似指标。论文还指出，量化虽然节省显存，但可能降低推理速度，因此需要结合工程优化和硬件支持来实现更均衡的部署。
classic:f513a89b640f.tldr: 系统评测表明，LLM 做到 4-bit 量化时通常还能保持接近原模型的效果，但推理速度未必更快。
classic:f513a89b640f.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是只讨论“能不能量化”，而是系统回答“量化后性能、对齐和效率会怎样变化”。对于想把大模型部署到资源受限环境中的研究者或工程师来说，它是一篇很实用的参考。

classic:446220cb4bad.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising technique to reduce the cost of large language models (LLMs). Specifically, PTQ can effectively mitigate memory consumption and reduce computational overhead in LLMs. To meet the requirements of both high efficiency and performance across diverse scenarios, a comprehensive evaluation of quantized LLMs is essential to guide the selection of quantization methods. This paper presents a thorough evaluation of these factors by evaluating the effect of PTQ on Weight, Activation, and KV Cache on 11 model families, including OPT, LLaMA2, Falcon, Bloomz, Mistral, ChatGLM, Vicuna, LongChat, StableLM, Gemma, and Mamba, with parameters ranging from 125M to 180B. The evaluation encompasses five types of tasks: basic NLP, emergent ability, trustworthiness, dialogue, and long-context tasks. Moreover, we also evaluate the state-of-the-art (SOTA) quantization methods to demonstrate their applicability. Based on the extensive experiments, we systematically summarize the effect of quantization, provide recommendations to apply quantization techniques, and point out future directions. The code can be found in https://github.com/thu-nics/qllm-eval.
classic:446220cb4bad.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注后训练量化（PTQ）在大语言模型中的实际效果，核心问题是如何在降低显存和计算开销的同时尽量保持模型性能。作者对权重、激活值和 KV Cache 的量化影响进行了系统评测，覆盖 11 个模型家族、从 125M 到 180B 的多种规模。实验任务也很全面，包括基础 NLP、涌现能力、可信度、对话和长上下文任务。论文最后总结了量化带来的影响，并给出方法选择建议和未来研究方向。
classic:446220cb4bad.tldr: 这是一篇面向大语言模型量化的系统评测论文，帮助你了解不同量化策略在真实任务中的性能与代价。
classic:446220cb4bad.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解量化方法在 LLM 上到底“能省多少、会掉多少”，这篇文章很值得看。它不是提出单一新算法，而是提供了一个覆盖面很广的评测框架和实践建议，适合作为后续研究和工程部署的参考。

classic:043f9043ccc0.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated state-of-the-art performance across various tasks. However, the latency of inference and the large GPU memory consumption of LLMs restrict their deployment performance. Recently, there have been some efficient attempts to quantize LLMs, yet inference with large batch size or long sequence still has the issue of being compute-bound.
