Fine-grained quantization methods have showcased their proficiency in achieving low-bit quantization for LLMs, while requiring FP16 data type for linear layer computations, which is time-consuming when dealing with large batch size or long sequence. In this paper, we introduce a method called FlattenQuant, which significantly reduces the maximum value of the tensor by flattening the large channels in the tensor, to achieve low bit per-tensor quantization with minimal accuracy loss. Our experiments show that FlattenQuant can directly use 4 bits to achieve 48.29% of the linear layer calculation in LLMs, with the remaining layers using 8 bits. The 4-bit matrix multiplication introduced in the FlattenQuant method can effectively address the compute-bound caused by large matrix calculation. Our work achieves up to 2$\times$ speedup and 2.3$\times$ memory reduction for LLMs with negligible loss in accuracy.
classic:043f9043ccc0.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于大语言模型在推理阶段面临的两个核心瓶颈：计算开销过大和显存占用过高，尤其是在大 batch 或长序列场景下容易变成 compute-bound。作者提出 FlattenQuant，通过“扁平化”张量中的大通道来降低最大值范围，从而实现低比特的 per-tensor 量化，并尽量减少精度损失。该方法可以直接让部分线性层使用 4 bit 计算，其余层使用 8 bit，从而缓解传统低比特量化仍依赖 FP16 计算的问题。实验表明，FlattenQuant 在几乎不损失精度的前提下，可带来最高 2 倍推理加速和 2.3 倍显存降低。
classic:043f9043ccc0.tldr: FlattenQuant 通过扁平化张量通道实现高效 per-tensor 4-bit 量化，显著缓解大模型推理的计算瓶颈并降低显存占用。
classic:043f9043ccc0.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它针对的是 LLM 部署中非常实际的推理加速问题，尤其适合大 batch 和长上下文场景。作为量化方向的经典参考，它展示了如何在尽量少损失精度的情况下，把低比特量化真正落到高效推理上。

classic:33b3be39883a.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in Large-scale language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance on various tasks. The immense sizes of LLMs have led to very high resource demand and cost for running the models. Though the models are largely served using uniform high-caliber GPUs nowadays, utilizing a heterogeneous cluster with a mix of available high- and low-capacity GPUs can potentially substantially reduce the serving cost. There is a lack of designs to support efficient LLM serving using a heterogeneous cluster, while the current solutions focus on model partition and uniform compression among homogeneous devices. This paper proposes LLM-PQ, a system that advocates adaptive model quantization and phase-aware partition to improve LLM serving efficiency on heterogeneous GPU clusters. We carefully decide on mixed-precision model quantization together with phase-aware model partition and micro-batch sizing in distributed LLM serving with an efficient algorithm, to greatly enhance inference throughput while fulfilling user-specified model quality targets. Extensive experiments on production inference workloads in 11 different clusters demonstrate that LLM-PQ achieves up to 2.88x (2.26x on average) throughput improvement in inference, showing great advantages over state-of-the-art works.
classic:33b3be39883a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在异构 GPU 集群上的高效部署问题，指出现有做法往往依赖统一的高性能 GPU，导致推理成本较高。作者提出 LLM-PQ，将自适应量化、相位感知的模型切分和 micro-batch 大小联合优化，以适配高低能力混合的集群资源。该方法在满足用户指定模型质量目标的前提下，显著提升了分布式推理吞吐量。实验覆盖 11 个不同集群，结果表明其在真实推理负载下具有很强的实用价值。
classic:33b3be39883a.tldr: LLM-PQ 通过自适应量化和相位感知切分，让大模型能更高效地跑在异构 GPU 集群上，最高提升 2.88 倍推理吞吐。
classic:33b3be39883a.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“如何低成本服务大模型”这个实际问题，落到了异构集群与量化协同优化的系统设计上。作为经典参考，它能帮助理解大模型推理部署中模型切分、量化和负载调度之间的关系。

classic:7f7e6e2b7413.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel in natural language processing but demand intensive computation. To mitigate this, various quantization methods have been explored, yet they compromise LLM performance. This paper unveils a previously overlooked type of outliers in LLMs. Such outliers are found to allocate most of the attention scores on initial tokens of input, termed as pivot tokens, which are crucial to the performance of quantized LLMs. Given that, we propose IntactKV to generate the KV cache of pivot tokens losslessly from the full-precision model. The approach is simple and easy to combine with existing quantization solutions with no extra inference overhead. Besides, IntactKV can be calibrated as additional LLM parameters to boost the quantized LLMs further with minimal training costs. Mathematical analysis also proves that IntactKV effectively reduces the upper bound of quantization error. Empirical results show that IntactKV brings consistent improvement over various quantization methods across different LLMs and downstream tasks, leading to the new state-of-the-art for LLM quantization. The codes are available at https://github.com/ruikangliu/IntactKV.
classic:7f7e6e2b7413.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化后性能下降的问题，指出其中一个常被忽视的原因是注意力中的“pivot tokens”会承载大量关键权重。作者发现这些位于输入开头的 token 对量化后的模型表现尤其重要，因此提出 IntactKV，在量化时将这些关键 token 的 KV cache 直接从全精度模型中无损保留。该方法实现简单，可与现有量化方案直接结合，且不会带来额外推理开销。实验表明，IntactKV 在多种模型和任务上都能稳定提升量化效果，并刷新了多项结果。
classic:7f7e6e2b7413.tldr: IntactKV 通过无损保留关键的 pivot tokens 的 KV cache，显著提升了大模型量化后的性能。
classic:7f7e6e2b7413.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它抓住了量化误差中一个很具体但影响很大的问题：少数关键 token 会主导注意力分配。它的方法简单、可插拔、几乎不增加推理成本，很适合作为大模型量化方向的经典参考。

classic:05666b25e623.abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) on edge or mobile devices offers significant benefits, such as enhanced data privacy and real-time processing capabilities. However, it also faces critical challenges due to the substantial memory requirement of LLMs. Quantization is an effective way of reducing the model size while maintaining good performance. However, even after quantization, LLMs may still be too big to fit entirely into the limited memory of edge or mobile devices and have to be partially loaded from the storage to complete the inference. In this case, the I/O latency of model loading becomes the bottleneck of the LLM inference latency. In this work, we take a preliminary step of studying applying data compression techniques to reduce data movement and thus speed up the inference of quantized LLM on memory-constrained devices. In particular, we discussed the compressibility of quantized LLMs, the trade-off between the compressibility and performance of quantized LLMs, and opportunities to optimize both of them jointly.
classic:05666b25e623.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注一个很实际的问题：量化后的大语言模型虽然更小，但在边缘设备或手机上仍可能太大，导致推理时需要频繁从存储中加载参数，I/O 延迟成为瓶颈。作者进一步提出，可以用数据压缩技术减少量化模型的数据搬运，从而提升推理速度。论文系统讨论了量化 LLM 的可压缩性，以及压缩率与模型性能之间的权衡关系。它的价值在于把“量化之后还不够小”这一部署痛点明确提出来，并给出进一步优化的研究方向。
classic:05666b25e623.tldr: 研究量化大语言模型在内存受限设备上的可压缩性，探索用压缩减少数据搬运并加速推理。
classic:05666b25e623.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为经典参考，因为它切中了量化模型部署到端侧时的真实瓶颈：不是算力，而是内存和 I/O。它帮助读者理解量化之后为什么还需要进一步考虑压缩，以及如何平衡速度、体积和性能。

classic:87d10c62a3c5.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have proven to be very superior to conventional methods in various tasks. However, their expensive computations and high memory requirements are prohibitive for deployment. Model quantization is an effective method for reducing this overhead. The problem is that in most previous works, the quantized model was calibrated using few samples from the training data, which might affect the generalization of the quantized LLMs to unknown cases and tasks. Hence in this work, we explore an important question: Can we design a data-independent quantization method for LLMs to guarantee its generalization performance? In this work, we propose EasyQuant, a training-free and data-independent weight-only quantization algorithm for LLMs. Our observation indicates that two factors: outliers in the weight and quantization ranges, are essential for reducing the quantization error. Therefore, in EasyQuant, we leave the outliers (less than 1%) unchanged and optimize the quantization range to reduce the reconstruction error. With these methods, we surprisingly find that EasyQuant achieves comparable performance to the original model. Since EasyQuant does not depend on any training data, the generalization performance of quantized LLMs is safely guaranteed. Moreover, EasyQuant can be implemented in parallel so that the quantized model could be attained in a few minutes even for LLMs over 100B. To our best knowledge, we are the first work that achieves almost lossless quantization performance for LLMs under a data-independent setting and our algorithm runs over 10 times faster than the data-dependent methods.
classic:87d10c62a3c5.summary_zh: 这篇论文讨论了大语言模型量化中的一个关键问题：如何在不依赖训练数据的情况下，仍然保持量化后的模型性能。作者提出了 EasyQuant，一种无需训练、无需数据的权重量化方法，通过保留少量异常值并优化量化范围来降低重构误差。实验结果表明，该方法在多种 LLM 上能达到接近原模型的效果，同时避免了数据校准带来的泛化风险。由于可并行实现，EasyQuant 还能显著加速超大模型的量化过程，适合实际部署。
classic:87d10c62a3c5.tldr: EasyQuant 提出了一种无需数据校准的 LLM 权重量化方法，能以很高速度实现接近无损的压缩效果。
classic:87d10c62a3c5.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为 LLM 量化方向的经典参考，因为它直接回答了“能否在没有数据的情况下做高质量量化”这一实际难题。它的核心思路简单而有效，兼顾了理论上的数据独立性和工程上的高效率。

classic:8f83a44feb42.abstract: Quantization has emerged as a promising technique for improving the memory and computational efficiency of large language models (LLMs). Though the trade-off between performance and efficiency is well-known, there is still much to be learned about the relationship between quantization and LLM performance. To shed light on this relationship, we propose a new perspective on quantization, viewing it as perturbations added to the weights and activations of LLMs. We call this approach "the lens of perturbation". Using this lens, we conduct experiments with various artificial perturbations to explore their impact on LLM performance. Our findings reveal several connections between the properties of perturbations and LLM performance, providing insights into the failure cases of uniform quantization and suggesting potential solutions to improve the robustness of LLM quantization. To demonstrate the significance of our findings, we implement a simple non-uniform quantization approach based on our insights. Our experiments show that this approach achieves minimal performance degradation on both 4-bit weight quantization and 8-bit quantization for weights and activations. These results validate the correctness of our approach and highlight its potential to improve the efficiency of LLMs without sacrificing performance.
classic:8f83a44feb42.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化为什么这么难，尤其是为什么简单的一致性量化会带来明显性能损失。作者提出把量化看作对权重和激活引入“扰动”的新视角，并通过人工扰动实验分析不同扰动特性对模型表现的影响。实验结果揭示了扰动性质与性能退化之间的若干关联，解释了量化失败的部分原因。基于这些发现，论文进一步设计了一个简单的非均匀量化方法，在 4-bit 权重量化和 8-bit 权重/激活量化上都取得了较小的性能下降。
classic:8f83a44feb42.tldr: 从“扰动”的角度重新理解 LLM 量化，解释了均匀量化为何容易失效，并给出更稳健的非均匀量化方案。
classic:8f83a44feb42.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为量化方向的经典参考，因为它不只做经验比较，还尝试从机制上解释量化误差如何影响大模型性能。对于想理解 LLM 低比特压缩为何会掉点、以及如何改进量化设计的人，这篇文章很有启发性。

classic:49e84bcb2668.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在低比特量化后精度下降的问题，目标是在尽量减少性能损失的同时降低模型存储和推理开销。作者提出了 Affine Transformation Quantization（AffineQuant）方法，通过仿射变换来更灵活地适配权重或激活分布，从而提升量化后的表示能力。相比传统量化方案，它更能缓解分布偏移和离群值带来的误差。该方法为大模型部署提供了一种更稳健的高效压缩思路。
classic:49e84bcb2668.tldr: AffineQuant 用仿射变换增强低比特量化的表达能力，帮助大语言模型在压缩后尽量保持精度。
classic:49e84bcb2668.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注大模型压缩和部署的人阅读，因为它针对“量化后精度掉得太多”这个核心难题提出了更灵活的解决办法。作为 ICLR 2024 的工作，它也很适合作为理解现代 LLM 量化方法的经典参考。

classic:54b2caa004db.abstract: Large generative models such as large language models (LLMs) and diffusion models have revolutionized the fields of NLP and computer vision respectively. However, their slow inference, high computation and memory requirement makes it challenging to deploy them on edge devices. In this study, we propose a light-weight quantization aware fine tuning technique using knowledge distillation (KD-QAT) to improve the performance of 4-bit weight quantized LLMs using commonly available datasets to realize a popular language use case, on device chat applications. To improve this paradigm of finetuning, as main contributions, we provide insights into stability of KD-QAT by empirically studying the gradient propagation during training to better understand the vulnerabilities of KD-QAT based approaches to low-bit quantization errors. Based on our insights, we propose ov-freeze, a simple technique to stabilize the KD-QAT process. Finally, we experiment with the popular 7B LLaMAv2-Chat model at 4-bit quantization level and demonstrate that ov-freeze results in near floating point precision performance, i.e., less than 0.7% loss of accuracy on Commonsense Reasoning benchmarks.
classic:54b2caa004db.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在低比特量化后性能下降、难以部署到边缘设备的问题。作者提出一种轻量级的量化感知微调方法，结合知识蒸馏来提升4-bit量化LLM的效果，并通过分析训练中的梯度传播来解释其不稳定性。基于这些观察，论文提出了 ov-freeze 技巧，用于稳定 KD-QAT 训练过程。实验表明，在 7B LLaMAv2-Chat 上，方法能把性能提升到接近浮点精度，常识推理任务上的精度损失小于 0.7%。
classic:54b2caa004db.tldr: 通过分析量化蒸馏中的梯度传播并提出 ov-freeze，显著稳定了 4-bit LLM 微调，几乎恢复浮点模型性能。
classic:54b2caa004db.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它把“为什么量化蒸馏会不稳定”讲清楚了，并给出一个很轻量、很实用的修正方法。对于想把大模型部署到端侧或做低资源推理的人来说，它是一个很好的经典参考。

classic:1e378cf531bb.abstract: The demand for inference on extremely large scale LLMs has seen enormous growth in the recent months. It made evident the colossal shortage of dedicated hardware capable of efficient and fast processing of the involved compute and memory movement. The problem is aggravated by the exploding raise in the lengths of the sequences being processed, since those require efficient on-chip storage of the KV-cache of size proportional to the sequence length. To make the required compute feasible and fit the involved data into available memory, numerous quantization techniques have been proposed that allow accurate quantization for both weights and activations. One of the main recent breakthroughs in this direction was introduction of the family of Block Floating Point (BFP) formats characterized by a block of mantissas with a shared scale factor. These enable memory- power-, and compute- efficient hardware support of the tensor operations and provide extremely good quantization accuracy. The main issues preventing widespread application of block formats is caused by the presence of outliers in weights and activations since those affect the accuracy of the other values in the same block. In this paper, we focus on the most critical problem of limited KV-cache storage. We propose a novel approach enabling usage of low precision BFP formats without compromising the resulting model accuracy. We exploit the common channel-wise patterns exhibited by the outliers to rearrange them in such a way, that their quantization quality is significantly improved. The methodology yields 2x savings in the memory footprint without significant degradation of the model's accuracy. Importantly, the rearrangement of channels happens at the compile time and thus has no impact on the inference latency.
classic:1e378cf531bb.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理中 KV-cache 存储占用过大、而低精度量化又容易受异常值影响的矛盾。作者针对块浮点数（BFP）格式在存在 outliers 时精度下降的问题，提出利用异常值的通道级模式对通道进行重排，从而提升同一块内的量化质量。该方法主要面向 KV-cache 压缩场景，可以在不明显损失模型精度的前提下实现约 2 倍内存节省。更重要的是，重排发生在编译期，因此不会增加推理时延，兼顾了实用性和硬件友好性。
classic:1e378cf531bb.tldr: 通过编译期通道重排缓解 outliers 对块量化的影响，让 LLM 的 KV-cache 在几乎不掉点的情况下实现约 2 倍压缩。
classic:1e378cf531bb.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它直接瞄准了大模型推理里最现实的瓶颈之一：KV-cache 太大、量化又容易被异常值破坏。它提供了一个简单但很实用的工程思路，适合作为理解 LLM 低比特量化和 outlier 处理的经典参考。

classic:38392340ee38.abstract: We introduce QuaRot, a new Quantization scheme based on Rotations, which is able to quantize LLMs end-to-end, including all weights, activations, and KV cache in 4 bits. QuaRot rotates LLMs in a way that removes outliers from the hidden state without changing the output, making quantization easier. This computational invariance is applied to the hidden state (residual) of the LLM, as well as to the activations of the feed-forward components, aspects of the attention mechanism, and to the KV cache. The result is a quantized model where all matrix multiplications are performed in 4 bits, without any channels identified for retention in higher precision. Our 4-bit quantized LLaMa2-70B model has losses of at most 0.47 WikiText-2 perplexity and retains 99% of the zero-shot performance. We also show that QuaRot can provide lossless 6 and 8 bit LLaMa2 models without any calibration data using round-to-nearest quantization. Code is available at: https://github.com/spcl/QuaRot.
classic:38392340ee38.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出了 QuaRot，一种基于旋转变换的量化方法，目标是在不改变模型输出的前提下消除大语言模型中的异常值。它可以把 LLM 的权重、激活值以及 KV cache 全部端到端压到 4 bit，并且不需要为某些通道保留更高精度。作者将这种“计算不变性”应用到残差、前馈网络、注意力机制和缓存中，使所有矩阵乘法都能在 4 bit 下完成。实验表明，4 bit 的 LLaMa2-70B 仍能保持接近原模型的困惑度和零样本性能。
classic:38392340ee38.tldr: QuaRot 通过旋转去除异常值，实现了 LLM 权重、激活和 KV cache 的全 4 bit 量化且几乎不掉点。
classic:38392340ee38.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“如何让大模型真正端到端低比特运行”推进了一步，不只是压缩权重，而是连激活和缓存都一起量化。它是理解异常值处理、旋转量化和高效推理设计的重要经典参考。

classic:904dad3a529d.abstract: Quantization is a promising method that reduces memory usage and computational intensity of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), but it often leads to significant output error that hinder model deployment. In this paper, we propose Bias Compensation (BC) to minimize the output error, thus realizing ultra-low-precision quantization without model fine-tuning. Instead of optimizing the non-convex quantization process as in most previous methods, the proposed BC bypasses the step to directly minimize the quantizing output error by identifying a bias vector for compensation. We have established that the minimization of output error through BC is a convex problem and provides an efficient strategy to procure optimal solutions associated with minimal output error,without the need for training or fine-tuning. We conduct extensive experiments on Vision Transformer models and Large Language Models, and the results show that our method notably reduces quantization output error, thereby permitting ultra-low-precision post-training quantization and enhancing the task performance of models. Especially, BC improves the accuracy of ViT-B with 4-bit PTQ4ViT by 36.89% on the ImageNet-1k task, and decreases the perplexity of OPT-350M with 3-bit GPTQ by 5.97 on WikiText2.The code is in https://github.com/GongCheng1919/bias-compensation.
classic:904dad3a529d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注深度神经网络量化后常见的输出误差过大问题，因为误差过大会直接影响模型部署效果。作者提出 Bias Compensation（BC）方法，不再像传统方法那样优化复杂的非凸量化过程，而是直接寻找一个偏置向量来补偿量化输出误差。论文证明这一误差最小化问题是凸的，因此可以高效求得最优解，而且不需要训练或微调。实验表明，BC 能显著降低 ViT 和大语言模型的量化误差，并支持更低比特的后训练量化。
classic:904dad3a529d.tldr: 提出一种无需微调的 Bias Compensation 方法，直接补偿量化输出误差，实现更低比特且更高精度的后训练量化。
classic:904dad3a529d.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它抓住了量化部署中的核心痛点——输出误差，而不是只做经验性的参数调节。作为经典参考，它展示了一种数学上更清晰、实现上更高效的低比特量化思路。

classic:988c186b8b08.abstract: This paper reveals the phenomenon of parameter heterogeneity in large language models (LLMs). We find that a small subset of "cherry" parameters exhibit a disproportionately large influence on model performance, while the vast majority of parameters have minimal impact. This heterogeneity is found to be prevalent across different model families, scales, and types. Motivated by this observation, we propose CherryQ, a novel quantization method that unifies the optimization of mixed-precision parameters. CherryQ identifies and preserves the critical cherry parameters in high precision while aggressively quantizing the remaining parameters to low precision. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of CherryQ. CherryQ outperforms existing quantization approaches in terms of perplexity and downstream task performance. Notably, our 3-bit quantized Vicuna-1.5 exhibits competitive performance compared to their 16-bit counterparts.
classic:988c186b8b08.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型中的参数异质性问题，发现只有一小部分“cherry”参数对模型性能有显著影响，而大多数参数的作用相对很小。基于这一观察，作者提出了 CherryQ，一种统一优化混合精度参数的量化方法。CherryQ 会保留关键参数的高精度表示，同时对其余参数进行更激进的低比特量化。实验表明，该方法在困惑度和下游任务表现上都优于现有量化方案，甚至让 3-bit 的 Vicuna-1.5 接近 16-bit 模型的效果。
classic:988c186b8b08.tldr: 发现 LLM 里少量“关键参数”决定大部分性能，并据此提出 CherryQ，实现更激进量化同时保持高精度表现。
classic:988c186b8b08.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它从“参数并不均匀重要”这个角度重新理解了大模型量化。它既给出了清晰的经验发现，也提供了能直接提升压缩效率的实用方法，适合作为量化方向的经典参考。

classic:fa410d4b116f.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained widespread adoption across various domains, including chatbots and auto-task completion agents. However, these models are susceptible to safety vulnerabilities such as jailbreaking, prompt injection, and privacy leakage attacks. These vulnerabilities can lead to the generation of malicious content, unauthorized actions, or the disclosure of confidential information. While foundational LLMs undergo alignment training and incorporate safety measures, they are often subject to fine-tuning, or doing quantization resource-constrained environments. This study investigates the impact of these modifications on LLM safety, a critical consideration for building reliable and secure AI systems. We evaluate foundational models including Mistral, Llama series, Qwen, and MosaicML, along with their fine-tuned variants. Our comprehensive analysis reveals that fine-tuning generally increases the success rates of jailbreak attacks, while quantization has variable effects on attack success rates. Importantly, we find that properly implemented guardrails significantly enhance resistance to jailbreak attempts. These findings contribute to our understanding of LLM vulnerabilities and provide insights for developing more robust safety strategies in the deployment of language models.
classic:fa410d4b116f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在真实部署中面临的安全风险，尤其是越狱、提示注入和隐私泄露等问题。作者系统评估了 Mistral、Llama、Qwen、MosaicML 等基础模型及其微调版本，比较了微调和量化对安全性的影响。结果显示，微调通常会提高越狱攻击的成功率，而量化的影响则不稳定、因模型和设置而异。论文还发现，设计得当的防护机制能够显著增强模型对越狱攻击的抵抗能力。
classic:fa410d4b116f.tldr: 微调往往会让 LLM 更容易被越狱，量化的安全影响则不固定，而有效的 guardrails 能明显提升防护效果。
classic:fa410d4b116f.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它直接回答了一个很实用的问题：把模型微调或量化之后，安全性会不会变差。对于想把 LLM 用到产品中的人来说，它是理解“性能提升”和“安全退化”之间权衡的经典参考。

classic:13184ddc7829.abstract: In this paper, we introduce an algorithm for data quantization based on the principles of Kashin representation. This approach hinges on decomposing any given vector, matrix, or tensor into two factors. The first factor maintains a small infinity norm, while the second exhibits a similarly constrained norm when multiplied by an orthogonal matrix. Surprisingly, the entries of factors after decomposition are well-concentrated around several peaks, which allows us to efficiently replace them with corresponding centroids for quantization purposes. We study the theoretical properties of the proposed approach and rigorously evaluate our compression algorithm in the context of next-word prediction tasks and on a set of downstream tasks for text classification. Our findings demonstrate that Kashin Quantization achieves competitive or superior quality in model performance while ensuring data compression, marking a significant advancement in the field of data quantization.
classic:13184ddc7829.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究如何在尽量不损失模型效果的前提下，对大语言模型进行高效量化与压缩。作者基于 Kashin 表示提出一种分解算法，把向量、矩阵或张量拆成两个因子，并控制它们的幅值范围，使得后续量化更稳定。由于分解后的参数分布会集中在若干峰值附近，论文可以用少量质心替代原始数值，从而实现更强压缩。实验表明，该方法在下一词预测和文本分类等任务上能取得具有竞争力甚至更好的性能。
classic:13184ddc7829.tldr: 基于 Kashin 表示的“过完备基量化”方法，在保持模型精度的同时实现了高效压缩。
classic:13184ddc7829.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它从理论和实验两方面给出了一个很有新意的量化思路，不只是压缩模型，还尽量保持了大模型的性能。对于想了解大模型低比特量化、表示分解和压缩方法的人来说，它是一个很好的经典参考。

classic:8df5e6c0f236.abstract: The LLaMA family, a collection of foundation language models ranging from 7B to 65B parameters, has become one of the most powerful open-source large language models (LLMs) and the popular LLM backbone of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs), widely used in computer vision and natural language understanding tasks. In particular, LLaMA3 models have recently been released and have achieved impressive performance in various domains with super-large scale pre-training on over 15T tokens of data. Given the wide application of low-bit quantization for LLMs in resource-constrained scenarios, we explore LLaMA3's capabilities when quantized to low bit-width. This exploration can potentially provide new insights and challenges for the low-bit quantization of LLaMA3 and other future LLMs, especially in addressing performance degradation issues that suffer in LLM compression. Specifically, we comprehensively evaluate the 10 existing post-training quantization and LoRA fine-tuning (LoRA-FT) methods of LLaMA3 on 1-8 bits and various datasets to reveal the low-bit quantization performance of LLaMA3. To uncover the capabilities of low-bit quantized MLLM, we assessed the performance of the LLaMA3-based LLaVA-Next-8B model under 2-4 ultra-low bits with post-training quantization methods. Our experimental results indicate that LLaMA3 still suffers from non-negligible degradation in linguistic and visual contexts, particularly under ultra-low bit widths. This highlights the significant performance gap at low bit-width that needs to be addressed in future developments. We expect that this empirical study will prove valuable in advancing future models, driving LLMs and MLLMs to achieve higher accuracy at lower bit to enhance practicality. Our project is released on https://github.com/M…
classic:8df5e6c0f236.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了 LLaMA3 在低比特量化下的实际表现，关注在资源受限场景中如何压缩大模型同时尽量保持性能。作者系统评估了 10 种现有的后训练量化方法和 LoRA 微调方法，覆盖 1 到 8 比特，并在多个数据集上进行测试。实验结果表明，LLaMA3 在超低比特下仍会出现明显的语言理解和视觉任务性能退化。本文的价值在于它为低比特量化 LLaMA3 以及未来更大模型提供了重要的经验基线和问题分析。
classic:8df5e6c0f236.tldr: 系统评估表明，LLaMA3 在超低比特量化下仍有明显性能损失，低比特压缩仍需进一步改进。
classic:8df5e6c0f236.simple_intro: 这是一篇很适合做量化方向参考的实证论文，因为它把 LLaMA3 在不同低比特设置下的表现讲得很清楚。对于想了解大模型压缩在真实效果上会损失多少、哪些方法更稳的人，这篇文章很有价值。

classic:725c7c67d37e.abstract: This paper investigates three different parameterizations of asymmetric uniform quantization for quantization-aware training: (1) scale and offset, (2) minimum and maximum, and (3) beta and gamma. We perform a comprehensive comparative analysis of these parameterizations' influence on quantization-aware training, using both controlled experiments and real-world large language models. Our particular focus is on their changing behavior in response to critical training hyperparameters, bit width and learning rate. Based on our investigation, we propose best practices to stabilize and accelerate quantization-aware training with learnable asymmetric quantization ranges.
classic:725c7c67d37e.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了量化感知训练（QAT）中非对称均匀量化范围的参数化方式，重点比较了三种表示法：scale 和 offset、minimum 和 maximum、以及 beta 和 gamma。作者通过受控实验和真实的大语言模型，系统分析了这些参数化方式在不同训练条件下的表现。论文特别关注比特宽度和学习率变化时，量化范围学习的稳定性与行为差异。最终给出了可操作的最佳实践，用于提升可学习非对称量化范围的稳定性和训练速度。
classic:725c7c67d37e.tldr: 系统比较 QAT 中三种非对称量化范围参数化方式，并给出稳定训练的实践建议。
classic:725c7c67d37e.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为量化感知训练里“如何设计可学习量化范围”的参考。它不仅做了方法对比，还直接分析了在大模型和关键超参数变化下的训练行为，因此对实际落地很有指导意义。

classic:f9e0c36b43ba.abstract: We consider the problem of accurate quantization for language models, where both the weights and activations are uniformly quantized to 4 bits per parameter, the lowest bitwidth format natively supported by GPU hardware. In this context, the key challenge is activation quantization: it is known that language models contain outlier channels whose values on average are orders of magnitude higher than than other channels, which prevents accurate low-bitwidth quantization with known techniques. We systematically study this phenomena and find that these outlier channels emerge early in training, and that they occur more frequently in layers with residual streams. We then propose a simple strategy which regularizes a layer's inputs via quantization-aware training (QAT) and its outputs via activation kurtosis regularization. We show that regularizing both the inputs and outputs is crucial for preventing a model's "migrating" the difficulty in input quantization to the weights, which makes post-training quantization (PTQ) of weights more difficult. When combined with weight PTQ, we show that our approach can obtain a W4A4 model that performs competitively to the standard-precision W16A16 baseline.
classic:f9e0c36b43ba.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了语言模型在 4 比特权重和 4 比特激活量化时精度下降的问题，核心困难来自少数异常通道的激活值远高于其他通道，从而破坏了低比特量化的稳定性。作者系统分析了这种异常通道的出现规律，发现它们在训练早期就会形成，并且在含有残差流的层中更常见。为缓解这一问题，论文提出用量化感知训练来正则化输入，并结合激活峰度正则化来约束输出。实验表明，同时约束输入和输出能够避免量化难度从激活“转移”到权重上，并最终得到在性能上接近标准精度基线的 W4A4 模型。
classic:f9e0c36b43ba.tldr: 通过量化感知训练和激活峰度正则化抑制异常通道，提升大语言模型 4bit 权重/激活量化精度。
classic:f9e0c36b43ba.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对低比特量化中最棘手的异常通道问题，给出了简单而有效的训练策略。对于想把大模型部署到 GPU 原生 4bit 格式上的研究和工程实践来说，它是很有参考价值的经典工作。

classic:717a26db062a.abstract: Recent studies introduced effective compression techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs) via post-training quantization or low-bit weight representation. Although quantized weights offer storage efficiency and allow for faster inference, existing works have indicated that quantization might compromise performance and exacerbate biases in LLMs. This study investigates the confidence and calibration of quantized models, considering factors such as language model type and scale as contributors to quantization loss. Firstly, we reveal that quantization with GPTQ to 4-bit results in a decrease in confidence regarding true labels, with varying impacts observed among different language models. Secondly, we observe fluctuations in the impact on confidence across different scales. Finally, we propose an explanation for quantization loss based on confidence levels, indicating that quantization disproportionately affects samples where the full model exhibited low confidence levels in the first place.
classic:717a26db062a.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型在量化后，模型对答案的置信度与校准是否会发生变化。作者发现，使用 GPTQ 将模型量化到 4-bit 后，模型对真实标签的置信度会下降，而且不同模型类型和不同规模的影响并不一致。进一步分析表明，量化带来的损失并不是平均分布的，而是更容易影响那些在完整模型中本来就低置信度的样本。论文从“置信度”角度解释了量化误差，为评估量化模型提供了新的视角。
classic:717a26db062a.tldr: GPTQ 4-bit 量化不只会压缩模型，还会明显影响 LLM 的置信度与校准，尤其伤害原本就不太确定的样本。
classic:717a26db062a.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不只关注量化后的性能掉多少，还进一步分析了“模型有多自信”这一更细的可靠性问题。它适合作为研究 LLM 量化影响、模型校准和推理可信度的经典参考。

classic:2054829a29fe.abstract: Quantization can accelerate large language model (LLM) inference. Going beyond INT8 quantization, the research community is actively exploring even lower precision, such as INT4. Nonetheless, state-of-the-art INT4 quantization techniques only accelerate low-batch, edge LLM inference, failing to deliver performance gains in large-batch, cloud-based LLM serving. We uncover a critical issue: existing INT4 quantization methods suffer from significant runtime overhead (20-90%) when dequantizing either weights or partial sums on GPUs. To address this challenge, we introduce QoQ, a W4A8KV4 quantization algorithm with 4-bit weight, 8-bit activation, and 4-bit KV cache. QoQ stands for quattuor-octo-quattuor, which represents 4-8-4 in Latin. QoQ is implemented by the QServe inference library that achieves measured speedup. The key insight driving QServe is that the efficiency of LLM serving on GPUs is critically influenced by operations on low-throughput CUDA cores. Building upon this insight, in QoQ algorithm, we introduce progressive quantization that can allow low dequantization overhead in W4A8 GEMM. Additionally, we develop SmoothAttention to effectively mitigate the accuracy degradation incurred by 4-bit KV quantization. In the QServe system, we perform compute-aware weight reordering and take advantage of register-level parallelism to reduce dequantization latency. We also make fused attention memory-bound, harnessing the performance gain brought by KV4 quantization. As a result, QServe improves the maximum achievable serving throughput of Llama-3-8B by 1.2x on A100, 1.4x on L40S; and Qwen1.5-72B by 2.4x on A100, 3.5x on L40S, compared to TensorRT-LLM. Remarkably, QServe on L40S GPU can achieve even higher throughput than TensorRT-LLM on A100. Thus, QServe effectively red…
classic:2054829a29fe.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在云端高并发推理时，INT4 量化虽然能降精度，但常常因为反量化开销过大而难以真正提升吞吐。作者提出了 W4A8KV4 的 QoQ 量化方案，并结合 QServe 系统做软硬件协同优化，以降低 GPU 上低吞吐 CUDA 核心相关操作的成本。方法上包括渐进式量化、SmoothAttention、权重重排和寄存器级并行等设计，既压低反量化延迟，也缓解 KV cache 4bit 带来的精度损失。实验表明，该方案能显著提升 LLM serving 吞吐，并在多款模型和 GPU 上优于 TensorRT-LLM。
classic:2054829a29fe.tldr: QServe 通过 W4A8KV4 量化与系统协同优化，让 INT4 级别的 LLM 云端服务真正获得吞吐收益。
classic:2054829a29fe.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不仅讨论“怎么把模型量化到更低比特”，还直面了真实部署中的性能瓶颈：反量化和系统开销。它是理解 LLM serving 中“算法设计 + 系统实现”如何联合提速的一个很好的经典参考。

classic:0c89e1fd7240.abstract: The increasing size of large language models (LLMs) traditionally requires low-precision integer formats to meet strict latency and power demands. Yet recently, alternative formats such as Normal Float (NF4) have increased model accuracy at the cost of increased chip area. In this work, we first conduct a large-scale analysis of LLM weights and activations across 30 networks and conclude that most distributions follow a Student's t-distribution. We then derive a new theoretically optimal format, Student Float (SF4), that improves over NF4 across modern LLMs, for example increasing the average accuracy on LLaMA2-7B by 0.76% across tasks. Using this format as a high-accuracy reference, we then propose augmenting E2M1 with two variants of supernormal support for higher model accuracy. Finally, we explore the quality and efficiency frontier across 11 datatypes by evaluating their model accuracy and hardware complexity. We discover a Pareto curve composed of INT4, E2M1, and E2M1 with supernormal support, which offers a continuous tradeoff between model accuracy and chip area. For example, E2M1 with supernormal support increases the accuracy of Phi-2 by up to 2.19% with 1.22% area overhead, enabling more LLM-based applications to be run at four bits. The supporting code is hosted at https://github.com/cornell-zhang/llm-datatypes.
classic:0c89e1fd7240.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在低比特量化下如何同时兼顾精度和硬件效率。作者先对30个网络中的LLM权重与激活分布做了大规模分析，发现它们大多符合Student's t分布，而不是常见的假设分布。基于这一发现，论文提出了理论上更合适的Student Float（SF4）格式，并证明它在多种现代LLM上能比NF4获得更高准确率。进一步地，作者还系统比较了11种数据格式的精度与芯片复杂度，给出了更清晰的质量-效率权衡边界。
classic:0c89e1fd7240.tldr: 通过分析LLM分布并设计SF4与增强版E2M1，论文给出了4比特量化中精度与芯片面积之间更优的折中方案。
classic:0c89e1fd7240.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是只做经验性改进，而是先从真实模型分布出发，找到更符合LLM特性的量化形式。它还把不同4比特格式放到同一条精度-硬件曲线上比较，适合作为理解LLM低比特量化设计的经典参考。

classic:0a22f2ba7650.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) are propelling us toward artificial general intelligence with their remarkable emergent abilities and reasoning capabilities. However, the substantial computational and memory requirements limit the widespread adoption. Quantization, a key compression technique, can effectively mitigate these demands by compressing and accelerating LLMs, albeit with potential risks to accuracy. Numerous studies have aimed to minimize the accuracy loss associated with quantization. However, their quantization configurations vary from each other and cannot be fairly compared. In this paper, we present LLMC, a plug-and-play compression toolkit, to fairly and systematically explore the impact of quantization. LLMC integrates dozens of algorithms, models, and hardwares, offering high extensibility from integer to floating-point quantization, from LLM to vision-language (VLM) model, from fixed-bit to mixed precision, and from quantization to sparsification. Powered by this versatile toolkit, our benchmark covers three key aspects: calibration data, algorithms (three strategies), and data formats, providing novel insights and detailed analyses for further research and practical guidance for users. Our toolkit is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/llmc.
classic:0a22f2ba7650.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型后训练量化中的一个核心问题：如何在显著降低计算和显存开销的同时，尽量减少精度损失。作者指出，现有量化研究往往使用不同的配置，导致结果难以公平比较，也缺少统一的实践指导。为此，论文提出了一个可插拔的压缩工具 LLMC，将多种算法、模型和硬件纳入同一框架中，支持更系统地评测量化效果。基于该工具，作者从校准数据、量化算法和数据格式三个方面构建了基准，并给出了面向研究和实际部署的分析结论。
classic:0a22f2ba7650.tldr: LLM-QBench 通过统一工具和基准，系统比较大语言模型后训练量化的关键选择，为实践提供更公平、可复现的参考。
classic:0a22f2ba7650.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不只是提出单一量化方法，而是搭建了一个更接近“最佳实践”的评测框架。对于想了解 LLM 量化该怎么选数据、选算法、选表示格式的人，它是很有参考价值的经典整理。

classic:ad6d573518cb.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can now handle longer sequences of tokens, enabling complex tasks like book understanding and generating lengthy novels. However, the key-value (KV) cache required for LLMs consumes substantial memory as context length increasing, becoming the bottleneck for deployment. In this paper, we present a strategy called SKVQ, which stands for sliding-window KV cache quantization, to address the issue of extremely low bitwidth KV cache quantization. To achieve this, SKVQ rearranges the channels of the KV cache in order to improve the similarity of channels in quantization groups, and applies clipped dynamic quantization at the group level. Additionally, SKVQ ensures that the most recent window tokens in the KV cache are preserved with high precision. This helps maintain the accuracy of a small but important portion of the KV cache.SKVQ achieves high compression ratios while maintaining accuracy. Our evaluation on LLMs demonstrates that SKVQ surpasses previous quantization approaches, allowing for quantization of the KV cache to 2-bit keys and 1.5-bit values with minimal loss of accuracy. With SKVQ, it is possible to process context lengths of up to 1M on an 80GB memory GPU for a 7b model and up to 7 times faster decoding.
classic:ad6d573518cb.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在长上下文推理时的核心瓶颈：KV cache 随着序列长度增长会占用大量显存，限制模型部署与推理效率。作者提出 SKVQ，一种滑动窗口式的 KV cache 量化方法，通过重排通道、按组进行裁剪动态量化，并对最近窗口内的 token 保留高精度。该方法在极低比特下仍能保持较好的模型精度，可将 key 量化到 2-bit、value 量化到 1.5-bit。实验表明，SKVQ 在压缩率和效果之间取得了很强的平衡，并显著提升长上下文推理的可行性。
classic:ad6d573518cb.tldr: SKVQ 用滑动窗口和通道重排实现超低比特 KV cache 量化，在几乎不掉点的情况下大幅降低长上下文推理显存开销。
classic:ad6d573518cb.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为 KV cache 量化方向的经典参考，因为它直接针对长上下文部署中的关键瓶颈，给出了很实用的系统级方案。它展示了如何在极端压缩下尽量保住精度，对理解 LLM 推理优化很有价值。

classic:3166d9a7ec32.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have distinguished themselves with outstanding performance in complex language modeling tasks, yet they come with significant computational and storage challenges. This paper explores the potential of quantization to mitigate these challenges. We systematically study the combined application of three well-known post-training techniques, SmoothQuant, AWQ, and GPTQ, and provide a comprehensive analysis of their interactions and implications for advancing LLM quantization. We enhance the versatility of these methods by enabling quantization to microscaling (MX) formats, extending the applicability of these PTQ algorithms beyond their original fixed-point format targets. We show that combining different PTQ methods enables us to quantize models to 4-bit weights and 8-bit activations using the MXINT format with negligible accuracy loss compared to the uncompressed baseline.
classic:3166d9a7ec32.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在推理时面临的计算和存储开销问题，目标是用量化来降低部署成本。作者系统研究了三种经典后训练量化方法 SmoothQuant、AWQ 和 GPTQ 的组合方式，并分析它们之间的相互作用。论文进一步将这些方法扩展到 microscaling（MX）格式，使其不再局限于传统定点量化。结果表明，结合多种后训练量化技术可以把模型压缩到 4-bit 权重和 8-bit 激活，同时几乎不损失精度。
classic:3166d9a7ec32.tldr: 结合 SmoothQuant、AWQ 和 GPTQ，可在几乎不掉点的情况下实现 4-bit 权重、8-bit 激活的高效 LLM 量化。
classic:3166d9a7ec32.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它不是只比较单一量化方法，而是系统研究多种经典 PTQ 技术的组合效果。对于想了解如何在保证精度的同时尽可能压缩大模型的人来说，它是很实用的参考。

classic:3c276136e2c4.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) is taking the world by storm with its unparalleled content creation ability. Large Language Models (LLMs) are at the forefront of this movement. However, the significant resource demands of LLMs often require cloud hosting, which raises issues regarding privacy, latency, and usage limitations. Although edge intelligence has long been utilized to solve these challenges by enabling real-time AI computation on ubiquitous edge resources close to data sources, most research has focused on traditional AI models and has left a gap in addressing the unique characteristics of LLM inference, such as considerable model size, auto-regressive processes, and self-attention mechanisms. In this paper, we present an edge intelligence optimization problem tailored for LLM inference. Specifically, with the deployment of the batching technique and model quantization on resource-limited edge devices, we formulate an inference model for transformer decoder-based LLMs. Furthermore, our approach aims to maximize the inference throughput via batch scheduling and joint allocation of communication and computation resources, while also considering edge resource constraints and varying user requirements of latency and accuracy. To address this NP-hard problem, we develop an optimal Depth-First Tree-Searching algorithm with online tree-Pruning (DFTSP) that operates within a feasible time complexity. Simulation results indicate that DFTSP surpasses other batching benchmarks in throughput across diverse user settings and quantization techniques, and it reduces time complexity by over 45% compared to the brute-force searching method.
classic:3c276136e2c4.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注如何把大语言模型推理从云端迁移到边缘设备，以缓解隐私、时延和使用限制等问题。作者针对 LLM 推理中模型大、自动回归生成和自注意力等特点，结合 batching 和量化，建立了适用于 transformer decoder 的边缘推理优化模型。论文进一步将问题形式化为在资源受限条件下，同时满足时延与精度需求的吞吐最大化调度问题。为求解这一 NP-hard 问题，作者提出了带在线剪枝的深度优先树搜索算法 DFTSP，并在仿真中验证了其吞吐和计算复杂度优势。
classic:3c276136e2c4.tldr: 面向边缘端大语言模型推理，本文用 batching + 量化 + 树搜索调度，在资源受限下提升吞吐并兼顾时延和精度。
classic:3c276136e2c4.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它把 LLM 推理优化问题放到了真实的边缘计算约束下讨论，而不是只停留在传统模型上。对于想了解大模型如何在端侧部署、以及 batching 和量化如何与资源调度协同的人，这篇文章很有参考价值。

classic:7ae4af43dc3d.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is an effective technique for compressing large language models (LLMs). However, while uniform-precision quantization is computationally efficient, it often compromises model performance. To address this, we propose SliM-LLM, a salience-driven mixed-precision quantization framework that allocates bit-widths at the group-wise. Our approach leverages the observation that important weights follow a structured distribution and introduces two key components: \textbf{1)} \textit{Salience-Determined Bit Allocation} adaptively assigns bit-widths to groups within each layer based on their salience; and \textbf{2)} \textit{Salience-Weighted Quantizer Calibration} optimizes quantizer parameters by incorporating element-level salience. With its structured partitioning, SliM-LLM provides a hardware-friendly solution that matches the efficiency of uniform quantization methods while improving accuracy. Experiments show that SliM-LLM achieves superior performance across various LLMs at low bit-widths. For example, a 2-bit quantized LLaMA-7B model reduces memory usage by nearly 6x compared to the floating-point baseline, decreases perplexity by 48\% compared to state-of-the-art gradient-free PTQ methods, and maintains GPU inference speed. Additionally, the extended version, SliM-LLM$^+$, which incorporates gradient-based quantization, further reduces perplexity by 35.1\%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Aaronhuang-778/SliM-LLM
classic:7ae4af43dc3d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型后训练量化中的一个核心问题：如何在尽量降低模型精度损失的同时，把模型压缩到更低比特位宽。作者提出了 SliM-LLM，一种基于显著性驱动的混合精度量化方法，按组分配不同 bit-width，并结合元素级显著性来校准量化器参数。该方法利用重要权重呈现结构化分布的观察，设计出更适合硬件实现的分组策略，从而兼顾效率与精度。实验表明，它在多种 LLM 和低比特场景下都能取得更好的困惑度表现，并保持推理速度。
classic:7ae4af43dc3d.tldr: SliM-LLM 用“显著性”指导混合精度量化，在几乎不牺牲推理效率的前提下显著提升低比特大模型的准确性。
classic:7ae4af43dc3d.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了 LLM 量化里最实际的矛盾：压得更狠和掉点更少，往往难以兼得。它提出的分组混合精度思路兼顾效果和硬件友好性，很适合作为理解现代 PTQ 方法的经典参考。

classic:3adaf3e2954d.abstract: Deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has major computational costs, due to their rapidly expanding size. Compression of LLMs reduces the memory footprint, latency, and energy required for their inference. Post-training Quantization (PTQ) techniques have been developed to compress LLMs while avoiding expensive re-training. Most PTQ approaches formulate the quantization error based on a layer-wise Euclidean loss, ignoring the model output. Then, each layer is calibrated using its layer-wise Hessian to update the weights towards minimizing the quantization error. The Hessian is also used for detecting the most salient weights to quantization. Such PTQ approaches are prone to accuracy drop in low-precision quantization. We propose Output-adaptive Calibration (OAC) to incorporate the model output in the calibration process. We formulate the quantization error based on the distortion of the output cross-entropy loss. OAC approximates the output-adaptive Hessian for each layer under reasonable assumptions to reduce the computational complexity. The output-adaptive Hessians are used to update the weight matrices and detect the salient weights towards maintaining the model output. Our proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines such as SpQR and BiLLM, especially, at extreme low-precision (2-bit and binary) quantization.
classic:3adaf3e2954d.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于大语言模型后训练量化中的精度损失问题，指出现有方法多按层最小化欧氏误差，却忽略了最终模型输出对任务性能的影响。作者提出 OAC（Output-adaptive Calibration），将输出端的交叉熵损失纳入校准目标，用更贴近模型行为的方式来度量量化误差。为降低计算开销，论文进一步近似构造了输出自适应的 Hessian，并用它来更新权重和筛选敏感参数。实验表明，OAC 在极低比特量化，尤其是 2-bit 和二值量化场景下，能比 SpQR、BiLLM 等基线取得更好的准确率保持。
classic:3adaf3e2954d.tldr: OAC 把“看输出”的校准目标引入 PTQ，显著提升了大模型在 2-bit 和二值量化下的精度表现。
classic:3adaf3e2954d.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直击 PTQ 里“只优化层内误差、却不关心最终输出”的核心缺陷，并给出了一种更贴近任务目标的校准思路。作为低比特量化的经典参考，它对想把 LLM 压到更低精度同时尽量保留性能的人很有启发。

classic:66c3326fb9bb.abstract: There has been significant interest in "extreme" compression of large language models (LLMs), i.e., to 1-2 bits per parameter, which allows such models to be executed efficiently on resource-constrained devices. Existing work focused on improved one-shot quantization techniques and weight representations; yet, purely post-training approaches are reaching diminishing returns in terms of the accuracy-vs-bit-width trade-off. State-of-the-art quantization methods such as QuIP# and AQLM include fine-tuning (part of) the compressed parameters over a limited amount of calibration data; however, such fine-tuning techniques over compressed weights often make exclusive use of straight-through estimators (STE), whose performance is not well-understood in this setting. In this work, we question the use of STE for extreme LLM compression, showing that it can be sub-optimal, and perform a systematic study of quantization-aware fine-tuning strategies for LLMs. We propose PV-Tuning - a representation-agnostic framework that generalizes and improves upon existing fine-tuning strategies, and provides convergence guarantees in restricted cases. On the practical side, when used for 1-2 bit vector quantization, PV-Tuning outperforms prior techniques for highly-performant models such as Llama and Mistral. Using PV-Tuning, we achieve the first Pareto-optimal quantization for Llama 2 family models at 2 bits per parameter.
classic:66c3326fb9bb.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型的极端压缩问题，目标是在每参数 1 到 2 比特的条件下尽量保持模型精度。作者指出，现有方法在纯后训练量化上已经接近收益瓶颈，而带少量校准数据的微调策略又过度依赖直通估计器（STE），其效果并不理想。为此，论文系统研究了量化感知微调，并提出了与表示形式无关的 PV-Tuning 框架，能够统一并改进现有策略。实验表明，该方法在 Llama 和 Mistral 等模型上的 1-2 bit 向量量化效果优于此前方法，并首次实现了 Llama 2 系列在 2 bit/参数下的 Pareto 最优量化。
classic:66c3326fb9bb.tldr: PV-Tuning 证明了用于极低比特 LLM 压缩的 STE 并非最优，并提出更强的量化微调框架，在 1-2 bit 场景下取得了领先结果。
classic:66c3326fb9bb.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型如何在极低内存和算力下运行，这篇论文非常值得看。它不仅给出了更有效的压缩训练方法，还对量化微调中的关键设计选择做了系统分析，适合作为极端量化方向的经典参考。

classic:ef66658f9716.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) techniques applied to weights, activations, and the KV cache greatly reduce memory usage, latency, and power consumption of Large Language Models (LLMs), but may lead to large quantization errors when outliers are present. Rotating activation or weight matrices helps remove outliers and benefits quantization. In this work, we identify a collection of applicable rotation parameterizations that lead to identical outputs in full-precision Transformer architectures while enhancing quantization accuracy. In addition, we find that some random rotations lead to much better quantization than others, with an up to 13 points difference in downstream zero-shot reasoning performance. As a result, we propose SpinQuant, a novel approach that incorporates learned rotation matrices for optimal quantized network accuracy. With 4-bit quantization of weight, activation, and KV-cache, SpinQuant narrows the accuracy gap on zero-shot reasoning tasks with full precision to merely 2.9 points on the LLaMA-2 7B model, surpassing LLM-QAT by 19.1 points and SmoothQuant by 25.0 points. Furthermore, SpinQuant also outperforms concurrent work QuaRot, which applies random rotations to remove outliers. In particular, for LLaMA-3 8B models that are hard to quantize, SpinQuant reduces the gap to full precision by up to 45.1% relative to QuaRot. Code is available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/SpinQuant.
classic:ef66658f9716.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型后训练量化中的一个核心问题：权重、激活和 KV cache 在低比特压缩时容易受到异常值影响，从而造成较大的精度损失。作者发现，通过对 Transformer 中的矩阵做旋转，可以在保持全精度输出等价的前提下显著缓解异常值问题，并提升量化效果。进一步地，他们指出不同旋转参数化和旋转方式对最终精度影响很大，因此提出了学习旋转矩阵的 SpinQuant 方法来自动找到更优的量化表示。实验表明，SpinQuant 在 4-bit 量化下能明显缩小与全精度模型的差距，并优于多种现有方法。
classic:ef66658f9716.tldr: SpinQuant 通过学习最优旋转矩阵来减少异常值带来的量化误差，让 LLM 的 4-bit 量化更接近全精度。
classic:ef66658f9716.simple_intro: 这篇工作值得看，因为它抓住了 LLM 量化里最常见也最棘手的“异常值”问题，并给出了一个很实用的旋转优化思路。作为经典参考，它既有清晰的理论动机，也有很强的工程效果，适合想理解现代 LLM 低比特量化的人阅读。

classic:49d07c3b642e.abstract: The prohibitive sizes of Large Language Models (LLMs) today make it difficult to deploy them on memory-constrained edge devices. This work introduces $\rm CALDERA$ -- a new post-training LLM compression algorithm that harnesses the inherent low-rank structure of a weight matrix $\mathbf{W}$ by approximating it via a low-rank, low-precision decomposition as $\mathbf{W} \approx \mathbf{Q} + \mathbf{L}\mathbf{R}$. Here, $\mathbf{L}$ and $\mathbf{R}$ are low rank factors, and the entries of $\mathbf{Q}$, $\mathbf{L}$ and $\mathbf{R}$ are quantized. The model is compressed by substituting each layer with its $\mathbf{Q} + \mathbf{L}\mathbf{R}$ decomposition, and the zero-shot performance of the compressed model is evaluated. Additionally, $\mathbf{L}$ and $\mathbf{R}$ are readily amenable to low-rank adaptation, consequently enhancing the zero-shot performance. $\rm CALDERA$ obtains this decomposition by formulating it as an optimization problem $\min_{\mathbf{Q},\mathbf{L},\mathbf{R}}\lVert(\mathbf{Q} + \mathbf{L}\mathbf{R} - \mathbf{W})\mathbf{X}^\top\rVert_{\rm F}^2$, where $\mathbf{X}$ is the calibration data, and $\mathbf{Q}, \mathbf{L}, \mathbf{R}$ are constrained to be representable using low-precision formats. Theoretical upper bounds on the approximation error of $\rm CALDERA$ are established using a rank-constrained regression framework, and the tradeoff between compression ratio and model performance is studied by analyzing the impact of target rank and quantization bit budget. Results illustrate that compressing LlaMa-$2$ $7$B/$13B$/$70$B and LlaMa-$3$ $8$B models using $\rm CALDERA$ outperforms existing post-training LLM compression techniques in the regime of less than $2.5$ bits per parameter. The implementation is available at: https://github.com/pilancilab/…
classic:49d07c3b642e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型参数规模过大、难以在内存受限设备上部署的问题，提出了一种新的后训练压缩方法 CALDERA。它将权重矩阵近似表示为低精度项与低秩分解之和，即 W≈Q+LR，并将 Q、L、R 都限制在低比特表示中，从而同时利用量化和低秩结构来压缩模型。方法通过校准数据上的优化目标来学习这一分解，并给出了相应的误差上界分析。实验表明，在每参数少于 2.5 bit 的压缩场景下，该方法在多个 LLaMA 模型上优于现有后训练压缩技术。
classic:49d07c3b642e.tldr: CALDERA 用“低秩 + 低精度”联合分解压缩大语言模型，在极低比特预算下仍能保持更好的零样本性能。
classic:49d07c3b642e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它把两种经典压缩思路——量化和低秩分解——结合成一个统一的后训练框架，思路清晰且实用。它非常适合作为大模型压缩、边缘部署和参数高效表示学习方向的经典参考。

classic:ff4f7b8f4fe3.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced natural language processing tasks such as machine translation, text generation, and sentiment analysis. However, their large size, often consisting of billions of parameters, poses challenges for storage, computation, and deployment, particularly in resource-constrained environments like mobile devices and edge computing platforms. Effective compression and quantization techniques are crucial for addressing these issues, reducing memory footprint and computational requirements without significantly compromising performance. Traditional methods that uniformly map parameters to compressed spaces fail to account for the uneven distribution of parameters, leading to substantial accuracy loss. In this work, we propose Athena, a novel algorithm for efficient block-wise post-training quantization of LLMs. Athena leverages Second-Order Matrix Derivative Information to guide the quantization process using the curvature information of the loss landscape. By grouping parameters by columns or rows and iteratively optimizing the quantization process, Athena updates the model parameters and Hessian matrix to achieve significant compression while maintaining high accuracy. This makes Athena a practical solution for deploying LLMs in various settings.
classic:ff4f7b8f4fe3.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型参数规模巨大、难以在存储和计算受限环境中部署的问题。作者提出 Athena，一种基于二阶矩阵导数信息的分块后训练量化方法，利用损失景观的曲率信息来指导量化过程。该方法按列或按行分组参数，并在迭代中联合更新模型参数与 Hessian 矩阵，以减少量化带来的精度损失。它为在移动端和边缘设备上部署 LLM 提供了一种更高效、实用的压缩方案。
classic:ff4f7b8f4fe3.tldr: Athena 用二阶信息做分块后训练量化，在大幅压缩 LLM 的同时尽量保持精度。
classic:ff4f7b8f4fe3.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“怎么把大模型压小、还尽量不掉点”这个实际问题，做成了一个有理论依据的量化方法。作为经典参考，它适合了解 LLM 后训练量化如何借助二阶信息提升效果。

classic:efdc7f687f1d.abstract: Quantization leverages lower-precision weights to reduce the memory usage of large language models (LLMs) and is a key technique for enabling their deployment on commodity hardware. While LLM quantization's impact on utility has been extensively explored, this work for the first time studies its adverse effects from a security perspective. We reveal that widely used quantization methods can be exploited to produce a harmful quantized LLM, even though the full-precision counterpart appears benign, potentially tricking users into deploying the malicious quantized model. We demonstrate this threat using a three-staged attack framework: (i) first, we obtain a malicious LLM through fine-tuning on an adversarial task; (ii) next, we quantize the malicious model and calculate constraints that characterize all full-precision models that map to the same quantized model; (iii) finally, using projected gradient descent, we tune out the poisoned behavior from the full-precision model while ensuring that its weights satisfy the constraints computed in step (ii). This procedure results in an LLM that exhibits benign behavior in full precision but when quantized, it follows the adversarial behavior injected in step (i). We experimentally demonstrate the feasibility and severity of such an attack across three diverse scenarios: vulnerable code generation, content injection, and over-refusal attack. In practice, the adversary could host the resulting full-precision model on an LLM community hub such as Hugging Face, exposing millions of users to the threat of deploying its malicious quantized version on their devices.
classic:efdc7f687f1d.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型量化带来的一个此前被忽视的问题：量化不仅能压缩模型、降低部署成本，也可能被恶意利用来隐藏攻击行为。作者提出了一个三阶段攻击框架，先训练出带有恶意行为的模型，再分析量化后的约束关系，最后调整全精度模型，使其在未量化时看起来正常，但一旦量化就会表现出预设的恶意行为。实验表明，这种攻击可以在代码生成、内容注入和过度拒答等场景中成立，说明量化模型的安全性需要被严肃关注。该工作的重要性在于，它从安全视角揭示了量化技术的潜在风险，为后续的安全评估和防御研究提供了新的问题定义。
classic:efdc7f687f1d.tldr: 量化本来是为了压缩 LLM，但这篇论文揭示它也可能被用来把“看起来正常”的全精度模型变成量化后才发作的恶意模型。
classic:efdc7f687f1d.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把量化从“压缩优化”问题推进到了“安全风险”问题，提醒我们部署模型时不能只看全精度表现。作为经典参考，它很适合了解 LLM 量化在真实应用中可能带来的新型攻击面。

classic:a442c320db85.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly but face significant memory demands. While quantization has shown promise for LLMs, current methods typically require lengthy training to alleviate the performance degradation from quantization loss. However, deploying LLMs across diverse scenarios with different resource constraints, e.g., servers and personal computers, requires repeated training per application, which amplifies the lengthy training problem. Given that, it is advantageous to train a once-for-all (OFA) supernet capable of yielding diverse optimal subnets for downstream applications through one-shot training. Nonetheless, the scale of current language models impedes efficiency and amplifies interference from weight sharing between subnets. We make an initial attempt to extend the once-for-all framework to large language models. Specifically, we decouple shared weights to eliminate the interference and incorporate Low-Rank adapters for training efficiency. Furthermore, we observe the imbalance allocation of training resources from the traditional uniform sampling. A non-parametric scheduler is introduced to adjust the sampling rate for each quantization configuration, achieving a more balanced allocation among subnets with varying demands. We validate the approach on LLaMA2 families, and downstream evaluation confirms our ability to maintain high performance while significantly reducing deployment time faced with multiple scenarios.
classic:a442c320db85.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化后性能下降与部署成本高的问题，尤其是在不同硬件场景下往往需要反复训练和适配。作者尝试把 once-for-all 框架扩展到 LLM，构建一个一次训练、可派生多种量化子网的超级网络。为降低子网之间的权重干扰，方法上对共享权重进行解耦，并引入 Low-Rank adapters 来提升训练效率。论文还设计了非参数调度器，平衡不同量化配置的采样资源，从而在多场景部署中兼顾性能与效率。
classic:a442c320db85.tldr: 提出一种面向量化大模型的 once-for-all 训练框架，让一个量化模型一次训练后即可高效适配多种部署场景。
classic:a442c320db85.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把量化 LLM 的“多场景重复训练”问题，转化成“一次训练、多个可部署子网”的统一方案。对于关心大模型落地、端侧部署和训练成本控制的人来说，它是很有代表性的经典参考。

classic:9627feb59e17.abstract: Large language models~(LLMs) have recently demonstrated promising performance in many tasks. However, the high storage and computational cost of LLMs has become a challenge for deploying LLMs. Weight quantization has been widely used for model compression, which can reduce both storage and computational cost. Most existing weight quantization methods for LLMs use a rank-one codebook for quantization, which results in substantial accuracy loss when the compression ratio is high. In this paper, we propose a novel weight quantization method, called low-rank codebook based quantization~(LCQ), for LLMs. LCQ adopts a low-rank codebook, the rank of which can be larger than one, for quantization. Experiments show that LCQ can achieve better accuracy than existing methods with a negligibly extra storage cost.
classic:9627feb59e17.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时面临的存储和计算开销过高问题，提出用权重量化来压缩模型。不同于多数方法只使用秩为1的码本，LCQ 采用可为更高秩的低秩码本进行量化，以减轻高压缩比下的精度损失。作者指出，这种设计只带来极小的额外存储开销，却能在实验中获得更好的准确率。整体来看，LCQ 为大模型压缩提供了一种更稳健的量化思路。
classic:9627feb59e17.tldr: LCQ 用低秩码本替代传统秩1码本，在几乎不增加存储的前提下提升了大语言模型量化精度。
classic:9627feb59e17.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它针对大模型量化中“压得越狠、掉点越多”的核心矛盾，提出了一个很直接的改进方向。作为经典参考，它能帮助理解码本设计如何影响量化精度与压缩率之间的平衡。

classic:416a2a1d0f2f.abstract: Despite advances using low-rank adapters and quantization, pretraining of large models on consumer hardware has not been possible without model sharding, offloading during training, or per-layer gradient updates. To address these limitations, we propose Low-Rank Adapters for Quantized Training (LoQT), a method for efficiently training quantized models. LoQT uses gradient-based tensor factorization to initialize low-rank trainable weight matrices that are periodically merged into quantized full-rank weight matrices. Our approach is suitable for both pretraining and fine-tuning models. We demonstrate this for language modeling and downstream task adaptation, finding that LoQT enables efficient training of models up to 7B parameters on a 24GB GPU. We also demonstrate the feasibility of training a 13B model using per-layer gradient updates on the same hardware.
classic:416a2a1d0f2f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是：在消费级 GPU 上训练大模型时，量化虽然能省显存，但传统方法仍常常需要模型切分、训练时卸载或逐层更新，限制了真正高效的预训练。作者提出 LoQT（Low-Rank Adapters for Quantized Training），用基于梯度的张量分解来初始化低秩可训练矩阵，并定期将其合并回量化后的全秩权重。这样既保留了低秩适配的训练效率，又兼顾了量化模型的存储优势。实验表明，LoQT 可在 24GB GPU 上高效训练最多 7B 参数模型，并让 13B 模型的逐层梯度更新训练成为可能。
classic:416a2a1d0f2f.tldr: LoQT 把低秩适配和量化训练结合起来，让消费级 GPU 也能更高效地训练大模型。
classic:416a2a1d0f2f.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了“显存不够但又想训练大模型”的现实难题。作为量化训练方向的代表性工作，它对如何在有限硬件上做预训练和微调都有很强的参考价值。

classic:aa28ee9737ad.abstract: Parameter quantization for Large Language Models (LLMs) has attracted increasing attentions recently in reducing memory costs and improving computational efficiency. Early approaches have been widely adopted. However, the existing methods suffer from poor performance in low-bit (such as 2 to 3 bits) scenarios. In this paper, we present a novel and effective Column-Level Adaptive weight Quantization (CLAQ) framework by introducing three different types of adaptive strategies for LLM quantization. Firstly, a K-Means clustering based algorithm is proposed that allows dynamic generation of quantization centroids for each column of a parameter matrix. Secondly, we design an outlier-guided adaptive precision search strategy which can dynamically assign varying bit-widths to different columns. Finally, a dynamic outlier reservation scheme is developed to retain some parameters in their original float point precision, in trade off of boosted model performance. Experiments on various mainstream open source LLMs including LLaMA-1, LLaMA-2 and Yi demonstrate that our methods achieve the state-of-the-art results across different bit settings, especially in extremely low-bit scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/fayuge/CLAQ.
classic:aa28ee9737ad.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于大语言模型的低比特后训练量化，目标是在尽量减少模型体积和计算开销的同时，尽可能保持模型性能。作者指出，现有方法在2到3比特这类极低比特场景下表现往往不够稳定，因此提出了 CLAQ 框架。CLAQ 通过列级自适应量化引入三种策略：基于 K-Means 的动态量化中心生成、面向异常值的自适应比特搜索，以及动态保留部分浮点参数。实验表明，该方法在多个主流开源 LLM 上取得了不同比特设置下的领先效果，尤其适合极低比特量化场景。
classic:aa28ee9737ad.tldr: CLAQ 用列级自适应量化策略提升了大模型在2到3比特等极低比特后训练量化下的效果。
classic:aa28ee9737ad.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对低比特量化最难的场景，提出了更细粒度、更灵活的量化设计。对于想了解 LLM 压缩、部署优化和量化前沿方法的人来说，它是很有代表性的参考。

classic:d50befdc8db2.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) serves as a potent technique to accelerate the inference of large language models (LLMs). Nonetheless, existing works still necessitate a considerable number of floating-point (FP) operations during inference, including additional quantization and de-quantization, as well as non-linear operators such as RMSNorm and Softmax. This limitation hinders the deployment of LLMs on the edge and cloud devices. In this paper, we identify the primary obstacle to integer-only quantization for LLMs lies in the large fluctuation of activations across channels and tokens in both linear and non-linear operations. To address this issue, we propose I-LLM, a novel integer-only fully-quantized PTQ framework tailored for LLMs. Specifically, (1) we develop Fully-Smooth Block-Reconstruction (FSBR) to aggressively smooth inter-channel variations of all activations and weights. (2) to alleviate degradation caused by inter-token variations, we introduce a novel approach called Dynamic Integer-only MatMul (DI-MatMul). This method enables dynamic quantization in full-integer matrix multiplication by dynamically quantizing the input and outputs with integer-only operations. (3) we design DI-ClippedSoftmax, DI-Exp, and DI-Normalization, which utilize bit shift to execute non-linear operators efficiently while maintaining accuracy. The experiment shows that our I-LLM achieves comparable accuracy to the FP baseline and outperforms non-integer quantization methods. For example, I-LLM can operate at W4A4 with negligible loss of accuracy. To our knowledge, we are the first to bridge the gap between integer-only quantization and LLMs. We've published our code on anonymous.4open.science, aiming to contribute to the advancement of this field.
classic:d50befdc8db2.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型后训练量化中的一个关键瓶颈：虽然低比特量化可以加速推理，但现有方法在推理时仍依赖较多浮点运算，包括额外的量化/反量化以及 RMSNorm、Softmax 等非线性算子。作者指出，激活在通道和 token 维度上的剧烈波动，是实现纯整数推理的主要障碍。为此，论文提出 I-LLM 框架，通过 Fully-Smooth Block-Reconstruction（FSBR）平滑激活与权重的通道差异，结合 Dynamic Integer-only MatMul（DI-MatMul）解决 token 间波动，并设计 DI-ClippedSoftmax、DI-Exp、DI-Normalization 等整数化非线性算子。实验表明，该方法在 W4A4 等设置下能保持接近浮点基线的精度，同时优于非整数量化方案，推动了 LLM 纯整数推理的实现。
classic:d50befdc8db2.tldr: I-LLM 通过平滑、动态整数矩阵乘和整数化非线性算子，实现了接近浮点精度的 LLM 纯整数低比特推理。
classic:d50befdc8db2.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接瞄准了 LLM 部署中的核心效率问题：如何把推理过程尽量变成真正的整数运算。它提出的思路兼顾了精度与硬件友好性，是理解“全整数量化”如何落地的重要经典参考。

classic:7cefd6380fac.abstract: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) enhances the efficiency of Large Language Models (LLMs) by enabling faster operation and compatibility with more accessible hardware through reduced memory usage, at the cost of small performance drops. We explore the role of calibration sets in PTQ, specifically their effect on hidden activations in various notable open-source LLMs. Calibration sets are crucial for evaluating activation magnitudes and identifying outliers, which can distort the quantization range and negatively impact performance. Our analysis reveals a marked contrast in quantization effectiveness across models. The older OPT model, upon which much of the quantization literature is based, shows significant performance deterioration and high susceptibility to outliers with varying calibration sets. In contrast, newer models like Llama-2 7B, Llama-3 8B, Command-R 35B, and Mistral 7B demonstrate strong robustness, with Mistral 7B showing near-immunity to outliers and stable activations. These findings suggest a shift in PTQ strategies might be needed. As advancements in pre-training methods reduce the relevance of outliers, there is an emerging need to reassess the fundamentals of current quantization literature. The emphasis should pivot towards optimizing inference speed, rather than primarily focusing on outlier preservation, to align with the evolving characteristics of state-of-the-art LLMs.
classic:7cefd6380fac.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型的后训练量化（PTQ）中，校准集和异常值对量化效果的影响。作者系统分析了多种开源模型的隐藏激活分布，发现以往量化研究中常见的 OPT 模型对异常值和校准集非常敏感，但新一代模型如 Llama-2、Llama-3、Command-R 和 Mistral 则表现出明显更强的鲁棒性。尤其是 Mistral 7B 几乎不受异常值影响，说明现代 LLM 的激活特征已经发生变化。论文因此指出，量化策略可能需要从“保留异常值”转向更关注推理速度与实际部署效率。
classic:7cefd6380fac.tldr: 现代 LLM 的 PTQ 对异常值和校准集越来越不敏感，传统基于 OPT 的量化经验需要重新审视。
classic:7cefd6380fac.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接挑战了很多经典量化工作的默认前提：异常值和校准集未必还是现代 LLM 量化中的核心问题。它适合作为理解新一代模型量化特性的参考，也能帮助读者把握 PTQ 研究正在发生的方向变化。

classic:efb3072feb31.abstract: Quantization of large language models (LLMs) faces significant challenges, particularly due to the presence of outlier activations that impede efficient low-bit representation. Traditional approaches predominantly address Normal Outliers, which are activations across all tokens with relatively large magnitudes. However, these methods struggle with smoothing Massive Outliers that display significantly larger values, which leads to significant performance degradation in low-bit quantization. In this paper, we introduce DuQuant, a novel approach that utilizes rotation and permutation transformations to more effectively mitigate both massive and normal outliers. First, DuQuant starts by constructing the rotation matrix, using specific outlier dimensions as prior knowledge, to redistribute outliers to adjacent channels by block-wise rotation. Second, We further employ a zigzag permutation to balance the distribution of outliers across blocks, thereby reducing block-wise variance. A subsequent rotation further smooths the activation landscape, enhancing model performance. DuQuant simplifies the quantization process and excels in managing outliers, outperforming the state-of-the-art baselines across various sizes and types of LLMs on multiple tasks, even with 4-bit weight-activation quantization. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hsu1023/DuQuant.
classic:efb3072feb31.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大语言模型低比特量化中最棘手的异常值问题展开研究，指出现有方法主要能处理普通异常值，却难以应对幅值更大的“巨型异常值”。作者提出 DuQuant，通过旋转和置换两类变换，把异常值从少数通道中分散到更均匀的分布，从而降低量化误差。具体做法包括基于异常维度先验的分块旋转、zigzag 置换以及进一步旋转平滑激活分布。实验表明，DuQuant 能在多种规模和类型的 LLM 上稳定提升 4-bit 权重-激活量化性能，并优于多项现有基线。
classic:efb3072feb31.tldr: DuQuant 用旋转+置换把 LLM 中的异常值“摊平”，显著提升了低比特量化效果。
classic:efb3072feb31.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它抓住了 LLM 量化里非常核心、也很实际的难点：异常激活会严重破坏低比特表示。DuQuant 的思路简单而有效，适合作为理解“如何通过结构变换改善量化”的经典参考。

classic:e37c39764b85.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on language tasks but face challenges when deployed on resource-constrained devices due to their extensive parameters and reliance on dense multiplications, resulting in high memory demands and latency bottlenecks. Shift-and-add reparameterization offers a promising solution by replacing costly multiplications with hardware-friendly primitives in both the attention and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) layers of an LLM. However, current reparameterization techniques require training from scratch or full parameter fine-tuning to restore accuracy, which is resource-intensive for LLMs. To address this, we propose accelerating pretrained LLMs through post-training shift-and-add reparameterization, creating efficient multiplication-free models, dubbed ShiftAddLLM. Specifically, we quantize each weight matrix into binary matrices paired with group-wise scaling factors. The associated multiplications are reparameterized into (1) shifts between activations and scaling factors and (2) queries and adds according to the binary matrices. To reduce accuracy loss, we present a multi-objective optimization method to minimize both weight and output activation reparameterization errors. Additionally, based on varying sensitivity across layers to reparameterization, we develop an automated bit allocation strategy to further reduce memory usage and latency. Experiments on five LLM families and eight tasks consistently validate the effectiveness of ShiftAddLLM, achieving average perplexity improvements of 5.6 and 22.7 points at comparable or lower latency compared to the most competitive quantized LLMs at 3 and 2 bits, respectively, and more than 80% memory and energy reductions over the original LLMs. Codes and models are availabl…
classic:e37c39764b85.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在端侧或资源受限设备上部署时，因参数规模大和大量矩阵乘法带来的内存、延迟与能耗问题。作者提出 ShiftAddLLM，用后训练的 shift-and-add 重参数化替代传统乘法，把权重矩阵量化为二值矩阵和分组缩放因子，并将乘法转化为移位与加法操作。为了尽量减少精度损失，论文还设计了同时优化权重和输出激活误差的多目标方法，并根据不同层的敏感性自动分配比特数。实验表明，该方法在多个模型家族和任务上都能显著降低内存和能耗，同时保持有竞争力的推理速度与性能。
classic:e37c39764b85.tldr: ShiftAddLLM 用后训练的无乘法重参数化把 LLM 变得更省内存、更低能耗、也更适合硬件高效部署。
classic:e37c39764b85.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它提供了一条不同于常规量化的加速路线：不只是压缩权重，而是直接把乘法改写成更便宜的位移和加法。作为经典参考，它很适合了解如何在尽量少改动预训练模型的前提下，兼顾效率和精度。

classic:81d55ad8a53d.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are omnipresent, however their practical deployment is challenging due to their ever increasing computational and memory demands. Quantization is one of the most effective ways to make them more compute and memory efficient. Quantization-aware training (QAT) methods, generally produce the best quantized performance, however it comes at the cost of potentially long training time and excessive memory usage, making it impractical when applying for LLMs. Inspired by parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) literature, we propose LR-QAT -- a lightweight and memory-efficient QAT algorithm for LLMs. LR-QAT employs several components to save memory without sacrificing predictive performance: (a) low-rank auxiliary weights that are aware of the quantization grid; (b) a downcasting operator using fixed-point or double-packed integers and (c) checkpointing. Unlike most related work, our method (i) is inference-efficient, leading to no additional overhead compared to traditional PTQ; (ii) can be seen as a general extended pretraining framework, meaning that the resulting model can still be utilized for any downstream task afterwards; (iii) can be applied across a wide range of quantization settings, such as different choices quantization granularity, activation quantization, and seamlessly combined with many PTQ techniques. We apply LR-QAT to LLaMA-1/2/3 and Mistral model families and validate its effectiveness on several downstream tasks. Our method outperforms common post-training quantization (PTQ) approaches and reaches the same model performance as full-model QAT at the fraction of its memory usage. Specifically, we can train a 7B LLM on a single consumer grade GPU with 24GB of memory. Our source code is available at h…
classic:81d55ad8a53d.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于大语言模型量化训练中的核心难题：传统量化感知训练虽然效果最好，但训练成本高、显存占用大，难以直接用于LLM。作者提出 LR-QAT，一种轻量且省显存的量化感知训练方法，通过低秩辅助权重、定点/双打包整数下采样和检查点机制来降低训练开销。该方法在推理阶段没有额外负担，和传统后训练量化相比更高效，同时又能接近甚至达到全模型QAT的性能。实验表明，它可适配多种量化设置，并能在单张24GB消费级GPU上训练7B模型，具有很强的实用价值。
classic:81d55ad8a53d.tldr: LR-QAT 让大模型量化感知训练变得更省显存、更易训练，同时保持接近全模型QAT的效果。
classic:81d55ad8a53d.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“效果最好但太贵”的QAT，改造成了更适合LLM落地的轻量方案。对于想理解大模型量化训练如何兼顾性能、显存和部署效率的人来说，它是一个很好的经典参考。

classic:335ef5801f92.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, but they are hindered by high computational costs and memory requirements. Ternarization, an extreme form of quantization, offers a solution by reducing memory usage and enabling energy-efficient floating-point additions. However, applying ternarization to LLMs faces challenges stemming from outliers in both weights and activations. In this work, observing asymmetric outliers and non-zero means in weights, we introduce Dual Learnable Ternarization (DLT), which enables both scales and shifts to be learnable. We also propose Outlier-Friendly Feature Knowledge Distillation (OFF) to recover the information lost in extremely low-bit quantization. The proposed OFF can incorporate semantic information and is insensitive to outliers. At the core of OFF is maximizing the mutual information between features in ternarized and floating-point models using cosine similarity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our TernaryLLM surpasses previous low-bit quantization methods on the standard text generation and zero-shot benchmarks for different LLM families. Specifically, for one of the most powerful open-source models, LLaMA-3, our approach (W1.58A16) outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method (W2A16) by 5.8 in terms of perplexity on C4 and by 8.2% in terms of average accuracy on zero-shot tasks.
classic:335ef5801f92.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时面临的高计算开销和显存占用问题，尝试把模型权重进一步压缩到三值量化。作者指出，LLM 中权重和激活的离群值会严重破坏极低比特量化效果，因此提出了 Dual Learnable Ternarization（DLT），让量化中的尺度和偏移都可学习，以更好适应非零均值和非对称离群点。与此同时，论文设计了 Outlier-Friendly Feature Knowledge Distillation（OFF），通过特征层面的蒸馏和互信息最大化，尽量恢复三值模型丢失的信息。实验表明，该方法在多个模型和基准上都优于此前低比特量化方法，说明三值化也能在保持较好效果的同时大幅降低成本。
classic:335ef5801f92.tldr: TernaryLLM 通过可学习三值量化和离群友好的蒸馏方法，把大语言模型压到更低比特，同时尽量保住性能。
classic:335ef5801f92.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“极低比特量化能否用于 LLM”这个很难的问题往前推进了一步。它提出的方法兼顾了压缩效率和实际精度，是研究超低比特部署和量化训练时很有参考价值的经典工作。

classic:c97d4907647b.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a promising way to scale up the learning capacity of large language models. It increases the number of parameters while keeping FLOPs nearly constant during inference through sparse activation. Yet, it still suffers from significant memory overheads due to the vast parameter size, necessitating model compression techniques. Post-training quantization offers a powerful approach for model compression. Existing methods adopt a fixed quantization precision for the entire MoE model. This rigid setup can lead to suboptimal performance, without considering the inherent sparse structure. For example, MoE's sparse routing mechanism leads to different activation patterns, where shared experts are accessed by all tokens while token-conditioned experts are selectively activated. This activation disparity suggests different quantization requirements, with consistently activated shared experts potentially needing higher precision to maintain model quality. In this paper, we study a fine-grained precision setup for MoE quantization. We explore MoE structure-aware quantization heuristics, ranging from coarse (e.g., MoE layers) to fine granularity (e.g., linear layers). Our investigations reveal critical principles, where different MoE structures require varying numbers of bits for effective quantization. Conclusions are supported by extensive benchmarking across two representative MoE models and six tasks including commonsense reasoning and natural language understanding. We further show that an MoE quantized in a fined-grained mixed precision achieved state-of-the-art 65.35% performance on average compared to the baseline 64.30% (i.e., GPTQ). Moreover, based on the findings, we introduce novel data-driven techniques for optimizing bit allocation in MoE qua…
classic:c97d4907647b.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了混合专家模型（MoE）的后训练量化问题，核心挑战是：MoE 虽然能在推理时保持较低 FLOPs，却因为参数规模巨大而带来显著内存开销。作者指出，现有方法通常对整个 MoE 模型采用统一量化精度，但这种做法没有考虑 MoE 的稀疏路由和不同专家的激活差异，容易造成性能损失。为此，论文系统比较了从 MoE 层级到线性层级的细粒度混合精度量化策略，并总结出不同结构需要不同比特数的关键规律。基于两个代表性 MoE 模型和六个任务的大量实验，论文证明细粒度精度分配可以进一步提升量化后的模型效果，并达到优于基线方法的平均性能。
classic:c97d4907647b.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了 MoE 模型的后训练量化，证明按结构分配不同精度比统一量化更有效。
classic:c97d4907647b.simple_intro: 如果你关心 MoE 模型如何在压缩后尽量保住性能，这篇论文很值得看，因为它不是只给出一种量化方法，而是总结了结构感知的量化规律。它也适合作为经典参考，帮助理解 MoE 稀疏激活与量化精度之间的关系。

classic:65e19fb154ae.abstract: Fine-tuning is a crucial process for adapting large language models (LLMs) to diverse applications. In certain scenarios, such as multi-tenant serving, deploying multiple LLMs becomes necessary to meet complex demands. Recent studies suggest decomposing a fine-tuned LLM into a base model and corresponding delta weights, which are then compressed using low-rank or low-bit approaches to reduce costs. In this work, we observe that existing low-rank and low-bit compression methods can significantly harm the model performance for task-specific fine-tuned LLMs (e.g., WizardMath for math problems). Motivated by the long-tail distribution of singular values in the delta weights, we propose a delta quantization approach using mixed-precision. This method employs higher-bit representation for singular vectors corresponding to larger singular values. We evaluate our approach on various fine-tuned LLMs, including math LLMs, code LLMs, chat LLMs, and even VLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach performs comparably to full fine-tuned LLMs, surpassing both low-rank and low-bit baselines by a considerable margin. Additionally, we show that our method is compatible with various backbone LLMs, such as Llama-2, Llama-3, and Mistral, highlighting its generalizability.
classic:65e19fb154ae.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注如何在不重新训练的前提下，压缩已经微调好的大语言模型增量权重（delta weights），以降低多模型部署和存储成本。作者指出，现有低秩和低比特压缩方法会明显损伤任务特化模型的性能，尤其是在数学、代码和对话模型上。基于增量权重奇异值的长尾分布，论文提出一种混合精度的 delta 压缩方法，对更重要的方向使用更高比特表示。实验表明，该方法在多种微调模型和不同基座模型上都能接近全量微调效果，并显著优于现有基线。
classic:65e19fb154ae.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的混合精度 delta 压缩方法，在大幅降低存储成本的同时尽量保留微调大模型的性能。
classic:65e19fb154ae.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型部署、模型压缩或多租户服务，这篇论文很值得看，因为它提供了一个简单直接、无需额外训练的压缩思路。它也很适合作为经典参考，帮助理解微调模型的“增量权重”为什么不能简单按统一低比特处理。

classic:52e4a1a27d54.abstract: Quantization is a proven effective method for compressing large language models. Although popular techniques like W8A8 and W4A16 effectively maintain model performance, they often fail to concurrently speed up the prefill and decoding stages of inference. W4A8 is a promising strategy to accelerate both of them while usually leads to a significant performance degradation. To address these issues, we present QQQ, a Quality Quattuor-bit Quantization method with 4-bit weights and 8-bit activations. QQQ employs adaptive smoothing and Hessian-based compensation, significantly enhancing the performance of quantized models without extensive training. Furthermore, we meticulously engineer W4A8 GEMM kernels to increase inference speed. Our specialized per-channel W4A8 GEMM and per-group W4A8 GEMM achieve impressive speed increases of 3.67$\times$ and 3.29 $\times$ over FP16 GEMM. Our extensive experiments show that QQQ achieves performance on par with existing state-of-the-art LLM quantization methods while significantly accelerating inference, achieving speed boosts up to 2.24 $\times$, 2.10$\times$, and 1.25$\times$ compared to FP16, W8A8, and W4A16, respectively.
classic:52e4a1a27d54.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化中的一个核心问题：如何在保持模型性能的同时，同时加速推理的预填充和解码阶段。作者提出了 QQQ，一种 4 比特权重、8 比特激活的量化方法，通过自适应平滑和基于 Hessian 的补偿来减少量化带来的性能损失。与此同时，论文还专门设计了高效的 W4A8 GEMM 内核，以进一步提升实际推理速度。实验表明，QQQ 在性能上可与先进量化方法相媲美，并带来显著的端到端加速。
classic:52e4a1a27d54.tldr: QQQ 用 4-bit 权重和 8-bit 激活，在尽量不掉点的前提下同时提升大模型预填充和解码推理速度。
classic:52e4a1a27d54.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为大模型高效推理量化的经典参考，因为它不仅讨论了“怎么量化得更准”，还解决了“怎么真正跑得更快”。如果你关心 LLM 部署中的性能-速度平衡，QQQ 很值得看。

classic:d30799e493c3.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory footprint of LLMs by quantizing weights to low-precision datatypes. Since LLM inference is usually memory-bound, PTQ methods can improve inference throughput. Recent state-of-the-art PTQ approaches use vector quantization (VQ) to quantize multiple weights at once, which improves information utilization through better shaping.
