However, VQ requires a codebook with size exponential in the dimension. This limits current VQ-based PTQ works to low VQ dimensions ($\le 8$) that in turn limit quantization quality. Here, we introduce QTIP, which instead uses trellis coded quantization (TCQ) to achieve ultra-high-dimensional quantization. TCQ uses a stateful decoder that separates the codebook size from the bitrate and effective dimension. QTIP introduces a spectrum of lookup-only to computed lookup-free trellis codes designed for a hardware-efficient "bitshift" trellis structure; these codes achieve state-of-the-art results in both quantization quality and inference speed.
classic:d30799e493c3.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型的后训练量化问题，目标是在尽量不损失精度的前提下降低模型存储和推理开销。作者指出，现有基于向量量化的方法虽然能更好地利用权重信息，但受限于码本规模随维度指数增长，难以扩展到更高维度。为此，QTIP 引入了基于 Trellis Coded Quantization 的量化框架，把码本大小与比特率和有效维度解耦，从而支持超高维量化。实验表明，该方法在量化质量和推理速度上都取得了很强的表现，并且兼顾了硬件效率。
classic:d30799e493c3.tldr: QTIP 用 trellis 编码替代传统向量量化，把高维量化做得更高效、更准确，还能兼顾推理速度。
classic:d30799e493c3.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了 LLM 量化里一个很实际的瓶颈：如何在高维下做更强的压缩，而不被码本爆炸限制。它是理解新一代高效 PTQ 方法、尤其是把算法设计和硬件实现结合起来的经典参考。

classic:a8b29206cc50.abstract: Despite recent advances in LLM quantization, activation quantization remains to be challenging due to the activation outliers. Conventional remedies, e.g., mixing precisions for different channels, introduce extra overhead and reduce the speedup. In this work, we develop a simple yet effective strategy to facilitate per-tensor activation quantization by preventing the generation of problematic tokens. Precisely, we propose a method to find a set of key-value cache, coined CushionCache, which mitigates outliers in subsequent tokens when inserted as a prefix. CushionCache works in two steps: First, we greedily search for a prompt token sequence that minimizes the maximum activation values in subsequent tokens. Then, we further tune the token cache to regularize the activations of subsequent tokens to be more quantization-friendly. The proposed method successfully addresses activation outliers of LLMs, providing a substantial performance boost for per-tensor activation quantization methods. We thoroughly evaluate our method over a wide range of models and benchmarks and find that it significantly surpasses the established baseline of per-tensor W8A8 quantization and can be seamlessly integrated with the recent activation quantization method.
classic:a8b29206cc50.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化中的一个核心难题：激活值中的异常大值会让按张量量化变得很不稳定，尤其影响激活量化效果。作者提出了 CushionCache，一种把特定的 key-value cache 作为前缀插入输入的方法，用来抑制后续 token 产生激活异常。方法分两步：先搜索能降低后续激活峰值的提示 token 序列，再进一步微调这个缓存，使激活分布更适合量化。实验表明，该方法能显著提升 per-tensor 激活量化的效果，并且可以与现有方法无缝结合。
classic:a8b29206cc50.tldr: 通过给输入前面加一段精心构造的“缓存前缀”，这篇论文有效抑制了 LLM 激活异常值，从而显著改善了激活量化。
classic:a8b29206cc50.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它用一种很简洁的思路解决了 LLM 量化里很棘手的激活 outlier 问题，而且不需要复杂的混合精度设计。它也是理解“如何让模型更量化友好”的一个很好的经典参考。

classic:f207b7b50b27.abstract: Binarization, which converts weight parameters to binary values, has emerged as an effective strategy to reduce the size of large language models (LLMs). However, typical binarization techniques significantly diminish linguistic effectiveness of LLMs. To address this issue, we introduce a novel binarization technique called Mixture of Scales (BinaryMoS). Unlike conventional methods, BinaryMoS employs multiple scaling experts for binary weights, dynamically merging these experts for each token to adaptively generate scaling factors. This token-adaptive approach boosts the representational power of binarized LLMs by enabling contextual adjustments to the values of binary weights. Moreover, because this adaptive process only involves the scaling factors rather than the entire weight matrix, BinaryMoS maintains compression efficiency similar to traditional static binarization methods. Our experimental results reveal that BinaryMoS surpasses conventional binarization techniques in various natural language processing tasks and even outperforms 2-bit quantization methods, all while maintaining similar model size to static binarization techniques.
classic:f207b7b50b27.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型二值化后性能大幅下降的问题，目标是在尽量不增加模型体积的前提下提升表达能力。作者提出 Mixture of Scales（BinaryMoS），通过多个缩放专家为二值权重生成并按 token 动态融合缩放因子，从而让模型能根据上下文自适应调整权重值。由于只对缩放系数做动态处理而不是整个权重矩阵，该方法仍保持了接近传统静态二值化的压缩效率。实验表明，BinaryMoS 在多项 NLP 任务上优于常规二值化方法，甚至超过了 2-bit 量化方法。
classic:f207b7b50b27.tldr: BinaryMoS 通过 token 自适应的多缩放因子设计，让二值化大语言模型在保持极小模型体积的同时显著提升性能。
classic:f207b7b50b27.simple_intro: 如果你关心超低比特量化和二值化，这篇论文很值得看，因为它直接解决了“模型变小但能力掉得太多”这一核心矛盾。它也很适合作为经典参考，了解如何用轻量的动态机制提升压缩模型的表达能力。

classic:6f3c6c7ea404.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate outstanding performance in various tasks in machine learning and have thus become one of the most important workloads in today's computing landscape. However, deploying LLM inference poses challenges due to the high compute and memory requirements stemming from the enormous model size and the difficulty of running it in the integer pipelines. In this paper, we present Tender, an algorithm-hardware co-design solution that enables efficient deployment of LLM inference at low precision. Based on our analysis of outlier values in LLMs, we propose a decomposed quantization technique in which the scale factors of decomposed matrices are powers of two apart. The proposed scheme allows us to avoid explicit requantization (i.e., dequantization/quantization) when accumulating the partial sums from the decomposed matrices, with a minimal extension to the commodity tensor compute hardware. Our evaluation shows that Tender achieves higher accuracy and inference performance compared to the state-of-the-art methods while also being significantly less intrusive to the existing accelerators.
classic:6f3c6c7ea404.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理部署中的核心瓶颈：模型太大、算力和内存开销高，而且低精度整数流水线下运行困难。作者提出 Tender，一种算法与硬件协同设计的方法，通过张量分解量化并让分解矩阵的缩放因子满足幂次关系，减少中间结果累加时的显式反量化/再量化开销。该方法结合了对模型异常值的分析，在尽量少改动现有张量计算硬件的前提下提升推理效率。实验结果表明，Tender 在精度和性能上都优于现有方法，且更适合实际落地。
classic:6f3c6c7ea404.tldr: Tender 用张量分解量化和运行时重定量化优化大模型推理，在少改硬件的情况下同时提升速度和精度。
classic:6f3c6c7ea404.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把量化算法和硬件实现一起设计，直接瞄准大模型部署最现实的性能瓶颈。作为 ISCA 2024 的工作，它也很适合作为理解“低精度推理如何落到真实加速器上”的经典参考。

classic:130ede7864c6.abstract: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown surprising performance in task-specific workloads as well as general tasks with the given prompts. However, to achieve unprecedented performance, recent LLMs use billions to trillions of parameters, which hinder the wide adaptation of those models due to their extremely large compute and memory requirements. To resolve the issue, various model compression methods are being actively investigated. In this work, we propose SDQ (Sparse Decomposed Quantization) to exploit both structured sparsity and quantization to achieve both high compute and memory efficiency. From our evaluations, we observe that SDQ can achieve 4x effective compute throughput with <1% quality drop.
classic:130ede7864c6.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理时计算和显存开销过高的问题。作者提出 SDQ（Sparse Decomposed Quantization），把结构化稀疏和量化结合起来，同时压缩模型的计算与存储成本。实验结果表明，该方法在几乎不损失质量的情况下，能够带来约 4 倍的有效计算吞吐提升。它为 LLM 高效部署提供了一种兼顾速度和精度的实用方案。
classic:130ede7864c6.tldr: SDQ 通过“稀疏 + 量化”联合压缩，让大语言模型推理更快、更省显存，且质量几乎不掉。
classic:130ede7864c6.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注 LLM 推理加速和模型压缩的人阅读，因为它把两种经典高效化思路结合到了一起。作为 2024 年的代表性工作，它很有参考价值，尤其适合了解大模型部署优化的最新路线。

classic:96ec00cda243.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a promising solution for deploying large language models (LLMs) on resource-constrained devices. Early methods developed for small-scale networks, such as ResNet, rely on gradient-based optimization, which becomes impractical for hyper-scale LLMs with billions of parameters. While recently proposed backpropagation-free or transformation-based methods alleviate this issue, they ignore inter-layer interactions or use the naive nearest-rounding-based quantized weight assignment to save the heavy computational cost of weight optimization. In this paper, we introduce a novel backpropagation-free PTQ algorithm that optimizes quantized weights by considering inter-layer dependencies. The key innovation is the development of attention-aware Hessian matrices that capture inter-layer interactions within the attention module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only outperforms existing weight quantization methods but also shows good synergy with conventional methods to suppress activation outliers, leading to state-of-the-art weight-activation quantization performance. The code will be available at https://github.com/SamsungLabs/BoA.
classic:96ec00cda243.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型的后训练量化问题，目标是在不进行反向传播的前提下，降低模型部署到资源受限设备时的存储和计算成本。作者指出，现有无梯度或基于变换的方法往往忽略层间依赖，或者直接采用简单的最近邻舍入来确定量化权重，因而效果受限。为此，论文提出一种考虑注意力模块中层间交互的 attention-aware Hessian 矩阵，用来更精细地优化量化权重。实验表明，该方法不仅优于现有权重量化方法，还能与抑制激活异常值的传统方法协同，取得更强的权重-激活联合量化效果。
classic:96ec00cda243.tldr: 提出一种无需反向传播、且显式建模注意力层间依赖的 PTQ 方法，显著提升大模型量化性能。
classic:96ec00cda243.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注大语言模型部署和量化压缩的人阅读，因为它直接解决了“如何在不做昂贵反向传播的情况下把 LLM 量化好”这一关键问题。它也是研究 PTQ 时很值得参考的经典思路，尤其适合想了解注意力结构如何影响量化误差建模的读者。

classic:fc1fcede807a.abstract: Efficient adaption of large language models (LLMs) on edge devices is essential for applications requiring continuous and privacy-preserving adaptation and inference. However, existing tuning techniques fall short because of the high computation and memory overheads. To this end, we introduce a computation- and memory-efficient LLM tuning framework, called Edge-LLM, to facilitate affordable and effective LLM adaptation on edge devices. Specifically, Edge-LLM features three core components: (1) a layer-wise unified compression (LUC) technique to reduce the computation overhead by generating layer-wise pruning sparsity and quantization bit-width policies, (2) an adaptive layer tuning and voting scheme to reduce the memory overhead by reducing the backpropagation depth, and (3) a complementary hardware scheduling strategy to handle the irregular computation patterns introduced by LUC and adaptive layer tuning, thereby achieving efficient computation and data movements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Edge-LLM achieves a 2.92x speed up and a 4x memory overhead reduction as compared to vanilla tuning methods with comparable task accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/GATECH-EIC/Edge-LLM
classic:fc1fcede807a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是如何让大语言模型在边缘设备上也能高效地做持续适配和推理，同时兼顾隐私与资源限制。作者提出了 Edge-LLM 框架，通过层级统一压缩（LUC）联合生成剪枝稀疏度和量化比特宽度策略，以降低计算开销。与此同时，框架还引入自适应层调优与投票机制，减少反向传播深度，从而显著降低内存占用。实验结果表明，相比普通微调方法，Edge-LLM 在保持相近任务效果的同时可实现 2.92 倍加速和 4 倍内存节省。
classic:fc1fcede807a.tldr: Edge-LLM 用层级压缩、自适应调优和硬件调度，让大模型在边缘设备上也能更省算力、更省内存地完成适配。
classic:fc1fcede807a.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注边缘端大模型部署、量化和高效微调的人阅读，因为它把“如何在有限资源上继续训练/适配 LLM”这个实际难题做成了系统方案。作为经典参考，它展示了压缩、训练策略和硬件协同优化如何一起提升端侧可用性。

classic:f0978616063f.abstract: Emergent Large Language Models (LLMs) use their extraordinary performance and powerful deduction capacity to discern from traditional language models. However, the expenses of computational resources and storage for these LLMs are stunning, quantization then arises as a trending conversation. To address accuracy decay caused by quantization, two streams of works in post-training quantization methods stand out. One uses other weights to compensate existing quantization error, while the other transfers the quantization difficulty to other parts in the model. Combining both merits, we introduce Learnable Singular value Increment (LSI) as an advanced solution. LSI uses Singular Value Decomposition to extract singular values of the weights and make them learnable to help weights compensate each other conditioned on activation. Incorporating LSI with existing techniques, we achieve state-of-the-art performance in diverse quantization settings, no matter in weight-only, weight-activation or extremely low bit scenarios. By unleashing the potential of LSI, efficient finetuning on quantized model is no longer a prohibitive problem.
classic:f0978616063f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化后精度下降的问题，目标是在尽量压缩模型参数和计算开销的同时，尽可能保住原始性能。作者提出了 Learnable Singular Value Increment（LSI）方法，借助奇异值分解把权重中的奇异值显式提取出来并设为可学习参数，让不同权重之间能够在激活条件下相互补偿量化误差。该方法可以与现有后训练量化技术结合，在权重-only、权重-激活以及极低比特等多种场景下都取得了很强的效果。论文的价值在于，它为“量化后如何恢复精度”提供了一个更通用、可组合的思路。
classic:f0978616063f.tldr: 通过让权重的奇异值可学习，LSI 让量化误差在模型内部相互补偿，从而显著提升多种低比特量化场景下的精度。
classic:f0978616063f.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为量化研究的经典参考，因为它直接针对 LLM 量化后最核心的精度损失问题，并给出了一种可以和现有方法叠加的通用方案。它的思路清晰，既有理论工具（SVD/奇异值）又有很强的工程实用性。

classic:bf4a4f8fa865.abstract: We present a simple meta quantization approach that quantizes different layers of a large language model (LLM) at different bit levels, and is independent of the underlying quantization technique. Specifically, we quantize the most important layers to higher bit precision and less important layers to lower bits. We propose two effective strategies to measure the importance of layers within LLMs: the first measures the importance of a layer based on how different its output embeddings are from the input embeddings (higher is better); the second estimates the importance of a layer using the number of layer weights that are much larger than average (smaller is better). We show that quantizing different layers at varying bits according to our importance scores results in minimal performance drop with a far more compressed model size. Finally, we present several practical key takeaways from our variable layer-wise quantization experiments: (a) LLM performance under variable quantization remains close to the original model until 25-50% of layers are moved in lower quantization using our proposed ordering but only until 5-10% if moved using no specific ordering; (b) Adding layer importance to inherently dynamic quantization techniques can further improve their performance, showing that our approach is complementary to other dynamic quantization methods; (c) Quantizing LLMs to lower bits performs substantially better than pruning unless extreme quantization (2-bit) is used; and (d) Layer-wise quantization to lower bits works better in the case of larger LLMs with more layers compared to smaller LLMs with fewer layers. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/RazvanDu/LayerwiseQuant/.
classic:bf4a4f8fa865.summary_zh: 这篇论文讨论了大语言模型量化中的一个实际问题：不同层对模型性能的重要性并不相同，因此不必对所有层使用相同的比特数。作者提出了一种与具体量化算法无关的“层级量化”方法，根据层的重要性把关键层保留在更高精度、次要层压到更低精度。为此，论文设计了两种衡量层重要性的策略，分别从层输入输出差异和权重分布特征来估计重要程度。实验表明，这种分层分比特的做法能在较小性能损失下显著压缩模型，并且对其他动态量化方法也有互补增益。
classic:bf4a4f8fa865.tldr: 把 LLM 不同层按重要性分配不同位宽，能在几乎不掉点的情况下实现更强压缩。
classic:bf4a4f8fa865.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于，它把“量化”从统一压缩变成了更细粒度的层级策略，思路简单但很实用。作为经典参考，它能帮助你理解为什么同样是低比特量化，分层处理往往比一刀切更有效。

classic:ab657d66afe4.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable performance across diverse language tasks. But their deployment is often constrained by their substantial computational and storage requirements. Quantization has emerged as a key technique for addressing this challenge, enabling the compression of large models with minimal impact on performance. The recent GPTQ algorithm, a post-training quantization (PTQ) method, has proven highly effective for compressing LLMs, sparking a wave of research that leverages GPTQ as a core component. Recognizing the pivotal role of GPTQ in the PTQ landscape, we introduce CDQuant, a simple and scalable alternative to GPTQ with improved performance. CDQuant uses greedy coordinate descent to minimize the layer-wise reconstruction loss to achieve high-quality quantized weights. Our algorithm is easy to implement and scales efficiently to models with hundreds of billions of parameters. We perform extensive evaluation on Gemma, and PaLM2 model families, and demonstrate that CDQuant consistently outperforms GPTQ in 2-4 bit weight quantization. Moreover, CDQuant improves the performance of state-of-the-art PTQ techniques such as QuIP and FrameQuant when used as a replacement for their GPTQ component, resulting in further gains in quality.
classic:ab657d66afe4.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时面临的存储和算力开销问题，提出用后训练量化来压缩模型并尽量保持精度。作者发现 GPTQ 虽然很有效，但仍有提升空间，因此提出了 CDQuant 作为一种更简单、可扩展的替代方案。CDQuant 采用贪心坐标下降来最小化逐层重建误差，从而得到更高质量的量化权重。实验表明，它在 Gemma 和 PaLM2 等模型上，尤其在 2 到 4 比特量化时，整体优于 GPTQ，并且还能提升 QuIP、FrameQuant 等方法的效果。
classic:ab657d66afe4.tldr: CDQuant 用贪心坐标下降改进大模型后训练量化，在 2-4 比特设置下比 GPTQ 更准且更易扩展。
classic:ab657d66afe4.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接面向大模型落地时最现实的压缩问题，并给出了一个简单、可扩展、效果更强的 PTQ 方法。对于想了解 GPTQ 之后量化方法如何继续进化的人，它是很好的经典参考。

classic:a6e4608a0de9.abstract: Quantizing the activations of large language models (LLMs) has been a significant challenge due to the presence of structured outliers. Most existing methods focus on the per-token or per-tensor quantization of activations, making it difficult to achieve both accuracy and hardware efficiency. To address this problem, we propose OutlierTune, an efficient per-channel post-training quantization (PTQ) method for the activations of LLMs. OutlierTune consists of two components: pre-execution of dequantization and symmetrization. The pre-execution of dequantization updates the model weights by the activation scaling factors, avoiding the internal scaling and costly additional computational overheads brought by the per-channel activation quantization. The symmetrization further reduces the quantization differences arising from the weight updates by ensuring the balanced numerical ranges across different activation channels. OutlierTune is easy to implement and hardware-efficient, introducing almost no additional computational overheads during the inference. Extensive experiments show that the proposed framework outperforms existing methods across multiple different tasks. Demonstrating better generalization, this framework improves the Int6 quantization of the instruction-tuning LLMs, such as OPT-IML, to the same level as half-precision (FP16). Moreover, we have shown that the proposed framework is 1.48x faster than the FP16 implementation while reducing approximately 2x memory usage.
classic:a6e4608a0de9.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大语言模型激活量化中“结构化离群值”带来的精度损失与硬件开销问题，提出了一种高效的按通道后训练量化方法 OutlierTune。方法的核心包括两个部分：将反量化提前到权重侧以避免推理时额外的内部缩放开销，以及通过对称化来平衡不同激活通道的数值范围。这样既能保持较好的量化精度，又几乎不增加推理计算负担。实验表明，该方法在多项任务上优于现有方案，并能把部分 LLM 的 Int6 量化效果提升到接近 FP16，同时显著减少显存占用并加速推理。
classic:a6e4608a0de9.tldr: OutlierTune 用“提前反量化 + 对称化”实现了高效的按通道激活量化，在几乎不增加推理开销的前提下提升了大模型量化精度。
classic:a6e4608a0de9.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它同时解决了量化“准不准”和“快不快”两个核心矛盾，且方案非常贴近实际部署。作为 LLM 激活量化的经典参考，它展示了如何通过简单但有效的工程设计把离群值问题转化为可落地的高效推理方案。

classic:f08cfa5dc6e9.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) on edge devices is increasingly important to enhance on-device intelligence. Weight quantization is crucial for reducing the memory footprint of LLMs on devices. However, low-bit LLMs necessitate mixed precision matrix multiplication (mpGEMM) of low precision weights and high precision activations during inference. Existing systems, lacking native support for mpGEMM, resort to dequantize weights for high precision computation. Such an indirect way can lead to a significant inference overhead. In this paper, we introduce T-MAC, an innovative lookup table(LUT)-based method designed for efficient low-bit LLM (i.e., weight-quantized LLM) inference on CPUs. T-MAC directly supports mpGEMM without dequantization, while simultaneously eliminating multiplications and reducing additions required. Specifically, T-MAC transforms the traditional data-type-centric multiplication to bit-wise table lookup, and enables a unified and scalable mpGEMM solution. Our LUT-based kernels scale linearly to the weight bit-width. Evaluated on low-bit Llama and BitNet models, T-MAC demonstrates up to 4x increase in throughput and 70% reduction in energy consumption compared to llama.cpp. For BitNet-b1.58-3B, T-MAC delivers a token generation throughput of 30 tokens/s with a single core and 71 tokens/s with eight cores on M2-Ultra, and 11 tokens/s on lower-end devices like Raspberry Pi 5, which significantly exceeds the adult average reading speed. T-MAC with LUT-based computing paradigm, paves the way for the practical deployment of low-bit LLMs on resource-constrained edge devices without compromising computational efficiency. The system is open-sourced at https://github.com/microsoft/T-MAC .
classic:f08cfa5dc6e9.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是低比特大语言模型在边缘设备上部署时，推理开销仍然很高的问题。现有系统通常先把低比特权重反量化成高精度，再做矩阵乘法，这会带来明显的额外计算和能耗。T-MAC 提出一种基于查找表的 CPU 推理方法，直接支持混合精度矩阵乘法，避免反量化，并减少乘法与加法开销。实验表明，它在低比特 Llama 和 BitNet 上相比 llama.cpp 可获得更高吞吐和更低能耗，适合资源受限设备上的实际部署。
classic:f08cfa5dc6e9.tldr: T-MAC 用查找表替代传统乘法，直接在 CPU 上高效运行低比特 LLM 推理，大幅提升边缘设备部署效率。
classic:f08cfa5dc6e9.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了低比特大模型在 CPU/边缘设备上“省内存但不够快”的核心瓶颈。作为经典参考，它展示了量化不只是压缩模型，也可以通过系统设计真正把推理效率做出来。

classic:a1c72dbba3d4.abstract: Due to their large size, generative Large Language Models (LLMs) require significant computing and storage resources. This paper introduces a new post-training quantization method, GPTQT, to reduce memory usage and enhance processing speed by expressing the weight of LLM in 3bit/2bit. Practice has shown that minimizing the quantization error of weights is ineffective, leading to overfitting. Therefore, GPTQT employs a progressive two-step approach: initially quantizing weights using Linear quantization to a relatively high bit, followed by converting obtained int weight to lower bit binary coding. A re-explore strategy is proposed to optimize initial scaling factor. During inference, these steps are merged into pure binary coding, enabling efficient computation. Testing across various models and datasets confirms GPTQT's effectiveness. Compared to the strong 3-bit quantization baseline, GPTQT further reduces perplexity by 4.01 on opt-66B and increases speed by 1.24 times on opt-30b. The results on Llama2 show that GPTQT is currently the best binary coding quantization method for such kind of LLMs.
classic:a1c72dbba3d4.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在推理时计算和存储开销过大的问题，目标是把模型权重压缩到 3bit/2bit 以提升效率。作者指出，单纯最小化量化误差容易带来过拟合，因此提出 GPTQT 这种后训练量化方法，采用“先高比特线性量化、再转为低比特二进制编码”的两步流程。为了进一步提升效果，论文还引入了重新探索初始缩放因子的策略，并在推理阶段将步骤融合为纯二进制编码以便高效计算。实验表明，GPTQT 在多个模型和数据集上都有效，在 3-bit 基线之上进一步降低困惑度并提升推理速度。
classic:a1c72dbba3d4.tldr: GPTQT 用“两步量化 + 二进制编码”把大语言模型压到 3bit/2bit，在保持效果的同时进一步提升推理效率。
classic:a1c72dbba3d4.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它针对大模型部署中的核心痛点——显存和算力成本——提出了一个很实用的量化方案。它也是理解“低比特量化如何兼顾精度与速度”的一个经典参考。

classic:450ef42b61f4.abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has facilitated their transformation into conversational chatbots that can grasp contextual nuances and generate pertinent sentences, closely mirroring human values through advanced techniques such as instruction tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). However, the computational efficiency required for LLMs, achieved through techniques like post-training quantization (PTQ), presents challenges such as token-flipping that can impair chatbot performance. In response, we propose a novel preference alignment approach, quantization-aware direct preference optimization (QDPO), that aligns quantized LLMs with their full-precision counterparts, improving conversational abilities. Evaluated on two instruction-tuned LLMs in various languages, QDPO demonstrated superior performance in improving conversational abilities compared to established PTQ and knowledge-distillation fine-tuning techniques, marking a significant step forward in the development of efficient and effective conversational LLMs.
classic:450ef42b61f4.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是：大语言模型在经过后训练量化后，虽然计算更省，但会出现 token 翻转等问题，从而削弱对话能力。作者提出了量化感知的直接偏好优化方法 QDPO，让量化后的模型尽量对齐其全精度版本的行为。该方法不只考虑压缩效率，也兼顾对话质量与人类偏好，对部署高效聊天模型很有价值。实验表明，QDPO 在多语言、指令微调模型上都优于常见的 PTQ 和知识蒸馏微调方法。
classic:450ef42b61f4.tldr: QDPO 让量化后的大语言模型在更省算力的同时，尽量保持接近全精度模型的对话能力。
classic:450ef42b61f4.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注大模型部署和量化效果的人阅读，因为它直接解决了“模型变小后聊天变差”的实际问题。作为经典参考，它展示了如何把偏好对齐思想用于量化模型优化。

classic:acb474f3bbcd.abstract: Quantization techniques are widely used to improve inference speed and deployment of large language models. While a wide body of work examines the impact of quantization on LLMs in English, none have evaluated across languages. We conduct a thorough analysis of quantized multilingual LLMs, focusing on performance across languages and at varying scales. We use automatic benchmarks, LLM-as-a-Judge, and human evaluation, finding that (1) harmful effects of quantization are apparent in human evaluation, which automatic metrics severely underestimate: a 1.7% average drop in Japanese across automatic tasks corresponds to a 16.0% drop reported by human evaluators on realistic prompts; (2) languages are disparately affected by quantization, with non-Latin script languages impacted worst; and (3) challenging tasks like mathematical reasoning degrade fastest. As the ability to serve low-compute models is critical for wide global adoption of NLP technologies, our results urge consideration of multilingual performance as a key evaluation criterion for efficient models.
classic:acb474f3bbcd.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了量化对多语言大语言模型的影响，问题是现有量化研究几乎只关注英文，缺少跨语言评估。作者结合自动基准、LLM-as-a-Judge 和人工评测，系统分析了不同语言、不同模型规模下量化后的性能变化。结果表明，自动指标会严重低估量化带来的真实损失，尤其在日语等语言上，人工评测观察到的下降远大于自动任务指标。论文强调，面向全球部署的高效模型应把多语言性能作为重要评价标准。
classic:acb474f3bbcd.tldr: 量化对多语言 LLM 的伤害在自动指标中常被低估，且非拉丁文字语言和复杂推理任务受影响最明显。
classic:acb474f3bbcd.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“量化是否真的适合全球多语言场景”这个问题讲清楚了。作为高效模型评估的经典参考，它提醒我们不能只看英文指标，还要重视不同语言上的真实使用效果。

classic:7ca9dd3d1a65.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), as a representative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT)method, significantly enhances the training efficiency by updating only a small portion of the weights in Large Language Models (LLMs). Recently, weight-only quantization techniques have also been applied to LoRA methods to reduce the memory footprint of fine-tuning. However, applying weight-activation quantization to the LoRA pipeline is under-explored, and we observe substantial performance degradation primarily due to the presence of activation outliers. In this work, we propose RoLoRA, the first LoRA-based scheme for effective weight-activation quantization. RoLoRA utilizes rotation for outlier elimination and proposes rotation-aware fine-tuning to preserve the outlier-free characteristics in rotated LLMs. Experimental results show RoLoRA consistently improves low-bit LoRA convergence and post-training quantization robustness in weight-activation settings. We evaluate RoLoRA across LLaMA2-7B/13B, LLaMA3-8B models, achieving up to 29.5% absolute accuracy gain of 4-bit weight-activation quantized LLaMA2- 13B on commonsense reasoning tasks compared to LoRA baseline. We further demonstrate its effectiveness on Large Multimodal Models (LLaVA-1.5-7B). Codes are available at https://github.com/HuangOwen/RoLoRA
classic:7ca9dd3d1a65.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是：在对大语言模型做 LoRA 微调时，如果进一步采用权重-激活量化，性能会明显下降，主要原因是激活值中存在离群点。作者提出 RoLoRA，先通过旋转操作消除离群点，再设计旋转感知的微调策略，保持旋转后模型的“无离群点”特性。实验表明，RoLoRA 能显著提升低比特 LoRA 的收敛效果和量化鲁棒性，并在 LLaMA2、LLaMA3 以及多模态模型上都取得了稳定收益。尤其是在 4-bit 权重-激活量化场景下，它在常识推理任务上相比 LoRA 基线带来最高 29.5% 的绝对准确率提升。
classic:7ca9dd3d1a65.tldr: RoLoRA 通过旋转去除激活离群点，并配合旋转感知微调，让 LoRA 在权重-激活量化下更稳、更准。
classic:7ca9dd3d1a65.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了低比特量化里最常见也最棘手的性能退化问题之一：激活离群点。作为 LoRA 与量化结合的经典参考，它给出了一个同时兼顾效率和精度的实用方案。

classic:e67119c41eea.abstract: Training Large Language Models (LLMs) is memory-intensive due to the large number of parameters and associated optimization states. GaLore, a recent method, reduces memory usage by projecting weight gradients into a low-rank subspace without compromising performance. However, GaLore relies on time-consuming Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) operations to identify the subspace, and the frequent subspace updates lead to significant training time overhead. Moreover, GaLore offers minimal improvements in accuracy and efficiency compared to LoRA in more accessible fine-tuning scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce Q-Galore, a novel approach that substantially reduces memory usage by combining quantization and low-rank projection, surpassing the benefits of GaLore. Our method is based on two key observations: (i) the gradient subspace exhibits diverse properties, with some layers converging early in training while others are subject to frequent changes; (ii) the projection matrices are highly resilient to low-bit quantization. Leveraging these insights, Q-GaLore adaptively updates the gradient subspace based on its convergence statistics, achieving comparable performance while significantly reducing the number of SVD operations. We maintain the projection matrices in INT4 format and weights in INT8 format, incorporating stochastic rounding to capture accumulated gradient information. This approach enables a high-precision training trajectory using only low-precision weights. We demonstrate that Q-GaLore achieves highly competitive performance with exceptional memory efficiency. At pre-training, Q-GaLore facilitates training a LLaMA-7B model from scratch on a single NVIDIA RTX 4060 Ti with only 16 GB memory. At fine-tuning, it reduces memory consumption by up…
classic:e67119c41eea.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是大语言模型训练时显存占用高、优化状态庞大的问题。作者在 GaLore 的低秩梯度投影基础上，引入量化与分层自适应更新机制，减少了频繁做 SVD 的开销。具体来说，方法将投影矩阵保留为 INT4、权重保留为 INT8，并配合随机舍入来保留累积梯度信息。实验表明，这种组合能在保持竞争性能的同时显著降低显存需求，甚至支持在单卡 16GB 上训练 LLaMA-7B。
classic:e67119c41eea.tldr: Q-GaLore 通过 INT4 投影、INT8 权重量化和自适应低秩更新，把大模型训练的显存和开销进一步压低。
classic:e67119c41eea.simple_intro: 这篇工作值得看，因为它把“低秩训练”和“低比特量化”结合起来，直接瞄准 LLM 训练中的显存瓶颈。作为经典参考，它展示了如何在尽量不损失性能的前提下，把训练做得更省内存、更实用。

classic:b7bc77b6b5c3.abstract: Attention, as a core layer of the ubiquitous Transformer architecture, is the bottleneck for large language models and long-context applications. FlashAttention elaborated an approach to speed up attention on GPUs through minimizing memory reads/writes. However, it has yet to take advantage of new capabilities present in recent hardware, with FlashAttention-2 achieving only 35% utilization on the H100 GPU. We develop three main techniques to speed up attention on Hopper GPUs: exploiting asynchrony of the Tensor Cores and TMA to (1) overlap overall computation and data movement via warp-specialization and (2) interleave block-wise matmul and softmax operations, and (3) block quantization and incoherent processing that leverages hardware support for FP8 low-precision. We demonstrate that our method, FlashAttention-3, achieves speedup on H100 GPUs by 1.5-2.0$\times$ with FP16 reaching up to 740 TFLOPs/s (75% utilization), and with FP8 reaching close to 1.2 PFLOPs/s. We validate that FP8 FlashAttention-3 achieves 2.6$\times$ lower numerical error than a baseline FP8 attention.
classic:b7bc77b6b5c3.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对 Transformer 中注意力计算在大模型和长上下文场景下成为性能瓶颈的问题，提出了 FlashAttention-3。它利用 Hopper GPU 上 Tensor Cores 与 TMA 的异步能力，通过 warp specialization、块级矩阵乘与 softmax 交错执行等方法，减少计算与数据搬运之间的等待。与此同时，论文引入块量化和 incoherent processing，充分发挥 FP8 低精度硬件支持。实验表明，FlashAttention-3 在 H100 上相比前代可进一步提升 1.5 到 2 倍性能，并在保持高吞吐的同时改善了数值精度。
classic:b7bc77b6b5c3.tldr: FlashAttention-3 通过异步执行和 FP8 低精度优化，把 H100 上的注意力计算进一步提速到接近硬件极限。
classic:b7bc77b6b5c3.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“如何让注意力真正跑满新一代 GPU”这个问题讲得非常清楚，并给出了工程上可落地的高性能方案。作为 FlashAttention 系列的延续，它也是理解现代高效注意力实现和低精度加速的重要经典参考。

classic:2586b3fb4360.abstract: When Large Language Models (LLMs) are compressed using techniques such as quantization, the predominant way to demonstrate the validity of such techniques is by measuring the model's accuracy on various benchmarks.If the accuracies of the baseline model and the compressed model are close, it is assumed that there was negligible degradation in quality.However, even when the accuracy of baseline and compressed model are similar, we observe the phenomenon of flips, wherein answers change from correct to incorrect and vice versa in proportion.We conduct a detailed study of metrics across multiple compression techniques, models and datasets, demonstrating that the behavior of compressed models as visible to end-users is often significantly different from the baseline model, even when accuracy is similar.We further evaluate compressed models qualitatively and quantitatively using MT-Bench and show that compressed models are significantly worse than baseline models in this free-form generative task.Thus, we argue that compression techniques should also be evaluated using distance metrics.We propose two such metrics, KL-Divergence and flips, and show that they are well correlated.
classic:2586b3fb4360.summary_zh: 这篇论文讨论了大模型量化后“只看准确率”可能掩盖真实质量退化的问题。作者发现，即使压缩前后 benchmark 准确率很接近，模型输出也可能出现大量“翻转”，也就是原本答对的变成答错，或相反。论文进一步在多个模型、数据集和压缩方法上分析了这种现象，并指出在自由生成任务中，压缩模型往往明显弱于基线模型。为此，作者建议除了准确率之外，还应使用 KL 散度和 flips 等距离指标来评估压缩效果。
classic:2586b3fb4360.tldr: 量化模型不能只看准确率；即便分数接近，输出行为也可能已经明显变差。
classic:2586b3fb4360.simple_intro: 这篇论文很适合作为量化评估的经典参考，因为它直接指出了“accuracy is not all you need”的核心问题：压缩后的模型可能在用户可见行为上和原模型差很多。它提醒我们，评估大模型压缩不能只盯着单一指标，而要更全面地看输出分布和生成质量。

classic:1d23bc22a9bc.abstract: Recently proposed methods for 1-bit and 1.58-bit quantization aware training investigate the performance and behavior of these methods in the context of large language models, finding state-of-the-art performance for models with more than 3B parameters. In this work, we investigate 1.58-bit quantization for small language and vision models ranging from 100K to 48M parameters. We introduce a variant of BitNet b1.58, which allows to rely on the median rather than the mean in the quantization process. Through extensive experiments we investigate the performance of 1.58-bit models obtained through quantization aware training. We further investigate the robustness of 1.58-bit quantization-aware training to changes in the learning rate and regularization through weight decay, finding different patterns for small language and vision models than previously reported for large language models. Our results showcase that 1.58-bit quantization-aware training provides state-of-the-art performance for small language models when doubling hidden layer sizes and reaches or even surpasses state-of-the-art performance for small vision models of identical size. Ultimately, we demonstrate that 1.58-bit quantization-aware training is a viable and promising approach also for training smaller deep learning networks, facilitating deployment of such models in low-resource use-cases and encouraging future research.
classic:1d23bc22a9bc.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了 1.58-bit 量化感知训练在小型语言模型和视觉模型上的表现，弥补了以往研究主要集中于 3B 参数以上大模型的空白。作者提出了一个 BitNet b1.58 的变体，在量化过程中用中位数替代均值，并通过大量实验系统评估了不同模型规模下的性能。结果表明，1.58-bit 量化不仅适用于大模型，在 100K 到 48M 参数的小网络上同样能取得很强的效果，尤其在扩大隐藏层后可达到或超过同规模最先进水平。该工作还分析了学习率和权重衰减等超参数对小模型的影响，证明了这种超低比特量化训练对低资源部署很有价值。
classic:1d23bc22a9bc.tldr: 1.58-bit 量化感知训练不仅适合大模型，在小型语言和视觉网络上也能达到甚至超过当前最优性能。
classic:1d23bc22a9bc.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把超低比特量化从“大模型专属”推进到了小模型场景，直接关系到低资源设备上的部署效率。作为经典参考，它也提供了小规模网络中量化训练的经验规律和超参数分析。

classic:9fb0cb5a60b1.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown immense potential across various domains, but their high memory requirements and inference costs remain critical challenges for deployment. Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising technique to reduce memory requirements and decoding latency. However, recent accurate quantization methods often depend on specialized computations or custom data formats to achieve better model quality, which limits their compatibility with popular frameworks, as they require dedicated inference kernels tailored to specific hardware and software platforms, hindering wider adoption. Furthermore, many competitive methods have high resource requirements and computational overhead for quantizing models, making it challenging to scale them to hundreds of billions of parameters. In response to these challenges, we propose LeanQuant (Loss-Error-Aware Network Quantization), a novel quantization method that is accurate, versatile, and scalable. In the existing popular iterative loss-error-based quantization framework, we identify a critical limitation in prior methods: the min-max affine quantization grid fails to preserve model quality due to outliers in inverse Hessian diagonals. To overcome this fundamental issue, we propose learning loss-error-aware grids, instead of using non-adaptive min-max affine grids. Our approach not only produces quantized models that are more accurate but also generalizes to a wider range of quantization types, including affine and non-uniform quantization, enhancing compatibility with more frameworks. Extensive experiments with recent LLMs demonstrate that LeanQuant is highly accurate, comparing favorably against competitive baselines in model quality, and scalable, achieving very accurate quantization of Llam…
classic:9fb0cb5a60b1.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型后训练量化中的一个核心问题：如何在显著降低模型体积和推理成本的同时，尽量保持模型精度。作者指出，现有一些高精度量化方法依赖特殊计算或定制数据格式，兼容性差，而且量化大模型时开销较高，不利于在通用框架中部署。为此，论文提出 LeanQuant，通过学习“感知损失-误差”的量化网格来替代传统的 min-max 仿射网格，从根本上缓解逆 Hessian 对角线中的异常值带来的质量损失。实验表明，该方法既更准确，又能支持更广泛的量化类型，兼具可扩展性和通用性。
classic:9fb0cb5a60b1.tldr: LeanQuant 通过学习损失-误差感知的量化网格，提升了大语言模型后训练量化的精度、兼容性和可扩展性。
classic:9fb0cb5a60b1.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它针对 LLM 量化里“精度、通用性、效率难兼顾”的老问题给出了一个更实用的方案。作为经典参考，它展示了如何在不依赖过多定制实现的前提下，提升量化质量并扩展到更大规模模型。

classic:163ef392b0af.abstract: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) is often constrained by memory bandwidth, where the primary bottleneck is the cost of transferring model parameters from the GPU's global memory to its registers. When coupled with custom kernels that fuse the dequantization and matmul operations, weight-only quantization can thus enable faster inference by reducing the amount of memory movement. However, developing high-performance kernels for weight-quantized LLMs presents substantial challenges, especially when the weights are compressed to non-evenly-divisible bit widths (e.g., 3 bits) with non-uniform, lookup table (LUT) quantization. This paper describes FLUTE, a flexible lookup table engine for LUT-quantized LLMs, which uses offline restructuring of the quantized weight matrix to minimize bit manipulations associated with unpacking, and vectorization and duplication of the lookup table to mitigate shared memory bandwidth constraints. At batch sizes < 32 and quantization group size of 128 (typical in LLM inference), the FLUTE kernel can be 2-4x faster than existing GEMM kernels. As an application of FLUTE, we explore a simple extension to lookup table-based NormalFloat quantization and apply it to quantize LLaMA3 to various configurations, obtaining competitive quantization performance against strong baselines while obtaining an end-to-end throughput increase of 1.5 to 2 times.
classic:163ef392b0af.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理中的核心瓶颈：参数从显存搬到寄存器的带宽开销。作者提出 FLUTE，一个面向查找表量化（LUT quantization）的灵活矩阵乘引擎，通过离线重排量化权重来减少解包时的位运算，并用向量化和查找表复制来缓解共享内存带宽压力。实验表明，在小批量推理和常见分组大小下，FLUTE 相比现有 GEMM 内核可提升 2 到 4 倍速度。作为应用，论文还将其扩展到基于 LUT 的 NormalFloat 量化，并在 LLaMA3 上获得了有竞争力的量化效果与 1.5 到 2 倍的端到端吞吐提升。
classic:163ef392b0af.tldr: FLUTE 用更高效的查找表矩阵乘把 LUT 量化 LLM 的推理速度提升到现有方法的 2–4 倍。
classic:163ef392b0af.simple_intro: 如果你关心量化后大模型如何真正“跑得快”，这篇论文非常值得看，因为它把算法设计和底层 GPU 内核优化结合得很紧。它也是理解 LUT 量化在实际部署中如何落地的一个很好的经典参考。

classic:be44c69ca199.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are crucial in modern natural language processing and artificial intelligence. However, they face challenges in managing their significant memory requirements. Although quantization-aware training (QAT) offers a solution by reducing memory consumption through low-bit representations with minimal accuracy loss, it is impractical due to substantial training resources. To address this, we propose Efficient Quantization-Aware Training (EfficientQAT), a more feasible QAT algorithm. EfficientQAT involves two consecutive phases: Block-wise training of all parameters (Block-AP) and end-to-end training of quantization parameters (E2E-QP). To the best of our knowledge, Block-AP is the first method to enable direct training of all parameters in a block-wise manner, reducing accuracy loss in low-bit scenarios by enhancing the solution space during optimization. E2E-QP then trains only the quantization parameters (step sizes) end-to-end, further improving the performance of quantized models by considering interactions among all sub-modules. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EfficientQAT outperforms previous quantization methods across a range of models, including base LLMs, instruction-tuned LLMs, and multimodal LLMs, with scales from 7B to 70B parameters at various quantization bits. For instance, EfficientQAT obtains a 2-bit Llama-2-70B model on a single A100-80GB GPU in 41 hours, with less than 3 points accuracy degradation compared to the full precision (69.48 vs. 72.41). Code is available at https://github.com/OpenGVLab/EfficientQAT.
classic:be44c69ca199.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化后如何尽量保留精度，同时降低显存和训练成本。作者提出 EfficientQAT，一种更实用的量化感知训练方法，分为两个阶段：先用 Block-AP 按块训练所有参数，再用 E2E-QP 端到端训练量化参数（步长）。这种设计既扩大了低比特优化的可行空间，又考虑了各子模块之间的耦合关系，从而提升量化模型表现。实验表明，它在 7B 到 70B 的多种 LLM 和多模态模型上都优于已有方法，并能在单张 A100 上较高效地训练出 2-bit 模型。
classic:be44c69ca199.tldr: EfficientQAT 用“按块训练 + 端到端调步长”的两阶段方案，让大语言模型的低比特量化训练更省资源、精度更稳。
classic:be44c69ca199.simple_intro: 如果你关心 LLM 量化训练如何从“理论可行”变成“工程可用”，这篇很值得看。它给出了一个明确、可复现的训练流程，并在大模型和低比特场景下展示了很强的实用性。

classic:c3797a45cb8b.abstract: With the commercialization of large language models (LLMs), weight-activation quantization has emerged to compress and accelerate LLMs, achieving high throughput while reducing inference costs. However, existing post-training quantization (PTQ) techniques for quantizing weights and activations of LLMs still suffer from non-negligible accuracy drops, especially on massive multitask language understanding. To address this issue, we propose Low-Rank Quantization (LRQ) - a simple yet effective post-training weight quantization method for LLMs that reconstructs the outputs of an intermediate Transformer block by leveraging low-rank weight-scaling matrices, replacing the conventional full weight-scaling matrices that entail as many learnable scales as their associated weights. Thanks to parameter sharing via low-rank structure, LRQ only needs to learn significantly fewer parameters while enabling the individual scaling of weights, thus boosting the generalization capability of quantized LLMs. We show the superiority of LRQ over prior LLM PTQ works under (i) 8-bit weight and per-tensor activation quantization, (ii) 4-bit weight and 8-bit per-token activation quantization, and (iii) low-bit weight-only quantization schemes. Our code is available at Software.
classic:c3797a45cb8b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在后训练量化中容易出现的精度下降问题，尤其是在多任务语言理解场景下更为明显。作者提出 LRQ 方法，用低秩的权重缩放矩阵来重构 Transformer 中间层输出，替代传统需要为每个权重学习缩放参数的全量矩阵。这样既减少了可学习参数数量，又保留了对权重的细粒度缩放能力，从而提升量化后模型的泛化表现。实验表明，LRQ 在多种量化设置下都优于已有 PTQ 方法。
classic:c3797a45cb8b.tldr: LRQ 用低秩权重缩放矩阵改进大语言模型后训练量化，在减少参数的同时显著缓解精度损失。
classic:c3797a45cb8b.simple_intro: 这篇工作适合作为 LLM 量化方向的经典参考，因为它抓住了“精度损失”和“参数效率”这两个核心矛盾。方法思路简单清晰，且在多种量化方案上都展示了稳定收益。

classic:00a504da4ece.abstract: The increasing scale of Transformer models has led to an increase in their pre-training computational requirements. While quantization has proven to be effective after pre-training and during fine-tuning, applying quantization in Transformers during pre-training has remained largely unexplored at scale for language modeling. This study aims to explore the impact of quantization for efficient pre-training of Transformers, with a focus on linear layer components. By systematically applying straightforward linear quantization to weights, activations, gradients, and optimizer states, we assess its effects on model efficiency, stability, and performance during training. By offering a comprehensive recipe of effective quantization strategies to be applied during the pre-training of Transformers, we promote high training efficiency from scratch while retaining language modeling ability. Code is available at https://github.com/chandar-lab/EfficientLLMs.
classic:00a504da4ece.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注 Transformer 语言模型在预训练阶段计算开销过高的问题，讨论量化能否像在微调后那样也用于从头训练。作者主要围绕线性层，对权重、激活、梯度和优化器状态进行简单而系统的量化实验，分析其对训练效率、稳定性和最终性能的影响。研究给出了一套在预训练中可行的量化实践方案，说明适当的量化可以在较少资源下维持语言建模能力。它为大模型高效预训练提供了直接可复用的经验和配方。
classic:00a504da4ece.tldr: 系统探索 Transformer 预训练中的量化策略，证明量化也能用于从零训练并提升效率。
classic:00a504da4ece.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“量化”从后训练阶段推进到预训练阶段，回答了一个很实际的问题：大模型能否在训练时就省算力。作为经典参考，它提供了清晰的实验结论和可操作的方案，适合做高效训练研究的入门依据。

classic:dd2928e1946e.abstract: Rapid advancements in GPU computational power has outpaced memory capacity and bandwidth growth, creating bottlenecks in Large Language Model (LLM) inference. Post-training quantization is the leading method for addressing memory-related bottlenecks in LLM inference, but it suffers from significant performance degradation below 4-bit precision. This paper addresses these challenges by investigating the pretraining of low-bitwidth models specifically Ternary Language Models (TriLMs) as an alternative to traditional floating-point models (FloatLMs) and their post-training quantized versions (QuantLMs). We present Spectra LLM suite, the first open suite of LLMs spanning multiple bit-widths, including FloatLMs, QuantLMs, and TriLMs, ranging from 99M to 3.9B parameters trained on 300B tokens. Our comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that TriLMs offer superior scaling behavior in terms of model size (in bits). Surprisingly, at scales exceeding one billion parameters, TriLMs consistently outperform their QuantLM and FloatLM counterparts for a given bit size across various benchmarks. Notably, the 3.9B parameter TriLM matches the performance of the FloatLM 3.9B across all benchmarks, despite having fewer bits than FloatLM 830M. Overall, this research provides valuable insights into the feasibility and scalability of low-bitwidth language models, paving the way for the development of more efficient LLMs. To enhance understanding of low-bitwidth models, we are releasing 500+ intermediate checkpoints of the Spectra suite at https://github.com/NolanoOrg/SpectraSuite.
classic:dd2928e1946e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理中的内存和带宽瓶颈问题，指出后训练量化在低于 4 bit 时往往会带来明显性能下降。作者没有只比较现成的量化方法，而是系统研究了从头预训练的低比特模型，特别是三值语言模型 TriLMs。论文发布了 Spectra LLM suite，覆盖 FloatLM、QuantLM 和 TriLM 等多种位宽、不同参数规模的模型，并在大规模训练与评测上做了全面比较。结果表明，TriLM 在按“比特数”衡量模型规模时具有更好的扩展性，在超十亿参数时甚至常常优于同等比特预算下的浮点和量化模型。
classic:dd2928e1946e.tldr: Spectra 系统证明：与其事后量化，不如直接预训练低比特语言模型，三值模型在大规模下更有潜力。
classic:dd2928e1946e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“低比特语言模型”从零散技巧变成了系统性的比较研究，结论对模型压缩和高效推理很有参考价值。对于想了解量化、三值网络和高效 LLM 设计的人来说，这是一个很好的经典入口。

classic:ff218e153eef.abstract: Modern recurrent layers are emerging as a promising path toward edge deployment of foundation models, especially in the context of large language models (LLMs). Compressing the whole input sequence in a finite-dimensional representation enables recurrent layers to model long-range dependencies while maintaining a constant inference cost for each token and a fixed memory requirement. However, the practical deployment of LLMs in resource-limited environments often requires further model compression, such as quantization and pruning. While these techniques are well-established for attention-based models, their effects on recurrent layers remain underexplored. In this preliminary work, we focus on post-training quantization for recurrent LLMs and show that Mamba models exhibit the same pattern of outlier channels observed in attention-based LLMs. We show that the reason for the difficulty of quantizing SSMs is caused by activation outliers, similar to those observed in transformer-based LLMs. We report baseline results for post-training quantization of Mamba that do not take into account the activation outliers and suggest first steps for outlier-aware quantization.
classic:ff218e153eef.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注递归式大语言模型 Mamba 的后训练量化问题，目标是在不重新训练的情况下进一步压缩模型，方便边缘设备部署。作者发现，Mamba 和基于注意力的 LLM 一样也存在明显的异常通道（outlier channels）和激活异常值，这正是量化困难的重要原因。论文通过实验说明，直接套用传统量化方法在 Mamba 上效果并不理想，并给出了不考虑异常值时的基线结果。它的价值在于把“异常通道”这一经典问题从 Transformer 扩展到了递归式模型，并为异常感知量化提供了初步方向。
classic:ff218e153eef.tldr: Mamba 量化也会被异常通道和激活异常值卡住，这篇论文揭示了问题并给出异常感知量化的起点。
classic:ff218e153eef.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把 Mamba 这类新型递归大模型的量化难点讲清楚了。对于想了解边缘部署、后训练量化以及异常值对模型压缩影响的人来说，它是很好的经典参考。

classic:02194fa6b75e.abstract: The quantization of large language models (LLMs) has been a prominent research area aimed at enabling their lightweight deployment in practice. Existing research about LLM's quantization has mainly explored the interplay between weights and activations, or employing auxiliary components while neglecting the necessity of adjusting weights during quantization. Consequently, original weight distributions frequently fail to yield desired results after round-to-nearest (RTN) quantization. Even though incorporating techniques such as mixed precision and low-rank error approximation in LLM's quantization can yield improved results, they inevitably introduce additional computational overhead. On the other hand, traditional techniques for weight quantization, such as Generative Post-Training Quantization, rely on manually tweaking weight distributions to minimize local errors, but they fall short of achieving globally optimal outcomes. Although the recently proposed Learnable Singular-value Increment improves global weight quantization by modifying weight distributions, it disrupts the original distribution considerably. This introduces pronounced bias toward the training data and can degrade downstream task performance. In this paper, we introduce Singular-value Diagonal Expansion, a more nuanced approach to refining weight distributions to achieve better quantization alignment. Furthermore, we introduce Cross-layer Learning that improves overall quantization outcomes by distributing errors more evenly across layers. Our plug-and-play weight-quantization methods demonstrate substantial performance improvements over state-of-the-art approaches, including OmniQuant, DuQuant, and PrefixQuant.
classic:02194fa6b75e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化后权重分布失配、RTN 量化误差大以及现有方法要么依赖额外计算、要么只做局部优化的问题。作者提出了 Singular-value Diagonal Expansion，用更细致的方式调整权重分布，使其与量化更匹配，同时通过 Cross-layer Learning 将误差在不同层之间更均匀地分摊。相比现有方法，这套即插即用的权重量化方案在不显著增加开销的前提下获得了更好的量化效果。论文的价值在于把“量化时如何改权重”这件事推到前台，提供了更接近全局优化的思路。
classic:02194fa6b75e.tldr: 提出 Singular-value Diagonal Expansion 和 Cross-layer Learning，在较小额外开销下显著提升 LLM 权重量化效果。
classic:02194fa6b75e.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型量化，这篇是值得看的新方法论文，因为它直接处理了“权重量化后分布不适配”的核心难题。它适合作为经典参考来理解：如何在尽量少改动模型本身的前提下，把量化误差降到更低。

classic:92278a1b671f.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance across various domains. However, the enormous number of model parameters makes fine-tuning challenging, significantly limiting their application and deployment. Existing solutions combine parameter quantization with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), reducing memory usage but causing performance degradation. Additionally, converting fine-tuned models to low-precision representations further degrades performance. In this paper, we identify an imbalance in fine-tuning quantized LLMs with LoRA: overly complex adapter inputs and outputs versus low effective trainability of the adapter, leading to underfitting during fine-tuning. Thus, we propose Quantized LLMs fine-tuning with Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation (Q-BLoRA), which simplifies the adapter's inputs and outputs while increasing the adapter's rank to alleviate underfitting during fine-tuning. For low-precision deployment, we propose Quantization-Aware fine-tuning with Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation (QA-BLoRA), which aligns with the block-wise quantization and facilitates quantization-aware fine-tuning of low-rank adaptation based on the parameter merging of Q-BLoRA. Both Q-BLoRA and QA-BLoRA are easily implemented and offer the following optimizations: (i) Q-BLoRA consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy compared to baselines and other variants; (ii) QA-BLoRA enables the direct generation of low-precision inference models, which exhibit significant performance improvements over other low-precision models. We validate the effectiveness of Q-BLoRA and QA-BLoRA across various models and scenarios. Code will be made available at \href{https://github.com/xiaocaigou/qbaraqahira}{https://github.com/xiaocaigou/qbaraqahira}
classic:92278a1b671f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注量化大语言模型在微调时性能下降的问题。作者指出，现有的量化 + LoRA 方法存在适配器输入输出过于复杂、但可训练能力不足的不平衡现象，容易导致欠拟合。为此，他们提出了 Q-BLoRA，通过简化适配器的输入输出并提高低秩分解的秩来提升微调效果。进一步地，QA-BLoRA 结合量化感知微调，使模型可以直接生成低精度部署版本，并在多种模型与任务上表现出更好的准确率和可部署性。
classic:92278a1b671f.tldr: Q-BLoRA/QA-BLoRA 通过平衡 LoRA 结构与量化设计，让量化大模型微调更准、更适合直接低精度部署。
classic:92278a1b671f.simple_intro: 如果你关心“怎么在省显存的同时尽量不掉点”这类大模型微调问题，这篇论文很值得看。它把量化微调中的结构不平衡讲得很清楚，并给出了一套易实现、效果稳定的改进方案，适合作为量化训练与部署的经典参考。

classic:84fe7412ac78.abstract: In this paper, we present the first structural binarization method for LLM compression to less than 1-bit precision. Although LLMs have achieved remarkable performance, their memory-bound nature during the inference stage hinders the adoption of resource-constrained devices. Reducing weights to 1-bit precision through binarization substantially enhances computational efficiency. We observe that some weights in binarized LLMs can be randomly flipped without significant performance degradation, suggesting the potential for further compression. To exploit this, our STBLLM employs an N:M sparsity technique to achieve structural binarization of the weights. Specifically, we introduce a novel Standardized Importance (SI) metric, which considers weight magnitude and input feature norm to more accurately assess weight significance. Then, we propose a layer-wise approach, allowing different layers of the LLM to be sparsified with varying N:M ratios, thereby balancing compression and accuracy. Furthermore, we implement a fine-grained grouping strategy for less important weights, applying distinct quantization schemes to sparse, intermediate, and dense regions. Finally, we design a specialized CUDA kernel to support structural binarization. We conduct extensive experiments on LLaMA-1/2/3, OPT family, and Mistral to evaluate the effectiveness of STBLLM. The results demonstrate that our approach performs better than other compressed binarization LLM methods while significantly reducing memory requirements.
classic:84fe7412ac78.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在推理阶段内存占用过高、难以部署到资源受限设备的问题。作者提出 STBLLM，将权重压缩到低于 1-bit 的结构化二值形式，并结合 N:M 稀疏性实现更进一步的压缩。论文还设计了标准化重要性（SI）指标、分层稀疏比例策略和细粒度分组量化，以在压缩率和精度之间取得更好的平衡。实验覆盖 LLaMA、OPT 和 Mistral 等模型，结果表明该方法在显著降低内存的同时优于其他二值化压缩方法。
classic:84fe7412ac78.tldr: STBLLM 通过结构化二值化把 LLM 压到 1-bit 以下，在大幅省内存的同时尽量保持性能。
classic:84fe7412ac78.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型如何真正落地到低资源设备，这篇论文很值得看。它代表了 LLM 极限压缩方向上的一个重要尝试，展示了二值化不一定只能停留在“1-bit”本身，还可以通过结构设计继续挖掘压缩空间。

classic:912adfd222ba.abstract: This paper presents the first study to explore the potential of parameter quantization for multimodal large language models to alleviate the significant resource constraint encountered during vision-language instruction tuning. We introduce a Quantization-aware Scale LeArning method based on multimodal Warmup, termed QSLAW. This method is grounded in two key innovations: (1) The learning of group-wise scale factors for quantized LLM weights to mitigate the quantization error arising from activation outliers and achieve more effective vision-language instruction tuning; (2) The implementation of a multimodal warmup that progressively integrates linguistic and multimodal training samples, thereby preventing overfitting of the quantized model to multimodal data while ensuring stable adaptation of multimodal large language models to downstream vision-language tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that models quantized by QSLAW perform on par with, or even surpass, their full-precision counterparts, while facilitating up to 1.4 times reduction in VL tuning time and GPU consumption. Our code is released at https://github.com/xjjxmu/QSLAW.
classic:912adfd222ba.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了多模态大语言模型在视觉-语言指令微调时面临的资源消耗问题，提出用参数量化来降低训练成本。作者设计了 QSLAW 方法，通过为量化后的 LLM 权重学习组级 scale 因子，减轻激活异常值带来的量化误差。与此同时，论文引入多模态 warmup，逐步融合语言与多模态样本，以避免量化模型对多模态数据过拟合并提升适配稳定性。实验表明，QSLAW 量化后的模型不仅能达到甚至超过全精度模型性能，还能将 VL 微调时间和 GPU 消耗降低最高 1.4 倍。
classic:912adfd222ba.tldr: QSLAW 用量化感知的 scale 学习和多模态 warmup，让多模态大语言模型在更省算力的情况下仍能高效微调。
classic:912adfd222ba.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“量化”真正推进到了多模态大模型的适配场景中，解决的是训练成本高、资源紧张的实际痛点。作为 2024 年的经典参考，它展示了如何在不明显牺牲性能的前提下提升训练效率。

classic:102bb0848e20.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized natural language processing tasks. However, their practical application is constrained by substantial memory and computational demands. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is considered an effective method to accelerate LLM inference. Despite its growing popularity in LLM model compression, PTQ deployment faces two major challenges. First, low-bit quantization leads to performance degradation. Second, restricted by the limited integer computing unit type on GPUs, quantized matrix operations with different precisions cannot be effectively accelerated. To address these issues, we introduce a novel arbitrary-bit quantization algorithm and inference framework, ABQ-LLM. It achieves superior performance across various quantization settings and enables efficient arbitrary-precision quantized inference on the GPU. ABQ-LLM introduces several key innovations: (1) a distribution correction method for transformer blocks to mitigate distribution differences caused by full quantization of weights and activations, improving performance at low bit-widths. (2) the bit balance strategy to counteract performance degradation from asymmetric distribution issues at very low bit-widths (e.g., 2-bit). (3) an innovative quantization acceleration framework that reconstructs the quantization matrix multiplication of arbitrary precision combinations based on BTC (Binary TensorCore) equivalents, gets rid of the limitations of INT4/INT8 computing units. ABQ-LLM can convert each component bit width gain into actual acceleration gain, maximizing performance under mixed precision(e.g., W6A6, W2A8). Based on W2*A8 quantization configuration on LLaMA-7B model, it achieved a WikiText2 perplexity of 7.59 (2.17$\downarrow $ vs 9.76 in AffineQuant). Compared to…
classic:102bb0848e20.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在落地时面临的两大瓶颈：模型太大、推理太慢，因此提出了后训练量化的加速方案。作者设计了 ABQ-LLM，一方面通过分布校正缓解权重和激活全量化带来的精度损失，另一方面用 bit balance 策略改善超低比特下的性能退化。更重要的是，它构建了一个面向任意比特组合的量化推理加速框架，突破了 GPU 只能高效支持 INT4/INT8 的限制。实验表明，该方法能在多种混合精度设置下同时兼顾精度与速度。
classic:102bb0848e20.tldr: ABQ-LLM 用任意比特量化和 GPU 加速框架，解决了 LLM 低比特推理既不准又不快的问题。
classic:102bb0848e20.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不仅讨论“怎么把模型量化得更小”，还进一步解决了“量化后如何真正跑得更快”这个工程关键问题。它适合作为量化推理与 LLM 部署方向的经典参考。

classic:ee1b074a984c.abstract: As inference on Large Language Models (LLMs) emerges as an important workload in machine learning applications, weight quantization has become a standard technique for efficient GPU deployment. Quantization not only reduces model size, but has also been shown to yield substantial speedups for single-user inference, due to reduced memory movement, with low accuracy impact. Yet, it remains open whether speedups are achievable also in \emph{batched} settings with multiple parallel clients, which are highly relevant for practical serving. It is unclear whether GPU kernels can be designed to remain practically memory-bound, while supporting the substantially increased compute requirements of batched workloads. This paper resolves this question positively by describing the design of Mixed-precision Auto-Regressive LINear kernels, called MARLIN. Concretely, given a model whose weights are compressed via quantization to, e.g., 4 bits per element, MARLIN shows that batchsizes up to 16-32 can be supported with close to maximum ($4\times$) quantization speedup, and larger batchsizes up to 64-128 with gradually decreasing, but still significant, acceleration. MARLIN accomplishes this via a combination of techniques, such as asynchronous memory access, complex task scheduling and pipelining, and bespoke quantization support. Our experiments show that MARLIN's near-optimal performance on individual LLM layers across different scenarios can also lead to end-to-end LLM inference speedups (of up to $2.8\times$) when integrated with the popular vLLM serving engine. Finally, MARLIN is extensible to further compression techniques, like NVIDIA 2:4 sparsity, leading to additional speedups.
classic:ee1b074a984c.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在实际服务中的批量推理效率问题，特别是在多用户并发场景下，量化是否还能带来明显加速。作者提出了 MARLIN 一组混合精度自回归线性内核，通过异步内存访问、任务调度与流水线设计，以及专门的量化支持，让 GPU 在较大 batch 下仍能保持接近内存受限的高效执行。实验表明，4-bit 量化在 batch size 16 到 32 时可接近 4 倍加速，在更大 batch 下仍有显著收益。将其集成到 vLLM 后，端到端推理最高可提升到 2.8 倍，并且还能与稀疏等压缩技术继续叠加。
classic:ee1b074a984c.tldr: MARLIN 证明了 LLM 量化不仅能加速单用户推理，也能在多用户批量服务中获得接近最优的显著性能提升。
classic:ee1b074a984c.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了一个很实际的工程问题：量化推理在并发服务场景里到底还能不能快。它给出了高性能 GPU kernel 的具体设计思路，是理解现代大模型部署优化的经典参考。

classic:b4e3871ba178.abstract: The advent of 1-bit large language models (LLMs) has attracted considerable attention and opened up new research opportunities. However, 1-bit LLMs only improve a fraction of models by applying extreme quantization to the projection layers while leaving attention heads unchanged. Therefore, to avoid fundamentally wrong choices of goals in future research, it is crucial to understand the actual improvements in computation and memory usage that 1-bit LLMs can deliver. In this work, we present an adaptation of Amdahl's Law tailored for the 1-bit LLM context, which illustrates how partial improvements in 1-bit LLMs impact overall model performance. Through extensive experiments, we uncover key nuances across different model architectures and hardware configurations, offering a roadmap for future research in the era of 1-bit LLMs.
classic:b4e3871ba178.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注 1-bit 大语言模型在实际计算与存储上的真实收益，而不是只看极端量化本身带来的表面优势。作者指出，现有 1-bit LLM 主要只量化了投影层，注意力部分仍然保持不变，因此整体加速和节省会受到明显限制。论文将 Amdahl 定律改造成适合 1-bit LLM 的分析框架，用来评估局部优化对整体性能的影响。通过大量实验，作者比较了不同模型结构和硬件条件下的表现，并总结出后续研究应优先关注的方向。
classic:b4e3871ba178.tldr: 用适配版 Amdahl 定律重新评估 1-bit LLM 的真实收益，提醒研究者别把局部量化优化误当成整体革命。
classic:b4e3871ba178.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不只是讨论“1-bit 能不能做”，而是进一步追问“到底能省多少、快多少”。对于想判断极端量化是否真有工程价值的人来说，它是一个很实用的经典参考。

classic:b5be09a53b4a.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized language processing, delivering outstanding results across multiple applications. However, deploying LLMs on edge devices poses several challenges with respect to memory, energy, and compute costs, limiting their widespread use in devices such as mobile phones. A promising solution is to reduce the number of bits used to represent weights and activations. While existing works have found partial success at quantizing LLMs to lower bitwidths, e.g. 4-bit weights, quantizing activations beyond 16 bits often leads to large computational overheads due to poor on-device quantization support, or a considerable accuracy drop. Yet, 8-bit activations are very attractive for on-device deployment as they would enable LLMs to fully exploit mobile-friendly hardware, e.g. Neural Processing Units (NPUs). In this work, we make a first attempt to facilitate the on-device deployment of LLMs using integer-only quantization. We first investigate the limitations of existing quantization methods for on-device deployment, with a special focus on activation quantization. We then address these limitations by introducing a simple post-training quantization method, named MobileQuant, that extends previous weight equivalent transformation works by jointly optimizing the weight transformation and activation range parameters in an end-to-end manner. MobileQuant demonstrates superior capabilities over existing methods by 1) achieving near-lossless quantization on a wide range of LLM benchmarks, 2) reducing latency and energy consumption by 20\%-50\% compared to current on-device quantization strategies, 3) requiring limited compute budget, 4) being compatible with mobile-friendly compute units, e.g. NPU.
classic:b5be09a53b4a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在手机等边缘设备上部署时面临的内存、能耗和算力瓶颈，尤其是激活量化在低比特场景下容易带来精度损失或额外开销的问题。作者指出，8-bit 激活对充分利用移动端 NPU 等硬件很有吸引力，但现有方法难以稳定实现。为此，论文提出了一个名为 MobileQuant 的后训练量化方法，通过端到端联合优化权重变换和激活范围参数，提升整数-only 量化的可部署性。实验表明，它能在多项 LLM 基准上接近无损，同时显著降低延迟和能耗。
classic:b5be09a53b4a.tldr: MobileQuant 让大语言模型更适合在手机上做整数-only 量化部署，兼顾精度、速度和能耗。
classic:b5be09a53b4a.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接面向“把 LLM 真正跑到手机上”这个落地难题，而不是只追求离线量化指标。它提出的方法简单且实用，适合作为理解移动端模型量化与部署优化的经典参考。

classic:1657656408c7.abstract: Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods have gained popularity and democratized the usage of Large Language Models (LLMs). Recent studies have shown that a small subset of weights significantly impacts performance. Based on this observation, we introduce a novel PEFT method, called Gaussian noise Injected Fine Tuning of Salient Weights (GIFT-SW). Our method updates only salient columns, while injecting Gaussian noise into non-salient ones. To identify these columns, we developeda generalized sensitivity metric that extends and unifies metrics from previous studies. Experiments with LLaMA models demonstrate that GIFT-SW outperforms full fine-tuning and modern PEFT methods under the same computational budget. Moreover, GIFT-SW offers practical advantages to recover performance of models subjected to mixed-precision quantization with keeping salient weights in full precision.
classic:1657656408c7.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型微调中的参数高效问题，指出并非所有权重都同等重要，只有一小部分“显著权重”对性能影响最大。作者提出 GIFT-SW 方法，只更新这些显著列权重，同时对非显著权重注入高斯噪声，以较低计算成本实现有效微调。为识别这些关键权重，论文还设计了一个统一前人工作的广义敏感度指标。实验表明，在相同预算下，GIFT-SW 不仅能优于全量微调和多种现代 PEFT 方法，还能帮助恢复混合精度量化后的模型性能。
classic:1657656408c7.tldr: GIFT-SW 只微调关键权重、给其余权重加噪声，在更省算力的同时还能超过多种 PEFT 方法。
classic:1657656408c7.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“哪些权重最重要”这个直觉做成了可操作的方法，并在大模型微调和量化恢复两个场景都验证了效果。对于想理解高效微调、模型压缩与精度恢复之间关系的读者，它是一个很有代表性的经典参考。

classic:de28136fb566.abstract: In recent years, compression of large language models (LLMs) has emerged as an important problem to enable language model deployment on resource-constrained devices, reduce computational costs, and mitigate the environmental footprint of large-scale AI infrastructure. In this paper, we lay down the foundation for LLM quantization from a convex optimization perspective and propose a quantization technique that builds on this foundation for optimum quantization outcomes. Our quantization framework, CVXQ, scales to models containing hundreds of billions of weight parameters and provides users with the flexibility to compress models to any specified model size, post-training. A reference implementation of CVXQ can be obtained from github.com/seannz/cvxq.
classic:de28136fb566.summary_zh: 这是一篇发表于Arxiv 2024的Quantization方向经典论文，适合作为该主题的代表性参考。 论文主要围绕“Foundations of Large Language Model Compression -- Part 1: Weight Quantization”展开。 原文摘要可帮助你快速定位方法与实验设定。
classic:de28136fb566.tldr: Quantization方向代表工作，发表于Arxiv 2024，适合快速建立该主题的经典论文地图。
classic:de28136fb566.simple_intro: 这是一篇发表于Arxiv 2024的Quantization方向经典论文，适合作为该主题的代表性参考。

classic:cc9ba1c58a67.abstract: To overcome the burden on the memory size and bandwidth due to ever-increasing size of large language models (LLMs), aggressive weight quantization has been recently studied, while lacking research on quantizing activations. In this paper, we present a hardware-software co-design method that results in an energy-efficient LLM accelerator, named OPAL, for generation tasks. First of all, a novel activation quantization method that leverages the microscaling data format while preserving several outliers per sub-tensor block (e.g., four out of 128 elements) is proposed. Second, on top of preserving outliers, mixed precision is utilized that sets 5-bit for inputs to sensitive layers in the decoder block of an LLM, while keeping inputs to less sensitive layers to 3-bit. Finally, we present the OPAL hardware architecture that consists of FP units for handling outliers and vectorized INT multipliers for dominant non-outlier related operations. In addition, OPAL uses log2-based approximation on softmax operations that only requires shift and subtraction to maximize power efficiency. As a result, we are able to improve the energy efficiency by 1.6~2.2x, and reduce the area by 2.4~3.1x with negligible accuracy loss, i.e., <1 perplexity increase.
classic:cc9ba1c58a67.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型规模不断增长，推理时的显存占用和带宽开销成为主要瓶颈，尤其是激活量化方面仍缺少有效方案。OPAL 提出了一种面向生成式 LLM 的软硬件协同设计方法，通过微缩放量化格式在每个子张量块中保留少量异常值，从而兼顾压缩率与精度。进一步地，OPAL 还为解码器中更敏感的层采用 5-bit、较不敏感的层采用 3-bit 的混合精度策略。基于这些设计，论文实现了专用加速器，在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著提升能效并降低面积。
classic:cc9ba1c58a67.tldr: OPAL 通过保留异常值的微缩放激活量化与软硬件协同设计，让生成式 LLM 推理更省能、更省面积且几乎不掉精度。
classic:cc9ba1c58a67.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不仅提出了更实用的低比特量化方法，还把量化算法和硬件结构一起设计，面向真实 LLM 推理场景优化。作为量化方向的经典参考，它很好地展示了如何在压缩、精度和硬件效率之间取得平衡。

classic:5092a6f2ed6f.abstract: Scaling model size significantly challenges the deployment and inference of Large Language Models (LLMs). Due to the redundancy in LLM weights, recent research has focused on pushing weight-only quantization to extremely low-bit (even down to 2 bits). It reduces memory requirements, optimizes storage costs, and decreases memory bandwidth needs during inference. However, due to numerical representation limitations, traditional scalar-based weight quantization struggles to achieve such extreme low-bit. Recent research on Vector Quantization (VQ) for LLMs has demonstrated the potential for extremely low-bit model quantization by compressing vectors into indices using lookup tables. In this paper, we introduce Vector Post-Training Quantization (VPTQ) for extremely low-bit quantization of LLMs. We use Second-Order Optimization to formulate the LLM VQ problem and guide our quantization algorithm design by solving the optimization. We further refine the weights using Channel-Independent Second-Order Optimization for a granular VQ. In addition, by decomposing the optimization problem, we propose a brief and effective codebook initialization algorithm. We also extend VPTQ to support residual and outlier quantization, which enhances model accuracy and further compresses the model. Our experimental results show that VPTQ reduces model quantization perplexity by $0.01$-$0.34$ on LLaMA-2, $0.38$-$0.68$ on Mistral-7B, $4.41$-$7.34$ on LLaMA-3 over SOTA at 2-bit, with an average accuracy improvement of $0.79$-$1.5\%$ on LLaMA-2, $1\%$ on Mistral-7B, $11$-$22\%$ on LLaMA-3 on QA tasks on average. We only utilize $10.4$-$18.6\%$ of the quantization algorithm execution time, resulting in a $1.6$-$1.8\times$ increase in inference throughput compared to SOTA.
classic:5092a6f2ed6f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时面临的高显存、高带宽和高推理成本问题，尤其是在极低比特量化下传统标量量化难以保持精度。作者提出了 VPTQ，一种向量后训练量化方法，把 LLM 的量化问题建模为二阶优化，并据此设计了量化流程、码本初始化以及更细粒度的权重细化策略。方法还支持残差量化和异常值量化，在进一步压缩模型的同时提升精度。实验表明，VPTQ 在 2-bit 场景下相比 SOTA 能更好地保持困惑度和下游任务表现，并显著提升推理吞吐。
classic:5092a6f2ed6f.tldr: VPTQ 用向量后训练量化把 LLM 压到 2-bit 仍尽量保精度，并带来更高推理吞吐。
classic:5092a6f2ed6f.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它针对“极低比特还能不能用”的核心难题给出了比较系统的解决方案。作为经典参考，它把二阶优化、码本设计和残差/异常值处理结合起来，适合了解 LLM 极限压缩的最新思路。

classic:d1dbe90b3a64.abstract: We train, for the first time, large language models using FP8 precision on datasets up to 2 trillion tokens -- a 20-fold increase over previous limits. Through these extended training runs, we uncover critical instabilities in FP8 training that were not observable in earlier works with shorter durations. We trace these instabilities to outlier amplification by the SwiGLU activation function. Interestingly, we show, both analytically and empirically, that this amplification happens only over prolonged training periods, and link it to a SwiGLU weight alignment process. To address this newly identified issue, we introduce Smooth-SwiGLU, a novel modification that ensures stable FP8 training without altering function behavior. We also demonstrate, for the first time, FP8 quantization of both Adam optimizer moments. Combining these innovations, we successfully train a 7B parameter model using FP8 precision on 256 Intel Gaudi2 accelerators, achieving on-par results with the BF16 baseline while delivering up to a $\sim 34 \%$ throughput improvement. A reference implementation is supplied in https://github.com/Anonymous1252022/Megatron-DeepSpeed.
classic:d1dbe90b3a64.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了如何将 FP8 训练扩展到万亿 token 级别的大语言模型，并首次在长达 2 万亿 token 的训练中验证其可行性。作者发现，FP8 在短训练中看不出的不稳定性会在长时间训练后显现，根源与 SwiGLU 激活带来的离群值放大有关。为解决这一问题，论文提出了 Smooth-SwiGLU，使 FP8 训练在不改变函数行为的前提下保持稳定。结合对 Adam 优化器动量的 FP8 量化，作者在 256 张 Intel Gaudi2 上训练出 7B 模型，效果与 BF16 基线相当且吞吐提升最高约 34%。
classic:d1dbe90b3a64.tldr: 首次把 FP8 训练推进到万亿 token 级别，并提出 Smooth-SwiGLU 解决长训练中的稳定性问题，实现更高吞吐且性能不掉队。
classic:d1dbe90b3a64.simple_intro: 这篇论文很值得看，因为它不仅证明了 FP8 可以用于超大规模、超长周期的 LLM 训练，还揭示了以前短实验看不到的稳定性隐患。对于关注低精度训练、训练加速和大模型工程化落地的人来说，这是一个很有参考价值的经典案例。

classic:568bf303453b.abstract: When quantizing weights and activations to increasingly narrower representations, the cost of additions begins to dominate that of multiplications in multiply-accumulate (MAC) units. Recent studies show that reducing addition costs via low-precision accumulation improves throughput, power, and area across inference platforms, albeit with an increased risk of overflow. Accumulator-aware quantization research has so far only considered the quantization-aware training (QAT) paradigm, in which models are fine-tuned or trained from scratch with quantization in the loop. As models and datasets continue to grow in size, QAT techniques become increasingly more expensive, which has motivated the recent surge in post-training quantization (PTQ) research. To bridge this gap, we introduce AXE, the first accumulator-aware quantization framework explicitly designed to endow overflow avoidance guarantees to PTQ algorithms. We present theoretical motivation for AXE and demonstrate its flexibility by implementing it on top of two existing algorithms: GPFQ and OPTQ. We design AXE to support multi-stage accumulation, opening the door to full datapath optimization for the first time. We evaluate AXE using recent language generation models; when quantizing Llama3 8B for a 16-bit multi-stage accumulation datapath, AXE maintains up to 98% of the FP16 perplexity, surpassing naive bit width manipulation by up to 15%.
classic:568bf303453b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是低比特量化后，累加器中的加法开销和溢出风险会逐渐成为推理系统的关键瓶颈。作者提出了首个面向后训练量化（PTQ）的累加器感知框架 AXE，用来在降低累加精度的同时提供避免溢出的保证。AXE 可以与现有 PTQ 方法结合，并支持多阶段累加，从而把优化范围扩展到完整数据通路。实验表明，它在语言模型上能较好保持精度，同时带来吞吐、功耗和面积上的潜在收益。
classic:568bf303453b.tldr: AXE 是首个面向 PTQ 的累加器感知量化框架，兼顾低精度累加带来的效率提升与溢出安全。
classic:568bf303453b.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“量化后如何安全地做累加”这个常被忽视的问题系统化了，且直接落到了 PTQ 场景。对于关注大模型推理加速、硬件友好量化和完整数据通路优化的人来说，它是很好的经典参考。

classic:4c1428402351.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely applied but face challenges in efficient inference. While quantization methods reduce computational demands, ultra-low bit quantization with arbitrary precision is hindered by limited GPU Tensor Core support and inefficient memory management, leading to suboptimal acceleration. To address these challenges, we propose a comprehensive acceleration scheme for arbitrary precision LLMs. At its core, we introduce a novel bipolar-INT data format that facilitates parallel computing and supports symmetric quantization, effectively reducing data redundancy. Building on this, we implement an arbitrary precision matrix multiplication scheme that decomposes and recovers matrices at the bit level, enabling flexible precision while maximizing GPU Tensor Core utilization. Furthermore, we develop an efficient matrix preprocessing method that optimizes data layout for subsequent computations. Finally, we design a data recovery-oriented memory management system that strategically utilizes fast shared memory, significantly enhancing kernel execution speed and minimizing memory access latency. Experimental results demonstrate our approach's effectiveness, with up to 2.4\times speedup in matrix multiplication compared to NVIDIA's CUTLASS. When integrated into LLMs, we achieve up to 6.7\times inference acceleration. These improvements significantly enhance LLM inference efficiency, enabling broader and more responsive applications of LLMs.
classic:4c1428402351.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在推理阶段的高效加速问题，尤其是超低比特和任意精度量化在 GPU 上难以充分利用 Tensor Core 的瓶颈。作者提出了一套完整的加速方案，包括新的 bipolar-INT 数据格式、按比特分解与恢复的矩阵乘法、面向计算的数据预处理以及更高效的内存管理。该方法在保证灵活精度的同时提升了 Tensor Core 的利用率，并显著减少了内存访问开销。实验表明，它在矩阵乘法上相对 CUTLASS 最快可达 2.4 倍提升，接入 LLM 后推理速度最高可提升 6.7 倍。
classic:4c1428402351.tldr: 提出一套面向任意精度量化 LLM 的 GPU 加速方案，显著提升 Tensor Core 利用率与推理速度。
classic:4c1428402351.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注 LLM 推理优化、量化加速和 GPU 系统实现的读者。它给出了从数据格式到内存调度的完整工程化思路，是研究低比特和任意精度推理时很有参考价值的经典工作。

classic:4b8e948f169e.abstract: Large language models have demonstrated promising capabilities upon scaling up parameters. However, serving large language models incurs substantial computation and memory movement costs due to their large scale. Quantization methods have been employed to reduce service costs and latency. Nevertheless, outliers in activations hinder the development of INT4 weight-activation quantization. Existing approaches separate outliers and normal values into two matrices or migrate outliers from activations to weights, suffering from high latency or accuracy degradation. Based on observing activations from large language models, outliers can be classified into channel-wise and spike outliers. In this work, we propose Rotated Runtime Smooth (RRS), a plug-and-play activation smoother for quantization, consisting of Runtime Smooth and the Rotation operation. Runtime Smooth (RS) is introduced to eliminate channel-wise outliers by smoothing activations with channel-wise maximums during runtime. The rotation operation can narrow the gap between spike outliers and normal values, alleviating the effect of victims caused by channel-wise smoothing. The proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art method in the LLaMA and Qwen families and improves WikiText-2 perplexity from 57.33 to 6.66 for INT4 inference.
classic:4b8e948f169e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在 INT4 量化推理中遇到的激活值异常值问题，它们会显著影响低比特推理的精度。作者观察到异常值主要可分为通道级异常和尖峰异常，并据此提出 Rotated Runtime Smooth（RRS）这种无需训练的激活平滑方法。RRS 结合运行时平滑与旋转操作，在不改动模型训练流程的前提下同时缓解两类异常值带来的影响。实验表明，该方法在 LLaMA 和 Qwen 系列上优于已有方法，并能显著提升 INT4 推理的困惑度表现。
classic:4b8e948f169e.tldr: RRS 通过“运行时平滑 + 旋转”在无需训练的情况下缓解激活异常值，显著提升大模型 INT4 推理精度。
classic:4b8e948f169e.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为量化方向的经典参考，因为它直接针对低比特推理中最棘手的激活异常值问题提出了实用方案。方法是即插即用的，既有工程价值，也能帮助理解大模型量化里“异常值处理”为何如此关键。

classic:e7d7607081d9.abstract: Quantization has established itself as the primary approach for decreasing the computational and storage expenses associated with Large Language Models (LLMs) inference. The majority of current research emphasizes quantizing weights and activations to enable low-bit general-matrix-multiply (GEMM) operations, with the remaining non-linear operations executed at higher precision. In our study, we discovered that following the application of these techniques, the primary bottleneck in LLMs inference lies in the softmax layer. The softmax operation comprises three phases: exponent calculation, accumulation, and normalization, Our work focuses on optimizing the first two phases. We propose an analytical approach to determine the optimal clipping value for the input to the softmax function, enabling sub-4-bit quantization for LLMs inference. This method accelerates the calculations of both $e^x$ and $\sum(e^x)$ with minimal to no accuracy degradation. For example, in LLaMA1-30B, we achieve baseline performance with 2-bit quantization on the well-known "Physical Interaction: Question Answering" (PIQA) dataset evaluation. This ultra-low bit quantization allows, for the first time, an acceleration of approximately 4x in the accumulation phase. The combination of accelerating both $e^x$ and $\sum(e^x)$ results in a 36.9% acceleration in the softmax operation.
classic:e7d7607081d9.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理中的量化加速问题，指出在现有权重量化和激活量化方法之后，softmax 往往成为新的主要瓶颈。作者围绕 softmax 的指数计算和累加两个阶段，提出一种解析方法来确定最优 clipping 值，从而支持低于 4 bit 的量化。该方法能在几乎不损失精度的情况下加速 e^x 和 ∑(e^x) 的计算，并在 LLaMA1-30B 上实现了 2 bit 量化下的基线性能。整体上，它把量化研究从 GEMM 加速进一步推进到非线性算子加速，对 LLM 推理优化具有实用价值。
classic:e7d7607081d9.tldr: 提出一种面向 softmax 的指数感知量化方法，在几乎不掉点的情况下显著加速 LLM 推理。
