classic:9ad134cdeb0f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在极低比特率下的后训练量化问题，目标是在尽量不损失性能的前提下进一步压缩模型权重。作者提出了 Channel-Relaxed Vector Quantization（CRVQ），通过挑选并重排少量关键通道，以及为这些关键通道使用扩展码本来放宽量化约束。该方法只增加很少的额外比特，却显著优于现有的亚 2-bit PTQ 基线，在实验中带来了 38.9% 的提升。它的价值在于把 1-bit 级别的极限压缩推向更接近“几乎无损”的可部署方案。
classic:9ad134cdeb0f.tldr: CRVQ 通过“关键通道重排 + 扩展码本”把 LLM 的极低比特量化压缩做得更接近无损。
classic:9ad134cdeb0f.simple_intro: 如果你关心把大模型部署到资源受限设备上，这篇论文很值得看，因为它直接挑战了亚 2-bit 乃至 1-bit 压缩的性能极限。它可以作为极端量化研究中的经典参考，帮助理解如何在压缩率和精度之间做更精细的权衡。

classic:86f59544c72e.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models (LLMs) holds the promise in reducing the prohibitive computational cost at inference time. Quantization of all weight, activation and key-value (KV) cache tensors to 4-bit without significantly degrading generalizability is challenging, due to the high quantization error caused by extreme outliers in activations. To tackle this problem, we propose ResQ, a PTQ method that pushes further the state-of-the-art. By means of principal component analysis (PCA), it identifies a low-rank subspace (in practice 1/8 of the hidden dimension) in which activation variances are highest, and keep the coefficients within this subspace in high precision, e.g. 8-bit, while quantizing the rest to 4-bit. Within each subspace, invariant random rotation is applied to further suppress outliers. We show that this is a provably optimal mixed precision quantization scheme that minimizes error. With the Llama and Qwen2.5 families of models, we demonstrate that ResQ outperforms recent uniform and mixed precision PTQ methods on a variety of benchmarks, achieving up to 33\% lower perplexity on Wikitext than the next best method SpinQuant, and upto 3\times speedup over 16-bit baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/utkarsh-dmx/project-resq.
classic:86f59544c72e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在后训练量化中的精度损失问题，尤其是激活值和 KV cache 中的极端异常值会显著放大量化误差。作者提出 ResQ 方法，先用 PCA 找到激活变化最大的低秩子空间，并将该子空间中的系数保留为高精度（如 8-bit），其余部分则量化到 4-bit。为了进一步抑制异常值，ResQ 在各子空间内加入随机旋转，从而形成一种混合精度量化方案。实验表明，该方法在 Llama 和 Qwen2.5 上优于多种统一精度和混合精度 PTQ 方法，在保持性能的同时还能带来显著推理加速。
classic:86f59544c72e.tldr: ResQ 通过“低秩子空间保高精度、其余部分低比特量化”的混合精度策略，显著降低 LLM 后训练量化误差。
classic:86f59544c72e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对 LLM 量化里最棘手的异常值问题，思路清晰且有理论支撑。作为 2024 年的经典参考，它展示了如何在压缩率、速度和模型精度之间取得更好的平衡。

classic:6da309d40c54.abstract: Quantization has become one of the most effective methodologies to compress LLMs into smaller size. However, the existing quantization solutions still show limitations of either non-negligible accuracy drop or system inefficiency. In this paper, we make a comprehensive analysis of the general quantization principles on their effect to the triangle of accuracy, memory consumption and system efficiency. We propose MixLLM that explores the new optimization space of mixed-precision quantization between output features based on the insight that different output features matter differently in the model. MixLLM identifies the output features with high salience in the global view rather than within each single layer, effectively assigning the larger bit-width to output features that need it most to achieve good accuracy with low memory consumption. We present the sweet spot of quantization configuration of algorithm-system co-design that leads to high accuracy and system efficiency. To address the system challenge, we design the two-step dequantization to make use of the int8 Tensor Core easily and fast data type conversion to reduce dequantization overhead significantly, and present the software pipeline to overlap the memory access, dequantization and the MatMul to the best. Extensive experiments show that with only 10% more bits, the PPL increasement can be reduced from about 0.5 in SOTA to within 0.2 for Llama 3.1 70B, while on average MMLU-Pro improves by 0.93 over the SOTA of three popular models. In addition to its superior accuracy, MixLLM also achieves state-of-the-art system efficiency.
classic:6da309d40c54.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化中的核心矛盾：如何在尽量压缩模型体积的同时，避免精度下降并保持系统效率。作者分析了精度、显存占用和推理效率之间的权衡，提出了 MixLLM，通过全局视角选择不同重要性的输出特征并分配混合精度。该方法不是在每一层局部做简单量化，而是寻找更优的全局配置，从而用较少的额外比特换取更好的准确率。与此同时，论文还设计了面向系统实现的两步反量化和高效流水线，显著降低了反量化开销。
classic:6da309d40c54.tldr: MixLLM 用全局混合精度量化把“更省”和“更准”同时推进，并在系统实现上把推理效率也做到了更优。
classic:6da309d40c54.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为 LLM 量化方向的经典参考，因为它不仅讨论算法上的精度提升，还把系统实现细节纳入整体设计。对于想理解“量化不只是压缩参数，还要兼顾推理工程效率”的读者很有启发。

classic:0a906c54bd1f.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于如何加速大语言模型推理，核心问题是在尽量保持模型效果的前提下，降低计算和存储开销。作者提出了结合分组量化与稀疏化的方法，通过把参数或激活压缩到更低精度，并进一步利用稀疏结构减少无效计算。该方法的目标是同时提升推理速度和资源利用率，适用于部署在算力和显存受限的场景。作为量化方向的工作，它为大模型高效推理提供了一种兼顾压缩率与性能的新思路。
classic:0a906c54bd1f.tldr: GQSA 通过分组量化和稀疏化联合压缩大语言模型，以更低成本实现更快推理。
classic:0a906c54bd1f.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型怎么在不显著掉点的情况下跑得更快，这篇论文值得看。它代表了量化与稀疏化结合来做推理加速的一类经典思路。

classic:d7773c58323e.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate exceptional performance across various domains, deploying LLMs on edge devices has emerged as a new trend. Quantization techniques, which reduce the size and memory requirements of LLMs, are effective for deploying LLMs on resource-limited edge devices. However, existing one-size-fits-all quantization methods often fail to dynamically adjust the memory requirements of LLMs, limiting their applications to practical edge devices with various computation resources. To tackle this issue, we propose Layer-Specific Adaptive Quantization (LSAQ), a system for adaptive quantization and dynamic deployment of LLMs based on layer importance. Specifically, LSAQ evaluates the importance of LLMs' neural layers by constructing top-k token sets from the inputs and outputs of each layer and calculating their Jaccard similarity. Based on layer importance, our system adaptively adjusts quantization strategies in real time according to the computation resource of edge devices, which applies higher quantization precision to layers with higher importance, and vice versa. {Experimental results show that LSAQ consistently outperforms the selected quantization baselines in terms of perplexity and zero-shot tasks. Additionally, it can devise appropriate quantization schemes for different usage scenarios to facilitate the deployment of LLMs.
classic:d7773c58323e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在边缘设备上部署时，如何在显存、算力受限的情况下尽量保持性能。作者指出传统“统一量化”方法无法根据不同层的重要性动态调整精度，因此提出了 LSAQ（Layer-Specific Adaptive Quantization）。LSAQ 通过比较每层输入输出的 top-k token 集合并计算 Jaccard 相似度，估计层的重要性，再依据设备资源为关键层分配更高精度、为不重要层采用更激进的量化。实验表明，该方法在困惑度和零样本任务上都优于若干基线，并能适配不同部署场景。
classic:d7773c58323e.tldr: LSAQ 通过“按层重要性自适应量化”，让大语言模型在资源受限设备上部署时更省内存且尽量少掉性能。
classic:d7773c58323e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“量化”从静态统一策略推进到可按层动态调节，更贴近真实设备部署需求。对于想了解大模型压缩、边缘推理和实用部署方案的人来说，它是一个很有代表性的经典参考。

classic:1acb4d2a992b.abstract: Quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) has recently gained popularity, particularly for on-device settings with limited hardware resources. While efficient, quantization inevitably degrades model quality, especially in aggressive low-bit settings such as 3-bit and 4-bit precision. In this paper, we propose DecDEC, an inference scheme that improves the quality of low-bit LLMs while preserving the key benefits of quantization: GPU memory savings and latency reduction. DecDEC stores the residual matrix -- the difference between full-precision and quantized weights -- in CPU, and dynamically fetches the residuals for only a small portion of the weights. This portion corresponds to the salient channels, marked by activation outliers, with the fetched residuals helping to correct quantization errors in these channels. Salient channels are identified dynamically at each decoding step by analyzing the input activations -- this enables adaptation to the dynamic nature of activation distribution, thus maximizing the effectiveness of error compensation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of DecDEC by augmenting state-of-the-art quantization methods. For example, DecDEC reduces the perplexity of a 3-bit Llama-3-8B-Instruct model from 10.15 to 9.12 -- outperforming its 3.5-bit counterpart -- while adding less than 0.0003\% to GPU memory usage and incurring only a 1.7\% inference slowdown on NVIDIA RTX 4050 Mobile.
classic:1acb4d2a992b.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对低比特量化大语言模型在 3-bit、4-bit 等激进设置下质量下降的问题，提出了一种推理阶段的动态误差补偿方法 DecDEC。方法将全精度与量化权重之间的残差矩阵存放在 CPU 中，并在解码时只为少量带有激活异常的显著通道动态取回残差来修正量化误差。由于显著通道会随输入分布变化而变化，DecDEC 通过每一步动态识别这些通道来提升补偿效果。实验表明，它能在几乎不增加 GPU 显存、仅带来很小推理开销的前提下显著改善低比特模型困惑度。
classic:1acb4d2a992b.tldr: DecDEC 通过动态补偿少量关键通道的量化误差，让 3-bit/4-bit LLM 在几乎不增加显存的情况下显著提升质量。
classic:1acb4d2a992b.simple_intro: 这篇工作值得看，因为它不是简单“把模型量化得更狠”，而是想办法把量化损失补回来，而且代价很小。作为低比特 LLM 推理优化的经典参考，它很适合关注端侧部署、显存受限场景和高效推理的人阅读。

classic:5cac4102e420.abstract: Quantized training of Large Language Models (LLMs) remains an open challenge, as maintaining accuracy while performing all matrix multiplications in low precision has proven difficult. This is particularly the case when fine-tuning pre-trained models, which can have large weight and activation outlier values that make lower-precision optimization difficult. To address this, we present HALO, a novel quantization-aware training approach for Transformers that enables accurate and efficient low-precision training by combining 1) strategic placement of Hadamard rotations in both forward and backward passes, which mitigate outliers, 2) high-performance kernel support, and 3) FSDP integration for low-precision communication. Our approach ensures that all large matrix multiplications during the forward and backward passes are executed in lower precision. Applied to LLAMA-family models, HALO achieves near-full-precision-equivalent results during fine-tuning on various tasks, while delivering up to 1.41x end-to-end speedup for full fine-tuning on RTX 4090 GPUs. HALO efficiently supports both standard and parameterefficient fine-tuning (PEFT). Our results demonstrate the first practical approach to fully quantized LLM fine-tuning that maintains accuracy in 8-bit precision, while delivering performance benefits. Code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/HALO.
classic:5cac4102e420.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究如何在训练和微调大语言模型时，把所有主要矩阵乘法都放到低精度下执行，同时尽量不损失精度。作者提出 HALO 方法，通过在前向和反向传播中策略性加入 Hadamard 旋转来缓解权重和激活中的离群值问题，并结合高性能算子与 FSDP 通信支持提升效率。实验表明，HALO 在 LLAMA 系列模型的多种微调任务上可以接近全精度效果，同时在 RTX 4090 上带来最高 1.41 倍端到端加速。它的重要价值在于首次较实用地展示了 8-bit 精度下的全量化 LLM 微调可行性。
classic:5cac4102e420.tldr: HALO 通过 Hadamard 旋转和低精度算子，让 LLM 训练与微调在 8-bit 下既快又准。
classic:5cac4102e420.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了“低精度训练会掉精度”这一量化训练中的核心难题，并给出了一套可落地的系统方案。作为经典参考，它同时兼顾了算法设计、工程实现和真实模型效果，适合了解低精度 LLM 训练的前沿进展。

classic:a0153f60b0c6.abstract: The recently introduced NVFP4 format demonstrates remarkable performance and memory benefits for quantized large language model (LLM) inference. However, we observe two types of redundancy in NVFP4 encoding: (1) The FP4 element format naturally exposes an unused quantization value due to its sign-magnitude representation that contains both positive and negative zeros. (2) The FP8 block scaling factor has an unused sign bit because it is always positive. Additionally, we find that LLM weights are more tolerant to a lower-precision block scaling factor. Based on these observations, we propose Redundant Zero Remapping (RaZeR), an enhanced numerical format that pushes the limits of NVFP4 for more accurate LLM quantization under the same memory footprint. RaZeR leverages the redundant bits of the block scaling factor to adaptively remap the redundant FP4 zero to additional quantization values with improved accuracy. To demonstrate the practicality of RaZeR, we design efficient GPU kernels for RaZeR-quantized LLM inference and propose novel hardware to natively support this. Extensive experiments validate RaZeR's superior performance for 4-bit LLM quantization. For example, relative to native NVFP4, RaZeR reduces the average perplexity loss by 34.6% and 31.2% under weight-only and weight-activation quantization, respectively. Code is available at: https://github.com/yc2367/NVFP4-RaZeR.
classic:a0153f60b0c6.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注 4-bit 大语言模型量化中的表示冗余问题，指出 NVFP4 编码里存在“负零”带来的未使用取值，以及块缩放因子中可利用的冗余比特。作者提出 RaZeR，通过重映射冗余零并复用缩放因子的比特，在不增加内存开销的前提下提升量化精度。论文还给出了高效 GPU 推理内核和面向硬件的支持方案，增强了方法的可落地性。实验表明，RaZeR 在权重-only 和权重-激活量化下都能显著降低困惑度损失。
classic:a0153f60b0c6.tldr: RaZeR 利用 NVFP4 中被浪费的“负零”和缩放因子冗余比特，在相同显存下把 4-bit 大模型量化做得更准。
classic:a0153f60b0c6.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为经典参考，因为它从数值表示细节出发，挖掘了量化格式里容易被忽视的冗余信息，并把它转化为实际精度收益。它同时覆盖算法、GPU 实现和硬件支持，展示了量化研究如何从理论设计走向系统落地。

classic:059ea889faf7.abstract: Deploying LLMs on edge devices presents serious technical challenges. Memory elasticity is crucial for edge devices with unified memory, where memory is shared and fluctuates dynamically. Existing solutions suffer from either poor transition granularity or high storage costs. We propose FlexQuant, a novel elasticity framework that generates an ensemble of quantized models, providing an elastic hosting solution with 15x granularity improvement and 10x storage reduction compared to SoTA methods. FlexQuant works with most quantization methods and creates a family of trade-off options under various storage limits through our pruning method. It brings great performance and flexibility to the edge deployment of LLMs.
classic:059ea889faf7.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是在边缘设备上本地部署大语言模型时，如何应对统一内存带来的动态波动和内存弹性问题。作者指出，现有方案要么切换粒度不够细，要么需要很高的存储开销。为此，FlexQuant 提出一种弹性量化框架，通过生成一组量化模型组成的集合，实现按需选择不同资源开销与性能折中的模型。实验表明，它相比现有最先进方法在切换粒度上提升 15 倍，同时将存储成本降低 10 倍。
classic:059ea889faf7.tldr: FlexQuant 用一组可切换的量化模型，为边缘设备上的本地 LLM 部署提供更细粒度、更低存储开销的弹性方案。
classic:059ea889faf7.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注边缘端大模型部署和量化压缩的人阅读，因为它直接解决了“算力和内存不稳定时怎么灵活用模型”的实际问题。作为经典参考，它展示了如何把量化从单一压缩手段扩展为可调度的弹性系统。

classic:1230b3eb0ca9.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly computationally complex, developing efficient deployment strategies, such as quantization, becomes crucial. State-of-the-art Post-training Quantization (PTQ) techniques often rely on calibration processes to maintain the accuracy of these models. However, while these calibration techniques can enhance performance in certain domains, they may not be as effective in others. This paper aims to draw attention to robust statistical approaches that can mitigate such issues. We propose a weight-adaptive PTQ method that can be considered a precursor to calibration-based PTQ methods, guiding the quantization process to preserve the distribution of weights by minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the quantized weights and the originally trained weights. This minimization ensures that the quantized model retains the Shannon information content of the original model to a great extent, guaranteeing robust and efficient deployment across many tasks. As such, our proposed approach can perform on par with most common calibration-based PTQ methods, establishing a new pre-calibration step for further adjusting the quantized weights with calibration. We show that our pre-calibration results achieve the same accuracy as some existing calibration-based PTQ methods on various LLMs.
classic:1230b3eb0ca9.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时的后训练量化问题，即如何在不明显损失精度的前提下大幅降低模型计算和存储开销。作者指出，现有很多PTQ方法依赖校准数据和校准流程，但这些方法在不同任务上的效果并不总是稳定。为此，论文提出一种统计性的预校准思路，在真正做校准之前先对权重进行自适应调整，通过最小化量化前后权重分布的KL散度来尽量保留原模型的信息量。实验表明，这种方法在多种LLM上可以达到与部分主流校准式PTQ方法相当的准确率，并且可作为后续校准的基础步骤。
classic:1230b3eb0ca9.tldr: 提出一种面向LLM后训练量化的统计预校准方法，在尽量保留权重分布与信息量的同时，达到接近主流校准式PTQ的精度。
classic:1230b3eb0ca9.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“量化前先做统计预校准”这个思路系统化了，给后训练量化提供了一个更稳健的起点。对于想理解LLM压缩、部署和校准关系的人来说，它是一个很有参考价值的经典方向。

classic:802409b88e29.abstract: Large-scale language models (LLMs) excel in language processing tasks but face deployment challenges due to high memory and computational demands. While low-bit quantization, such as 4-bit techniques, offers a potential solution, these methods often suffer from significant accuracy loss or require considerable effort for implementation such as reordering, rotation, etc. To address these challenges, we propose QRazor, a simple yet effective quantization scheme that enables 4-bit quantization of weights, activations, and KV cache in transformer-based LLMs. QRazor operates in two stages: first, quantizing data using 8 or 16-bit integers as a basis with absolute max scaling to preserve accuracy close to full-precision models, and second, compressing the quantized data to 4-bit using our significant data razoring (SDR) technique, which retains only the four most salient bits. Without any additional requirment of fine-tuning or additional training, QRazor achieves performance similar or better compared to state-of-the-art in 4-bit quantization method, surpassing Smoothquant and QLLM by over 12 points and Quarot(RTN) by more than 2.9 points in zero-shot reasoning task accuracy on the LLaMA2-7B model. Additionally, we introduce an integer-based arithmetic unit optimized for QRazor, allowing direct low-precision operations on SDR data without decompression.
classic:802409b88e29.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时面临的高显存和高计算成本问题，提出一种更简单可靠的 4-bit 量化方案 QRazor。它先用 8 位或 16 位整数配合绝对最大值缩放来尽量保留精度，再通过“significant data razoring”只保留最关键的 4 个比特，从而把权重、激活和 KV cache 一起压到 4-bit。该方法不需要额外微调、重训练或复杂的重排/旋转操作，却能在多项任务上达到甚至超过现有 4-bit 方法的效果。论文还设计了适配 SDR 数据的整数算术单元，便于直接做低精度计算。
classic:802409b88e29.tldr: QRazor 用一种几乎不需要额外工程的两阶段压缩，把 LLM 的权重、激活和 KV cache 稳定量化到 4-bit，并保持很强的精度。
classic:802409b88e29.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型如何在低显存设备上高效部署，这篇论文很值得看，因为它把“4-bit 量化”做得更简单、更稳。它适合作为经典参考，尤其适合了解如何在尽量少改模型和训练流程的前提下实现高质量压缩。

classic:229b22cb1799.abstract: Large-scale language models (LLMs) excel in language processing tasks but face deployment challenges due to high memory and computational demands. While low-bit quantization, such as 4-bit techniques, offers a potential solution, these methods often suffer from significant accuracy loss or require considerable effort for implementation such as reordering, rotation, etc. To address these challenges, we propose QRazor, a simple yet effective quantization scheme that enables 4-bit quantization of weights, activations, and KV cache in transformer-based LLMs. QRazor operates in two stages: first, quantizing data using 8 or 16-bit integers as a basis with absolute max scaling to preserve accuracy close to full-precision models, and second, compressing the quantized data to 4-bit using our significant data razoring (SDR) technique, which retains only the four most salient bits. Without any additional requirment of fine-tuning or additional training, QRazor achieves performance similar or better compared to state-of-the-art in 4-bit quantization method, surpassing Smoothquant and QLLM by over 12 points and Quarot(RTN) by more than 2.9 points in zero-shot reasoning task accuracy on the LLaMA2-7B model. Additionally, we introduce an integer-based arithmetic unit optimized for QRazor, allowing direct low-precision operations on SDR data without decompression.
classic:229b22cb1799.summary_zh: 这篇论文讨论了大语言模型在部署时面临的显存和算力压力，以及低比特量化常带来的精度下降问题。作者提出了一种新的量化方法，通过正交变换和缩放等处理，让模型参数与激活分布更适合做 4-bit 压缩。该方法无需额外微调或再训练，就能较好保留模型性能，并且在权重、激活和 KV cache 上都能进行低比特量化。论文还设计了面向这种表示的整数算术单元，进一步提升了实际推理效率。
classic:229b22cb1799.tldr: 提出一种无需再训练的 4-bit 量化方案，在尽量保留精度的同时显著降低 LLM 的存储与推理开销。
classic:229b22cb1799.simple_intro: 如果你想了解大模型低比特量化如何在“压缩率”和“精度”之间取得更好的平衡，这篇论文很值得看。它代表了经典量化思路中非常实用的一类：先让数据分布更适合量化，再做高效压缩。

classic:8a43255eed11.abstract: Post-training pruning, as one of the key techniques for compressing large language models, plays a vital role in lightweight model deployment and model sparsity. However, current mainstream pruning methods dependent on the Hessian matrix face significant limitations in both pruning speed and practical effectiveness due to the computationally intensive nature of second-order derivative calculations. This paper presents SwiftPrune, a novel Hessian-free weight pruning method that achieves hardware-efficient model compression through two key innovations: 1) SwiftPrune eliminates the need for computationally intensive Hessian matrix calculations by introducing a contribution-based weight metric, which evaluates the importance of weights without relying on second-order derivatives. 2) we employ the Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (EWMA) technique to bypass weight sorting, enabling the selection of weights that contribute most to LLM accuracy and further reducing time complexity. Our approach is extended to support structured sparsity pruning, facilitating efficient execution on modern hardware accelerators. We validate the SwiftPrune on three LLMs (namely LLaMA2, LLaMA3, and Pythia), demonstrating that it significantly enhances compression performance. The experimental findings reveal that SwiftPrune completes the pruning process within seconds, achieving an average speedup of 12.29x (up to 56.02x) over existing SOTA approaches.
classic:8a43255eed11.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在后训练阶段的剪枝压缩问题，目标是在尽量不损失精度的前提下提升部署效率。现有方法往往依赖 Hessian 矩阵来衡量权重重要性，但二阶导数计算开销大，导致剪枝速度慢、实用性受限。论文提出 SwiftPrune，一种无需 Hessian 的权重剪枝方法，改用基于贡献度的权重指标来评估重要性，并结合 EWMA 机制避免排序开销，从而显著降低时间复杂度。实验表明，该方法可在几秒内完成剪枝，并在多个 LLM 上获得明显的压缩加速效果。
classic:8a43255eed11.tldr: SwiftPrune 提出一种无需 Hessian 的大模型剪枝方法，能在保持效果的同时把剪枝速度提升到秒级。
classic:8a43255eed11.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了大语言模型压缩中“剪枝慢、成本高”的核心瓶颈。作为经典参考，它展示了如何用更轻量的设计替代昂贵的二阶信息计算，并把理论上的剪枝方法更好地推向硬件可执行的实践。

classic:35d0cf7d6c0e.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in natural language processing, but their high computational and memory costs hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices. Binarization represents the most extreme form of quantization, yet binarized models still contain redundancy that can be further removed. Pruning provides a natural way to eliminate such redundancy, but na\"ive combination with binarization often results in severe performance degradation. In this paper, we propose Progressive Binarization with Semi-Structured Pruning (PBS$^2$P), a novel post-training framework that seamlessly integrates binarization and semi-structured pruning. We first propose Stepwise semi-structured Pruning with Binarization Optimization (SPBO), which progressively introduces sparsity while optimizing binarization parameters to jointly reduce pruning and quantization error, yielding more stable and accurate compression. Additionally, we propose a Coarse-to-Fine Search (CFS) that first allocates pruning ratios and then refines element selection, further enhancing overall performance. Extensive experiments across multiple LLM families show that PBS$^2$P consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) binary post-training quantization methods in both perplexity and downstream accuracy. The code and models will be available at https://github.com/XIANGLONGYAN/PBS2P.
classic:35d0cf7d6c0e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时面临的高计算和高内存开销问题，尝试把二值化这种极端量化方式与剪枝结合起来进一步压缩模型。作者指出，简单地把剪枝和二值化叠加会带来明显性能退化，因此提出了后训练框架 PBS^2P。该方法通过逐步引入半结构化稀疏，并联合优化二值化参数，来同时降低量化误差和剪枝误差。实验表明，它在多个 LLM 家族上都比现有二值后训练量化方法取得更好的困惑度和下游任务准确率。
classic:35d0cf7d6c0e.tldr: PBS^2P 将渐进二值化和半结构化剪枝结合起来，在保持压缩率的同时更稳地提升二值 LLM 的性能。
classic:35d0cf7d6c0e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它处理的是 LLM 压缩里很难兼顾的两个目标：极致压缩和尽量少掉点。作为二值化与剪枝结合的经典参考，它展示了如何通过渐进式策略让激进压缩更可用。

classic:c3c0d347ee69.abstract: Why rely on dense neural networks and then blindly sparsify them when prior knowledge about the problem structure is already available? Many inverse problems admit algorithm-unrolled networks that naturally encode physics and sparsity. In this work, we propose a Physics-Inspired Binary Neural Network (PIBiNN) that combines two key components: (i) data-driven one-bit quantization with a single global scale, and (ii) problem-driven sparsity predefined by physics and requiring no updates during training. This design yields compression rates below one bit per weight by exploiting structural zeros, while preserving essential operator geometry. Unlike ternary or pruning-based schemes, our approach avoids ad-hoc sparsification, reduces metadata overhead, and aligns directly with the underlying task. Experiments suggest that PIBiNN achieves advantages in both memory efficiency and generalization compared to competitive baselines such as ternary and channel-wise quantization.
classic:c3c0d347ee69.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大规模推理模型在存储和计算上的高成本问题，提出不要先训练稠密网络再盲目稀疏化，而是直接利用逆问题中的物理结构与先验知识。作者设计了一个物理启发的二值神经网络 PIBiNN，将数据驱动的一比特量化与由物理决定、训练中无需更新的结构化稀疏相结合。该方法通过利用结构性零值把压缩率做到低于每权重一比特，同时尽量保持算子几何性质不被破坏。实验结果表明，它在内存效率和泛化能力上都优于三值量化、通道级量化等竞争基线。
classic:c3c0d347ee69.tldr: PIBiNN 用“单比特量化 + 物理先验稀疏”实现超高压缩的高效推理模型。
classic:c3c0d347ee69.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，是因为它把“压缩模型”这件事从事后剪枝，推进到直接按问题结构设计网络。作为量化与高效推理方向的参考，它提供了一种更贴合物理先验、也更省显存的经典思路。

classic:15d62af96759.abstract: One approach to reducing the massive costs of large language models (LLMs) is the use of quantized or sparse representations for training or deployment. While post-training compression methods are very popular, the question of obtaining even more accurate compressed models by directly training over such representations, i.e., Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), is still open: for example, a recent study (arXiv:2411.04330) put the "optimal" bit-width at which models can be trained using QAT, while staying accuracy-competitive with standard FP16/BF16 precision, at 8-bits weights and activations. We advance this state-of-the-art via a new method called QuEST, for which we demonstrate optimality at 4-bits and stable convergence as low as 1-bit weights and activations. QuEST achieves this by improving two key aspects of QAT methods: (1) accurate and fast quantization of the (continuous) distributions of weights and activations via Hadamard normalization and MSE-optimal fitting; (2) a new trust gradient estimator based on the idea of explicitly minimizing the error between the noisy gradient computed over quantized states and the "true" (but unknown) full-precision gradient. Experiments on Llama-type architectures show that QuEST induces stable scaling laws across the entire range of hardware-supported precisions, and can be extended to sparse representations. We provide GPU kernel support showing that models produced by QuEST can be executed efficiently. Our code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/QuEST.
classic:15d62af96759.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了如何在训练大语言模型时使用极低比特的量化表示，同时尽量保持训练稳定和模型精度。作者提出了 QuEST 方法，通过 Hadamard 归一化与 MSE 最优拟合，改进了权重和激活的量化过程，使其更快、更准确。与此同时，论文设计了新的 trust gradient estimator，用来减小量化状态下的噪声梯度与全精度梯度之间的误差。实验表明，QuEST 不仅在 4-bit 上达到很强的效果，还能稳定扩展到 1-bit 权重和激活，并支持稀疏表示与高效 GPU 执行。
classic:15d62af96759.tldr: QuEST 让大语言模型能在低至 1-bit 的权重和激活下稳定训练，并把量化训练的精度和可训练性推进到新的水平。
classic:15d62af96759.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接挑战了“量化训练只能在较高比特下稳定进行”的常见认知。它为低比特 LLM 训练提供了一个很有代表性的经典方案，也适合想了解前沿 QAT 方法的人作为参考。

classic:e999d4053099.abstract: The optimal bit-width for achieving the best trade-off between quantized model size and accuracy has been a subject of ongoing debate. While some advocate for 4-bit quantization, others propose that 1.58-bit offers superior results. However, the lack of a cohesive framework for different bits has left such conclusions relatively tenuous. We present ParetoQ, the first unified framework that facilitates rigorous comparisons across 1-bit, 1.58-bit, 2-bit, 3-bit, and 4-bit quantization settings. Our findings reveal a notable learning transition between 2 and 3 bits: For 3-bits and above, the fine-tuned models stay close to their original pre-trained distributions, whereas for learning 2-bit networks or below, the representations change drastically. By optimizing training schemes and refining quantization functions, ParetoQ surpasses all previous methods tailored to specific bit widths. Remarkably, our ParetoQ ternary 600M-parameter model even outperforms the previous SoTA ternary 3B-parameter model in accuracy, using only one-fifth of the parameters. Extensive experimentation shows that ternary, 2-bit, and 3-bit quantization maintains comparable performance in the size-accuracy trade-off and generally exceeds 4-bit and binary quantization. Considering hardware constraints, 2-bit quantization offers promising potential for memory reduction and speedup.
classic:e999d4053099.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注超低比特大语言模型量化中的核心问题：在 1-bit、1.58-bit、2-bit、3-bit 和 4-bit 之间，究竟怎样权衡模型大小与精度。作者提出了统一框架 ParetoQ，用来在不同位宽下进行严格、可比的实验分析，并进一步优化训练策略与量化函数。实验发现 2-bit 和 3-bit 之间存在明显的学习转折：3-bit 及以上模型更接近原始预训练分布，而 2-bit 及以下则会发生更剧烈的表示变化。ParetoQ 在多个位宽上都优于以往方法，并表明三值、2-bit 和 3-bit 量化在性价比上具有很强竞争力，尤其 2-bit 量化对显存压缩和加速很有潜力。
classic:e999d4053099.tldr: ParetoQ 统一比较极低比特量化，揭示 2-bit/3-bit 是关键分界，并在多种位宽上刷新了性能。
classic:e999d4053099.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把极低比特量化从“各说各话”推进到统一可比较的框架。对于想理解大模型如何在极限压缩下保持精度、以及低比特量化的真实边界的人来说，它是很好的经典参考。

classic:d32bdfb46049.abstract: Outliers have been widely observed in Large Language Models (LLMs), significantly impacting model performance and posing challenges for model compression. Understanding the functionality and formation mechanisms of these outliers is critically important. Existing works, however, largely focus on reducing the impact of outliers from an algorithmic perspective, lacking an in-depth investigation into their causes and roles. In this work, we provide a detailed analysis of the formation process, underlying causes, and functions of outliers in LLMs. We define and categorize three types of outliers-activation outliers, weight outliers, and attention outliers-and analyze their distributions across different dimensions, uncovering inherent connections between their occurrences and their ultimate influence on the attention mechanism. Based on these observations, we hypothesize and explore the mechanisms by which these outliers arise and function, demonstrating through theoretical derivations and experiments that they emerge due to the self-attention mechanism's softmax operation. These outliers act as implicit context-aware scaling factors within the attention mechanism. As these outliers stem from systematic influences, we term them systematic outliers. Our study not only enhances the understanding of Transformer-based LLMs but also shows that structurally eliminating outliers can accelerate convergence and improve model compression. The code is avilable at https://github.com/an-yongqi/systematic-outliers.
classic:d32bdfb46049.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大型语言模型中长期存在的“异常值”现象，指出它们不仅影响模型性能，也给量化和压缩带来困难。作者将异常值分为激活异常值、权重异常值和注意力异常值三类，系统分析了它们在不同维度上的分布及其与注意力机制的关系。论文进一步通过理论推导和实验说明，这些异常值主要源于自注意力中的 softmax 操作，并会作为一种隐式的、与上下文相关的缩放因子发挥作用。作者将这种由结构性机制产生的异常值称为“systematic outliers”，为理解 Transformer 和改进模型压缩提供了新的视角。
classic:d32bdfb46049.tldr: 论文揭示了 LLM 中异常值并非偶然噪声，而是由 softmax 和注意力结构系统性产生，并会影响压缩与性能。
classic:d32bdfb46049.simple_intro: 这是一篇很适合作为经典参考的论文，因为它不只是“处理”异常值，而是深入解释了异常值为什么会出现、它们在模型里起什么作用。对于研究量化、压缩和 Transformer 机制的人来说，这篇工作提供了重要的理论视角和实验依据。

classic:fc8daec94fbd.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing but pose significant challenges for real-world deployment. These models necessitate considerable computing resources, which can be costly and frequently unavailable. Model compression techniques such as quantization are often leveraged to alleviate resource demand, but they may have a negative impact on the generation quality. In this study, we explore the integration of 4-bit Post-training Quantization (PTQ) with QLoRA to address these issues. We demonstrate through extensive experiments that this integration outperforms standard PTQ, and in some cases even 16-bit full-parameter fine-tuning on LLMs, validated across proprietary and public datasets with different quantization algorithms. The results demonstrate the efficacy of PTQ-QLoRA integration, offering a viable solution for deploying powerful LLMs in resource-constrained environments without compromising on performance.
classic:fc8daec94fbd.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在真实部署中算力和显存开销过高的问题，提出将 4-bit 的后训练量化（PTQ）与 QLoRA 结合来缓解资源压力。作者通过大量实验验证，这种融合方法在多种量化算法和不同数据集上都优于标准 PTQ。更重要的是，在部分场景下，它的效果甚至可以超过 16-bit 的全参数微调。论文说明了 PTQ 与 QLoRA 结合在低资源环境中部署高性能 LLM 的实际价值。
classic:fc8daec94fbd.tldr: 将 4-bit PTQ 和 QLoRA 结合后，量化模型在多项实验中不仅优于标准 PTQ，部分情况下还可超过 16-bit 全参数微调。
classic:fc8daec94fbd.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，是因为它直接回答了“量化后还能不能再通过轻量微调把性能拉回来”这个很实际的问题。对于想把大模型部署到资源受限环境中的研究者和工程师，它提供了一个很有参考价值的组合方案。

classic:13e75d9ba391.abstract: Recent advances in large language models have led to specialized models excelling in specific domains, creating a need for efficient model merging techniques. While traditional merging approaches combine parameters into a single static model, they often compromise task-specific performance. However, task-specific routing methods maintain accuracy but introduce substantial storage overhead. We present \texttt{1bit}-Merging, a novel framework that integrates task-specific routing with 1-bit quantized task vectors to balance performance and storage efficiency. Our approach leverages the observation that different task-specific models store knowledge in distinct layers-chat models primarily in attention layers and math/code models in MLP layers, enabling targeted compression strategies. Through extensive experiments with LLaMA2 and Mistral model families across chat, mathematical reasoning, and code generation tasks, we demonstrate that 1bit-Merging achieves comparable or superior performance to existing methods while significantly reducing storage requirements. Our framework offers a practical solution for combining specialized models while maintaining their individual strengths and addressing the storage challenges of current approaches.
classic:13e75d9ba391.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在不同任务上逐渐专门化后，如何把多个专用模型高效合并成一个系统。作者指出，传统静态合并会损失任务性能，而任务路由虽然更准，却带来较高存储开销。为此，论文提出 1bit-Merging，将任务特定路由与 1 比特量化的任务向量结合，在尽量保持效果的同时大幅压缩存储。实验表明，它在聊天、数学推理和代码生成等任务上能取得与现有方法相当甚至更好的表现。
classic:13e75d9ba391.tldr: 1bit-Merging 用任务路由加 1 比特量化任务向量，实现了更省存储、效果又强的多专用大模型合并。
classic:13e75d9ba391.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关心大模型压缩、模型合并和多任务部署的人阅读，因为它直接回应了“怎么把多个专用模型合成一个更实用的模型”这一现实问题。它也很有参考价值，展示了如何针对不同能力分布层做定向压缩，而不是简单粗暴地把参数混在一起。

classic:718178ac4416.abstract: The burgeoning computational demands for training large language models (LLMs) necessitate efficient methods, including quantized training, which leverages low-bit arithmetic operations to reduce costs. While FP8 precision has shown potential, leveraging FP4 remains challenging due to inherent quantization errors and limited representation capability. Based on the Transformer architecture, we present an FP4 training scheme for LLMs, overcoming these obstacles through mixed-precision quantization strategies tailed for different modules and training stages. This allows us to apply the precision level suitable to distinct components within the model, ensuring that multi-head attention and linear layers are handled appropriately. Our pretraining recipe ensures stability in backpropagation by incorporating fine-grained quantization methods with a target precision training schedule. Experimental results demonstrate that our FP4 training scheme achieves accuracy comparable to BF16 and FP8, with smaller theoretical computational cost. With the advent of next-generation hardware supporting FP4, our method sets the foundation for efficient ultra-low precision training.
classic:718178ac4416.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型预训练计算成本过高的问题，尝试用更低比特的 FP4 精度来降低训练开销。作者基于 Transformer 架构设计了一个 FP4 训练方案，通过针对不同模块和训练阶段采用混合精度量化，缓解了 FP4 容易带来的量化误差和训练不稳定。该方法在注意力层和线性层上做了细粒度处理，并配合目标精度训练调度来保证反向传播稳定。实验结果表明，它在精度上可接近 BF16 和 FP8，同时具备更低的理论计算成本，为未来支持 FP4 的硬件上的高效训练提供了基础。
classic:718178ac4416.tldr: 提出一种面向大语言模型预训练的 FP4 混合精度训练方案，在保持接近 BF16/FP8 精度的同时进一步降低计算成本。
classic:718178ac4416.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接面向 LLM 训练的核心瓶颈——算力和成本，探索了比 FP8 更激进的 FP4 训练可行性。作为超低精度训练方向的代表性工作，它对后续硬件协同和高效预训练设计很有参考价值。

classic:29c7692cb6fd.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require immense resources for training and inference. Quantization, a technique that reduces the precision of model parameters, offers a promising solution for improving LLM efficiency and sustainability. While post-training quantization methods typically achieve 4-8 bits per parameter, recent research suggests that training LLMs with 1.58 bits per weight parameter from scratch can maintain model accuracy while greatly reducing memory requirements and energy consumption at inference time. Here, we investigate a training strategy for quantization-aware pre-training, where the models are first trained with 16-bit precision and then transition into 1.58-bit quantization-aware training. Our results on 11 downstream tasks show that this 16-to-1.58-bit training strategy is preferable over full 1.58-bit training and leaves models closer to those which have undergone 16-bit training. We further investigate the effects of retaining the optimizer state at the transition point and gradually phasing in quantization strength -- finding that both techniques alleviate the magnitude of loss spikes, but also that these effects can be compensated through further training.
classic:29c7692cb6fd.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型训练中的低比特量化问题，目标是在尽量保持模型能力的同时显著降低推理时的内存和能耗。作者研究了一种量化感知预训练策略：先用16-bit精度训练，再切换到1.58-bit继续训练。实验表明，这种16到1.58-bit的过渡方式在11个下游任务上优于从头进行全1.58-bit训练，并且能让模型更接近16-bit训练得到的状态。论文还分析了在切换时保留优化器状态、以及逐步增强量化强度对稳定训练的作用。
classic:29c7692cb6fd.tldr: 先16-bit预训练再切到1.58-bit，比从头全低比特训练更稳、更好。
classic:29c7692cb6fd.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注高效大模型训练和推理的读者，因为它直接回答了“什么时候从高精度切到极低比特”这个关键问题。它对BitNet类模型的训练策略给出了实证参考，也为节省算力与保持性能之间的平衡提供了经典思路。

classic:abbb7d53eac8.abstract: Language Models (LLMs) are often quantized to lower precision to reduce the memory cost and latency in inference. However, quantization often degrades model performance, thus fine-tuning is required for various down-stream tasks. Traditional fine-tuning methods such as stochastic gradient descent and Adam optimization require backpropagation, which are error-prone in the low-precision settings. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Quantized Zeroth-Order (QuZO) framework, specifically designed for fine-tuning LLMs through low-precision (e.g., 4- or 8-bit) forward passes. Our method can avoid the error-prone low-precision straight-through estimator, and utilizes optimized stochastic rounding to mitigate the increased bias. QuZO simplifies the training process, while achieving results comparable to first-order methods in ${\rm FP}8$ and superior accuracy in ${\rm INT}8$ and ${\rm INT}4$ training. Experiments demonstrate that low-bit training QuZO achieves performance comparable to MeZO optimization on GLUE, Multi-Choice, and Generation tasks, while reducing memory cost by $2.94 \times$ in LLaMA2-7B fine-tuning compared to quantized first-order methods.
classic:abbb7d53eac8.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型量化后性能下降的问题，指出在低精度场景下，传统依赖反向传播的微调方法容易出错且不稳定。作者提出 QuZO（Quantized Zeroth-Order）框架，直接使用低精度前向计算进行零阶微调，并通过优化的随机舍入来降低量化带来的偏差。实验表明，QuZO 在 FP8、INT8 和 INT4 训练中都能取得接近一阶方法的效果，且在多项任务上表现稳定。相比量化的一阶微调方法，它还能显著降低显存开销，适合资源受限的模型微调场景。
classic:abbb7d53eac8.tldr: QuZO 提出一种面向低比特大模型微调的零阶量化训练框架，在减少显存开销的同时保持接近一阶方法的性能。
classic:abbb7d53eac8.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了“量化后怎么继续高效微调大模型”这一实际难题。作为低比特训练与优化结合的经典参考，它对部署友好、资源受限场景尤其有启发。

classic:42e9efea3a92.abstract: Post-training Quantization (PTQ) technique has been extensively adopted for large language models (LLMs) compression owing to its efficiency and low resource requirement. However, current research lacks a in-depth analysis of the superior and applicable scenarios of each PTQ strategy. In addition, existing algorithms focus primarily on performance, overlooking the trade-off among model size, performance, and quantization bitwidth. To mitigate these confusions, we provide a novel benchmark for LLMs PTQ in this paper. Firstly, in order to support our benchmark, we propose a comprehensive taxonomy for existing mainstream methods by scrutinizing their computational strategies (e.g., optimization-based, compensation-based, etc.). Then, we conduct extensive experiments with the baseline within each class, covering models with various sizes (7B-70B), bitwidths, training levels (LLaMA1/2/3/3.1), architectures (Mixtral, DeepSeekMoE and Mamba) and modality (LLaVA1.5 and VILA1.5) on a wide range of evaluation metrics.Through comparative analysis on the results, we summarize the superior of each PTQ strategy and modelsize-bitwidth trade-off considering the performance. For example, our benchmark reveals that compensation-based technique demonstrates outstanding cross-architecture robustness and extremely low-bit PTQ for ultra large models should be reexamined. Finally, we further accordingly claim that a practical combination of compensation and other PTQ strategy can achieve SOTA various robustness. We believe that our benchmark will provide valuable recommendations for the deployment of LLMs and future research on PTQ approaches.We conduct an repository for our benchmark at https://github.com/zjq0455/PTQ_Benchmark.
classic:42e9efea3a92.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦大语言模型的后训练量化（PTQ）问题，指出现有研究虽然很多，但缺少对不同量化策略适用场景的系统比较，也很少同时考虑模型体积、性能和量化比特数之间的权衡。作者提出了一个新的PTQ基准框架，并按照计算策略对主流方法做了全面分类，如优化式、补偿式等。随后，他们在不同规模模型、不同位宽、不同训练版本、不同架构以及多模态模型上进行了大规模实验与统一评测。通过比较分析，论文总结了各类PTQ策略的优势与局限，为实际部署和后续研究提供了更清晰的参考。
classic:42e9efea3a92.tldr: 这是一篇面向LLM后训练量化的系统性基准论文，给出方法分类、统一评测和实用部署建议。
classic:42e9efea3a92.simple_intro: 如果你想快速了解LLM量化领域里各种PTQ方法到底各擅长什么，这篇论文很值得看。它不是只追求单点性能，而是把“怎么选方法、选多少比特、适合什么模型”这类工程问题讲清楚了。

classic:8053dad555af.abstract: We investigate how different compression techniques -- such as weight and activation quantization, and weight sparsity -- affect the scaling behavior of large language models (LLMs) during pretraining. Building on previous work showing that weight sparsity acts as a constant multiplier on model size in scaling laws, we demonstrate that this "effective parameter" scaling pattern extends to quantization as well. Specifically, we establish that weight-only quantization achieves strong parameter efficiency multipliers, while full quantization of both weights and activations shows diminishing returns at lower bitwidths. Our results suggest that different compression techniques can be unified under a common scaling law framework, enabling principled comparison and combination of these methods.
classic:8053dad555af.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型预训练中的压缩技术如何影响尺度规律，重点分析了权重量化、激活量化和权重稀疏化对模型性能与参数效率的作用。作者在此前“稀疏性可视作有效参数倍增”的基础上，进一步证明这种有效参数缩放模式也适用于量化。结果表明，仅对权重进行量化可以带来很强的参数效率提升，而权重与激活同时进行低比特量化时，收益会逐渐减弱。论文尝试用统一的尺度规律框架来比较和组合不同压缩方法，为压缩训练提供了更系统的理论视角。
classic:8053dad555af.tldr: 提出一个统一的压缩尺度规律框架，说明稀疏和量化都可通过“有效参数”视角比较其参数效率。
classic:8053dad555af.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把几种常见的模型压缩方法放到同一套尺度规律里分析，帮助理解“压缩到底省了多少参数”。如果你关心大模型预训练中的量化、稀疏化以及二者如何组合，它是一篇很好的经典参考。

classic:56dec26075b8.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are one of the most important killer computer applications. The recent algorithmic advancement proposes a fine-grained group-wise quantization for LLMs, which treats a small set (e.g., 64) of values in a tensor as a compression unit. It effectively preserves the model accuracy without retraining, and has become the standard approach to efficiently deploy LLMs. On the other hand, there are works that propose various adaptive data types to better adapt to different distributions and further reduce the required bit length for LLMs. In this work, our detailed analysis unveils a key finding that while different tensors exhibit similar distributions, small groups can have markedly different distributions. As such, the group-level diversity requires a new level of adaptivity for which existing adaptive data types fail to provide. In this paper, we propose MANT, a mathematically adaptive numeric type, featuring a more flexible encoding paradigm with a wider range of data distribution and more efficient decodingcomputation fusion mechanism to address these challenges. Based on MANT, we develop a supporting framework to assign the appropriate data type for each group adaptively. Meanwhile, the dynamically generated Key-Value (KV) caches in LLMs introduce further complexity for real-time quantization. To tackle this, we propose an efficient real-time quantization mechanism. Besides, we implement a specific processing element (PE) to efficiently support MANT and incorporate a real-time quantization unit. By integrating these components into a systolic array, MANT unifies the group-wise weight and KV cache quantization and addresses the associated challenges. Our evaluation shows achieving, on average, 2.99x (up to 4.46x) speedup and 2.81x (up to 4.10x)…
classic:56dec26075b8.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在低比特量化部署中的效率与精度平衡问题，尤其是细粒度分组量化在不同小组内分布差异较大时难以进一步压缩的挑战。作者通过分析发现，虽然不同张量整体分布相似，但小组级别的分布差异显著，因此需要比现有自适应数据类型更细的适配能力。为此，论文提出 MANT（一种数学自适应数值类型），通过更灵活的编码方式和更高效的解码计算融合机制，为每个组动态选择合适的数据类型。实验表明，该方法不仅能统一处理权重和 KV cache 量化，还能显著提升推理速度并降低量化开销。
classic:56dec26075b8.tldr: MANT 提出一种面向 LLM 分组量化的数学自适应数值类型，在保持精度的同时提升低比特部署效率。
classic:56dec26075b8.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对 LLM 量化落地中的核心痛点——不同小组分布差异导致的压缩瓶颈——给出了系统性解决方案。它适合作为经典参考，帮助理解下一代自适应量化如何同时兼顾精度、速度和硬件实现。

classic:77d2cb271f24.abstract: Serving Large Language Models (LLMs) is costly. However, post-training weight quantization can address this problem by both compressing their sizes for limited memory and saving bandwidth for acceleration. As not all weight dimensions are equally important, those methods typically rely on a sensitivity metric, which indicates the element-wise influence of weights on loss function and is used to preprocess original weights for better quantization. In this work, we conduct an empirical study on the accuracy of the sensitivity metric, and find that existing gradient and Hessian based metrics are very inaccurate: they underestimate quantization's impact on the loss function by orders of magnitude, mainly due to the small convergence radius of local 2nd order approximation, \ie, gradient and Hessian term in Taylor's formula. To tackle this problem, we propose Post-quantization Integral (PQI), an accurate metric to estimate posterior sensitivity in a fine-grained manner. To leverage this accurate metric, we further propose ReQuant, a simple yet powerful framework that mainly consists of two Dense-and-Sparse detach components: self-adaptive outlier selection and step-wise significant weights detach. Results show that ReQuant boosts state-of-the-art post-training quantization methods, with a pronounced improvement of 2.66 perplexity gain on Llama 3.2 1B with QTIP.
classic:77d2cb271f24.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型后训练权重量化中的“敏感权重”识别问题，因为不同权重对量化误差和最终损失的影响并不相同。作者通过实证研究发现，现有基于梯度和 Hessian 的敏感度度量严重低估了量化对损失的影响，主要原因是局部二阶近似的有效范围太小。为了解决这一问题，论文提出了 Post-quantization Integral（PQI），用更精细的方式估计后验敏感度。基于 PQI，作者进一步设计了 ReQuant 框架，通过稠密-稀疏解耦提升量化效果，并在多个方法上取得了明显性能增益。
classic:77d2cb271f24.tldr: 提出 PQI 和 ReQuant，更准确地识别量化中的敏感权重，显著提升大模型后训练量化效果。
classic:77d2cb271f24.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接指出了传统敏感度指标在量化中“不准”的核心问题，并给出了更可靠的替代方案。对于想理解大模型后训练量化如何在精度和压缩率之间取得平衡的人来说，它是很有参考价值的经典工作。

classic:2efa620c1614.abstract: Layer-wise quantization is a key technique for efficiently compressing large models without expensive retraining. Previous methods typically quantize the weights of each layer by "uniformly" optimizing the layer reconstruction loss across all output tokens. However, in this paper, we demonstrate that better-quantized models can be obtained by prioritizing learning from important tokens (e.g. which have large attention scores). Building on this finding, we propose RSQ (Rotate, Scale, then Quantize), which (1) applies rotations (orthogonal transformation) to the model to mitigate outliers (those with exceptionally large magnitude), (2) scales the token feature based on its importance, and (3) quantizes the model using the GPTQ framework with the second-order statistics computed by scaled tokens. To compute token importance, we explore both heuristic and dynamic strategies. Based on a thorough analysis of all approaches, we adopt attention concentration, which uses attention scores of each token as its importance, as the best approach. We demonstrate that RSQ consistently outperforms baseline methods across multiple downstream tasks and three model families: LLaMA3, Mistral, and Qwen2.5. Additionally, models quantized with RSQ achieve superior performance on long-context tasks, further highlighting its effectiveness. Lastly, RSQ demonstrates generalizability across various setups, including different model sizes, calibration datasets, bit precisions, and quantization methods.
classic:2efa620c1614.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型层级量化中的一个关键问题：传统方法通常对所有输出 token 一视同仁地优化重建误差，但这并不一定最有效。作者发现，如果在量化时优先学习“重要 token”，例如注意力分数更高的 token，模型可以获得更好的量化效果。基于这一观察，论文提出 RSQ（Rotate, Scale, then Quantize）框架，先用旋转缓解异常值，再按 token 重要性进行缩放，最后结合 GPTQ 与加权后的二阶统计量完成量化。实验表明，RSQ 在多个模型家族、下游任务和长上下文任务上都优于现有基线，并且具有较好的泛化性。
classic:2efa620c1614.tldr: RSQ 通过“先旋转、再按重要 token 缩放、最后量化”的策略，让大模型量化效果更好、长上下文表现更强。
classic:2efa620c1614.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“哪些 token 更重要”引入了量化过程，给传统的均匀量化提供了更有效的改进思路。对于想了解大模型压缩、GPTQ 改进和长上下文量化性能的人来说，它是一个很好的参考。

classic:3ff7e5ca053b.abstract: We present a novel approach to selective model quantization that transcends the limitations of architecture-specific and size-dependent compression methods for Large Language Models (LLMs) using Entropy-Weighted Quantization (EWQ). By analyzing the entropy distribution across transformer blocks, EWQ determines which blocks can be safely quantized without causing significant performance degradation, independent of model architecture or size. Our method outperforms uniform quantization approaches, maintaining Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU) accuracy scores within 0.5% of unquantized models while reducing memory usage by up to 18%. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EWQ across multiple architectures -- from 1.6B to 70B parameters -- and showcase consistent improvements in the quality-compression trade-off regardless of model scale or architectural design. A surprising finding of EWQ is its ability to reduce perplexity compared to unquantized models, suggesting the presence of beneficial regularization through selective precision reduction. This improvement holds across different model families, indicating a fundamental relationship between layer-level entropy and optimal precision requirements. Additionally, we introduce FastEWQ, a rapid method for entropy distribution analysis that eliminates the need for loading model weights. This technique leverages universal characteristics of entropy distribution that persist across various architectures and scales, enabling near-instantaneous quantization decisions while maintaining 80% classification accuracy with full entropy analysis. Our results demonstrate that effective quantization strategies can be developed independently of specific architectural choices or model sizes, opening new possibilities for effici…
classic:3ff7e5ca053b.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究如何在不依赖模型架构和参数规模的前提下，对大语言模型进行更稳健的选择性量化。作者提出 Entropy-Weighted Quantization（EWQ），通过分析 transformer 各层的熵分布，判断哪些层可以安全压缩而不明显损伤性能。实验表明，该方法在 1.6B 到 70B 的多种模型上都能稳定工作，MMLU 准确率几乎不变，同时最多可减少 18% 的显存占用。更有意思的是，部分模型在量化后困惑度反而下降，说明选择性降精度可能带来一定正则化效果。
classic:3ff7e5ca053b.tldr: EWQ 用层级熵分布来决定哪些层该量化，跨架构、跨规模都能保持几乎不掉点的压缩效果。
classic:3ff7e5ca053b.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把量化策略从“依赖特定模型经验”推进到“更通用的层级判别规则”，对不同家族和不同大小的 LLM 都有参考价值。对于想做高效部署或研究量化理论的人来说，它提供了一个很有代表性的经典思路。

classic:29eb4aa56854.abstract: Large Vision and Language Models have exhibited remarkable human-like intelligence in tasks such as natural language comprehension, problem-solving, logical reasoning, and knowledge retrieval. However, training and serving these models require substantial computational resources, posing a significant barrier to their widespread application and further research. To mitigate this challenge, various model compression techniques have been developed to reduce computational requirements. Nevertheless, existing methods often employ uniform quantization configurations, failing to account for the varying difficulties across different layers in quantizing large neural network models. This paper tackles this issue by leveraging layer-sensitivity features, such as activation sensitivity and weight distribution Kurtosis, to identify layers that are challenging to quantize accurately and allocate additional memory budget. The proposed methods, named SensiBoost and KurtBoost, respectively, demonstrate notable improvement in quantization accuracy, achieving up to 9% lower perplexity with only a 2% increase in memory budget on LLama models compared to the baseline.
classic:29eb4aa56854.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大规模视觉与语言模型在量化后精度下降的问题，指出现有方法通常对所有层使用统一的量化配置，没有考虑不同层的量化难度差异。作者提出基于层敏感性的量化策略，利用激活敏感度和权重分布峰度等特征来识别更难量化的层，并为这些层分配更多内存预算。论文提出的 SensiBoost 和 KurtBoost 方法在 LLaMA 模型上实现了更好的量化效果，在仅增加 2% 内存预算的情况下，困惑度最高降低 9%。这项工作为如何在有限资源下更精细地提升量化精度提供了实用思路。
classic:29eb4aa56854.tldr: 通过识别“难量化”的层并给它们更多预算，这篇论文在几乎不增加成本的情况下显著提升了量化精度。
classic:29eb4aa56854.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“量化不是一刀切”的想法做成了具体方法，适合想提高大模型压缩精度的人参考。它也提供了可直接迁移的层敏感分析思路，对后续量化研究很有启发。

classic:0a154ab323ad.abstract: Quantization has been widely used to compress and accelerate inference of large language models (LLMs). Existing methods focus on exploring the per-token dynamic calibration to ensure both inference acceleration and model accuracy under 4-bit quantization. However, in autoregressive generation inference of long sequences, the overhead of repeated dynamic quantization and dequantization steps becomes considerably expensive. In this work, we propose MergeQuant, an accurate and efficient per-channel static quantization framework. MergeQuant integrates the per-channel quantization steps with the corresponding scalings and linear mappings through a Quantization Step Migration (QSM) method, thereby eliminating the quantization overheads before and after matrix multiplication. Furthermore, in view of the significant differences between the different channel ranges, we propose dimensional reconstruction and adaptive clipping to address the non-uniformity of quantization scale factors and redistribute the channel variations to the subsequent modules to balance the parameter distribution under QSM. Within the static quantization setting of W4A4, MergeQuant reduces the accuracy gap on zero-shot tasks compared to FP16 baseline to 1.3 points on Llama-2-70B model. On Llama-2-7B model, MergeQuant achieves up to 1.77x speedup in decoding, and up to 2.06x speedup in end-to-end compared to FP16 baseline.
classic:0a154ab323ad.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在4-bit量化下推理速度与精度难以兼顾的问题，尤其是长序列自回归生成中动态量化带来的额外开销。作者提出 MergeQuant，一个按通道的静态量化框架，通过量化步迁移（QSM）把量化、缩放和线性映射融合到矩阵乘法前后，从而减少推理时的额外计算。论文还引入维度重构和自适应裁剪，缓解不同通道尺度不均带来的量化误差。实验表明，该方法在保持较高精度的同时显著提升了解码和端到端速度。
classic:0a154ab323ad.tldr: MergeQuant 用通道级静态量化替代动态量化，在 4-bit 下同时提升 LLM 推理速度和精度。
classic:0a154ab323ad.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为量化方向的经典参考，因为它直接针对大模型部署中最实际的痛点：4-bit 量化既要快，也不能掉太多精度。它提出的思路不仅有效，而且很贴近工程落地场景，值得做模型压缩和高效推理的人重点看。

classic:305098e769f8.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) scale, model compression is crucial for edge deployment and accessibility. Weight-only quantization reduces model size but suffers from performance degradation at lower bit widths. Moreover, standard finetuning is incompatible with quantized models, and alternative methods often fall short of full finetuning. In this paper, we propose ClusComp, a simple yet effective compression paradigm that clusters weight matrices into codebooks and finetunes them block-by-block. ClusComp (1) achieves superior performance in 2-4 bit quantization, (2) pushes compression to 1-bit while outperforming ultra-low-bit methods with minimal finetuning, and (3) enables efficient finetuning, even surpassing existing quantization-based approaches and rivaling full FP16 finetuning. Notably, ClusComp supports compression and finetuning of 70B LLMs on a single A6000-48GB GPU.
classic:305098e769f8.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大模型在边缘部署和低成本使用中的压缩问题，特别是低比特量化带来的性能损失，以及量化模型难以直接进行标准微调的限制。作者提出 ClusComp，一种将权重矩阵聚类为 codebook 并按 block 逐块微调的简单压缩范式。该方法在 2-4 bit 量化上表现更优，也能在极低的 1-bit 压缩下保持较强效果。更重要的是，它同时支持高效微调，甚至在部分场景下接近或超过全精度微调，并可在单张 A6000 48GB GPU 上处理 70B 级模型。
classic:305098e769f8.tldr: ClusComp 用“聚类 + 分块微调”把低比特压缩和高效微调合二为一，适合超大模型的低成本部署。
classic:305098e769f8.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“压缩”和“微调”这两个常常割裂的目标统一成了一个简单范式，而且效果很强。对于想了解超低比特量化、模型压缩和高效适配的人来说，它是很好的经典参考。

classic:89742ab5b235.abstract: As the Mix-of-Experts (MoE) architecture increases the number of parameters in large models, there is an even greater need for model quantization. However, existing quantization methods overlook the expert dynamics of MoE across multiple datasets. Moreover, the existing static quantization cannot adapt MoE to various data change scenarios. In this paper, we perform a multi-level analysis to reveal MoE dynamics and define the significance of each channel/each expert. Based on the analysis results, we propose \textit{DynaMo}, an end-to-end MoE quantization framework. DynaMo adopts an expert-level mixed-precision baseline quantization strategy, which ensures the quantized MoEs are compatible with multiple existing datasets. Furthermore, DynaMo incorporates a channel-level dynamic switching mechanism to adapt these quantized MoE models to novel datasets. Experiments show that DynaMo achieves a 2.78~4.54 PPL decrease and a 1.85%~3.77% accuracy improvement in various datasets, with ~3x inference speedup and negligible overhead.
classic:89742ab5b235.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注 MoE（Mixture-of-Experts）模型在量化时面临的新问题：模型参数规模更大，但传统量化方法往往忽略了不同数据集下专家行为的动态变化。作者通过多层次分析揭示了 MoE 中不同通道和不同专家的重要性，并据此提出了端到端量化框架 DynaMo。DynaMo 先在专家级别采用混合精度的基础量化策略，以兼容多个已有数据集，再通过通道级动态切换机制适配新的数据分布。实验表明，该方法能在保持几乎无额外开销的情况下提升精度、降低困惑度，并带来约 3 倍推理加速。
classic:89742ab5b235.tldr: DynaMo 通过专家级混合精度和通道级动态切换，让 MoE 量化同时兼顾多数据集兼容性与新场景适应性。
classic:89742ab5b235.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它不是简单套用通用量化方法，而是专门分析了 MoE 的专家动态和数据分布差异。对于研究大模型压缩、部署和 MoE 体系的人来说，它提供了一个更贴近真实使用场景的经典参考思路。

classic:a6b070345f4f.abstract: We introduce GPTAQ, a novel finetuning-free quantization method for compressing large-scale transformer architectures. Unlike the previous GPTQ method, which independently calibrates each layer, we always match the quantized layer's output to the exact output in the full-precision model, resulting in a scheme that we call asymmetric calibration. Such a scheme can effectively reduce the quantization error accumulated in previous layers. We analyze this problem using optimal brain compression to derive a close-formed solution. The new solution explicitly minimizes the quantization error as well as the accumulated asymmetry error. Furthermore, we utilize various techniques to parallelize the solution calculation, including channel parallelization, neuron decomposition, and Cholesky reformulation for matrix fusion. As a result, GPTAQ is easy to implement, simply using 20 more lines of code than GPTQ but improving its performance under low-bit quantization. Remarkably, on a single GPU, we quantize a 405B language transformer as well as EVA-02, the rank first vision transformer that achieves 90% pretraining Imagenet accuracy. Code is available at Github.
classic:a6b070345f4f.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出了 GPTAQ，一种无需微调的高效量化方法，用于压缩大规模 Transformer 模型。与 GPTQ 逐层独立校准不同，GPTAQ 始终让量化后层的输出尽量匹配全精度模型输出，采用“非对称校准”来减少前序层误差的累积。作者基于 optimal brain compression 推导了闭式解，同时显式最小化量化误差与累计非对称误差。借助通道并行、神经元分解和 Cholesky 重构等技巧，该方法实现简单且在低比特量化下效果更好。
classic:a6b070345f4f.tldr: GPTAQ 通过非对称校准在无需微调的前提下显著降低低比特量化误差，并能高效处理超大模型。
classic:a6b070345f4f.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它针对大模型量化中“误差层层累积”的核心痛点，提出了一个更稳健、实现也很轻量的替代方案。作为经典参考，它展示了如何在不做微调的情况下，把理论推导和工程优化结合起来提升量化性能。

classic:603b34e7aafe.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces a model's memory footprint by mapping full precision weights into low bit weights without costly retraining, but can degrade its downstream performance especially in low 2- to 3-bit settings. We develop a new mixed-precision PTQ approach, Task-Circuit Quantization (TaCQ), that draws parallels to automated circuit discovery, directly conditioning the quantization process on specific weight circuits -- which we define as sets of weights associated with downstream task performance. These weights are kept as 16-bit weights, while others are quantized, maintaining performance while only adding a marginal memory cost. Specifically, TaCQ contrasts unquantized model weights with a uniformly-quantized model to estimate the expected change in weights due to quantization and uses gradient information to predict the resulting impact on task performance, allowing us to preserve task-specific weights. We compare TaCQ-based quantization to existing mixed-precision quantization methods when conditioning both on general-purpose and task-specific data. Across QA, math reasoning, and text-to-SQL tasks for both Llama-3 and Qwen2.5, we find that TaCQ outperforms baselines using the same calibration data and a lower weight budget, achieving major improvements in the 2 and 3-bit regime. With only 3.1 bits we are able to recover 96% of Llama-3-8B-Instruct's unquantized 16-bit MMLU performance, obtaining a 5.25% absolute improvement over SPQR. We also observe consistently large gains over existing methods in the 2-bit regime, with an average gain of 14.74% over the strongest baseline, SliM-LLM. Moreover, we observe a 7.20% gain without conditioning on specific tasks, showing TaCQ's ability to identify important weights is not limited to task-conditioned…
classic:603b34e7aafe.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注后训练量化在 2 到 3 比特低精度场景下容易明显损伤模型性能的问题。作者提出 Task-Circuit Quantization（TaCQ），把量化过程与任务相关的“权重电路”识别结合起来，优先保留对下游任务更关键的权重为 16-bit，其余权重再进行量化。方法上，TaCQ通过对比全精度模型与均匀量化模型，并结合梯度信息估计量化对任务表现的影响，从而更精准地决定哪些参数需要保留。实验显示，它在 QA、数学推理和 text-to-SQL 等任务上，尤其在 2/3-bit 场景中，能以较小额外显存开销显著优于现有混合精度量化方法。
classic:603b34e7aafe.tldr: TaCQ 通过定位任务关键权重并保留高精度，实现了低比特量化下更好的性能保持。
classic:603b34e7aafe.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“哪些权重最重要”这个问题和量化压缩直接结合起来，思路清晰且有解释性。对于想在大模型低比特部署中尽量少掉点性能的读者，它是很有参考价值的经典方法。

classic:0efcda43d47c.abstract: Layer-wise PTQ is a promising technique for compressing large language models (LLMs), due to its simplicity and effectiveness without requiring retraining. However, recent progress in this area is saturating, underscoring the need to revisit its core limitations and explore further improvements. We address this challenge by identifying a key limitation of existing layer-wise PTQ methods: the growth of quantization errors across layers significantly degrades performance, particularly in low-bit regimes. To address this fundamental issue, we propose Quantization Error Propagation (QEP), a general, lightweight, and scalable framework that enhances layer-wise PTQ by explicitly propagating quantization errors and compensating for accumulated errors. QEP also offers a tunable propagation mechanism that prevents overfitting and controls computational overhead, enabling the framework to adapt to various architectures and resource budgets. Extensive experiments on several LLMs demonstrate that QEP-enhanced layer-wise PTQ achieves substantially higher accuracy than existing methods. Notably, the gains are most pronounced in the extremely low-bit quantization regime.
classic:0efcda43d47c.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型的层级后训练量化（layer-wise PTQ）在低比特条件下性能下降的问题。作者指出，现有方法的核心瓶颈在于量化误差会在层与层之间持续传播并累积，最终显著损害模型表现。为此，论文提出了 Quantization Error Propagation（QEP）框架，通过显式传播并补偿误差来缓解这种累积效应。实验表明，QEP 能在多种 LLM 上稳定提升量化后的准确率，尤其在极低比特场景下收益最明显。
classic:0efcda43d47c.tldr: QEP 通过显式建模并补偿量化误差传播，显著提升了大语言模型层级后训练量化在低比特下的效果。
classic:0efcda43d47c.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是简单地在现有 PTQ 方法上微调，而是直接追问量化误差为什么会越传越差，并给出了一种通用的修正思路。对于想了解低比特 LLM 量化瓶颈和经典 PTQ 改进方向的人来说，它是很好的参考。

classic:232d7f405e12.abstract: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been able to handle longer and longer contexts. However, a context that is too long may cause intolerant inference latency and GPU memory usage. Existing methods propose mixed-precision quantization to the key-value (KV) cache in LLMs based on token granularity, which is time-consuming in the search process and hardware inefficient during computation. This paper introduces a novel approach called Cocktail, which employs chunk-adaptive mixed-precision quantization to optimize the KV cache. Cocktail consists of two modules: chunk-level quantization search and chunk-level KV cache computation. Chunk-level quantization search determines the optimal bitwidth configuration of the KV cache chunks quickly based on the similarity scores between the corresponding context chunks and the query, maintaining the model accuracy. Furthermore, chunk-level KV cache computation reorders the KV cache chunks before quantization, avoiding the hardware inefficiency caused by mixed-precision quantization in inference computation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Cocktail outperforms state-of-the-art KV cache quantization methods on various models and datasets.
classic:232d7f405e12.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注长上下文 LLM 推理中的两个核心瓶颈：KV cache 占用显存过大，以及推理延迟过高。作者指出，现有基于 token 粒度的混合精度量化虽然能压缩 KV cache，但搜索开销大，而且在实际计算时不够硬件友好。为此，论文提出 Cocktail，用 chunk 级自适应混合精度量化来同时兼顾压缩效率和推理速度。它通过基于上下文块与查询相似度的快速位宽搜索，以及量化前的块重排，提升了精度保持和计算效率。
classic:232d7f405e12.tldr: Cocktail 通过 chunk 级自适应混合精度量化，让长上下文 LLM 的 KV cache 更省显存、推理更快。
classic:232d7f405e12.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为长上下文推理量化方向的经典参考，因为它直接针对 KV cache 这一关键瓶颈提出了更贴近硬件执行方式的优化思路。它把“压缩得更小”和“跑得更快”同时考虑进来，思路清晰、工程价值强。

classic:bad2e9148296.abstract: Post-training Quantization (PTQ) has become a widely used technique for improving inference efficiency of large language models (LLMs). However, existing PTQ methods generally suffer from crucial limitations such as heavy calibration data requirements and inflexible choice of target number of bits. In this paper, we propose RaanA, a unified PTQ framework that overcomes these challenges by introducing two novel components: 1) RaBitQ-H, a variant of a randomized vector quantization method RaBitQ, designed for fast, accurate, and highly efficient quantization; and 2) AllocateBits, an algorithm that optimally allocates bit-widths across layers based on their quantization sensitivity. RaanA achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art quantization methods while being extremely fast, requiring minimal calibration data, and enabling flexible bit allocation. Extensive experiments demonstrate RaanA's efficacy in balancing efficiency and accuracy. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/FFTYYY/RaanA .
classic:bad2e9148296.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型后训练量化中的两个核心问题：校准数据需求高，以及量化位宽设置不够灵活。作者提出了统一的 RaanA 框架，包含更快更高效的 RaBitQ-H 量化方法和根据层敏感度自动分配位宽的 AllocateBits 算法。该方法在保持与先进方法相近精度的同时，显著提升了量化速度，并减少了对校准数据的依赖。它的价值在于为 LLM 的高效部署提供了一种兼顾速度、灵活性和精度的实用方案。
classic:bad2e9148296.tldr: RaanA 提出一种快速、少校准数据、可灵活分配位宽的后训练量化框架，在效率和精度之间取得了很好的平衡。
classic:bad2e9148296.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了 PTQ 在实际部署中最常见的两类痛点：慢和不灵活。对于想了解如何在大模型量化中兼顾工程可用性与精度的人来说，它是很有参考价值的经典方向。

classic:81467d6df4d3.abstract: Quantizing large language models (LLMs) to 1-bit precision significantly reduces computational costs, but existing quantization techniques suffer from noticeable performance degradation when using weight and activation precisions below 4 bits (W4A4). In this paper, we propose a post-training quantization framework with W(1+1)A(1*4) configuration, where weights are quantized to 1 bit with an additional 1 bit for fine-grain grouping and activations are quantized to 1 bit with a 4-fold increase in the number of channels. For weight quantization, we propose utilizing Hessian-aware fine-grained grouping along with an EM-based quantization scheme. For activation quantization, we decompose INT4-quantized activations into a 4 * INT1 format equivalently and simultaneously smooth the scaling factors based on quantization errors, which further reduces the quantization errors in activations. Our method surpasses state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLM quantization baselines on W2A4 across multiple tasks, pushing the boundaries of existing LLM quantization methods toward fully binarized models. Code is available at https://github.com/JimmyCrave/LLM-PTQ-binarization.
classic:81467d6df4d3.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注如何把大语言模型压缩到接近二值化的极低比特精度，以显著降低推理计算和存储成本。作者提出了一种后训练量化框架，将权重量化到 1 bit，并通过额外的细粒度分组和基于 Hessian 的分组策略提升量化效果；同时将激活量化为 1 bit，并用等价分解和误差感知的缩放调整来减少损失。实验结果表明，该方法在多个任务上超过了现有最先进的低比特量化基线，推动了 LLM 向全二值模型演进。它的价值在于为极限压缩下仍尽量保持模型性能提供了实用方案。
classic:81467d6df4d3.tldr: 提出一种面向 LLM 的后训练二值化量化框架，在极低比特下仍能优于多项现有基线。
classic:81467d6df4d3.simple_intro: 如果你关心 LLM 的极限压缩、低成本部署和二值化研究，这篇论文很值得看。它把“几乎只有 1 bit”的量化做到了更可用的程度，是低比特量化方向的重要参考。

classic:77757edff2de.abstract: Improving the efficiency of inference in Large Language Models (LLMs) is a critical area of research. Post-training Quantization (PTQ) is a popular technique, but it often faces challenges at low-bit levels, particularly in downstream tasks. Quantization-aware Training (QAT) can alleviate this problem, but it requires significantly more computational resources. To tackle this, we introduced Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Quantization-Aware Training (DL-QAT), which merges the advantages of QAT while training only less than 1% of the total parameters. Specifically, we introduce a group-specific quantization magnitude to adjust the overall scale of each quantization group. Within each quantization group, we use LoRA matrices to update the weight size and direction in the quantization space. We validated the effectiveness of our method on the LLaMA and LLaMA2 model families. The results show significant improvements over our baseline method across different quantization granularities. For instance, for LLaMA-7B, our approach outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method by 4.2% in MMLU on 3-bit LLaMA-7B model. Additionally, our quantization results on pre-trained models also surpass previous QAT methods, demonstrating the superior performance and efficiency of our approach.
classic:77757edff2de.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在低比特量化后性能下降、尤其是在下游任务上表现不稳定的问题。作者提出 DL-QAT，一种权重量化感知训练方法，通过分解权重并引入低秩 LoRA 更新，在量化空间中同时调整权重的尺度和方向。该方法只训练不到 1% 的参数，却能结合 QAT 的精度优势与较低的训练开销。实验表明，它在 LLaMA 和 LLaMA2 上都显著优于已有方法，尤其在 3-bit 设置下带来明显提升。
classic:77757edff2de.tldr: DL-QAT 通过“权重分解 + 低秩更新”把 QAT 做得更省参数、更适合低比特 LLM 量化。
classic:77757edff2de.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型如何在尽量少损失精度的前提下压缩和加速，这篇论文很值得看。它展示了一种比传统 QAT 更轻量、但在低比特场景更有效的经典思路。

classic:ef6581801368.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become pivotal in artificial intelligence, demonstrating strong capabilities in reasoning, understanding, and generating data. However, their deployment on edge devices is hindered by their substantial size, often reaching several billion parameters. Quantization is a widely used method to reduce memory usage and inference time, however LLMs present unique challenges due to the prevalence of outliers in their activations. In this work, we leverage the theoretical advantages of Hadamard matrices over random rotation matrices to push the boundaries of quantization in LLMs. We demonstrate that Hadamard matrices are more effective in reducing outliers, which are a significant obstacle in achieving low-bit quantization. Our method based on a gradual binary search enables 3-bit quantization for weights, activations, and key-value (KV) caches, resulting in a 40% increase in accuracy on common benchmarks compared to SoTA methods. We extend the use of rotation matrices to support non-power-of-2 embedding dimensions, similar to the Qwen architecture, by employing the Paley algorithm. We theoretically demonstrates the superiority of Hadamard matrices in reducing outliers.We achieved 3-bit quantization for weights, activations, and KV cache, significantly enhancing model performance. Our experimental results on multiple models family like Mistral, LLaMA, and Qwen demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, outperforming existing methods and enabling practical 3-bit quantization.
classic:ef6581801368.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是大语言模型在低比特量化时，激活值中大量异常值会严重影响精度的问题。作者提出一种基于渐进式二分搜索的量化方法，并利用 Hadamard 矩阵在抑制异常值方面的理论优势，来提升量化效果。该方法还能支持非 2 的幂次嵌入维度，并通过 Paley 算法扩展到更多模型架构。实验表明，它可以实现权重、激活和 KV cache 的 3-bit 量化，并在多个基准和模型家族上显著优于现有方法。
classic:ef6581801368.tldr: 用渐进式二分搜索结合 Hadamard 旋转，作者把 LLM 的权重、激活和 KV cache 都推进到可用的 3-bit 量化。
classic:ef6581801368.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对 LLM 量化中最棘手的激活异常值问题，给出了一个兼顾理论和工程实现的通用方案。作为经典参考，它展示了如何把低比特量化从“能做”推进到“好用”。

classic:bb74092a496f.abstract: Quantization is a powerful tool to improve large language model (LLM) inference efficiency by utilizing more energy-efficient low-precision datapaths and reducing memory footprint. However, accurately quantizing LLM weights and activations to low precision is challenging without degrading model accuracy. We propose fine-grained mixed precision (FGMP) quantization, a post-training mixed-precision quantization hardware-software co-design methodology that maintains accuracy while quantizing the majority of weights and activations to reduced precision. Our work makes the following contributions: 1) We develop a policy that uses the perturbation in each value, weighted by the Fisher information, to select which weight and activation blocks to keep in higher precision. This approach preserves accuracy by identifying which weight and activation blocks need to be retained in higher precision to minimize the perturbation in the model loss. 2) We also propose a sensitivity-weighted clipping approach for fine-grained quantization which helps retain accuracy for blocks that are quantized to low precision. 3) We then propose hardware augmentations to leverage the efficiency benefits of FGMP quantization. Our hardware implementation encompasses i) datapath support for FGMP at block granularity, and ii) a mixed-precision activation quantization unit to assign activation blocks to high or low precision on the fly with minimal runtime and energy overhead. Our design, prototyped using NVFP4 (an FP4 format with microscaling) as the low-precision datatype and FP8 as the high-precision datatype, facilitates efficient FGMP quantization, attaining <1% perplexity degradation on Wikitext-103 for the Llama-2-7B model relative to an all-FP8 baseline design while consuming 14% less energy during…
classic:bb74092a496f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理中的量化难题：如何在尽量降低权重和激活精度以提升效率的同时，不明显损失模型精度。作者提出了一种细粒度混合精度（FGMP）后训练量化方法，通过结合 Fisher 信息和扰动分析，选择需要保留高精度的权重与激活块。与此同时，论文还提出了敏感度加权裁剪策略，帮助低精度块尽量保持准确性。为了让算法真正落地，作者进一步设计了支持块级混合精度的硬件增强方案，在 Llama-2-7B 上实现了接近全 FP8 的精度表现，同时带来额外能效收益。
classic:bb74092a496f.tldr: FGMP 用细粒度混合精度量化和硬件协同设计，在几乎不掉精度的前提下提升了 LLM 推理效率。
classic:bb74092a496f.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不仅提出了更精细的 LLM 量化策略，还把算法和硬件一起设计，强调可部署性。作为经典参考，它适合想了解“低精度推理如何兼顾精度与能效”的读者。

classic:07aa67ed949b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是如何让大语言模型在推理时更高效，尤其是面向代码生成这类对性能和延迟都很敏感的任务。作者提出将向量量化与大语言模型推理结合起来，以降低计算和存储开销，同时尽量保持生成质量。论文重点讨论了面向代码生成场景的高性能实现方式，说明量化不仅能压缩模型，还可以通过系统级优化提升实际推理吞吐。其价值在于为大模型部署提供了一条兼顾效率与效果的工程路径。
classic:07aa67ed949b.tldr: 把向量量化引入大模型推理，加速代码生成，同时尽量保持输出质量。
classic:07aa67ed949b.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为量化与大模型推理优化方向的参考，尤其关注“如何把理论上的压缩真正变成可用的高性能系统”。如果你关心大模型部署、推理加速或代码生成应用，它是很值得看的经典候选。

classic:8dec1e77ca0b.abstract: Efficient deployment of 1-bit Large Language Models (LLMs) is hindered by activation outliers, which complicate quantization to low bit-widths. We introduce BitNet v2, a novel framework enabling native 4-bit activation quantization for 1-bit LLMs. To tackle outliers in attention and feed-forward network activations, we propose H-BitLinear, a module applying an online Hadamard transformation prior to activation quantization. This transformation smooths sharp activation distributions into more Gaussian-like forms, suitable for low-bit representation. Experiments show BitNet v2 trained from scratch with 8-bit activations matches BitNet b1.58 performance. Crucially, BitNet v2 achieves minimal performance degradation when trained with native 4-bit activations, significantly reducing memory footprint and computational cost for batched inference.
classic:8dec1e77ca0b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注 1-bit LLM 在进一步量化激活值时遇到的离群点问题，这会显著增加低比特部署的难度。作者提出 BitNet v2，并设计了 H-BitLinear，在激活量化前先进行在线 Hadamard 变换，以平滑激活分布、降低离群点影响。该方法使模型能够原生支持 4-bit 激活量化，同时尽量保持性能不下降。实验表明，BitNet v2 在更低内存占用和更低计算成本下，仍能取得与前代方法相近的效果。
classic:8dec1e77ca0b.tldr: BitNet v2 通过在线 Hadamard 变换解决激活离群点问题，让 1-bit LLM 能原生使用 4-bit 激活并保持接近原性能。
classic:8dec1e77ca0b.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注大模型低比特量化和高效推理的人阅读，因为它直接解决了 1-bit LLM 落地时最棘手的激活量化问题。作为经典参考，它展示了一种简单但有效的结构改造思路，能在性能、显存和计算开销之间取得更好的平衡。

classic:06b668545d59.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced the natural language processing paradigm but impose substantial demands on memory and computational resources. Quantization is one of the most effective ways to reduce memory consumption of LLMs. However, advanced single-precision quantization methods experience significant accuracy degradation when quantizing to ultra-low bits. Existing mixed-precision quantization methods are quantized by groups with coarse granularity. Employing high precision for group data leads to substantial memory overhead, whereas low precision severely impacts model accuracy. To address this issue, we propose FineQ, software-hardware co-design for low-bit fine-grained mixed-precision quantization of LLMs. First, FineQ partitions the weights into finer-grained clusters and considers the distribution of outliers within these clusters, thus achieving a balance between model accuracy and memory overhead. Then, we propose an outlier protection mechanism within clusters that uses 3 bits to represent outliers and introduce an encoding scheme for index and data concatenation to enable aligned memory access. Finally, we introduce an accelerator utilizing temporal coding that effectively supports the quantization algorithm while simplifying the multipliers in the systolic array. FineQ achieves higher model accuracy compared to the SOTA mixed-precision quantization algorithm at a close average bit-width. Meanwhile, the accelerator achieves up to 1.79x energy efficiency and reduces the area of the systolic array by 61.2%.
classic:06b668545d59.summary_zh: LLM 量化在降低存储和计算开销方面很有效，但当比特数降得很低时，模型精度往往会明显下降，现有混合精度方法又常因分组粒度粗而带来额外内存负担。FineQ 提出了一种软硬件协同设计方案，把权重切分成更细粒度的簇，并结合簇内离群值分布进行混合精度分配，从而在精度和开销之间取得更好的平衡。方法中还设计了离群值保护机制，用 3 bit 表示离群值，并通过索引与数据拼接的编码方式实现对齐访存。配套的加速器利用时序编码支持该量化方案，在简化阵列乘法器的同时提升能效并降低面积。
classic:06b668545d59.tldr: FineQ 通过细粒度混合精度量化和软硬件协同设计，在超低比特下同时提升 LLM 精度、能效与硬件效率。
classic:06b668545d59.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为低比特 LLM 量化方向的经典参考，因为它不仅关注算法精度，还把存储格式和硬件实现一起考虑。对于想了解“算法怎么落地到加速器上”的读者，它很有代表性。

classic:e79562e2d406.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in various natural language processing tasks. However, their size presents significant challenges for deployment and inference. This paper investigates the quantization of LLMs, focusing on the LLaMA architecture and its derivatives. We challenge existing assumptions about activation outliers in LLMs and propose a novel mixed-precision quantization approach tailored for LLaMA-like models. Our method leverages the observation that activation spikes in LLaMA architectures are predominantly concentrated in specific projection layers. By applying higher precision (FP16 or FP8) to these layers while quantizing the rest of the model to lower bit-widths, we achieve superior performance compared to existing quantization techniques. Experimental results on LLaMA2, LLaMA3, and Mistral models demonstrate significant improvements in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy, particularly for 8-bit per-tensor quantization. Our approach outperforms general-purpose methods designed to handle outliers across all architecture types, highlighting the benefits of architecture-specific quantization strategies. This research contributes to the ongoing efforts to make LLMs more efficient and deployable, potentially enabling their use in resource-constrained environments. Our findings emphasize the importance of considering model-specific characteristics in developing effective quantization pipelines for state-of-the-art language models by identifying and targeting a small number of projections that concentrate activation spikes.
classic:e79562e2d406.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型量化部署中的精度损失问题，重点分析了 LLaMA 及其衍生模型中的激活异常值现象。作者发现，激活尖峰并不是均匀分布在全模型中，而是主要集中在少数几个投影层。基于这一观察，论文提出了一种混合精度量化策略：对这些关键层保留更高精度（FP16 或 FP8），其余部分则进行低比特量化。实验表明，该方法在 LLaMA2、LLaMA3 和 Mistral 上都能显著改善困惑度和零样本准确率，尤其适合 8-bit per-tensor 量化场景。
classic:e79562e2d406.tldr: 只给 LLaMA 里真正“尖峰多”的少数投影层保留高精度，其余部分低比特量化，能明显提升效果。
classic:e79562e2d406.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它没有把量化问题一概而论，而是针对 LLaMA 系列模型的结构特点做了更细粒度的优化。它展示了“模型结构感知”的量化策略在实际效果上往往优于通用方法，是做高效部署时很有参考价值的一类工作。

classic:d2a1fd463e27.abstract: The rapid deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) highlights the need for efficient low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ), due to their high memory costs. A key challenge in weight quantization is the presence of outliers, which inflate quantization ranges and lead to large errors.
