classic:dcb5b90b629f.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究如何在不重新训练的情况下，对超大规模 GPT 类语言模型进行高比例剪枝。作者提出了 SparseGPT，一种专为大模型设计的一次性剪枝方法，能够在保持精度几乎不变的前提下实现至少 50% 的稀疏化。实验表明，它可以在 OPT-175B 和 BLOOM-176B 这类超大模型上快速运行，并达到 60% 的非结构化稀疏度而困惑度几乎不受影响。该方法还可扩展到 2:4、4:8 等半结构化稀疏模式，并能与量化方法兼容。
classic:dcb5b90b629f.tldr: SparseGPT 证明了超大语言模型可以在无需重训的情况下被一次性剪枝到高稀疏度，同时几乎不损失性能。
classic:dcb5b90b629f.simple_intro: 这篇论文是大模型剪枝领域的代表性工作，展示了“剪掉一半以上参数但几乎不掉点”的可行性。对于理解大模型压缩、加速和部署，这是一篇非常值得参考的经典论文。

classic:d10441a7ea68.abstract: Fine-tuning large pre-trained language models on downstream tasks has become an important paradigm in NLP. However, common practice fine-tunes all of the parameters in a pre-trained model, which becomes prohibitive when a large number of downstream tasks are present. Therefore, many fine-tuning methods are proposed to learn incremental updates of pre-trained weights in a parameter efficient way, e.g., low-rank increments. These methods often evenly distribute the budget of incremental updates across all pre-trained weight matrices, and overlook the varying importance of different weight parameters. As a consequence, the fine-tuning performance is suboptimal. To bridge this gap, we propose AdaLoRA, which adaptively allocates the parameter budget among weight matrices according to their importance score. In particular, AdaLoRA parameterizes the incremental updates in the form of singular value decomposition. Such a novel approach allows us to effectively prune the singular values of unimportant updates, which is essentially to reduce their parameter budget but circumvent intensive exact SVD computations. We conduct extensive experiments with several pre-trained models on natural language processing, question answering, and natural language generation to validate the effectiveness of AdaLoRA. Results demonstrate that AdaLoRA manifests notable improvement over baselines, especially in the low budget settings. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/QingruZhang/AdaLoRA .
classic:d10441a7ea68.summary_zh: AdaLoRA 关注大模型微调中的参数高效问题：当下游任务很多时，直接微调整个模型成本过高，而现有低秩方法又往往把预算平均分配到各层，忽视了不同权重矩阵的重要性差异。为此，论文提出一种自适应预算分配策略，根据重要性分数动态决定各层可用的参数预算。方法上，AdaLoRA 将增量更新参数化为奇异值分解形式，并通过剪枝不重要的奇异值来压缩预算，避免了昂贵的精确 SVD 计算。实验表明，它在多种 NLP 任务上都优于基线，尤其在低预算场景下提升明显。
classic:d10441a7ea68.tldr: AdaLoRA 通过按重要性自适应分配低秩微调预算，在省参数的同时显著提升了大模型下游任务效果。
classic:d10441a7ea68.simple_intro: 这篇论文是参数高效微调领域的经典工作之一，核心思想清晰：不是所有层都该分到同样多的更新预算。它很适合作为理解 LoRA 系列方法如何进一步优化微调效率的入门参考。

classic:be3b8789d8e6.abstract: Language models have been shown to perform better with an increase in scale on a wide variety of tasks via the in-context learning paradigm. In this paper, we investigate the hypothesis that the ability of a large language model to in-context learn-perform a task is not uniformly spread across all of its underlying components. Using a 66 billion parameter language model (OPT-66B) across a diverse set of 14 downstream tasks, we find this is indeed the case: $\sim$70% of attention heads and $\sim$20% of feed forward networks can be removed with minimal decline in task performance. We find substantial overlap in the set of attention heads (un)important for in-context learning across tasks and number of in-context examples. We also address our hypothesis through a task-agnostic lens, finding that a small set of attention heads in OPT-66B score highly on their ability to perform primitive induction operations associated with in-context learning, namely, prefix matching and copying. These induction heads overlap with task-specific important heads, reinforcing arguments by Olsson et al. (arXiv:2209.11895) regarding induction head generality to more sophisticated behaviors associated with in-context learning. Overall, our study provides several insights that indicate large language models may be under-trained for in-context learning and opens up questions on how to pre-train language models to more effectively perform in-context learning.
classic:be3b8789d8e6.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大模型做上下文学习（in-context learning）时，能力是否均匀分布在所有参数组件上。作者以 660 亿参数的 OPT-66B 为例，在 14 个下游任务上做可解释性分析，发现约 70% 的注意力头和约 20% 的前馈网络可以被移除，而任务性能下降很小。论文还发现，不同任务和不同上下文示例数量下，重要注意力头有较强重叠。进一步分析表明，一小部分“归纳头”主要负责前缀匹配和复制等基础操作，并与任务关键头重合。
classic:be3b8789d8e6.tldr: OPT-66B 的上下文学习能力主要集中在少数关键注意力头上，大量组件可被剪除而性能几乎不变。
classic:be3b8789d8e6.simple_intro: 这篇论文很值得看，因为它用 66B 级别模型把“规模越大越会做上下文学习”这一经验现象拆解到了组件层面。它不仅帮助理解大模型内部机制，也对剪枝、稀疏化和更高效预训练提供了经典参考。

classic:607ea4639915.abstract: Chaofan Tao, Lu Hou, Haoli Bai, Jiansheng Wei, Xin Jiang, Qun Liu, Ping Luo, Ngai Wong. Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2023. 2023.
classic:607ea4639915.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注如何在不显著损失生成质量的前提下，压缩大型预训练语言模型的参数规模和计算开销。作者研究结构化剪枝方法，使被剪掉的部分更适合真实硬件上的高效推理，而不只是理论上的稀疏化。论文的价值在于，它为大模型部署提供了更实用的加速思路，帮助在性能与效率之间取得更好的平衡。
classic:607ea4639915.tldr: 提出结构化剪枝思路，让生成式预训练语言模型在尽量保留效果的同时更高效、更易部署。
classic:607ea4639915.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注大模型压缩和推理加速的人阅读，因为它讨论的是“怎么把模型真正变轻、变快”。作为剪枝与稀疏化方向的经典参考，它连接了算法设计和实际部署需求。

classic:bd3b75332147.abstract: As their size increases, Large Languages Models (LLMs) are natural candidates for network pruning methods: approaches that drop a subset of network weights while striving to preserve performance. Existing methods, however, require either retraining, which is rarely affordable for billion-scale LLMs, or solving a weight reconstruction problem reliant on second-order information, which may also be computationally expensive. In this paper, we introduce a novel, straightforward yet effective pruning method, termed Wanda (Pruning by Weights and activations), designed to induce sparsity in pretrained LLMs. Motivated by the recent observation of emergent large magnitude features in LLMs, our approach prunes weights with the smallest magnitudes multiplied by the corresponding input activations, on a per-output basis. Notably, Wanda requires no retraining or weight update, and the pruned LLM can be used as is. We conduct a thorough evaluation of our method Wanda on LLaMA and LLaMA-2 across various language benchmarks. Wanda significantly outperforms the established baseline of magnitude pruning and performs competitively against recent method involving intensive weight update. Code is available at https://github.com/locuslab/wanda.
classic:bd3b75332147.summary_zh: 这是一篇发表于ICLR 2024的Pruning and Sparsity方向经典论文，适合作为该主题的代表性参考。 论文主要围绕“A Simple and Effective Pruning Approach for Large Language Models”展开。 原文摘要可帮助你快速定位方法与实验设定。
classic:bd3b75332147.tldr: Pruning and Sparsity方向代表工作，发表于ICLR 2024，适合快速建立该主题的经典论文地图。
classic:bd3b75332147.simple_intro: 这是一篇发表于ICLR 2024的Pruning and Sparsity方向经典论文，适合作为该主题的代表性参考。

classic:b884ebb11017.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), such as LLaMA and T5, have shown exceptional performance across various tasks through fine-tuning. Although low-rank adaption (LoRA) has emerged to cheaply fine-tune these LLMs on downstream tasks, their deployment is still hindered by the vast model scale and computational costs. Post-training model pruning offers a way to compress LLMs. However, the current pruning methods designed for LLMs are not compatible with LoRA. This is due to their utilization of unstructured pruning on LLMs, impeding the merging of LoRA weights, or their dependence on the gradients of pre-trained weights to guide pruning, which can impose significant memory overhead. To this end, we propose LoRAPrune, a new framework that delivers an accurate structured pruned model in a highly memory-efficient manner. Specifically, we first design a LoRA-guided pruning criterion, which uses the weights and gradients of LoRA, rather than the gradients of pre-trained weights for importance estimation. We subsequently integrate this criterion into an iterative pruning process, effectively removing redundant channels and heads. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of our LoRAPrune over existing approaches on the LLaMA series models. At a 50\% compression rate, LoRAPrune demonstrates superior performance over LLM-Pruner, achieving a reduction in perplexity by 4.81 on WikiText2 and 3.46 on PTB, while also decreasing memory usage by 52.6%. Besides, LoRAPrune also matches semi-structural pruning across multiple LLMs, proving its wide applicability. The code is available at https://github.com/aim-uofa/LoRAPrune.
classic:b884ebb11017.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在微调后仍然体量巨大、部署成本高的问题，尤其是传统剪枝方法与 LoRA 兼容性差的矛盾。作者提出 LoRAPrune，用 LoRA 自身的权重和梯度来估计重要性，避免依赖预训练权重梯度带来的高内存开销。方法上，它结合结构化剪枝和迭代式裁剪，能够有效移除冗余通道和注意力头，同时保留较好的性能。实验表明，在多种 LLaMA 系列模型上，该方法相比现有方案在压缩率、困惑度和内存占用方面都有明显优势。
classic:b884ebb11017.tldr: LoRAPrune 让 LoRA 微调后的大模型也能高效做结构化剪枝，并在低内存开销下保持更强性能。
classic:b884ebb11017.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，是因为它解决了“LoRA 微调”和“模型剪枝”难以兼容的实际部署难题。作为经典参考，它展示了如何把参数高效微调与压缩结合起来，为大模型落地提供了更实用的思路。

classic:6b416030c9b1.abstract: Large Language Models (LLM) achieved considerable results on natural language understanding tasks. However, their sheer size causes a large memory consumption or high latency at inference time, which renders deployment on hardware-constrained applications challenging. Neural architecture search…
classic:6b416030c9b1.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型参数规模过大带来的部署难题，尤其是推理时的显存占用和延迟问题。作者将结构化剪枝与神经架构搜索结合起来，在保留模型性能的同时自动寻找更紧凑的网络结构。相比非结构化稀疏方法，这种方式更容易获得真实的推理加速和更好的硬件友好性。论文为大模型压缩与高效部署提供了一条具有实践价值的经典思路。
classic:6b416030c9b1.tldr: 把结构化剪枝和神经架构搜索结合起来，让大语言模型在尽量少掉点性能的前提下更小、更快、更好部署。
classic:6b416030c9b1.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型如何真正落地，这篇论文很值得看，因为它解决的是“模型太大、跑不动”这个现实问题。它也是剪枝与自动搜索结合做高效模型设计的一个经典参考。

classic:d90f56f8412a.abstract: Large language models(LLMs) containing tens of billions of parameters (or even more) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in various NLP tasks. However, substantial model size poses challenges to training, inference, and deployment so that it is necessary to compress the model. At present, most model compression for LLMs requires manual design of pruning features, which has problems such as complex optimization pipeline and difficulty in retaining the capabilities of certain parts of the model.Therefore, we propose a novel pruning approach: firstly, a training set of a certain number of architecture-accuracy pairs is established, and then a non-neural model is trained as an accuracy predictor. Using the accuracy predictor to further optimize the search space and search, the optimal model can be automatically selected. Experiments show that our proposed approach is effective and efficient. Compared with the baseline, the perplexity(PPL) on Wikitext2 and PTB dropped by 9.48% and 5,76% respectively, and the average accuracy of MMLU increased by 6.28%.
classic:d90f56f8412a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型参数规模过大带来的训练、推理和部署成本问题，提出一种更自动化的剪枝方法。与依赖人工设计剪枝特征的传统方案不同，作者先构建“架构-准确率”样本集，再训练一个非神经网络的准确率预测器，用来评估不同剪枝结构的效果。基于这个预测器，方法可以更高效地缩小搜索空间并自动选择更优模型。实验结果表明，该方法在保持甚至提升模型能力的同时，能有效降低困惑度并改善下游任务表现。
classic:d90f56f8412a.tldr: 通过训练准确率预测器自动搜索剪枝结构，这篇工作让大语言模型压缩更省人工、也更高效。
classic:d90f56f8412a.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为剪枝方向的经典参考，因为它把“人工设计剪枝规则”改成了“用预测器自动选结构”，思路很实用。它展示了如何在压缩大模型的同时尽量保住性能，对后续做自动化模型压缩很有启发。

classic:516c5a1ff4aa.abstract: With the fast growth of parameter size, it becomes increasingly challenging to deploy large generative models as they typically require large GPU memory consumption and massive computation. Unstructured model pruning has been a common approach to reduce both GPU memory footprint and the overall computation while retaining good model accuracy. However, the existing solutions do not provide a highly-efficient support for handling unstructured sparsity on modern GPUs, especially on the highly-structured Tensor Core hardware. Therefore, we propose Flash-LLM for enabling low-cost and highly-efficient large generative model inference with the sophisticated support of unstructured sparsity on high-performance but highly restrictive Tensor Cores. Based on our key observation that the main bottleneck of generative model inference is the several skinny matrix multiplications for which Tensor Cores would be significantly under-utilized due to low computational intensity, we propose a general Load-as-Sparse and Compute-as-Dense methodology for unstructured sparse matrix multiplication. The basic insight is to address the significant memory bandwidth bottleneck while tolerating redundant computations that are not critical for end-to-end performance on Tensor Cores. Based on this, we design an effective software framework for Tensor Core based unstructured SpMM, leveraging on-chip resources for efficient sparse data extraction and computation/memory-access overlapping. At SpMM kernel level, Flash-LLM significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art library, i.e., Sputnik and SparTA by an average of 2.9x and 1.5x, respectively. At end-to-end framework level on OPT-30B/66B/175B models, for tokens per GPU-second, Flash-LLM achieves up to 3.8x and 3.6x improvement over DeepSpeed and Faste…
classic:516c5a1ff4aa.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大模型推理在显存占用和计算开销上都非常昂贵的问题，尤其是在现代 GPU 的 Tensor Core 上，非结构化稀疏虽然能压缩模型，却难以被高效利用。作者提出 Flash-LLM，用“Load-as-Sparse, Compute-as-Dense”的思路处理稀疏矩阵乘法：一方面减少稀疏数据带来的带宽压力，另一方面允许一定的冗余计算来换取更高的整体效率。论文还设计了面向 Tensor Core 的软件框架，通过片上资源调度、稀疏数据提取和计算/访存重叠来提升性能。实验表明，它在稀疏 SpMM 和端到端大模型推理上都能显著优于现有方案，兼顾成本、速度和可部署性。
classic:516c5a1ff4aa.tldr: Flash-LLM 用面向 Tensor Core 的稀疏计算框架，把非结构化稀疏大模型推理做得更快、更省。
classic:516c5a1ff4aa.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是只讨论“怎么剪枝”，而是进一步解决了“剪枝后如何在 GPU 上真正高效跑起来”的工程难题。它很适合作为稀疏推理、Tensor Core 优化和大模型部署方向的经典参考。

classic:56d869eb7171.abstract: Despite their remarkable achievements, modern Large Language Models (LLMs) face exorbitant computational and memory footprints. Recently, several works have shown significant success in training-free and data-free compression (pruning and quantization) of LLMs that achieve 50 - 60% sparsity and reduce the bit width to 3 or 4 bits per weight, with negligible degradation of perplexity over the uncompressed baseline. As recent research efforts are focused on developing increasingly sophisticated compression methods, our work takes a step back and re-evaluates the effectiveness of existing SoTA compression methods, which rely on a fairly simple and widely questioned metric, perplexity (even for dense LLMs). We introduce Knowledge-Intensive Compressed LLM BenchmarK (LLM-KICK), a collection of carefully curated tasks to redefine the evaluation protocol for compressed LLMs, which have significant alignment with their dense counterparts and perplexity fail to capture subtle change in their true capabilities. LLM-KICK unveils many favorable merits and unfortunate plights of current SoTA compression methods: all pruning methods suffer significant performance degradation, sometimes at trivial sparsity ratios (e.g., 25-30%), and fail for N:M sparsity in knowledge-intensive tasks; current quantization methods are more successful than pruning; yet, pruned LLMs even at $\geq 50$% sparsity are robust in-context retrieval and summarization systems; among others. LLM-KICK is designed to holistically access compressed LLMs' ability for language understanding, reasoning, generation, in-context retrieval, in-context summarization, etc. We hope our study can foster the development of better LLM compression methods. The reproduced codes are available at https://github.com/VITA-Group/llm-kick.
classic:56d869eb7171.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于大语言模型压缩后的真实能力评估问题。作者指出，现有很多剪枝和量化方法主要依赖困惑度（perplexity）来判断效果，但这个指标很难反映模型在知识密集型任务中的细微退化。为此，论文提出了 LLM-KICK 基准，系统评测压缩后模型在语言理解、推理、生成、上下文检索和上下文总结等能力上的表现。结果显示，当前剪枝方法在不少任务上会明显掉性能，甚至在较低稀疏率下也不稳定，而量化方法整体更稳健。
classic:56d869eb7171.tldr: 这篇论文提出 LLM-KICK，重新审视 LLM 压缩效果，揭示了很多方法在困惑度看起来不错、但真实能力却显著下降的问题。
classic:56d869eb7171.simple_intro: 如果你想了解 LLM 压缩到底“压掉了什么”，这篇文章非常值得看。它不仅是压缩方法的评测基准，也提醒研究者不要只看困惑度，而要关注模型在真实任务中的综合能力。

classic:26e9da206a73.abstract: We present Junk DNA Hypothesis by adopting a novel task-centric angle for the pre-trained weights of large language models (LLMs). It has been believed that weights in LLMs contain significant redundancy, leading to the conception that a considerable chunk of the parameters can be removed by pruning without compromising performance. Contrary to this belief, this paper presents a counter-argument: small-magnitude weights of pre-trained model weights encode vital knowledge essential for tackling difficult downstream tasks - manifested as the monotonic relationship between the performance drop of downstream tasks across the difficulty spectrum, as we prune more pre-trained weights by magnitude. Moreover, we reveal that these seemingly inconsequential weights can result in irreparable loss of knowledge and performance degradation in difficult tasks, even when downstream continual training is allowed. Interestingly, our evaluations show that the other popular compression, namely quantization, fails to exhibit similar monotonic effect and does not as convincingly disentangle this task-difficulty information. To study formally, we introduce several quantifiable metrics to gauge the downstream task difficulty: (1) within the same task category, and (2) across different task categories. Our extensive experiments substantiate the Junk DNA Hypothesis across a diverse range of model sizes, tasks, datasets, and even pruning methods. Codes are available at: https://github.com/VITA-Group/Junk_DNA_Hypothesis.git.
classic:26e9da206a73.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究大语言模型中“按权重大小剪枝”是否真的只会删掉冗余参数。作者从下游任务难度的角度出发，发现预训练权重里那些看似很小的参数，实际上可能承载了完成困难任务所需的关键信息。随着剪枝比例增加，模型在不同难度任务上的性能下降呈现出单调加剧的趋势，而且这种损伤在继续下游训练后也可能无法完全恢复。论文因此提出“Junk DNA Hypothesis”，说明小权重并不等于无用权重。
classic:26e9da206a73.tldr: 小幅权重并非可有可无：按幅度剪掉它们会让 LLM 在困难下游任务上出现单调、甚至不可逆的退化。
classic:26e9da206a73.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接挑战了“LLM 参数高度冗余、可以放心剪掉小权重”的常见直觉。它为理解剪枝、任务难度和知识保留之间的关系提供了一个很有代表性的经典视角。

classic:56179e1c6213.abstract: Despite the remarkable success of Large Language Models (LLMs), the massive size poses significant deployment challenges, particularly on resource-constrained hardware. While existing LLM compression methods focus on quantization, pruning remains relatively unexplored due to the high cost of training-based approaches and data collection challenges. One-shot pruning methods, although cost-effective and data-free, have become dominant in LLM pruning, but lead to performance decline under the structured pruning setting. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm for structurally pruning LLMs, called Compresso. Our approach, through the collaboration of the proposed resource-efficient pruning algorithm and the LLM itself, learns optimal pruning decisions during the training process. Compresso addresses the challenges of expensive training costs and data collection by incorporating Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) into the $L_0$ regularization during the instruction tuning process. Then, we further augment the pruning algorithm by introducing a collaborative prompt that fosters collaboration between the LLM and the pruning algorithm, significantly boosting the overall performance. To this end, Compresso prunes LLaMA-7B to 5.4B, maintaining original performance and even surpassing LLaMA-7B in reading comprehension by 2.62%. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Compresso significantly outperforms one-shot pruning baselines across various sparsity ratios, achieving up to 2.21%, 11.43%, 7.04%, and 4.81% higher scores on the commonsense reasoning, reading comprehension, MMLU, and BBH benchmarks, respectively.
classic:56179e1c6213.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时参数规模过大、难以在资源受限设备上使用的问题，尤其是结构化剪枝在现有方法中容易带来性能下降。作者提出了 Compresso，一种在训练过程中学习剪枝决策的新框架，把 LoRA 与 L0 正则化结合到指令微调中，以降低训练和数据收集成本。进一步地，论文引入协同提示，让模型本身与剪枝算法共同完成决策，从而显著提升剪枝效果。实验表明，Compresso 在多种稀疏率下都优于主流 one-shot 剪枝基线，并能在压缩 LLaMA-7B 的同时基本保持原有性能。
classic:56179e1c6213.tldr: Compresso 通过训练中协同学习剪枝决策，让大模型在结构化剪枝后仍能保持高性能，优于多数 one-shot 剪枝方法。
classic:56179e1c6213.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，是因为它提出了一个更实用的结构化剪枝思路，不再只依赖一次性裁剪，而是让模型参与到剪枝学习中。它适合作为经典参考，理解大语言模型压缩如何兼顾效率、训练成本和性能保持。

classic:74edb87c38be.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), renowned for their remarkable performance across diverse domains, present a challenge when it comes to practical deployment due to their colossal model size. In response to this challenge, efforts have been directed toward the application of traditional network pruning techniques to LLMs, uncovering a massive number of parameters that can be pruned in one-shot without hurting performance. Prevailing LLM pruning strategies have consistently adhered to the practice of uniformly pruning all layers at equivalent sparsity, resulting in robust performance. However, this observation stands in contrast to the prevailing trends observed in the field of vision models, where non-uniform layerwise sparsity typically yields stronger results. To understand the underlying reasons for this disparity, we conduct a comprehensive study and discover a strong correlation with the emergence of activation outliers in LLMs. Inspired by this finding, we introduce a novel LLM pruning methodology that incorporates a tailored set of non-uniform layerwise sparsity ratios, termed as Outlier Weighed Layerwise sparsity (OWL). The sparsity ratio of OWL is proportional to the outlier ratio observed within each layer, facilitating a more effective alignment between layerwise weight sparsity and outlier ratios. Our empirical evaluation, conducted across the LLaMA-V1 family and OPT, spanning various benchmarks, demonstrates the distinct advantages offered by OWL over previous methods. For instance, OWL exhibits a remarkable performance gain, surpassing the state-of-the-art Wanda and SparseGPT by 61.22 and 6.80 perplexity at a high sparsity level of 70%, respectively, while delivering 2.6x end-to-end inference speed-up in the DeepSparse inference engine. Codes are available at…
classic:74edb87c38be.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在实际部署中模型太大、难以高效推理的问题，研究目标是在高稀疏度下尽量保持性能。作者发现，LLM 中不同层的激活异常值（outlier）分布与剪枝敏感性高度相关，这解释了为何统一层间稀疏率并不总是最优。基于这一观察，论文提出 Outlier Weighed Layerwise sparsity（OWL），按各层 outlier 比例分配不同的稀疏率，使剪枝更贴合模型内部结构。实验表明，OWL 在 LLaMA 和 OPT 等模型上能在高稀疏度下显著优于 Wanda 和 SparseGPT，并带来实际推理加速。
classic:74edb87c38be.tldr: OWL 通过根据各层 outlier 比例分配非均匀稀疏率，让 LLM 在高稀疏剪枝下保持更好精度并获得更快推理。
classic:74edb87c38be.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它抓住了 LLM 剪枝里一个很关键但常被忽略的现象：激活 outlier 会影响各层对剪枝的敏感度。它给出了一个简单而有效的层级稀疏分配策略，是理解和实践大模型高稀疏剪枝的经典参考。

classic:4e8eeed0e9e2.abstract: The popularity of LLaMA (Touvron et al., 2023a;b) and other recently emerged moderate-sized large language models (LLMs) highlights the potential of building smaller yet powerful LLMs. Regardless, the cost of training such models from scratch on trillions of tokens remains high. In this work, we study structured pruning as an effective means to develop smaller LLMs from pre-trained, larger models. Our approach employs two key techniques: (1) targeted structured pruning, which prunes a larger model to a specified target shape by removing layers, heads, and intermediate and hidden dimensions in an end-to-end manner, and (2) dynamic batch loading, which dynamically updates the composition of sampled data in each training batch based on varying losses across different domains. We demonstrate the efficacy of our approach by presenting the Sheared-LLaMA series, pruning the LLaMA2-7B model down to 1.3B and 2.7B parameters. Sheared-LLaMA models outperform state-of-the-art open-source models of equivalent sizes, such as Pythia, INCITE, OpenLLaMA and the concurrent TinyLlama models, on a wide range of downstream and instruction tuning evaluations, while requiring only 3% of compute compared to training such models from scratch. This work provides compelling evidence that leveraging existing LLMs with structured pruning is a far more cost-effective approach for building competitive small-scale LLMs
classic:4e8eeed0e9e2.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注一个现实问题：从零训练大语言模型成本极高，而直接获得高性能小模型又很难。作者提出了一种结构化剪枝方法，把预训练的 LLaMA2-7B 按目标形状裁剪成更小的模型，同时在训练中引入动态批次加载来适配不同领域数据的损失变化。实验表明，Sheared-LLaMA 系列在 1.3B 和 2.7B 规模上都能超过同等参数量的多个开源基线。更重要的是，它只需约从零训练同类模型 3% 的计算量，说明利用现有大模型做结构化剪枝是构建高性价比小模型的有效路线。
classic:4e8eeed0e9e2.tldr: 用结构化剪枝把大模型“裁”成高质量小模型，Sheared-LLaMA 以极低算力成本达到并超过同规模开源基线。
classic:4e8eeed0e9e2.simple_intro: 这篇论文很值得看，因为它给出了一个实用且高效的“小模型制造方案”，不是从零重训，而是直接利用现成大模型。它也很适合作为剪枝与稀疏化方向的经典参考，展示了结构化剪枝在大语言模型时代的真实价值。

classic:da0fcc20efe6.abstract: The ever-increasing large language models (LLMs), though opening a potential path for the upcoming artificial general intelligence, sadly drops a daunting obstacle on the way towards their on-device deployment. As one of the most well-established pre-LLMs approaches in reducing model complexity, network pruning appears to lag behind in the era of LLMs, due mostly to its costly fine-tuning (or re-training) necessity under the massive volumes of model parameter and training data. To close this industry-academia gap, we introduce Dynamic Sparse No Training (DSnoT), a training-free fine-tuning approach that slightly updates sparse LLMs without the expensive backpropagation and any weight updates. Inspired by the Dynamic Sparse Training, DSnoT minimizes the reconstruction error between the dense and sparse LLMs, in the fashion of performing iterative weight pruning-and-growing on top of sparse LLMs. To accomplish this purpose, DSnoT particularly takes into account the anticipated reduction in reconstruction error for pruning and growing, as well as the variance w.r.t. different input data for growing each weight. This practice can be executed efficiently in linear time since its obviates the need of backpropagation for fine-tuning LLMs. Extensive experiments on LLaMA-V1/V2, Vicuna, and OPT across various benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of DSnoT in enhancing the performance of sparse LLMs, especially at high sparsity levels. For instance, DSnoT is able to outperform the state-of-the-art Wanda by 26.79 perplexity at 70% sparsity with LLaMA-7B. Our paper offers fresh insights into how to fine-tune sparse LLMs in an efficient training-free manner and open new venues to scale the great potential of sparsity to LLMs. Codes are available at https://github.com/zyxxmu/DSnoT.
classic:da0fcc20efe6.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时参数庞大、剪枝后往往还需要昂贵微调的问题。作者提出了 Dynamic Sparse No Training（DSnoT），一种无需反向传播、无需权重更新的训练自由稀疏微调方法，通过迭代式的剪枝与生长来尽量减小稠密模型与稀疏模型之间的重建误差。方法进一步考虑了剪枝和生长对误差的预期影响，以及不同输入数据下权重变化的方差，从而实现高效的线性时间优化。实验表明，DSnoT 在多个模型和基准上都能显著提升高稀疏率下的性能。
classic:da0fcc20efe6.tldr: DSnoT 提出了一种不需要训练的稀疏 LLM 微调方法，在高稀疏率下也能有效提升模型效果。
classic:da0fcc20efe6.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注大模型压缩和剪枝后恢复性能的读者，因为它把“剪枝后还要再训练”的成本进一步降了下来。作为经典参考，它展示了如何在不做反向传播的前提下，让稀疏大模型尽量接近原始性能。

classic:ccad8a3d158b.abstract: Various Large Language Models~(LLMs) from the Generative Pretrained Transformer(GPT) family have achieved outstanding performances in a wide range of text generation tasks. However, the enormous model sizes have hindered their practical use in real-world applications due to high inference latency. Therefore, improving the efficiencies of LLMs through quantization, pruning, and other means has been a key issue in LLM studies. In this work, we propose a method based on Hessian sensitivity-aware mixed sparsity pruning to prune LLMs to at least 50% sparsity without the need of any retraining. It allocates sparsity adaptively based on sensitivity, allowing us to reduce pruning-induced error while maintaining the overall sparsity level. The advantages of the proposed method exhibit even more when the sparsity is extremely high. Furthermore, our method is compatible with quantization, enabling further compression of LLMs. We have released the available code.
classic:ccad8a3d158b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型参数规模巨大、推理延迟高的问题，提出一种无需再训练的一次性剪枝方法。方法核心是基于 Hessian 的敏感度感知混合稀疏度分配，根据不同层的敏感程度自适应决定剪枝比例，从而在保持总体稀疏率的同时尽量减少性能损失。作者证明该方法可以将模型剪到至少 50% 稀疏度，并且在极高稀疏率下优势更明显。该方法还兼容量化，可进一步提升压缩效果。
classic:ccad8a3d158b.tldr: 一种无需重训练的敏感度感知混合稀疏剪枝方法，可将大语言模型高效压缩到至少 50% 稀疏度。
classic:ccad8a3d158b.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合想了解大模型高效压缩的人阅读，因为它给出了一个简单直接、无需重训练的剪枝方案。作为经典参考，它展示了如何用敏感度信息更聪明地分配稀疏度，兼顾压缩率和精度。

classic:c32ba631d8cb.abstract: Prompt-based learning has been an effective paradigm for large pretrained language models (LLM), enabling few-shot or even zero-shot learning. Black-box prompt search has received growing interest recently for its distinctive properties of gradient-free optimization, proven particularly useful and powerful for model-as-a-service usage. However, the discrete nature and the complexity of combinatorial optimization hinder the efficiency of modern black-box approaches. Despite extensive research on search algorithms, the crucial aspect of search space design and optimization has been largely overlooked. In this paper, we first conduct a sensitivity analysis by prompting LLM, revealing that only a small number of tokens exert a disproportionate amount of influence on LLM predictions. Leveraging this insight, we propose the Clustering and Pruning for Efficient Black-box Prompt Search (ClaPS), a simple black-box search method that first clusters and prunes the search space to focus exclusively on influential prompt tokens. By employing even simple search methods within the pruned search space, ClaPS achieves state-of-the-art performance across various tasks and LLMs, surpassing the performance of complex approaches while significantly reducing search costs. Our findings underscore the critical role of search space design and optimization in enhancing both the usefulness and the efficiency of black-box prompt-based learning.
classic:c32ba631d8cb.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注黑盒提示词搜索中的效率问题：在不访问模型梯度、只能通过输入输出交互的场景下，如何更快找到有效提示。作者先通过敏感性分析发现，提示词里只有少数 token 对模型预测影响很大，绝大多数 token 的作用较弱。基于这个观察，论文提出 ClaPS，通过聚类和剪枝先缩小搜索空间，只保留更有影响力的提示词位置，再在精简后的空间里进行搜索。实验表明，这种方法不仅显著降低搜索成本，还能在多个任务和模型上取得优于更复杂方法的效果。
classic:c32ba631d8cb.tldr: ClaPS 通过聚类和剪枝把黑盒提示词搜索聚焦到“最有影响力”的 token 上，从而用更低成本获得更好的提示词。
classic:c32ba631d8cb.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它抓住了黑盒 prompt 搜索里一个很关键但常被忽视的问题：不是搜索算法越复杂越好，搜索空间设计同样决定效率和效果。它也很适合作为经典参考，展示了如何用简单直观的分析和剪枝思路，提升大模型提示学习的实用性。

classic:cb7f1ebacc1a.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have reshaped natural language processing with their impressive capabilities. However, their ever-increasing size has raised concerns about their effective deployment and the need for LLM compression. This study introduces the Divergent Token Metrics (DTMs), a novel approach to assessing compressed LLMs, addressing the limitations of traditional perplexity or accuracy measures that fail to accurately reflect text generation quality. DTMs measure token divergences that allow deeper insights into the subtleties of model compression, in particular, when evaluating components' impacts individually. Utilizing the First Divergent Token Metric (FDTM) in model sparsification reveals that 25% of all attention components can be pruned beyond 90% on the Llama-2 model family, still keeping SOTA performance. For quantization, FDTM suggests that more than 80% of parameters can be naively transformed to int8 without special outlier management. These evaluations indicate the necessity of choosing appropriate compressions for parameters individually -- and that FDTM can identify those -- while standard metrics result in deteriorated outcomes.
classic:cb7f1ebacc1a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型压缩后，如何更准确地评估其生成质量。作者指出，传统的困惑度和准确率往往不能真实反映文本生成中的细微退化，因此提出了 Divergent Token Metrics（DTMs）来衡量压缩模型在 token 级别上的偏离程度。基于 First Divergent Token Metric（FDTM），论文进一步分析了剪枝与量化中不同组件的影响，发现 Llama-2 系列中可移除大量注意力组件而仍保持较强性能。实验还表明，FDTM 能帮助识别哪些参数更适合单独压缩，从而提升模型压缩策略的可靠性与可解释性。
classic:cb7f1ebacc1a.tldr: 提出 DTMs/FDTM 用 token 级别偏离来评估 LLM 压缩质量，能更准确指导剪枝和量化。
classic:cb7f1ebacc1a.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是只看困惑度这类粗指标，而是直接分析生成过程中“第一个偏掉的 token”，更贴近真实文本质量。作为经典参考，它很适合用来理解如何更科学地做 LLM 剪枝和量化评估。

classic:8071f165269d.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed the landscape of artificial intelligence, while their enormous size presents significant challenges in terms of computational costs. We introduce LoRAShear, a novel efficient approach to structurally prune LLMs and recover knowledge. Given general LLMs, LoRAShear at first creates the dependency graphs over LoRA modules to discover minimally removal structures and analyze the knowledge distribution. It then proceeds progressive structured pruning on LoRA adaptors and enables inherent knowledge transfer to better preserve the information in the redundant structures. To recover the lost knowledge during pruning, LoRAShear meticulously studies and proposes a dynamic fine-tuning schemes with dynamic data adaptors to effectively narrow down the performance gap to the full models. Numerical results demonstrate that by only using one GPU within a couple of GPU days, LoRAShear effectively reduced footprint of LLMs by 20% with only 1.0% performance degradation and significantly outperforms state-of-the-arts. The source code will be available at https://github.com/microsoft/lorashear.
classic:8071f165269d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型体积巨大、推理和部署成本高的问题，提出了一种高效的结构化剪枝与知识恢复方法 LoRAShear。它先基于 LoRA 模块构建依赖图，识别出可最小化移除的结构并分析知识分布，再对 LoRA 适配器进行渐进式结构化剪枝。随后，论文设计动态微调方案和动态数据适配器，用于尽量弥补剪枝带来的性能损失。实验表明，该方法在仅用一张 GPU、少量训练时间的条件下，可将模型规模减少约 20%，而性能下降仅约 1.0%。
classic:8071f165269d.tldr: LoRAShear 通过结构化剪枝 LoRA 适配器并结合动态知识恢复，在大幅压缩大模型的同时尽量保持性能。
classic:8071f165269d.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它面向 LLM 部署中的真实痛点，给出了一套兼顾压缩效率和性能保持的实用方案。作为经典参考，它对理解“如何剪掉大模型但不伤太多精度”很有启发。

classic:8aa62a1e8c4a.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) with billions of parameters have drastically transformed AI applications. However, their demanding computation during inference has raised significant challenges for deployment on resource-constrained devices. Despite recent trends favoring alternative activation functions such as GELU or SiLU, known for increased computation, this study strongly advocates for reinstating ReLU activation in LLMs. We demonstrate that using the ReLU activation function has a negligible impact on convergence and performance while significantly reducing computation and weight transfer. This reduction is particularly valuable during the memory-bound inference step, where efficiency is paramount. Exploring sparsity patterns in ReLU-based LLMs, we unveil the reutilization of activated neurons for generating new tokens and leveraging these insights, we propose practical strategies to substantially reduce LLM inference computation up to three times, using ReLU activations with minimal performance trade-offs.
classic:8aa62a1e8c4a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理阶段计算开销过高的问题，尤其是在资源受限设备上的部署压力。作者主张在LLM中重新使用ReLU激活函数，认为它相比GELU或SiLU能显著降低计算和权重传输成本。实验表明，ReLU对模型收敛和性能影响很小，同时还能带来明显的激活稀疏性。基于这种稀疏模式，论文进一步提出了可将推理计算量最高减少到约三分之一的实用方法。
classic:8aa62a1e8c4a.tldr: ReLU在大语言模型中不仅几乎不损失性能，还能利用激活稀疏性显著降低推理计算开销。
classic:8aa62a1e8c4a.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接挑战了LLM里“更平滑的激活函数一定更好”的常见做法，提出了一个简单但高效的替代方案。它适合作为经典参考，帮助理解如何从激活函数与稀疏性角度优化推理效率。

classic:d103da4ee41d.abstract: Traditional pruning methods are known to be challenging to work in Large Language Models (LLMs) for Generative AI because of their unaffordable training process and large computational demands. For the first time, we introduce the information entropy of hidden state features into a pruning metric design, namely E-Sparse, to improve the accuracy of N:M sparsity on LLM. E-Sparse employs the information richness to leverage the channel importance, and further incorporates several novel techniques to put it into effect: (1) it introduces information entropy to enhance the significance of parameter weights and input feature norms as a novel pruning metric, and performs N:M sparsity without modifying the remaining weights. (2) it designs global naive shuffle and local block shuffle to quickly optimize the information distribution and adequately cope with the impact of N:M sparsity on LLMs' accuracy. E-Sparse is implemented as a Sparse-GEMM on FasterTransformer and runs on NVIDIA Ampere GPUs. Extensive experiments on the LLaMA family and OPT models show that E-Sparse can significantly speed up the model inference over the dense model (up to 1.53X) and obtain significant memory saving (up to 43.52%), with acceptable accuracy loss.
classic:d103da4ee41d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大型语言模型推理中“剪枝难、加速不明显”的问题，尤其是在不愿意付出昂贵训练成本的情况下如何实现有效稀疏化。作者提出了 E-Sparse，将隐藏状态的熵信息引入剪枝指标，用信息丰富度来衡量通道重要性，并结合 N:M 稀疏模式进行结构化压缩。为了减轻稀疏带来的精度损失，论文还设计了全局 naive shuffle 和局部 block shuffle 来优化信息分布。实验表明，该方法在 LLaMA 和 OPT 上能实现可观的推理加速与显存节省，同时保持较小的精度下降。
classic:d103da4ee41d.tldr: E-Sparse 用隐藏状态熵来指导 N:M 稀疏化，让大语言模型在较小精度损失下实现更快推理和更省显存。
classic:d103da4ee41d.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“信息熵”引入了 LLM 剪枝设计，为稀疏化提供了一个更有辨识度的指标。它也很适合作为经典参考，帮助理解如何在大模型推理中兼顾加速、压缩和精度。

classic:6c9666b69727.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) with billions of parameters are prime targets for network pruning, removing some model weights without hurting performance. Prior approaches such as magnitude pruning, SparseGPT, and Wanda, either concentrated solely on weights or integrated weights with activations for sparsity. However, they overlooked the informative gradients derived from pretrained LLMs. In this paper, we present a novel sparsity-centric pruning method for pretrained LLMs, termed Gradient-based Language Model Pruner (GBLM-Pruner). GBLM-Pruner leverages the first-order term of the Taylor expansion, operating in a training-free manner by harnessing properly normalized gradients from a few calibration samples to determine the pruning metric, and substantially outperforms competitive counterparts like SparseGPT and Wanda in multiple benchmarks. Intriguingly, by incorporating gradients, unstructured pruning with our method tends to reveal some structural patterns, which mirrors the geometric interdependence inherent in the LLMs' parameter structure. Additionally, GBLM-Pruner functions without any subsequent retraining or weight updates to maintain its simplicity as other counterparts. Extensive evaluations on LLaMA-1 and LLaMA-2 across various benchmarks show that GBLM-Pruner surpasses magnitude pruning, Wanda and SparseGPT by significant margins. We further extend our approach on Vision Transformer. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/GBLM-Pruner.
classic:6c9666b69727.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型剪枝中“只看权重大小”不够的问题，指出已有方法忽略了预训练模型中蕴含的梯度信息。作者提出 GBLM-Pruner，用少量校准样本计算并归一化梯度，基于泰勒展开的一阶项来决定哪些参数应被剪掉。该方法是训练无关的，不需要额外微调或重训练，却能在 LLaMA-1、LLaMA-2 等多个基准上显著优于 magnitude pruning、Wanda 和 SparseGPT。论文还发现，引入梯度后，非结构化剪枝会自然呈现一定结构模式，揭示了模型参数之间的几何关联。
classic:6c9666b69727.tldr: GBLM-Pruner 把梯度引入 LLM 剪枝决策，在无需重训练的情况下显著优于只看权重或激活的传统方法。
classic:6c9666b69727.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型压缩，这篇文章很值得看，因为它给出了一个更“懂模型内部信息”的剪枝视角：不只看参数大小，还看梯度。它是经典参考的原因在于方法简单、无需训练，并且在多个模型和任务上都有强竞争力。

classic:78a3a3471421.abstract: Quantization and pruning form the foundation of compression for neural networks, enabling efficient inference for large language models (LLMs). Recently, various quantization and pruning techniques have demonstrated remarkable performance in a post-training setting. They rely upon calibration data, a small set of unlabeled examples that are used to generate layer activations. However, no prior work has systematically investigated how the calibration data impacts the effectiveness of model compression methods. In this paper, we present the first extensive empirical study on the effect of calibration data upon LLM performance. We trial a variety of quantization and pruning methods, datasets, tasks, and models. Surprisingly, we find substantial variations in downstream task performance, contrasting existing work that suggests a greater level of robustness to the calibration data. Finally, we make a series of recommendations for the effective use of calibration data in LLM quantization and pruning.
classic:78a3a3471421.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在后训练量化和剪枝中的一个关键问题：用于生成层激活的校准数据，会怎样影响压缩效果。作者系统评估了多种量化与剪枝方法、数据集、任务和模型，发现不同校准数据带来的下游性能差异非常明显。这个结果说明，校准数据并不像先前一些工作暗示的那样具有很强的鲁棒性。论文最后给出了如何更有效使用校准数据的实践建议，对模型压缩和高效推理很有参考价值。
classic:78a3a3471421.tldr: 首次系统研究校准数据对后训练量化与剪枝的影响，发现它会显著左右大模型压缩后的任务表现。
classic:78a3a3471421.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它补上了一个经常被忽略但非常实际的问题：压缩方法到底有多依赖校准数据。对于做 LLM 量化、剪枝和部署的人来说，它提供了重要的经验结论和使用建议。

classic:75120d089395.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注如何在压缩大语言模型时，尽量保留关键能力并减少性能损失。作者提出 BESA 方法，通过按块分配稀疏性，让模型不同参数区域获得更灵活的剪枝预算。相比一刀切的全局剪枝方式，这种块级参数高效稀疏分配更能适应大模型内部结构差异。它的价值在于为大语言模型剪枝提供了一种更精细、可控的压缩思路。
classic:75120d089395.tldr: BESA 通过块级稀疏性分配来剪枝大语言模型，在压缩效率和性能保留之间取得更好的平衡。
classic:75120d089395.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型压缩，这篇论文值得看，因为它把“剪哪里、剪多少”这件事做得更细致。它适合作为经典参考，用来理解结构化稀疏和参数高效剪枝在 LLM 上的应用。

classic:15db2a049d5d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注如何在保持大语言模型性能的同时，尽可能减少模型中的冗余参数，从而降低推理和部署成本。作者提出了一种名为“将梯度推向零”的新剪枝方法，通过利用训练或微调过程中的梯度信息来识别不重要的权重，并逐步将其去除。与依赖静态权重大小的传统剪枝相比，这种方法更直接地反映参数对损失函数的贡献。它为大模型压缩提供了一种更有针对性的思路，具有较强的实用价值。
classic:15db2a049d5d.tldr: 利用梯度信息把不重要的参数“推向零”，从而实现大语言模型的高效剪枝。
classic:15db2a049d5d.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注大模型压缩、加速和部署成本控制的读者阅读。它提供了一种不同于常见幅值剪枝的思路，是理解现代 LLM 剪枝方法时值得参考的工作。

classic:d47db3ee64a1.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时计算和存储开销过大的问题，提出一种训练后剪枝方法来在不重新训练的前提下压缩模型。作者通过一种即插即用式的剪枝流程，尽量保留模型原有能力，同时去除冗余参数。方法强调效率和实用性，适合大模型落地场景中的快速压缩需求。作为 ICLR 2024 的工作，它展示了后训练剪枝在大语言模型上的可行性与应用价值。
classic:d47db3ee64a1.tldr: 一种面向大语言模型的高效后训练剪枝方法，主打无需重训、即插即用地压缩模型。
classic:d47db3ee64a1.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接面向大模型部署中的现实痛点：算力、显存和推理成本。它也适合作为经典参考，了解训练后剪枝如何在大语言模型上兼顾效率与性能。

classic:49046c1c246d.abstract: Despite the remarkable performance of generative large language models (LLMs) on abstractive summarization, they face two significant challenges: their considerable size and tendency to hallucinate. Hallucinations are concerning because they erode reliability and raise safety issues. Pruning is a technique that reduces model size by removing redundant weights, enabling more efficient sparse inference. Pruned models yield downstream task performance comparable to the original, making them ideal alternatives when operating on a limited budget. However, the effect that pruning has upon hallucinations in abstractive summarization with LLMs has yet to be explored. In this paper, we provide an extensive empirical study across five summarization datasets, two state-of-the-art pruning methods, and five instruction-tuned LLMs. Surprisingly, we find that hallucinations are less prevalent from pruned LLMs than the original models. Our analysis suggests that pruned models tend to depend more on the source document for summary generation. This leads to a higher lexical overlap between the generated summary and the source document, which could be a reason for the reduction in hallucination risk.
classic:49046c1c246d.summary_zh: 这是一篇发表于Arxiv 2023的Pruning and Sparsity方向经典论文，适合作为该主题的代表性参考。 论文主要围绕“Lighter, yet More Faithful: Investigating Hallucinations in Pruned Large Language Models for Abstractive Summarization”展开。 原文摘要可帮助你快速定位方法与实验设定。
classic:49046c1c246d.tldr: Pruning and Sparsity方向代表工作，发表于Arxiv 2023，适合快速建立该主题的经典论文地图。
classic:49046c1c246d.simple_intro: 这是一篇发表于Arxiv 2023的Pruning and Sparsity方向经典论文，适合作为该主题的代表性参考。

classic:c4120c10cb6e.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), such as LLaMA and T5, have shown exceptional performance across various tasks through fine-tuning. Although low-rank adaption (LoRA) has emerged to cheaply fine-tune these LLMs on downstream tasks, their deployment is still hindered by the vast model scale and computational costs. Post-training model pruning offers a way to compress LLMs. However, the current pruning methods designed for LLMs are not compatible with LoRA. This is due to their utilization of unstructured pruning on LLMs, impeding the merging of LoRA weights, or their dependence on the gradients of pre-trained weights to guide pruning, which can impose significant memory overhead. To this end, we propose LoRAPrune, a new framework that delivers an accurate structured pruned model in a highly memory-efficient manner. Specifically, we first design a LoRA-guided pruning criterion, which uses the weights and gradients of LoRA, rather than the gradients of pre-trained weights for importance estimation. We subsequently integrate this criterion into an iterative pruning process, effectively removing redundant channels and heads. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of our LoRAPrune over existing approaches on the LLaMA series models. At a 50\% compression rate, LoRAPrune demonstrates superior performance over LLM-Pruner, achieving a reduction in perplexity by 4.81 on WikiText2 and 3.46 on PTB, while also decreasing memory usage by 52.6%. Besides, LoRAPrune also matches semi-structural pruning across multiple LLMs, proving its wide applicability. The code is available at https://github.com/aim-uofa/LoRAPrune.
classic:c4120c10cb6e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是：大语言模型在经过 LoRA 微调后，如何在继续保持效果的同时进一步压缩部署成本。作者指出，现有面向 LLM 的剪枝方法要么与 LoRA 不兼容，要么依赖预训练权重梯度，带来较高显存开销。为此，论文提出 LoRAPrune，用 LoRA 的权重和梯度来设计剪枝准则，并通过迭代式结构化剪枝去除冗余通道和注意力头。实验表明，该方法在多个 LLaMA 系列模型上能以更低内存实现更好的性能，兼具实用性和通用性。
classic:c4120c10cb6e.tldr: LoRAPrune 让 LoRA 微调后的大模型也能高效做结构化剪枝，兼顾压缩率、效果和显存开销。
classic:c4120c10cb6e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了“LoRA 微调 + 模型剪枝”难以兼容的实际问题，方法设计很贴近大模型部署需求。它也适合作为相关方向的经典参考，帮助理解如何把参数高效微调和结构化压缩结合起来。

classic:9c17f96afde0.abstract: In AI research, the optimization of Large Language Models (LLMs) remains a significant challenge, crucial for advancing the field's practical applications and sustainability. Building upon the foundational work of Professor Song Han's lab at MIT, this paper introduces a novel approach in developing Mini-GPTs via contextual pruning. Our methodology strategically prunes the computational architecture of traditional LLMs, like Phi-1.5, focusing on retaining core functionalities while drastically reducing model sizes. We employ the technique across diverse and complex datasets, including US law, Medical Q&A, Skyrim dialogue, English-Taiwanese translation, and Economics articles. The results underscore the efficiency and effectiveness of contextual pruning, not merely as a theoretical concept but as a practical tool in developing domain-specific, resource-efficient LLMs. Contextual pruning is a promising method for building domain-specific LLMs, and this research is a building block towards future development with more hardware compute, refined fine-tuning, and quantization.
classic:9c17f96afde0.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在实际部署中“太大、太贵、太难用”的问题，提出通过上下文剪枝（contextual pruning）来压缩模型。作者以 Phi-1.5 等传统 LLM 为基础，在保留核心能力的同时，删除不必要的计算结构，从而显著减小模型规模。实验覆盖法律、医疗问答、游戏对话、英中翻译和经济文章等多个领域，展示了这种方法在领域特化场景中的有效性。它的价值在于为构建更高效、资源友好的小型 LLM 提供了可行路径。
classic:9c17f96afde0.tldr: Mini-GPTs 通过上下文剪枝把大语言模型做得更小更省算力，同时尽量保留核心能力，适合领域专用部署。
classic:9c17f96afde0.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“如何让大模型更轻量”这个工程问题做成了一个清晰的方法框架。对于想了解剪枝、稀疏化和小型领域模型的人来说，它是一个很实用的参考。

classic:14673048baee.abstract: State-of-the-art language models are becoming increasingly large in an effort to achieve the highest performance on large corpora of available textual data. However, the sheer size of the Transformer architectures makes it difficult to deploy models within computational, environmental or device-specific constraints. We explore data-driven compression of existing pretrained models as an alternative to training smaller models from scratch. To do so, we scale Kronecker-factored curvature approximations of the target loss landscape to large language models. In doing so, we can compute both the dynamic allocation of structures that can be removed as well as updates of remaining weights that account for the removal. We provide a general framework for unstructured, semi-structured and structured pruning and improve upon weight updates to capture more correlations between weights, while remaining computationally efficient. Experimentally, our method can prune rows and columns from a range of OPT models and Llamav2-7B by 20%-30%, with a negligible loss in performance, and achieve state-of-the-art results in unstructured and semi-structured pruning of large language models.
classic:14673048baee.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大型语言模型过于庞大、难以在算力、能耗和设备约束下部署的问题，提出对已有预训练模型进行数据驱动压缩，而不是从头训练更小模型。作者将 Kronecker-factored curvature 近似扩展到大语言模型，用来估计哪些结构可以被移除，以及移除后应如何更新剩余权重。论文给出了一个统一框架，支持非结构化、半结构化和结构化剪枝，并改进了权重更新以更好地保留模型性能。实验表明，该方法可对 OPT 和 Llama v2-7B 等模型剪除 20% 到 30% 的行列，且性能损失很小。
classic:14673048baee.tldr: 用曲率近似做大模型“外科手术式”剪枝，在几乎不掉点的情况下显著压缩 LLM。
classic:14673048baee.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把经典的剪枝思想推进到了大语言模型规模，并且兼顾了可解释性和实用性。对于想了解“如何在不重训大模型的前提下高效压缩模型”的读者，它是很有代表性的参考。

classic:9be1a92f91b1.abstract: Network Pruning is a promising way to address the huge computing resource demands of the deployment and inference of Large Language Models (LLMs). Retraining-free is important for LLMs' pruning methods. However, almost all of the existing retraining-free pruning approaches for LLMs focus on unstructured pruning, which requires specific hardware support for acceleration. In this paper, we propose a novel retraining-free structured pruning framework for LLMs, named FLAP (FLuctuation-based Adaptive Structured Pruning). It is hardware-friendly by effectively reducing storage and enhancing inference speed. For effective structured pruning of LLMs, we highlight three critical elements that demand the utmost attention: formulating structured importance metrics, adaptively searching the global compressed model, and implementing compensation mechanisms to mitigate performance loss. First, FLAP determines whether the output feature map is easily recoverable when a column of weight is removed, based on the fluctuation pruning metric. Then it standardizes the importance scores to adaptively determine the global compressed model structure. At last, FLAP adds additional bias terms to recover the output feature maps using the baseline values. We thoroughly evaluate our approach on a variety of language benchmarks. Without any retraining, our method significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods, including LLM-Pruner and the extension of Wanda in structured pruning. The code is released at https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/FLAP.
classic:9be1a92f91b1.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大语言模型部署和推理时计算资源开销过大的问题，研究了无需再训练的结构化剪枝方法。作者提出 FLAP（基于波动的自适应结构化剪枝），通过波动剪枝度量判断移除权重列后输出特征是否容易恢复，并据此构建结构重要性指标。方法还会自适应搜索全局压缩后的模型结构，并加入额外偏置项来补偿性能损失。实验表明，FLAP 在无需 retraining 的情况下，能在多项语言基准上显著优于现有结构化剪枝方法，且更适合真实硬件部署。
classic:9be1a92f91b1.tldr: FLAP 提出一种无需再训练的大模型结构化剪枝方法，兼顾压缩效率、推理速度和实际硬件友好性。
classic:9be1a92f91b1.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“能直接部署”的要求放在了首位，解决了很多剪枝方法依赖特殊硬件或需要再训练的问题。作为经典参考，它展示了如何把结构重要性评估、全局搜索和补偿机制结合起来做高质量大模型压缩。

classic:220233334dfb.abstract: Pruning large language models (LLMs) from the BERT family has emerged as a standard compression benchmark, and several pruning methods have been proposed for this task. The recent ``Sparsity May Cry'' (SMC) benchmark put into question the validity of all existing methods, exhibiting a more complex setup where many known pruning methods appear to fail. We revisit the question of accurate BERT-pruning during fine-tuning on downstream datasets, and propose a set of general guidelines for successful pruning, even on the challenging SMC benchmark. First, we perform a cost-vs-benefits analysis of pruning model components, such as the embeddings and the classification head; second, we provide a simple-yet-general way of scaling training, sparsification and learning rate schedules relative to the desired target sparsity; finally, we investigate the importance of proper parametrization for Knowledge Distillation in the context of LLMs. Our simple insights lead to state-of-the-art results, both on classic BERT-pruning benchmarks, as well as on the SMC benchmark, showing that even classic gradual magnitude pruning (GMP) can yield competitive results, with the right approach.
classic:220233334dfb.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注在下游任务微调过程中如何准确剪枝 BERT 系列大语言模型，目标是在压缩模型的同时尽量恢复或保持精度。作者针对“Sparsity May Cry”这一更具挑战性的基准，重新审视了以往剪枝方法失效的原因，并从组件剪枝、训练与稀疏化日程、学习率设置以及知识蒸馏参数化等方面提出通用建议。实验表明，只要策略得当，经典的渐进式幅值剪枝也能在困难基准上取得有竞争力的结果。该工作为理解和实践 LLM 剪枝提供了实用、可复用的经验总结。
classic:220233334dfb.tldr: 提出一套通用剪枝与训练策略，使经典 BERT/LLM 剪枝方法在困难的 SMC 基准上也能恢复高精度。
classic:220233334dfb.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是只报告一个新剪枝算法，而是系统梳理了“为什么很多方法在新基准上失效”以及“怎样把经典方法做对”。对于想在真实场景里压缩 BERT/LLM 的读者，它提供了很实用的经典参考。

classic:dcf7f63447bd.abstract: Neural Networks can be effectively compressed through pruning, significantly reducing storage and compute demands while maintaining predictive performance. Simple yet effective methods like magnitude pruning remove less important parameters and typically require a costly retraining procedure to restore performance. However, with the rise of LLMs, full retraining has become infeasible due to memory and compute constraints. This study challenges the practice of retraining all parameters by showing that updating a small subset of highly expressive parameters can suffice to recover or even enhance performance after pruning. Surprisingly, retraining just 0.01%-0.05% of the parameters in GPT-architectures can match the performance of full retraining across various sparsity levels, significantly reducing compute and memory requirements, and enabling retraining of models with up to 30 billion parameters on a single GPU in minutes. To bridge the gap to full retraining in the high sparsity regime, we introduce two novel LoRA variants that, unlike standard LoRA, allow merging adapters back without compromising sparsity. Going a step further, we show that these methods can be applied for memory-efficient layer-wise reconstruction, significantly enhancing state-of-the-art retraining-free methods like Wanda (Sun et al., 2023) and SparseGPT (Frantar & Alistarh, 2023). Our findings present a promising alternative to avoiding retraining.
classic:dcf7f63447bd.summary_zh: 这篇论文讨论了大模型剪枝后的“重训练-恢复性能”问题，指出传统需要对全部参数进行重训练的方法在LLM时代已不现实。作者发现，只需更新极少量具有高表达能力的参数，就能在多种稀疏度下恢复甚至提升性能，在GPT架构中仅重训0.01%到0.05%的参数就可接近全量重训效果。为进一步适应高稀疏场景，论文提出了可在合并后保持稀疏性的两种LoRA变体，并将其用于更高效的逐层重建。整体上，它为剪枝后的恢复训练提供了一条更省算力、省显存的替代路径。
classic:dcf7f63447bd.tldr: PERP提出：剪枝后不必全量重训，只更新极少量关键参数也能恢复大模型性能。
classic:dcf7f63447bd.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接挑战了剪枝领域长期默认的“全参数重训练”范式，特别贴合LLM时代的算力约束。它既有明确的工程价值，也给后续稀疏模型恢复与低成本微调提供了重要参考。

classic:e921b58103c3.abstract: Pruning large language models (LLMs) is a challenging task due to their enormous size. The primary difficulty is fine-tuning the model after pruning, which is needed to recover the lost performance caused by dropping weights. Recent approaches have either ignored fine-tuning entirely, focusing on efficient pruning criteria, or attempted layer-wise weight updates, preserving the behavior of each layer. However, even layer-wise weight updates can be costly for LLMs, and previous works have resorted to various approximations. In our paper, we propose a fast and effective weight update algorithm for pruned layers based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM). We further extend it with a simple gradual pruning mask selection and achieve state-of-the-art pruning performance across a wide range of LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/fmfi-compbio/admm-pruning.
classic:e921b58103c3.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型剪枝后的一个核心难题：参数被删除后，如何高效地恢复模型性能。作者提出了一种基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的快速权重更新算法，用于对被剪枝的层进行优化修正。与此同时，论文还结合了一个简单的渐进式剪枝掩码选择策略，以提升整体剪枝效果。实验表明，该方法在多种大语言模型上都取得了领先的剪枝性能，并兼顾了速度与效果。
classic:e921b58103c3.tldr: 提出基于 ADMM 的快速权重更新方法，让剪枝后的大语言模型能够更快、更有效地恢复性能。
classic:e921b58103c3.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了 LLM 剪枝中最实际也最棘手的问题之一：剪完以后怎么高效补回来。对于想了解“剪枝不仅要删得准，还要恢复得快”的研究者来说，它是很有参考价值的经典工作。

classic:945a0dac82e7.abstract: Fine-tuning and inference with large Language Models (LM) are generally known to be expensive. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning over pretrained LMs reduces training memory by updating a small number of LM parameters but does not improve inference efficiency. Structured pruning improves LM inference efficiency by removing consistent parameter blocks, yet often increases training memory and time. To improve both training and inference efficiency, we introduce APT that adaptively prunes and tunes parameters for the LMs. At the early stage of fine-tuning, APT dynamically adds salient tuning parameters for fast and accurate convergence while discarding unimportant parameters for efficiency. Compared to baselines, our experiments show that APT maintains up to 98% task performance when pruning RoBERTa and T5 models with 40% parameters left while keeping 86.4% LLaMA models' performance with 70% parameters remained. Furthermore, APT speeds up LMs fine-tuning by up to 8x and reduces large LMs memory training footprint by up to 70%.
classic:945a0dac82e7.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大语言模型微调和推理成本高的问题，提出了 APT 方法，用于在训练阶段和推理阶段同时提升效率。APT 会在微调早期动态保留更重要的参数、移除不重要的参数，从而在保证收敛速度和任务效果的同时减少计算与内存开销。与只做参数高效微调或只做结构化剪枝的方法不同，APT 兼顾了训练效率和推理效率。实验表明，它在多种模型上能以较少参数保留接近原始性能，并显著加速微调、降低训练显存占用。
classic:945a0dac82e7.tldr: APT 通过“边剪枝边微调”同时提升大语言模型的训练和推理效率，在较少参数下仍能保持较高性能。
classic:945a0dac82e7.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它把“训练省资源”和“推理更快”这两个常常冲突的目标统一起来了。作为参数剪枝与高效微调方向的经典参考，它展示了一种实用的动态压缩思路。

classic:eca20de56b83.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are difficult to fully fine-tune (e.g., with instructions or human feedback) due to their sheer number of parameters. A family of parameter-efficient sparse fine-tuning methods have proven promising in terms of performance but their memory requirements increase proportionally to the size of the LLMs. In this work, we scale sparse fine-tuning to state-of-the-art LLMs like LLaMA 2 7B and 13B. We propose SpIEL, a novel sparse fine-tuning method which, for a desired density level, maintains an array of parameter indices and the deltas of these parameters relative to their pretrained values. It iterates over: (a) updating the active deltas, (b) pruning indices (based on the change of magnitude of their deltas) and (c) regrowth of indices. For regrowth, we explore two criteria based on either the accumulated gradients of a few candidate parameters or their approximate momenta estimated using the efficient SM3 optimizer. We experiment with instruction-tuning of LLMs on standard dataset mixtures, finding that SpIEL is often superior to popular parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods like LoRA (low-rank adaptation) in terms of performance and comparable in terms of run time. We additionally show that SpIEL is compatible with both quantization and efficient optimizers, to facilitate scaling to ever-larger model sizes. We release the code for SpIEL at https://github.com/AlanAnsell/peft and for the instruction-tuning experiments at https://github.com/ducdauge/sft-llm.
classic:eca20de56b83.summary_zh: 这篇论文讨论了大语言模型在全量微调时参数和显存开销过大的问题，尤其是在指令微调或人类反馈对齐场景下更难扩展。作者提出了 SpIEL，一种稀疏微调方法，通过维护活跃参数索引和参数增量，并在训练中不断进行剪枝与生长来更新可训练子集。论文还设计了基于梯度累积或 SM3 近似动量的重生策略，使稀疏微调能够扩展到 LLaMA 2 7B/13B 这类更大的模型。实验表明，SpIEL 在性能上 часто 优于 LoRA 等常见参数高效微调方法，同时运行时间也具有竞争力，并且可与量化和高效优化器兼容。
classic:eca20de56b83.tldr: SpIEL 通过动态剪枝和生长把稀疏微调扩展到更大的 LLM，在性能上常优于 LoRA 且更易扩展。
classic:eca20de56b83.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型微调如何在有限显存下继续扩展，这篇论文很值得看。它把稀疏训练从“能用”推进到“能在更大 LLM 上稳定用”，是参数高效微调方向的重要参考。

classic:f46558e64877.abstract: Large language models have become the cornerstone of natural language processing, but their use comes with substantial costs in terms of compute and memory resources. Sparsification provides a solution to alleviate these resource constraints, and recent works have shown that trained models can be sparsified post-hoc. Existing sparsification techniques face challenges as they need additional data structures and offer constrained speedup with current hardware. In this paper we present SliceGPT, a new post-training sparsification scheme which replaces each weight matrix with a smaller (dense) matrix, reducing the embedding dimension of the network. Through extensive experimentation, we show that SliceGPT can remove up to 25% of the model parameters (including embeddings) for LLAMA2-70B, OPT 66B and Phi-2 models while maintaining 99%, 99% and 90% zero-shot task performance of the dense model respectively. Our sliced models run on fewer GPUs and run faster without any additional code optimization: on 24GB consumer GPUs we reduce the total compute for inference on LLAMA2-70B to 64% of that of the dense model; on 40GB A100 GPUs we reduce it to 66%. We offer a new insight, computational invariance in transformer networks, which enables SliceGPT and we hope it will inspire and enable future avenues to reduce memory and computation demands for pre-trained models. Code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/TransformerCompression
classic:f46558e64877.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理时计算和显存开销过高的问题，提出了一种后训练压缩方法 SliceGPT。它不依赖复杂的稀疏结构，而是通过删除权重矩阵中的行和列，把每一层改造成更小的稠密矩阵，从而直接降低网络的嵌入维度。作者在 LLAMA2-70B、OPT-66B 和 Phi-2 上验证了方法的有效性，最多可移除 25% 参数，同时仍保持较高的零样本任务性能。该方法还能让模型在更少 GPU 上运行，并且无需额外代码优化就能带来实际加速。
classic:f46558e64877.tldr: SliceGPT 通过删除行列把大模型“切小”，在几乎不损失性能的前提下同时减少参数、显存和推理开销。
classic:f46558e64877.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它给出了一个非常直接、工程上也很实用的大模型压缩思路。它不仅能帮助理解后训练稀疏化的前沿方法，也提出了“计算不变性”的新视角，适合作为模型压缩方向的经典参考。

classic:b70c83fc1c76.abstract: Structured pruning of modern large language models (LLMs) has emerged as a way of decreasing their high computational needs. Width pruning reduces the size of projection weight matrices (e.g., by removing attention heads) while maintaining the number of layers. Depth pruning, in contrast, removes entire layers or blocks, while keeping the size of the remaining weights unchanged. Most current research focuses on either width-only or a blend of width and depth pruning, with little comparative analysis between the two units (width vs. depth) concerning their impact on LLM inference efficiency. In this work, we show that simple depth pruning can effectively compress LLMs while achieving comparable or superior performance to recent width pruning studies. Our pruning method boosts inference speeds, especially under memory-constrained conditions that require limited batch sizes for running LLMs, where width pruning is ineffective. In retraining pruned models for quality recovery, continued pretraining on a large corpus markedly outperforms LoRA-based tuning, particularly at severe pruning ratios. We hope this work can help build compact yet capable LLMs. Code and models can be found at: https://github.com/Nota-NetsPresso/shortened-llm
classic:b70c83fc1c76.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型结构化剪枝中的效率问题，讨论了宽度剪枝和深度剪枝在推理加速上的差异。作者提出一种非常简单的深度剪枝方法，通过直接删除整层或模块来压缩 LLM，而不改变剩余层的参数形状。实验表明，这种方法在不少场景下能取得与甚至优于近期宽度剪枝工作的效果，尤其在显存受限、批量较小时更能体现加速优势。对于剪枝后模型的恢复，论文还发现继续预训练比基于 LoRA 的微调更有效。
classic:b70c83fc1c76.tldr: 简单的深度剪枝就能高效压缩 LLM，并在显存受限场景下比宽度剪枝更有推理加速优势。
classic:b70c83fc1c76.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它用很直接的方式回答了“剪哪些地方更划算”这个经典问题。它对比了宽度与深度两类剪枝，并给出在实际部署中很有参考价值的结论。

classic:e5fa8f7eeb9b.abstract: Structured pruning is a promising approach to create smaller, faster large language models. However, existing methods typically rely on computing the gradient via backward passes, which can inflate memory requirements and compute costs. In this work we introduce Bonsai, a gradient-free structured pruning method that eliminates the need for backpropagation, significantly reducing memory requirements and compute costs while achieving state-of-the-art pruning performance. Bonsai uses forward-pass-only perturbative pruning to enable efficient compression of large models on a broader range of hardware configurations. Unlike existing structured pruning approaches, Bonsai not only achieves better compression with fewer resources but also produces models that are twice as fast as those generated by semi-structured pruning. As a concrete demonstration, we use Bonsai to prune 7B and 8B models to 50% sparsity on a single A6000 GPU -- a task challenging for backprop-based methods in memory-constrained settings, as they require 2-3x the memory. Our results show that removing backprop as a requirement not only enables pruning larger models on constrained hardware but can also lead to state-of-the-art efficiency and performance.
classic:e5fa8f7eeb9b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型结构化剪枝中“需要反向传播”带来的高内存和高计算成本问题。作者提出了 Bonsai，一种只依赖前向传播的无梯度结构化剪枝方法，通过扰动式评估完成压缩，避免了反向传播。实验表明，Bonsai 在更少资源下实现了有竞争力甚至更好的剪枝效果，并且生成的模型推理速度更快。该方法还展示了在单张 A6000 GPU 上对 7B/8B 模型进行 50% 稀疏剪枝的可行性。
classic:e5fa8f7eeb9b.tldr: Bonsai 用纯前向传播实现大模型结构化剪枝，显著降低内存开销并带来更快的模型。
classic:e5fa8f7eeb9b.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接降低了 LLM 剪枝的门槛，让资源受限环境也能做大模型压缩。作为经典参考，它展示了“去掉反向传播也能做高效剪枝”的思路，对后续稀疏化和模型部署很有启发。

classic:0ee206cc3aec.abstract: The considerable size of Large Language Models (LLMs) presents notable deployment challenges, particularly on resource-constrained hardware. Structured pruning, offers an effective means to compress LLMs, thereby reducing storage costs and enhancing inference speed for more efficient utilization. In this work, we study data-efficient and resource-efficient structure pruning methods to obtain smaller yet still powerful models. Knowledge Distillation is well-suited for pruning, as the intact model can serve as an excellent teacher for pruned students. However, it becomes challenging in the context of LLMs due to memory constraints. To address this, we propose an efficient progressive Numerous-teacher pruning method (NutePrune). NutePrune mitigates excessive memory costs by loading only one intact model and integrating it with various masks and LoRA modules, enabling it to seamlessly switch between teacher and student roles. This approach allows us to leverage numerous teachers with varying capacities to progressively guide the pruned model, enhancing overall performance. Extensive experiments across various tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of NutePrune. In LLaMA-7B zero-shot experiments, NutePrune retains 97.17% of the performance of the original model at 20% sparsity and 95.07% at 25% sparsity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lucius-lsr/NutePrune.
classic:0ee206cc3aec.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时因参数规模过大而带来的存储和推理开销问题，尤其是资源受限设备上的落地难题。作者研究了结构化剪枝，并指出知识蒸馏虽然适合帮助剪枝模型保持性能，但在 LLM 场景下会受到显存和内存限制。为此，论文提出了 NutePrune，一种高效的渐进式多教师剪枝方法，只加载一个完整模型，再结合不同的 mask 和 LoRA 模块在教师与学生角色间切换。实验表明，该方法能在较高稀疏率下仍较好保留原模型性能，适合作为大模型压缩与高效部署的参考方案。
classic:0ee206cc3aec.tldr: NutePrune 通过“一个完整模型 + 多个教师视角”的渐进式剪枝，低内存地压缩大语言模型，同时尽量保住性能。
classic:0ee206cc3aec.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了 LLM 剪枝中“蒸馏有效但太占显存”的实际痛点，方法设计很贴近工程部署需求。对于想了解大模型结构化剪枝、知识蒸馏和高效压缩的研究者，这是一个很有代表性的经典参考。

classic:4c6f325a6896.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) based on transformer are witnessing a notable trend of size expansion, which brings considerable costs to both model training and inference. However, existing methods such as model quantization, knowledge distillation, and model pruning are constrained by various issues, including hardware support limitations, the need for extensive training, and alterations to the model internal structure. In this paper, we propose a concise layer-wise structured pruner called \textit{Layer Collapse (LaCo)}, in which rear model layers collapse into a prior layer, enabling a rapid reduction in model size while preserving the model structure. Comprehensive experiments show that our method maintains an average task performance of over 80\% at pruning ratios of 25-30\%, significantly outperforming existing state-of-the-art structured pruning methods. We also conduct post-training experiments to confirm that the \textit{LaCo} effectively inherits the parameters of the original model. Additionally, we perform ablation studies on various settings of \textit{LaCo}. Finally, we discuss our motivation from the perspective of layer-wise similarity and evaluate the performance of the pruned LLMs across various pruning ratios\footnote{\url{https://github.com/yangyifei729/LaCo}}.
classic:4c6f325a6896.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型随着规模增大而带来的训练和推理成本问题，尤其是现有量化、蒸馏和剪枝方法各自存在硬件支持、训练开销或结构改动等限制。作者提出了 Layer Collapse（LaCo）这种按层进行的结构化剪枝方法，让后面的层“折叠”到前面的层上，从而在尽量保持模型结构的同时快速压缩模型大小。实验表明，在 25% 到 30% 的剪枝率下，LaCo 仍能保留平均超过 80% 的任务性能，并且整体效果优于已有的结构化剪枝方法。论文还从层间相似性和后训练继承性角度分析了方法有效性，适合作为大模型剪枝方向的经典参考。
classic:4c6f325a6896.tldr: LaCo 通过“层折叠”实现快速结构化剪枝，在较高压缩率下仍能保持大部分 LLM 性能。
classic:4c6f325a6896.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，是因为它提供了一种简单直接、结构清晰的大模型压缩思路，既考虑了效果，也兼顾了实际部署的可行性。对于想了解 LLM 剪枝如何在不大改模型结构的前提下提速降本的人来说，它很有参考价值。

classic:04b34b1864c6.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) possess outstanding capabilities in addressing various natural language processing (NLP) tasks. However, the sheer size of these models poses challenges in terms of storage, training and inference due to the inclusion of billions of parameters through layer stacking. While traditional approaches such as model pruning or distillation offer ways for reducing model size, they often come at the expense of performance retention. In our investigation, we systematically explore the approach of reducing the number of layers in LLMs. Surprisingly, we observe that even with fewer layers, LLMs maintain similar or better performance levels, particularly in prompt-based fine-tuning for text classification tasks. Remarkably, in certain cases, models with a single layer outperform their fully layered counterparts. These findings offer valuable insights for future work aimed at mitigating the size constraints of LLMs while preserving their performance, thereby opening avenues for significantly more efficient use of LLMs.
classic:04b34b1864c6.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型层数过多带来的存储、训练和推理负担，探讨是否真的需要如此深的层叠结构。作者系统研究了通过直接减少层数来压缩 LLM 的方法，并发现模型在减少层数后仍能保持相近甚至更好的性能，尤其是在基于提示的文本分类微调任务中。更令人意外的是，在某些情况下，单层模型的表现甚至优于完整层数的模型。论文的价值在于，它为“剪层”这一简单但有效的压缩方向提供了实证依据，也为未来构建更高效的 LLM 提供了新思路。
classic:04b34b1864c6.tldr: 减少大语言模型的层数不一定会明显掉点，某些任务上甚至可能更好。
classic:04b34b1864c6.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它挑战了“模型越深越好”的直觉，说明删掉部分层也可能保住性能。作为经典参考，它很适合想了解 LLM 压缩、剪枝和高效推理方向的人。

classic:5d44647bb5d7.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于稀疏大语言模型在微调时效率不高、训练不稳定以及难以充分利用稀疏结构的问题。作者提出 EBFT（Effective and Block-Wise Fine-Tuning），以分块方式对稀疏模型进行有效微调，从而更好地适配参数更新与稀疏连接结构。该方法旨在在保持稀疏模型优势的同时，提升微调效果与训练效率。对于稀疏 LLM 的后训练和部署优化场景，这项工作提供了一个实用的经典参考思路。
classic:5d44647bb5d7.tldr: EBFT 提出一种面向稀疏大语言模型的分块微调方法，用更高效的方式提升稀疏模型的微调效果。
classic:5d44647bb5d7.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了稀疏大模型“能剪枝但不好微调”的实际问题。它为稀疏 LLM 的后训练提供了一个更实用的优化方向，适合作为稀疏化与参数高效训练的参考。

classic:0328d0e31e50.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are reshaping the research landscape in artificial intelligence, particularly as model parameters scale up significantly, unlocking remarkable capabilities across various domains. Nevertheless, the scalability of model parameters faces constraints due to limitations in GPU memory and computational speed. To address these constraints, various weight compression methods have emerged, such as Pruning and Quantization. Given the low-rank nature of weight matrices in language models, the reduction of weights through matrix decomposition undoubtedly holds significant potential and promise. In this paper, drawing upon the intrinsic structure of LLMs, we propose a novel approach termed Data-free Joint Rank-k Approximation for compressing the parameter matrices. Significantly, our method is characterized by without necessitating additional involvement of any corpus, while simultaneously preserving orthogonality in conjunction with pruning and quantization methods. We achieve a model pruning of 80% parameters while retaining 93.43% of the original performance without any calibration data. Additionally, we explore the fundamental properties of the weight matrix of LLMs undergone Rank-k Approximation and conduct comprehensive experiments to elucidate our hypothesis.
classic:0328d0e31e50.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在参数规模快速增长后带来的显存和计算开销问题，提出了一种无需额外语料的数据无关权重压缩方法。作者利用LLM权重矩阵的低秩结构，采用联合的 Rank-k 近似来进行压缩，并且可以与剪枝和量化方法结合使用。该方法在不依赖校准数据的情况下实现了80%的参数剪枝，同时保留了93.43%的原始性能。论文的价值在于提供了一种更轻量、更实用的LLM压缩思路，并验证了权重矩阵结构可被有效利用。
classic:0328d0e31e50.tldr: 一种无需校准数据、利用低秩结构压缩大语言模型权重的方法，可在大幅剪枝下保持较高性能。
classic:0328d0e31e50.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为经典参考，因为它直接针对LLM部署中的核心痛点——模型太大、太耗资源——提出了简洁而有效的压缩方案。它也很有代表性地展示了如何从模型权重结构本身出发，设计无需数据参与的压缩方法。

classic:c697bfee8d9b.abstract: The transformative impact of large language models (LLMs) like LLaMA and GPT on natural language processing is countered by their prohibitive computational demands. Pruning has emerged as a pivotal compression strategy, introducing sparsity to enhance both memory and computational efficiency. Yet, traditional global pruning is impractical for LLMs due to scalability issues, while local pruning, despite its efficiency, leads to suboptimal solutions. Addressing these challenges, we propose SparseLLM, a novel framework that redefines the global pruning process into manageable, coordinated subproblems, allowing for resource-efficient optimization with global optimality. SparseLLM's approach, which conceptualizes LLMs as a chain of modular functions and leverages auxiliary variables for problem decomposition, not only facilitates a pragmatic application on LLMs but also demonstrates significant performance improvements, particularly in high-sparsity regimes where it surpasses current state-of-the-art methods.
classic:c697bfee8d9b.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于大语言模型在推理和部署中计算与存储成本过高的问题，提出用剪枝来提升模型稀疏性和效率。作者指出，传统全局剪枝在LLM上难以直接扩展，而局部剪枝又容易得到次优结果。为此，论文提出 SparseLLM，把全局剪枝重构为多个可协调的小子问题，并通过辅助变量实现可行的分解优化。实验表明，该方法在高稀疏率场景下表现尤其突出，能优于现有方法。
classic:c697bfee8d9b.tldr: SparseLLM 将难以扩展的全局剪枝拆成可协调子问题，让大语言模型在高稀疏率下也能高效且更优地压缩。
classic:c697bfee8d9b.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“全局剪枝”这个理论上更优、但在大模型上难以落地的方法，变成了可实际操作的框架。对于研究大模型压缩、稀疏化和高效部署的人来说，它是一个很有代表性的经典参考。

classic:5d8f56e609e7.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to advance in performance, their size has escalated significantly, with current LLMs containing billions or even trillions of parameters. However, in this study, we discovered that many layers of LLMs exhibit high similarity, and some layers play a negligible role in network functionality. Based on this observation, we define a metric called Block Influence (BI) to gauge the significance of each layer in LLMs. We then propose a straightforward pruning approach: layer removal, in which we directly delete the redundant layers in LLMs based on their BI scores. Experiments demonstrate that our method, which we call ShortGPT, significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in model pruning. Moreover, ShortGPT is orthogonal to quantization-like methods, enabling further reduction in parameters and computation. The ability to achieve better results through simple layer removal, as opposed to more complex pruning techniques, suggests a high degree of redundancy in the model architecture.
classic:5d8f56e609e7.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型参数规模不断膨胀带来的推理开销问题，指出许多层之间存在高度相似性，甚至有些层对模型功能贡献很小。作者提出了一个衡量每层重要性的指标 Block Influence（BI），用来判断哪些层更适合删除。基于这一指标，论文提出了非常直接的层删除剪枝方法 ShortGPT，直接移除冗余层而不是做复杂的结构改造。实验表明，ShortGPT 在模型剪枝上优于以往方法，并且还能与量化等技术结合进一步压缩模型。
classic:5d8f56e609e7.tldr: ShortGPT 发现 LLM 的很多层其实是冗余的，并通过 Block Influence 指标直接删层，实现了简单但效果很强的模型剪枝。
classic:5d8f56e609e7.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它用一个很直观的观点挑战了“层数越多越好”的默认印象：LLM 中确实存在大量可删的冗余层。对于想了解大模型压缩、剪枝以及高效部署的人来说，它是一个非常经典的参考。

classic:30b4704b0dde.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have shown significant visual reasoning capabilities by connecting a visual encoder and a large language model. LMMs typically take in a fixed and large amount of visual tokens, such as the penultimate layer features in the CLIP visual encoder, as the prefix content. Recent LMMs incorporate more complex visual inputs, such as high-resolution images and videos, which further increases the number of visual tokens significantly. However, due to the inherent design of the Transformer architecture, the computational costs of these models tend to increase quadratically with the number of input tokens. To tackle this problem, we explore a token reduction mechanism that identifies significant spatial redundancy among visual tokens. In response, we propose PruMerge, a novel adaptive visual token reduction strategy that significantly reduces the number of visual tokens without compromising the performance of LMMs. Specifically, to metric the importance of each token, we exploit the sparsity observed in the visual encoder, characterized by the sparse distribution of attention scores between the class token and visual tokens. This sparsity enables us to dynamically select the most crucial visual tokens to retain. Subsequently, we cluster the selected (unpruned) tokens based on their key similarity and merge them with the unpruned tokens, effectively supplementing and enhancing their informational content. Empirically, when applied to LLaVA-1.5, our approach can compress the visual tokens by 14 times on average, and achieve comparable performance across diverse visual question-answering and reasoning tasks. Code and checkpoints are at https://llava-prumerge.github.io/.
classic:30b4704b0dde.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大型多模态模型在处理高分辨率图像和视频时视觉 token 数量过多、计算开销随输入长度急剧增长的问题展开研究。作者观察到视觉编码器中的注意力分布具有稀疏性，因此提出了 PruMerge，一种自适应的视觉 token 减少策略，用于识别并保留更重要的 token。随后，方法会根据 token 的键值相似性进行聚类与合并，从而在尽量不损失信息的前提下压缩输入。实验表明，该方法可将 LLaVA-1.5 的视觉 token 平均压缩 14 倍，同时在多种视觉问答和推理任务上保持接近原始模型的表现。
classic:30b4704b0dde.tldr: PruMerge 利用视觉注意力稀疏性自适应合并 token，把多模态模型的视觉输入大幅压缩，同时尽量保持性能。
classic:30b4704b0dde.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为多模态模型效率优化的经典参考，因为它直接解决了视觉 token 过多带来的计算瓶颈。它展示了如何利用模型内部的稀疏性做自适应剪枝与合并，思路清晰且实用。

classic:6aa1de6ec0f6.abstract: This paper introduces LLM-Streamline, a pioneer work on layer pruning for large language models (LLMs). It is based on the observation that different layers have varying impacts on hidden states, enabling the identification of less important layers to be pruned.LLM-Streamline comprises two parts: layer pruning, which removes consecutive layers with the lowest importance based on target sparsity, and layer replacement, a novel module that trains a lightweight network to replace the pruned layers to mitigate performance loss. Additionally, a new metric called stability is proposed to address the limitations of the widely used accuracy metric in evaluating model compression. Experiments show that LLM-Streamline outperforms both previous and concurrent state-of-the-art pruning methods in terms of both performance and training efficiency.Our code is available at https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/LLM-Streamline
classic:6aa1de6ec0f6.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型压缩中的层剪枝问题，指出不同层对隐藏状态的影响并不相同，因此可以识别并移除较不重要的连续层。作者提出了 LLM-Streamline 方法，包含层剪枝和层替换两部分：前者按目标稀疏度删除重要性最低的连续层，后者训练一个轻量网络来替代被剪掉的层，以减轻性能损失。论文还提出了新的评估指标 stability，用来弥补单纯依赖准确率衡量压缩效果的不足。实验结果表明，该方法在性能和训练效率上都优于此前及同期的先进剪枝方法。
classic:6aa1de6ec0f6.tldr: LLM-Streamline 通过剪掉不重要的连续层并用轻量网络替代，实现了更高效、性能更稳的大模型压缩。
classic:6aa1de6ec0f6.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为层剪枝方向的经典参考，因为它把“哪些层可以删”这件事做得更系统，也给出了替代被删层的实用方案。对于想了解大语言模型压缩如何兼顾效率和效果的人，这篇工作很值得看。

classic:b4a73ceba3c3.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show excellent performance in difficult tasks, but they often require massive memories and computational resources. How to reduce the parameter scale of LLMs has become research hotspots. In this study, we make an important observation that the multi-head self-attention (MHA) sub-layer of Transformer exhibits noticeable low-rank structure, while the feed-forward network (FFN) sub-layer does not. With this regard, we design a mixed compression model, which organically combines Low-Rank matrix approximation And structured Pruning (LoRAP). For the MHA sub-layer, we propose an input activation weighted singular value decomposition method to strengthen the low-rank characteristic. Furthermore, we discover that the weight matrices in MHA sub-layer have different low-rank degrees. Thus, a novel parameter allocation scheme according to the discrepancy of low-rank degrees is devised. For the FFN sub-layer, we propose a gradient-free structured channel pruning method. During the pruning, we get an interesting finding that the least important 1% of parameter actually play a vital role in model performance. Extensive evaluations on zero-shot perplexity and zero-shot task classification indicate that our proposal is superior to previous structured compression rivals under multiple compression ratios.
classic:b4a73ceba3c3.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型参数规模过大、推理和部署成本高的问题，提出对 Transformer 不同子层进行差异化压缩。作者发现多头自注意力（MHA）子层具有明显的低秩结构，而前馈网络（FFN）子层并不适合简单做低秩近似。基于这一观察，论文设计了 LoRAP：对 MHA 采用加权奇异值分解和按低秩程度分配参数，对 FFN 采用无梯度的结构化通道剪枝。实验表明，该方法在多种压缩比例下都优于以往的结构化压缩方法，兼顾了压缩率和模型性能。
classic:b4a73ceba3c3.tldr: LoRAP 认为 Transformer 的不同子层应采用不同压缩策略：MHA 做低秩分解，FFN 做结构化剪枝，从而更高效地压缩大语言模型。
classic:b4a73ceba3c3.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它没有把 Transformer 当作一个整体来压缩，而是细致分析了不同子层的结构差异，思路很经典也很实用。它适合作为大模型剪枝与结构化压缩方向的参考工作。

classic:8379f22cad69.abstract: Juan Pablo Munoz, Jinjie Yuan, Yi Zheng, Nilesh Jain. Proceedings of the 2024 Joint International Conference on Computational Linguistics, Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC-COLING 2024). 2024.
classic:8379f22cad69.summary_zh: 这篇论文面向大语言模型在微调和部署时计算与存储开销过大的问题，提出了一种名为 LoNAS 的弹性低秩适配方法。它将低秩适配器设计得更灵活，可以根据资源约束动态调整参数规模，从而在不同预算下获得更好的效率与效果平衡。相比传统固定尺寸的参数高效微调方法，LoNAS 更适合在算力有限的场景中使用。该工作为大模型压缩与高效适配提供了实用思路，也呼应了剪枝与稀疏化方向对“更省资源”的核心需求。
classic:8379f22cad69.tldr: LoNAS 通过弹性低秩适配器，让大语言模型能在不同资源预算下更高效地微调与部署。
