However, standard one-shot distillation methods often produce suboptimal results due to a mismatch between teacher-generated rationales and the student's specific learning requirements. In this paper, we introduce the UNDO: UNderstanding Distillation as Optimization framework, designed to bridge this gap by iteratively identifying the student's errors and prompting the teacher to refine its explanations accordingly. Each iteration directly targets the student's learning deficiencies, motivating the teacher to provide tailored and enhanced rationales that specifically address these weaknesses. Empirical evaluations on various challenging mathematical and commonsense reasoning tasks demonstrate that our iterative distillation method, UNDO, significantly outperforms standard one-step distillation methods, achieving performance gains of up to 20%. Additionally, we show that teacher-generated data refined through our iterative process remains effective even when applied to different student models, underscoring the broad applicability of our approach. Our work fundamentally reframes knowledge distillation as an iterative teacher-student interaction, effectively leveraging dynamic refinement by the teacher for better knowledge distillation.
classic:d4d9ae43cdb1.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注知识蒸馏中一个常见问题：教师模型一次性生成的解释，往往和学生模型真正缺失的能力不完全匹配，导致蒸馏效果不理想。作者提出 UNDO 框架，把蒸馏重新理解为一个迭代优化过程：先识别学生的错误和薄弱点，再提示教师针对这些缺陷改写和细化解释。这样得到的训练数据更贴合学生的学习需求，能够持续修正偏差并提升学习效率。实验表明，UNDO 在数学推理和常识推理任务上都显著优于传统单轮蒸馏，最高提升可达 20%。
classic:d4d9ae43cdb1.tldr: UNDO 通过“先找学生错在哪，再让教师定向改讲解”的迭代蒸馏方式，显著提升了小模型的学习效果。
classic:d4d9ae43cdb1.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把知识蒸馏从“老师直接教”提升为“师生反复对齐”的优化过程，解释了为什么很多蒸馏方法效果不稳定。它也提供了一个很实用的思路：先诊断学生的不足，再定制教师输出，让蒸馏更像真正有效的教学。

classic:596fc96dccb9.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注知识蒸馏中的效率问题，即如何在尽量保留大模型能力的同时，显著降低训练和部署成本。作者提出了一种基于低秩克隆（Low-Rank Clone）的蒸馏方法，通过更紧凑的参数化方式来传递和重用知识。相比传统需要大量 token 参与的蒸馏过程，该方法强调用更少的“token/表示”获得更高的信息密度。它的价值在于为高效蒸馏提供了一种更轻量、可能更易扩展的思路。
classic:596fc96dccb9.tldr: 用低秩克隆实现高效知识蒸馏，让更少的表示承载更多知识。
classic:596fc96dccb9.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直面蒸馏里“如何更省、更快”的核心问题，并给出一个名字很有辨识度的效率方案。对于关注模型压缩、低成本部署和蒸馏方法设计的人来说，它是一个很有参考价值的经典候选。

classic:5eb4ac966a83.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance in following natural language instructions to solve unseen tasks. However, it remains unclear whether models truly understand task definitions and whether the human-written definitions are optimal. In this paper, we systematically study the role of task definitions in instruction learning. We first conduct an ablation analysis informed by human annotations to understand which parts of a task definition are most important, and find that model performance only drops substantially when removing contents describing the task output, in particular label information. Next, we propose an automatic algorithm to compress task definitions to a minimal supporting set of tokens, and find that 60\% of tokens can be removed while maintaining or even improving model performance. Based on these results, we propose two strategies to help models better leverage task instructions: (1) providing only key information for tasks in a common structured format, and (2) adding a meta-tuning stage to help the model better understand the definitions. With these two strategies, we achieve a 4.2 Rouge-L improvement over 119 unseen test tasks.
classic:5eb4ac966a83.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究大语言模型在指令学习中到底有多依赖任务定义，并系统分析了任务定义中哪些部分最关键。作者通过消融实验发现，模型性能真正明显下降的主要是删除了与任务输出相关的内容，尤其是标签信息。随后，他们提出一种自动压缩任务定义的方法，结果表明可以删去约 60% 的词而不影响甚至提升性能。基于这些发现，论文进一步提出结构化呈现关键指令信息和加入元微调两种策略，在未见任务上取得了更好的效果。
classic:5eb4ac966a83.tldr: 研究发现任务定义里最关键的是输出和标签信息，压缩后仍能保持甚至提升指令学习效果。
classic:5eb4ac966a83.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接挑战了“越完整的任务定义越好”这一常见假设，给出了更高效的指令设计思路。作为经典参考，它能帮助读者理解如何用更少的提示信息，让模型更好地学会新任务。

classic:e9f6c70f08c8.abstract: Performing inference on large volumes of samples with large language models (LLMs) can be computationally and financially costly in industry and real-world use. We propose batch prompting, a simple yet effective prompting approach that enables the LLM to run inference in batches, instead of one sample at a time. Our method reduces both token and time costs while retaining downstream performance. We theoretically demonstrate that under a few-shot in-context learning setting, the inference costs decrease almost inverse linearly with the number of samples in each batch. We extensively validate the effectiveness of batch prompting on ten datasets across commonsense QA, arithmetic reasoning, and NLI/NLU: batch prompting significantly~(up to 5x with six samples in batch) reduces the LLM (Codex) inference token and time costs while achieving better or comparable performance. For state-of-the-art Chat-based LLMs, e.g., GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, we show the benefits of batch prompting also hold. Further analysis shows that the number of samples in each batch and the complexity of tasks affect its performance. Moreover, batch prompting can be applied across different reasoning methods using LLMs. Our code can be found at the site https://github.com/xlang-ai/batch-prompting.
classic:e9f6c70f08c8.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是大语言模型在大规模推理时成本高、速度慢的问题。作者提出了一种简单有效的 batch prompting 方法，把多个样本打包到一次提示中一起推理，而不是逐条处理。理论分析表明，在少样本上下文学习场景下，推理成本会随着 batch 大小近似反比下降。实验覆盖常识问答、算术推理和自然语言推理等 10 个数据集，结果显示该方法能显著降低 token 和时间成本，同时保持甚至提升效果。
classic:e9f6c70f08c8.tldr: Batch prompting 让大模型一次处理多个样本，大幅降低推理的 token 和时间成本，同时性能不降反升。
classic:e9f6c70f08c8.simple_intro: 这篇论文很值得看，因为它解决的是大模型落地时最现实的成本问题，而方法本身又非常简单实用。作为经典参考，它能帮助你理解如何在不改模型的前提下提升 LLM API 推理效率。

classic:b79895de9b9a.abstract: Transformer-based language models (LMs) are powerful and widely-applicable tools, but their usefulness is constrained by a finite context window and the expensive computational cost of processing long text documents. We propose to adapt pre-trained LMs into AutoCompressors. These language models are capable of compressing long contexts into compact summary vectors, which are then accessible to the model as soft prompts. Summary vectors are trained with an unsupervised objective, whereby long documents are processed in segments, and summary vectors from all previous segments are used in language modeling. We fine-tune OPT and Llama-2 models on sequences of up to 30,720 tokens and show that AutoCompressors can utilize long contexts to improve perplexity. We evaluate AutoCompressors on in-context learning by compressing task demonstrations and find that summary vectors are good substitutes for plain-text demonstrations, increasing accuracy while reducing inference costs. Finally, we explore the benefits of pre-computing summary vectors for large corpora by applying summary vectors to retrievalaugmented language modeling and a passage re-ranking task. Overall, AutoCompressors emerge as a simple and inexpensive solution to extend the context window of LMs while speeding up inference over long contexts.
classic:b79895de9b9a.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对语言模型上下文窗口有限、长文本推理成本高的问题，提出将预训练语言模型改造成 AutoCompressor。方法上，它把长文档分段处理，并用前面片段的摘要向量作为软提示参与后续建模，从而在无监督目标下学习压缩上下文。作者在 OPT 和 Llama-2 上进行了最长 30,720 token 的微调，证明这种方式能更好利用长上下文、降低困惑度。实验还表明，摘要向量可替代部分文本示例用于 in-context learning，并能用于检索增强建模和重排序，兼顾效果与效率。
classic:b79895de9b9a.tldr: 把长上下文压成可复用的摘要向量，让语言模型更省算力地处理长文本并提升效果。
classic:b79895de9b9a.simple_intro: 这篇论文的价值在于，它用很直接的方法解决了大模型“看得长但看得贵”的核心矛盾。作为经典参考，它很适合想了解长上下文压缩、软提示和高效推理的人阅读。

classic:310efdeb39c5.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they face challenges in managing long documents and extended conversations, due to significantly increased computational requirements, both in memory and inference time, and potential context truncation when the input exceeds the LLM's fixed context length. This paper proposes a method called Selective Context that enhances the inference efficiency of LLMs by identifying and pruning redundancy in the input context to make the input more compact. We test our approach using common data sources requiring long context processing: arXiv papers, news articles, and long conversations, on tasks of summarisation, question answering, and response generation. Experimental results show that Selective Context significantly reduces memory cost and decreases generation latency while maintaining comparable performance compared to that achieved when full context is used. Specifically, we achieve a 50\% reduction in context cost, resulting in a 36\% reduction in inference memory usage and a 32\% reduction in inference time, while observing only a minor drop of .023 in BERTscore and .038 in faithfulness on four downstream applications, indicating that our method strikes a good balance between efficiency and performance.
classic:310efdeb39c5.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于大语言模型在长文档和长对话推理时计算开销大、延迟高以及上下文截断的问题。作者提出 Selective Context 方法，通过识别并删减输入上下文中的冗余信息，让输入更紧凑。该方法在摘要、问答和回复生成等任务上进行验证，能够显著降低显存和推理时间，同时保持接近原始上下文的效果。实验表明，它在效率和性能之间取得了很好的平衡，具有较强的实用价值。
classic:310efdeb39c5.tldr: Selective Context 通过压缩冗余上下文，显著降低大语言模型长文本推理的显存和时间开销，同时尽量保持性能。
classic:310efdeb39c5.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了大模型处理长上下文时最常见也最实际的效率瓶颈。作为经典参考，它展示了“少用上下文但不明显掉效果”的一种实用思路。

classic:f9bb42c8b26d.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been applied in various applications due to their astonishing capabilities. With advancements in technologies such as chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and in-context learning (ICL), the prompts fed to LLMs are becoming increasingly lengthy, even exceeding tens of thousands of tokens. To accelerate model inference and reduce cost, this paper presents LLMLingua, a coarse-to-fine prompt compression method that involves a budget controller to maintain semantic integrity under high compression ratios, a token-level iterative compression algorithm to better model the interdependence between compressed contents, and an instruction tuning based method for distribution alignment between language models. We conduct experiments and analysis over four datasets from different scenarios, i.e., GSM8K, BBH, ShareGPT, and Arxiv-March23; showing that the proposed approach yields state-of-the-art performance and allows for up to 20x compression with little performance loss. Our code is available at https://aka.ms/LLMLingua.
classic:f9bb42c8b26d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理时提示词越来越长、导致计算成本高和速度变慢的问题。作者提出了 LLMLingua，一种从粗到细的提示压缩方法，通过预算控制器保持语义完整性，并用迭代式 token 级压缩更好地保留关键信息。论文还结合指令微调来缩小压缩前后分布差异，从而提升压缩效果。实验表明，该方法在多个任务上能实现最高约 20 倍压缩，同时只带来很小的性能损失。
classic:f9bb42c8b26d.tldr: LLMLingua 通过智能压缩提示词，大幅降低大模型推理成本，同时尽量保持原有效果。
classic:f9bb42c8b26d.simple_intro: 这篇论文是理解“如何让大模型更省钱、更快运行”的经典参考。它把提示压缩做成了一个系统性方法，兼顾压缩率和语义保真，适合关注高效推理和提示工程的人阅读。

classic:c34228f7c9e6.abstract: Deep generative modeling of natural languages has achieved many successes, such as producing fluent sentences and translating from one language into another. However, the development of generative modeling techniques for paraphrase generation still lags behind largely due to the challenges in addressing the complex conflicts between expression diversity and semantic preservation. This paper proposes to generate diverse and high-quality paraphrases by exploiting the pre-trained models with instance-dependent prompts. To learn generalizable prompts, we assume that the number of abstract transforming patterns of paraphrase generation (governed by prompts) is finite and usually not large. Therefore, we present vector-quantized prompts as the cues to control the generation of pre-trained models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves new state-of-art results on three benchmark datasets, including Quora, Wikianswers, and MSCOCO. We will release all the code upon acceptance.
classic:c34228f7c9e6.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注改写生成中的核心难题：既要保持原意不变，又要尽量生成多样且自然的表达。作者提出了一种基于实例依赖提示词的生成方法，并用向量量化提示（vector-quantized prompts）来学习可泛化的控制信号，假设改写模式是有限的。这样做可以把复杂的改写变化压缩为一组离散提示，从而更有效地引导预训练模型生成高质量同义改写。实验表明，该方法在 Quora、Wikianswers 和 MSCOCO 等基准上取得了新的最优结果。
classic:c34228f7c9e6.tldr: 用向量量化提示学习来控制预训练模型，实现更高质量、更丰富的句子改写生成。
classic:c34228f7c9e6.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合想了解“提示学习”如何用于文本生成控制的读者，尤其是改写生成这一类兼顾语义保持与表达多样性的任务。它是将离散表示、实例条件提示和预训练生成模型结合起来的一个有代表性的经典工作。

classic:61183430df2d.abstract: The primary way of building AI applications is shifting from training specialist models to prompting generalist models. A common practice for prompting generalist models, often referred to as in-context learning, is to append a few examples (demonstrations) to the prompt to help the model better understand the task. While effective, in-context learning can be inefficient because it makes the input prompt much longer, consuming valuable space in the context window and leading to larger computational costs. In this paper, we propose DynaICL, a recipe for efficient prompting with black-box generalist models that dynamically allocate in-context examples according to the input complexity and the computational budget. To achieve this, we train a meta controller that predicts the number of in-context examples suitable for the generalist model to make a good prediction based on the performance-efficiency trade-off for a specific input. We then dynamically allocate the number of demonstrations for an input according to predictions from the meta controller and the given computation budget. Experimental results show that dynamic example allocation helps achieve a better performance-efficiency trade-off in two practical settings where computational resources or the required performance is constrained. Specifically, DynaICL saves up to 46% token budget compared to the common practice that allocates the same number of in-context examples to each input. We also find that a meta controller trained on a certain backbone model and tasks can successfully generalize to unseen models and tasks.
classic:61183430df2d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大模型提示中的一个实际问题：传统的 in-context learning 往往给每个输入固定加入相同数量的示例，虽然有效，但会显著增加上下文长度和计算成本。作者提出 DynaICL，根据输入复杂度和计算预算动态分配示例数量，用一个元控制器预测当前输入更合适的示例数。这样可以在性能和效率之间取得更好的平衡，尤其适用于算力受限或性能要求明确的场景。实验表明，该方法最多可节省 46% 的 token 预算，并且具有一定的跨模型、跨任务泛化能力。
classic:61183430df2d.tldr: DynaICL 通过按需动态分配示例数量，让 in-context learning 在更少 token 开销下保持更好的效果。
classic:61183430df2d.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为高效提示学习的经典参考，因为它直接解决了“示例加多少才合适”这一实际问题。它把经验性的固定提示，提升为可根据输入和预算自适应的策略，思路简洁且很实用。

classic:0395c36014f7.abstract: Prompting is the primary way to utilize the multitask capabilities of language models (LMs), but prompts occupy valuable space in the input context window, and repeatedly encoding the same prompt is computationally inefficient. Finetuning and distillation methods allow for specialization of LMs without prompting, but require retraining the model for each task. To avoid this trade-off entirely, we present gisting, which trains an LM to compress prompts into smaller sets of "gist" tokens which can be cached and reused for compute efficiency. Gist models can be trained with no additional cost over standard instruction finetuning by simply modifying Transformer attention masks to encourage prompt compression. On decoder (LLaMA-7B) and encoder-decoder (FLAN-T5-XXL) LMs, gisting enables up to 26x compression of prompts, resulting in up to 40% FLOPs reductions, 4.2% wall time speedups, and storage savings, all with minimal loss in output quality.
classic:0395c36014f7.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在使用提示词时的两个痛点：提示词占用上下文窗口，而且每次重复编码同一提示都会带来额外计算开销。作者提出 gisting 方法，把长提示压缩成更短的 gist tokens，并且这些压缩后的表示可以缓存和复用，从而提高推理效率。该方法不需要像微调或蒸馏那样为每个任务重新训练模型，只需通过修改 Transformer 的注意力掩码即可训练。实验表明，在 LLaMA-7B 和 FLAN-T5-XXL 上，gisting 可实现最高 26 倍压缩，并带来 FLOPs、运行时间和存储方面的明显节省，同时输出质量损失很小。
classic:0395c36014f7.tldr: 把长提示压成可复用的 gist tokens，在几乎不损失效果的前提下显著降低推理开销。
classic:0395c36014f7.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“提示词太长、重复计算太贵”这个实际问题，转化成了一个可训练、可缓存的压缩方案。作为高效提示领域的经典工作，它提供了一个兼顾通用性和计算效率的新思路。

classic:44e726a57e48.abstract: We propose the In-context Autoencoder (ICAE), leveraging the power of a large language model (LLM) to compress a long context into short compact memory slots that can be directly conditioned on by the LLM for various purposes. ICAE is first pretrained using both autoencoding and language modeling objectives on massive text data, enabling it to generate memory slots that accurately and comprehensively represent the original context. Then, it is fine-tuned on instruction data for producing desirable responses to various prompts. Experiments demonstrate that our lightweight ICAE, introducing about 1% additional parameters, effectively achieves $4\times$ context compression based on Llama, offering advantages in both improved latency and GPU memory cost during inference, and showing an interesting insight in memorization as well as potential for scalability. These promising results imply a novel perspective on the connection between working memory in cognitive science and representation learning in LLMs, revealing ICAE's significant implications in addressing the long context problem and suggesting further research in LLM context management. Our data, code and models are available at https://github.com/getao/icae.
classic:44e726a57e48.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在长上下文场景中的效率与成本问题，提出了一种名为 In-context Autoencoder（ICAE）的上下文压缩方法。ICAE 利用大模型把长文本压缩成少量紧凑的 memory slots，并让模型可以直接基于这些槽位继续推理与生成。作者先用自编码和语言建模目标进行预训练，再在指令数据上微调，以适应不同任务需求。实验表明，该方法只引入约 1% 的额外参数，就能在 Llama 基础上实现约 4 倍上下文压缩，同时降低推理延迟和显存开销。
classic:44e726a57e48.tldr: ICAE 用极少额外参数把长上下文压缩成可直接使用的记忆槽位，在提升长文本处理效率的同时减少推理成本。
classic:44e726a57e48.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它从“上下文压缩”角度为长上下文问题提供了一个很实用的解决思路，而且开销很小。它也把 LLM 的记忆机制和认知科学中的工作记忆联系起来，是理解高效提示与上下文管理的经典参考。

classic:2af77741976f.abstract: Compressed prompts aid instruction-tuned language models (LMs) in overcoming context window limitations and reducing computational costs. Existing methods, which primarily based on training embeddings, face various challenges associated with interpretability, the fixed number of embedding tokens, reusability across different LMs, and inapplicability when interacting with black-box APIs. This study proposes prompt compression with reinforcement learning (PCRL), which is a discrete prompt compression method that addresses these issues. The proposed PCRL method utilizes a computationally efficient policy network that edits prompts directly. The training approach employed in the proposed PCRLs can be applied flexibly to various types of LMs, including both decoder-only and encoder-decoder architecture and it can be trained without gradient access to the LMs or labeled data. The proposed PCRL achieves an average reduction of 24.6% in terms of the token count across various instruction prompts while maintaining sufficient performance. In addition, we demonstrate that the learned policy can be transferred to larger LMs, and through a comprehensive analysis, we explore the token importance within the prompts. Our code is accessible at https://github.com/nenomigami/PromptCompressor.
classic:2af77741976f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注提示词过长带来的上下文窗口限制和计算成本问题，目标是在尽量不损失性能的前提下压缩提示词。作者提出了一种基于强化学习的离散提示压缩方法 PCRL，直接对提示词进行编辑，而不是依赖嵌入训练。该方法不需要访问模型梯度，也不依赖标注数据，因此可以灵活应用于不同类型的语言模型，包括黑盒 API。实验表明，PCRL 在多种指令提示上平均可减少 24.6% 的 token 数，同时保持较好的效果。
classic:2af77741976f.tldr: 用强化学习直接编辑提示词，实现无需梯度、可迁移的离散压缩，并在保持性能的同时显著减少 token。
classic:2af77741976f.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为经典参考，因为它把“提示压缩”从连续嵌入方法推进到了更实用的离散编辑方案。对于需要处理长提示、黑盒模型或受限算力场景的研究和应用都很有参考价值。

classic:b7507e16ab1c.abstract: As the ever-increasing token limits of large language models (LLMs) have enabled long context as input, prompting with single data samples might no longer an efficient way. A straightforward strategy improving efficiency is to batch data within the token limit (e.g., 8k for gpt-3.5-turbo; 32k for GPT-4), which we call BatchPrompt. We have two initial observations for prompting with batched data. First, we find that prompting with batched data in longer contexts will inevitably lead to worse performance, compared to single-data prompting. Second, the performance of the language model is significantly correlated with the positions and order of the batched data, due to the corresponding change in decoder context. To retain efficiency and overcome performance loss, we propose Batch Permutation and Ensembling (BPE), and a novel Self-reflection-guided EArly Stopping (SEAS) technique. Our comprehensive experimental evaluation demonstrates that BPE can boost the performance of BatchPrompt with a striking margin on a range of popular NLP tasks, including question answering (Boolq), textual entailment (RTE), and duplicate questions identification (QQP). These performances are even competitive with/higher than single-data prompting(SinglePrompt), while BatchPrompt requires much fewer LLM calls and input tokens (For SinglePrompt v.s. BatchPrompt with batch size 32, using just 9%-16% the number of LLM calls, Boolq accuracy 90.6% to 90.9% with 27.4% tokens, QQP accuracy 87.2% to 88.4% with 18.6% tokens, RTE accuracy 91.5% to 91.1% with 30.8% tokens). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to technically improve prompting efficiency of large language models. We hope our simple yet effective approach will shed light on the future research of large language models. The co…
classic:b7507e16ab1c.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型提示词使用中的效率问题：当上下文窗口越来越长时，逐条样本单独提示会带来较高的调用成本。作者提出 BatchPrompt，将多个数据样本打包在一个上下文中进行提示，以减少 LLM 调用次数和输入 token。论文进一步发现，批量提示的效果会受到样本顺序和位置影响，因此提出 Batch Permutation and Ensembling（BPE）以及自反思引导的早停方法 SEAS 来缓解性能下降。实验表明，这些方法在 BoolQ、RTE、QQP 等任务上能以更少资源达到与单样本提示相当甚至更好的效果。
classic:b7507e16ab1c.tldr: BatchPrompt 通过批量提示、样本排列集成和早停策略，让大模型在更少调用和 token 下保持甚至提升性能。
classic:b7507e16ab1c.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接回应了长上下文时代的一个现实问题：如何更省钱、更高效地用好大模型。它提出的方法简单但实用，适合作为理解高效提示设计的经典参考。

classic:77d064915057.abstract: Compressing Large Language Models (LLMs) often leads to reduced performance, especially for knowledge-intensive tasks. In this work, we dive into how compression damages LLMs' inherent knowledge and the possible remedies. We start by proposing two conjectures on the nature of the damage: one is certain knowledge being forgotten (or erased) after LLM compression, hence necessitating the compressed model to (re)learn from data with additional parameters; the other presumes that knowledge is internally displaced and hence one requires merely "inference re-direction" with input-side augmentation such as prompting, to recover the knowledge-related performance. Extensive experiments are then designed to (in)validate the two conjectures. We observe the promise of prompting in comparison to model tuning; we further unlock prompting's potential by introducing a variant called Inference-time Dynamic Prompting (IDP), that can effectively increase prompt diversity without incurring any inference overhead. Our experiments consistently suggest that compared to the classical re-training alternatives such as LoRA, prompting with IDP leads to better or comparable post-compression performance recovery, while saving the extra parameter size by 21x and reducing inference latency by 60%. Our experiments hence strongly endorse the conjecture of "knowledge displaced" over "knowledge forgotten", and shed light on a new efficient mechanism to restore compressed LLM performance. We additionally visualize and analyze the different attention and activation patterns between prompted and re-trained models, demonstrating they achieve performance recovery in two different regimes.
classic:77d064915057.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了大语言模型压缩后性能下降的问题，尤其是在知识密集型任务上为何会退化。作者提出两种解释：一种是压缩让知识被“遗忘”了，需要重新训练来补回；另一种是知识没有消失，而是被“错位”了，只需通过输入侧提示进行重新引导即可恢复。基于大量实验，论文发现提示工程，尤其是推理时动态提示（IDP），在恢复压缩模型性能上往往优于或不弱于 LoRA 等重训练方法。与此同时，它还能显著减少额外参数和推理开销，为压缩模型的高效修复提供了新的思路。
classic:77d064915057.tldr: 压缩 LLM 退化后，不一定要重训，用动态 prompting 往往就能高效恢复性能。
classic:77d064915057.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“压缩后怎么修复模型”这个问题，转化成了一个很实用的提示设计问题。它也很适合作为经典参考，帮助理解 prompting 在高效恢复压缩模型能力方面的潜力。

classic:4d111a5fac4d.abstract: Retrieving documents and prepending them in-context at inference time improves performance of language model (LMs) on a wide range of tasks. However, these documents, often spanning hundreds of words, make inference substantially more expensive. We propose compressing the retrieved documents into textual summaries prior to in-context integration. This not only reduces the computational costs but also relieves the burden of LMs to identify relevant information in long retrieved documents. We present two compressors -- an extractive compressor which selects useful sentences from retrieved documents and an abstractive compressor which generates summaries by synthesizing information from multiple documents. Both compressors are trained to improve LMs' performance on end tasks when the generated summaries are prepended to the LMs' input, while keeping the summary concise.If the retrieved documents are irrelevant to the input or offer no additional information to LM, our compressor can return an empty string, implementing selective augmentation.We evaluate our approach on language modeling task and open domain question answering task. We achieve a compression rate of as low as 6% with minimal loss in performance for both tasks, significantly outperforming the off-the-shelf summarization models. We show that our compressors trained for one LM can transfer to other LMs on the language modeling task and provide summaries largely faithful to the retrieved documents.
classic:4d111a5fac4d.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注检索增强语言模型在推理时的一个核心问题：直接把检索到的长文档拼接进上下文，虽然能提升效果，但计算开销很大，也增加了模型从冗长材料中筛选关键信息的难度。作者提出在注入上下文之前先对检索结果做压缩，设计了两种压缩器：一种通过抽取关键句子进行压缩，另一种通过跨文档生成摘要进行压缩。除此之外，方法还支持“选择性增强”：当检索内容无关或没有额外价值时，可以直接返回空字符串，避免无效注入。实验表明，在极低压缩率下仍能保持接近原始性能，并且优于通用摘要模型，体现了高效检索增强的实用价值。
classic:4d111a5fac4d.tldr: 先把检索到的长文档压缩成短摘要，再决定是否注入上下文，从而显著降低检索增强推理成本。
classic:4d111a5fac4d.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合想了解“如何让检索增强更省算力”的读者，因为它直接解决了长上下文带来的效率瓶颈。作为经典参考，它展示了压缩、摘要和选择性增强如何结合起来，兼顾效果与成本。

classic:a66fc4a4a281.abstract: In long context scenarios, large language models (LLMs) face three main challenges: higher computational cost, performance reduction, and position bias. Research indicates that LLM performance hinges on the density and position of key information in the input prompt. Inspired by these findings, we propose LongLLMLingua for prompt compression towards improving LLMs' perception of the key information to simultaneously address the three challenges. Our extensive evaluation across various long context scenarios demonstrates that LongLLMLingua not only enhances performance but also significantly reduces costs and latency. For instance, in the NaturalQuestions benchmark, LongLLMLingua boosts performance by up to 21.4% with around 4x fewer tokens in GPT-3.5-Turbo, leading to substantial cost savings. It achieves a 94.0% cost reduction in the LooGLE benchmark. Moreover, when compressing prompts of about 10k tokens at ratios of 2x-6x, LongLLMLingua can accelerate end-to-end latency by 1.4x-2.6x. Our code is available at https://aka.ms/LongLLMLingua.
classic:a66fc4a4a281.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注长上下文场景下大语言模型面临的三个核心问题：计算成本高、性能下降以及位置偏置。作者提出 LongLLMLingua，一种面向提示词压缩的方法，通过提升模型对关键信息的感知来保留任务所需内容、削减冗余输入。该方法不仅能减少 token 数量和推理延迟，还能在多项长文本基准上提升效果。实验表明，它在大幅降本的同时，往往还能带来更好的回答质量，具有很强的实用价值。
classic:a66fc4a4a281.tldr: LongLLMLingua 用提示词压缩同时降低长上下文推理成本、缓解位置偏置，并提升 LLM 表现。
classic:a66fc4a4a281.simple_intro: 这是长上下文 LLM 优化领域很有代表性的经典工作，解决的是“又长又贵又不准”的实际痛点。它适合作为理解提示压缩、长文本推理加速与信息保留策略的入门参考。

classic:20e005cf0dec.abstract: Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) often impose limitations on the length of the text input to ensure the generation of fluent and relevant responses. This constraint restricts their applicability in scenarios involving long texts. We propose a novel semantic compression method that enables generalization to texts that are 6-8 times longer, without incurring significant computational costs or requiring fine-tuning. Our proposed framework draws inspiration from source coding in information theory and employs a pre-trained model to reduce the semantic redundancy of long inputs before passing them to the LLMs for downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively extends the context window of LLMs across a range of tasks including question answering, summarization, few-shot learning, and information retrieval. Furthermore, the proposed semantic compression method exhibits consistent fluency in text generation while reducing the associated computational overhead.
classic:20e005cf0dec.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型上下文长度受限的问题，指出长文本输入会带来计算开销和信息利用不足。作者提出一种语义压缩方法，在不需要微调的情况下，先用预训练模型压缩长输入中的语义冗余，再交给LLM处理下游任务。该方法借鉴信息论中的源编码思想，可以将可处理文本长度扩展到原来的6到8倍。实验表明，它在问答、摘要、少样本学习和信息检索等任务中都能保持较好的效果，并降低计算成本。
classic:20e005cf0dec.tldr: 用语义压缩先“瘦身”长文本，再送入LLM处理，从而把上下文窗口扩展到原来的6到8倍。
classic:20e005cf0dec.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为长上下文处理的经典参考，因为它给出了一个不依赖微调、成本较低的通用扩窗思路。它把信息论思想引入LLM输入压缩，思路简洁，适用面也比较广。

classic:821e09d6d30a.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities, yet they still struggle with math reasoning. In this work, we propose CoT-Influx, a novel approach that pushes the boundary of few-shot Chain-of-Thoughts (CoT) learning to improve LLM mathematical reasoning. Motivated by the observation that adding more concise CoT examples in the prompt can improve LLM reasoning performance, CoT-Influx employs a coarse-to-fine pruner to maximize the input of effective and concise CoT examples. The pruner first selects as many crucial CoT examples as possible and then prunes unimportant tokens to fit the context window. A math reasoning dataset with diverse difficulty levels and reasoning steps is used to train the pruner, along with a math-specialized reinforcement learning approach. As a result, by enabling more CoT examples with double the context window size in tokens, CoT-Influx significantly outperforms various prompting baselines across various LLMs (LLaMA2-7B, 13B, 70B) and 5 math datasets, achieving up to 4.55% absolute improvements. Remarkably, without any fine-tuning, LLaMA2-70B with CoT-Influx surpasses GPT-3.5 and a wide range of larger LLMs (PaLM, Minerva 540B, etc.) on the GSM8K. CoT-Influx serves as a plug-and-play module for LLMs and is compatible with most existing reasoning prompting techniques, such as self-consistency and self-verification.
classic:821e09d6d30a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在数学推理上仍然容易出错的问题，尤其是在少样本链式思维提示中，如何在有限上下文窗口里塞进更有效的示例。作者提出 CoT-Influx，一个粗到细的上下文剪枝方法：先尽量保留关键的 CoT 示例，再裁掉无关 token，以容纳更多高质量推理例子。为训练这个剪枝器，论文结合了不同难度的数学推理数据和面向数学任务的强化学习。实验表明，它能在多个模型和数学数据集上稳定提升表现，且作为即插即用模块可与 self-consistency、self-verification 等方法兼容。
classic:821e09d6d30a.tldr: CoT-Influx 通过强化学习驱动的上下文剪枝，让提示词中塞进更多高质量推理示例，从而显著提升 LLM 数学推理能力。
classic:821e09d6d30a.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于，它把“提示词不是越长越好”这件事做成了一个可训练、可复用的方法。对于想提升 LLM 推理效果、又受上下文长度限制的场景，它是一个很有代表性的经典参考。

classic:455c4a4af1e9.abstract: Chain of Thought (CoT) is significant in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs). However, the correlation between the effectiveness of CoT and the length of reasoning steps in prompts remains largely unknown. To shed light on this, we have conducted several empirical experiments to explore the relations. Specifically, we design experiments that expand and compress the rationale reasoning steps within CoT demonstrations while keeping all other factors constant. We have the following key findings. First, the results indicate that lengthening the reasoning steps in prompts, even without adding new information into the prompt, considerably enhances LLMs' reasoning abilities across multiple datasets. Alternatively, shortening the reasoning steps, even while preserving the key information, significantly diminishes the reasoning abilities of models. This finding highlights the importance of the number of steps in CoT prompts and provides practical guidance to make better use of LLMs' potential in complex problem-solving scenarios. Second, we also investigated the relationship between the performance of CoT and the rationales used in demonstrations. Surprisingly, the result shows that even incorrect rationales can yield favorable outcomes if they maintain the requisite length of inference. Third, we observed that the advantages of increasing reasoning steps are task-dependent: simpler tasks require fewer steps, whereas complex tasks gain significantly from longer inference sequences. The code is available at https://github.com/MingyuJ666/The-Impact-of-Reasoning-Step-Length-on-Large-Language-Models
classic:455c4a4af1e9.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了 Chain of Thought（CoT）提示中“推理步骤长度”对大语言模型推理能力的影响。作者通过扩展和压缩示例中的推理步骤，在保持其他条件不变的情况下做了一系列实验。结果表明，增加推理步骤数量即使不引入新信息，也能显著提升模型在多个数据集上的表现；而缩短步骤则会明显削弱推理能力。论文还发现，这种收益具有任务依赖性，复杂任务通常更需要更长的推理链。
classic:455c4a4af1e9.tldr: CoT 不只是“有没有”，还很看“推理步骤有多长”：更长的步骤往往能显著提升大模型推理效果。
classic:455c4a4af1e9.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为 CoT 提示研究的经典参考，因为它把“推理长度”这个容易被忽视的因素单独拎出来做了系统分析。它给出的结论对如何设计更有效的提示模板很有实践价值。

classic:b12319933c42.abstract: This paper presents a context key/value compression method for Transformer language models in online scenarios, where the context continually expands. As the context lengthens, the attention process demands increasing memory and computations, which in turn reduces the throughput of the language model. To address this challenge, we propose a compressed context memory system that continually compresses the accumulating attention key/value pairs into a compact memory space, facilitating language model inference in a limited memory space of computing environments. Our compression process involves integrating a lightweight conditional LoRA into the language model's forward pass during inference, without the need for fine-tuning the model's entire set of weights. We achieve efficient training by modeling the recursive compression process as a single parallelized forward computation. Through evaluations on conversation, personalization, and multi-task learning, we demonstrate that our approach achieves the performance level of a full context model with $5\times$ smaller context memory size. We further demonstrate the applicability of our approach in a streaming setting with an unlimited context length, outperforming the sliding window approach. Codes are available at https://github.com/snu-mllab/context-memory.
classic:b12319933c42.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注在线语言模型交互中的一个核心问题：上下文不断增长时，Transformer 的注意力键值缓存会占用越来越多内存，并显著拖慢推理速度。作者提出一种压缩上下文记忆的方法，把不断累积的 key/value 对递归压缩到紧凑的记忆空间中，从而在有限计算资源下保持高效推理。方法上，他们在推理过程中引入轻量级的 conditional LoRA，不需要对整个模型重新微调。实验表明，该方法在对话、个性化和多任务场景下能以约 5 倍更小的上下文内存达到接近完整上下文模型的表现，并且在无限长度流式设置中优于滑动窗口方案。
classic:b12319933c42.tldr: 提出一种在线上下文压缩记忆机制，在不重训整个模型的情况下，将长上下文推理的内存占用降到约 1/5，同时保持接近完整上下文的效果。
classic:b12319933c42.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了长对话和流式输入中“上下文越长越慢、越占内存”的实际痛点。作为 Efficient Prompting 方向的经典参考，它提供了一个兼顾效果与效率的可落地思路。

classic:182ac599f567.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are great at processing multiple natural language processing tasks, but their abilities are constrained by inferior performance with long context, slow inference speed, and the high cost of computing the results. Deploying LLMs with precise and informative context helps users process large-scale datasets more effectively and cost-efficiently. Existing works rely on compressing long prompt contexts into soft prompts. However, soft prompt compression encounters limitations in transferability across different LLMs, especially API-based LLMs. To this end, this work aims to compress lengthy prompts in the form of natural language with LLM transferability. This poses two challenges: (i) Natural Language (NL) prompts are incompatible with back-propagation, and (ii) NL prompts lack flexibility in imposing length constraints. In this work, we propose a Natural Language Prompt Encapsulation (Nano-Capsulator) framework compressing original prompts into NL formatted Capsule Prompt while maintaining the prompt utility and transferability. Specifically, to tackle the first challenge, the Nano-Capsulator is optimized by a reward function that interacts with the proposed semantics preserving loss. To address the second question, the Nano-Capsulator is optimized by a reward function featuring length constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that the Capsule Prompt can reduce 81.4% of the original length, decrease inference latency up to 4.5x, and save 80.1% of budget overheads while providing transferability across diverse LLMs and different datasets.
classic:182ac599f567.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在长上下文场景中面临的计算成本高、推理慢以及上下文过长带来的性能下降问题。作者指出，现有的软提示压缩虽然有效，但跨不同模型尤其是API型大模型的可迁移性较差。为此，论文提出 Nano-Capsulator，将长提示压缩成自然语言形式的 Capsule Prompt，同时尽量保留原始语义和任务效果。实验表明，这种方法可显著缩短提示长度、降低推理延迟，并且具备较好的跨模型迁移能力。
classic:182ac599f567.tldr: 把长提示压缩成可迁移的自然语言短提示，兼顾语义保真、长度约束和推理效率。
classic:182ac599f567.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“提示压缩”从软参数形式推进到更易理解、也更适合跨模型使用的自然语言形式。作为高效提示方向的经典参考，它直接回应了大模型部署中最实际的成本和迁移问题。

classic:7de5dc292ccd.abstract: Chain of Thought (CoT) is significant in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs). However, the correlation between the effectiveness of CoT and the length of reasoning steps in prompts remains largely unknown. To shed light on this, we have conducted several empirical experiments to explore the relations. Specifically, we design experiments that expand and compress the rationale reasoning steps within CoT demonstrations while keeping all other factors constant. We have the following key findings. First, the results indicate that lengthening the reasoning steps in prompts, even without adding new information into the prompt, considerably enhances LLMs' reasoning abilities across multiple datasets. Alternatively, shortening the reasoning steps, even while preserving the key information, significantly diminishes the reasoning abilities of models. This finding highlights the importance of the number of steps in CoT prompts and provides practical guidance to make better use of LLMs' potential in complex problem-solving scenarios. Second, we also investigated the relationship between the performance of CoT and the rationales used in demonstrations. Surprisingly, the result shows that even incorrect rationales can yield favorable outcomes if they maintain the requisite length of inference. Third, we observed that the advantages of increasing reasoning steps are task-dependent: simpler tasks require fewer steps, whereas complex tasks gain significantly from longer inference sequences. The code is available at https://github.com/MingyuJ666/The-Impact-of-Reasoning-Step-Length-on-Large-Language-Models
classic:7de5dc292ccd.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了 Chain of Thought 提示中“推理步骤长度”与大语言模型推理效果之间的关系。作者通过系统地扩展或压缩 CoT 示范中的推理过程，在保持其他条件不变的情况下观察模型表现变化。结果发现，即使不增加新信息，只要推理步骤变长，模型往往会更擅长推理；相反，压缩步骤会明显削弱性能。论文还指出，推理长度的重要性甚至可能大于示范本身是否完全正确，并且这种收益会随任务复杂度而变化。
classic:7de5dc292ccd.tldr: CoT 里“说得更长”常常比“说得更对”更能提升模型推理能力。
classic:7de5dc292ccd.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合想理解提示学习和 CoT 机制的人，因为它直接揭示了“推理长度”对模型表现的真实影响。作为经典参考，它能帮助读者更好地设计少样本提示，并理解为什么有些长链式推理会显著提升大模型效果。

classic:ec23584cdca8.abstract: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with handling dialogues with long contexts due to efficiency and consistency issues. According to our observation, dialogue contexts are highly structured, and the special token of \textit{End-of-Utterance} (EoU) in dialogues has the potential to aggregate information. We refer to the EoU tokens as ``conversational attention sinks'' (conv-attn sinks). Accordingly, we introduce StreamingDialogue, which compresses long dialogue history into conv-attn sinks with minimal losses, and thus reduces computational complexity quadratically with the number of sinks (i.e., the number of utterances). Current LLMs already demonstrate the ability to handle long context window, e.g., a window size of 200K or more. To this end, by compressing utterances into EoUs, our method has the potential to handle more than 200K of utterances, resulting in a prolonged dialogue learning. In order to minimize information losses from reconstruction after compression, we design two learning strategies of short-memory reconstruction (SMR) and long-memory reactivation (LMR). Our method outperforms strong baselines in dialogue tasks and achieves a 4 $\times$ speedup while reducing memory usage by 18 $\times$ compared to dense attention recomputation.
classic:ec23584cdca8.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注长对话在大语言模型中处理效率低、上下文一致性差的问题。作者观察到对话中的 End-of-Utterance（EoU）标记具有聚合信息的作用，因此将其视为“对话注意力汇聚点”，并提出 StreamingDialogue，把长对话历史压缩到这些汇聚点中。为了尽量减少压缩带来的信息损失，论文设计了短记忆重建（SMR）和长记忆再激活（LMR）两种学习策略。实验表明，该方法在对话任务上优于强基线，同时可实现 4 倍加速并将内存占用降低 18 倍。
classic:ec23584cdca8.tldr: StreamingDialogue 利用对话中的 EoU 标记压缩长上下文，实现更长对话建模且几乎不损失效果。
classic:ec23584cdca8.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为长上下文对话压缩方向的经典参考，因为它把“结构化对话”这一先验用得非常直接。它不仅提升了效率，还尽量保持了对话信息的完整性，适合关注长对话、记忆压缩和高效推理的读者。

classic:2d4b441c92c3.abstract: This paper focuses on task-agnostic prompt compression for better generalizability and efficiency. Considering the redundancy in natural language, existing approaches compress prompts by removing tokens or lexical units according to their information entropy obtained from a causal language model such as LLaMa-7B. The challenge is that information entropy may be a suboptimal compression metric: (i) it only leverages unidirectional context and may fail to capture all essential information needed for prompt compression; (ii) it is not aligned with the prompt compression objective. To address these issues, we propose a data distillation procedure to derive knowledge from an LLM to compress prompts without losing crucial information, and meantime, introduce an extractive text compression dataset. We formulate prompt compression as a token classification problem to guarantee the faithfulness of the compressed prompt to the original one, and use a Transformer encoder as the base architecture to capture all essential information for prompt compression from the full bidirectional context. Our approach leads to lower latency by explicitly learning the compression objective with smaller models such as XLM-RoBERTa-large and mBERT. We evaluate our method on both in-domain and out-of-domain datasets, including MeetingBank, LongBench, ZeroScrolls, GSM8K, and BBH. Despite its small size, our model shows significant performance gains over strong baselines and demonstrates robust generalization ability across different LLMs. Additionally, our model is 3x-6x faster than existing prompt compression methods, while accelerating the end-to-end latency by 1.6x-2.9x with compression ratios of 2x-5x. Our code is available at https://aka.ms/LLMLingua-2.
classic:2d4b441c92c3.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究的是与任务无关的提示词压缩，目标是在尽量不丢失关键信息的前提下，让大模型推理更快、更省成本。作者指出，过去常用的信息熵指标主要依赖单向上下文，而且和压缩目标并不完全一致，因此可能不是最优方案。为此，论文提出通过数据蒸馏从大模型中学习压缩知识，并把提示压缩建模为逐 token 分类问题，以更好地保留原始提示中的关键内容。实验表明，该方法不仅在多种数据集上泛化能力强，而且在较小模型上也能获得明显加速和稳定性能提升。
classic:2d4b441c92c3.tldr: LLMLingua-2 通过数据蒸馏和 token 分类实现更快、更忠实、可泛化的提示词压缩。
classic:2d4b441c92c3.simple_intro: 这篇论文很值得看，因为它把“如何压缩提示词”从启发式方法推进到可学习、可泛化的框架。它也是高效提示方向的代表工作之一，兼顾了速度、忠实性和跨任务适用性。

classic:040375eb0753.abstract: Prompt compression is an innovative method for efficiently condensing input prompts while preserving essential information. To facilitate quick-start services, user-friendly interfaces, and compatibility with common datasets and metrics, we present the Prompt Compression Toolkit (PCToolkit). This toolkit is a unified plug-and-play solution for compressing prompts in Large Language Models (LLMs), featuring cutting-edge prompt compressors, diverse datasets, and metrics for comprehensive performance evaluation. PCToolkit boasts a modular design, allowing for easy integration of new datasets and metrics through portable and user-friendly interfaces. In this paper, we outline the key components and functionalities of PCToolkit. We conducted evaluations of the compressors within PCToolkit across various natural language tasks, including reconstruction, summarization, mathematical problem-solving, question answering, few-shot learning, synthetic tasks, code completion, boolean expressions, multiple choice questions, and lies recognition.
classic:040375eb0753.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型中的提示压缩问题，即如何在尽量保留关键信息的前提下缩短输入提示，从而提升效率。作者提出了 PCToolkit，一个统一的即插即用提示压缩工具箱，集成了多种前沿压缩器、常用数据集和评测指标。该工具箱采用模块化设计，便于快速接入新的数据集和指标，降低了研究和应用门槛。论文还在重建、摘要、数学推理、问答、少样本学习等多种任务上对不同压缩器进行了系统评测。
classic:040375eb0753.tldr: PCToolkit 提供了一个统一、可扩展的提示压缩工具箱，帮助研究者和开发者高效评估并应用大语言模型的 prompt compression。
classic:040375eb0753.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把分散的提示压缩方法、数据集和评测方式整合到一个统一框架中，方便复现和比较。对于想研究高效提示、降低推理成本或快速搭建相关实验的人来说，它是一个很实用的经典参考。

classic:f55902e7d82a.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown exceptional abilities for multiple different natural language processing tasks. While prompting is a crucial tool for LLM inference, we observe that there is a significant cost associated with exceedingly lengthy prompts. Existing attempts to compress lengthy prompts lead to substandard results in terms of readability/interpretability of the compressed prompt, with a detrimental impact on prompt utility. To address this, we propose PromptSAW: Prompt compresSion via Relation AWare graphs, an effective strategy for prompt compression over task-agnostic and task-aware prompts. Prompt-SAW uses the prompt's textual information to build a graph and later extracts key information elements in the graph to come up with the compressed prompt. We also propose GSM8K-aug, i.e., an extended version of the existing GSM8K benchmark for task-agnostic prompts in order to provide a comprehensive evaluation platform. Experimental evaluation using benchmark datasets shows that prompts compressed by Prompt-SAW are not only better in terms of readability, but they also outperform the best-performing baseline models by up to 10.1 and 77.1, respectively, for task-agnostic and task-aware settings while compressing the original prompt text by 34.9 and 56.7.
classic:f55902e7d82a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型提示词过长带来的推理成本与效率问题，指出现有提示压缩方法往往会损害压缩结果的可读性和可解释性。作者提出 Prompt-SAW，一种基于关系感知图的提示压缩方法，先将提示文本构建成图，再从图中抽取关键信息生成更短的提示。该方法同时适用于任务无关和任务相关提示，并通过新增的 GSM8K-aug 基准扩展了评测场景。实验表明，Prompt-SAW 在保持压缩率的同时，还能显著优于强基线，兼顾压缩效果与提示可用性。
classic:f55902e7d82a.tldr: Prompt-SAW 用关系感知图压缩长提示词，在提升可读性的同时还能明显优于现有方法。
classic:f55902e7d82a.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注高效提示和长文本压缩的人阅读，因为它直接解决了“提示越长、成本越高”的实际问题。它的经典价值在于把结构化图建模引入提示压缩，并强调压缩后仍要保持可读性和任务效果。

classic:8a8ca71ac79b.abstract: In many modern LLM applications, such as retrieval augmented generation, prompts have become programs themselves. In these settings, prompt programs are repeatedly called with different user queries or data instances. A big practical challenge is optimizing such prompt programs. Recent work has mostly focused on either simple prompt programs or assumed that the general structure of a prompt program is fixed. We introduce SAMMO, a framework to perform symbolic prompt program search for compile-time optimizations of prompt programs. SAMMO represents prompt programs on a symbolic level which allows for a rich set of transformations that can be searched over during optimization. We show that SAMMO generalizes previous methods and improves the performance of complex prompts on (1) instruction tuning, (2) RAG pipeline tuning, and (3) prompt compression, across several different LLMs. We make all code available open-source at https://github.com/microsoft/sammo .
classic:8a8ca71ac79b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注现代大语言模型应用中“提示词本身就是程序”的新问题，尤其是在检索增强生成、指令调优等场景里，提示程序会被反复调用，因此需要高效优化。作者提出 SAMMO 框架，将提示程序表示为符号层结构，并在编译期对可变换的程序结构进行搜索优化。相比只处理简单提示或固定结构的方法，SAMMO 能支持更丰富的结构变换。实验表明，它在多个模型和任务上都能提升复杂提示的效果，包括指令调优、RAG 管线调优和提示压缩。
classic:8a8ca71ac79b.tldr: SAMMO 把提示词当作可搜索优化的程序，在编译期自动改写并提升复杂提示的效果。
classic:8a8ca71ac79b.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“提示工程”推进到了“提示程序优化”的层面，适合需要批量、重复调用提示的实际系统。作为结构感知的自动优化框架，它也为后续研究如何系统性地设计和压缩复杂提示提供了经典参考。

classic:311c8f04692b.abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has inaugurated a transformative epoch in natural language processing, fostering unprecedented proficiency in text generation, comprehension, and contextual scrutiny. Nevertheless, effectively handling extensive contexts, crucial for myriad applications, poses a formidable obstacle owing to the intrinsic constraints of the models' context window sizes and the computational burdens entailed by their operations. This investigation presents an innovative framework that strategically tailors LLMs for streamlined context processing by harnessing the synergies among natural language summarization, soft prompt compression, and augmented utility preservation mechanisms. Our methodology, dubbed SoftPromptComp, amalgamates natural language prompts extracted from summarization methodologies with dynamically generated soft prompts to forge a concise yet semantically robust depiction of protracted contexts. This depiction undergoes further refinement via a weighting mechanism optimizing information retention and utility for subsequent tasks. We substantiate that our framework markedly diminishes computational overhead and enhances LLMs' efficacy across various benchmarks, while upholding or even augmenting the caliber of the produced content. By amalgamating soft prompt compression with sophisticated summarization, SoftPromptComp confronts the dual challenges of managing lengthy contexts and ensuring model scalability. Our findings point towards a propitious trajectory for augmenting LLMs' applicability and efficiency, rendering them more versatile and pragmatic for real-world applications. This research enriches the ongoing discourse on optimizing language models, providing insights into the potency of soft prompts and summariz…
classic:311c8f04692b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在处理长上下文时面临的两大问题：上下文窗口有限，以及计算开销过高。作者提出 SoftPromptComp 框架，把自然语言摘要与动态生成的 soft prompt 结合起来，将长文本压缩成更短但仍保留语义的表示。随后，方法还通过加权机制进一步优化信息保留与后续任务可用性。实验表明，这种方法能显著降低计算成本，同时在多个基准上保持甚至提升模型效果。
classic:311c8f04692b.tldr: SoftPromptComp 用“摘要 + soft prompt 压缩”来高效处理长上下文，降低成本并提升或保持 LLM 表现。
classic:311c8f04692b.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对 LLM 在长文本场景中的核心瓶颈，提出了一个兼顾效率和效果的实用方案。作为效率型提示方法的参考，它展示了 soft prompt 与摘要压缩结合的潜力，适合关注长上下文处理和模型加速的人阅读。

classic:bb0982147f38.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant strides in information acquisition. However, their overreliance on potentially flawed parametric knowledge leads to hallucinations and inaccuracies, particularly when handling long-tail, domain-specific queries. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this limitation by incorporating external, non-parametric knowledge. Nevertheless, the retrieved long-context documents often contain noisy, irrelevant information alongside vital knowledge, negatively diluting LLMs' attention. Inspired by the supportive role of essential concepts in individuals' reading comprehension, we propose a novel concept-based RAG framework with the Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR)-based concept distillation algorithm. The proposed algorithm compresses the cluttered raw retrieved documents into a compact set of crucial concepts distilled from the informative nodes of AMR by referring to reliable linguistic features. The concepts explicitly constrain LLMs to focus solely on vital information in the inference process. We conduct extensive experiments on open-domain question-answering datasets to empirically evaluate the proposed method's effectiveness. The results indicate that the concept-based RAG framework outperforms other baseline methods, particularly as the number of supporting documents increases, while also exhibiting robustness across various backbone LLMs. This emphasizes the distilled concepts are informative for augmenting the RAG process by filtering out interference information. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work introducing AMR to enhance the RAG, presenting a potential solution to augment inference performance with semantic-based context compression.
classic:bb0982147f38.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注 RAG 在处理长上下文检索结果时容易被噪声信息干扰、从而削弱模型回答质量的问题。作者提出一种基于 AMR（抽象意义表示）的概念蒸馏方法，把冗长且杂乱的检索文档压缩为少量关键概念。这样做可以显式引导大语言模型只关注核心信息，减少无关内容对推理的干扰。实验表明，该方法在开放域问答任务上优于多种基线，且在不同底座模型和更多支持文档的场景下都表现出较强鲁棒性。
classic:bb0982147f38.tldr: 用 AMR 把检索到的长文档压缩成关键概念，帮助 RAG 更专注核心信息、减少噪声干扰。
classic:bb0982147f38.simple_intro: 如果你关心 RAG 如何处理“检索回来的内容太长、太杂”的问题，这篇很值得看。它把语义压缩和检索增强结合起来，是理解长上下文压缩思路的一个经典参考。

classic:5d04c387b396.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enhances the reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by prepending a few demonstrations. It motivates researchers to introduce more examples to provide additional contextual information for the generation. However, existing methods show a significant limitation due to the problem of excessive growth in context length, which causes a large hardware burden. In addition, shallow-relevant examples selected by off-the-shelf tools hinder LLMs from capturing useful contextual information for generation. In this paper, we propose \textbf{UniICL}, a novel \textbf{Uni}fied \textbf{ICL} framework that unifies demonstration compression, demonstration selection, and final response generation. Furthermore, to boost inference efficiency, we design a tailored compression strategy that allows UniICL to cache compression results into \textbf{Demonstration Bank} (\textbf{DB}), which avoids repeated compression of the same demonstration. Extensive out-of-domain evaluations prove the advantages of UniICL in both effectiveness and efficiency.
classic:5d04c387b396.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注上下文学习中的一个核心问题：示例越多，模型推理效果可能越好，但上下文长度也会迅速膨胀，带来明显的算力和硬件负担。作者提出 UniICL，把示例选择、示例压缩和最终回答生成统一到一个框架中，减少冗余上下文对推理的影响。为了进一步提升效率，方法还设计了可缓存压缩结果的 Demonstration Bank，避免对同一示例重复压缩。实验表明，UniICL 在效果和效率上都优于现有方法。
classic:5d04c387b396.tldr: UniICL 统一了示例选择与压缩，让大模型做 in-context learning 时更省上下文、更省算力。
classic:5d04c387b396.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为高效提示学习的经典参考，因为它直接解决了 ICL 中“示例越多越占上下文”的实际瓶颈。它的统一框架和缓存式压缩设计，对需要高效部署大模型的人很有启发。

classic:a038d6bd10d8.abstract: Long prompt leads to huge hardware costs when using transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs). Unfortunately, many tasks, such as summarization, inevitably introduce long documents, and the wide application of in-context learning easily makes the prompt length explode. This paper proposes a Self-Compressor (SelfCP), which employs the target LLM itself to compress over-limit prompts into dense vectors while keeping the allowed prompts unmodified. Dense vectors are then projected into dense tokens via a learnable connector to make the same LLM unburden to understand. The connector is supervised-tuned under the language modeling objective of the LLM on relatively long texts selected from publicly accessed datasets, involving an instruction dataset to make SelfCP respond to various prompts, while the target LLM keeps frozen during training. We build the lightweight SelfCP upon 2 different backbones with merely 17M learnable parameters originating from the connector and a learnable embedding. Evaluation on both English and Chinese benchmarks demonstrate that SelfCP effectively substitutes 12$\times$ over-limit prompts with dense tokens to reduce memory costs and booster inference throughputs, yet improving response quality. The outstanding performance brings an efficient solution for LLMs to tackle long prompts without training LLMs from scratch.
classic:a038d6bd10d8.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在处理长提示词时带来的高显存和高计算成本问题，尤其是在长文总结和上下文学习中提示长度容易爆炸。作者提出 SelfCP，用目标 LLM 自身把超长提示压缩成稠密向量，再通过一个可学习的连接器转成稠密 token 输入模型，从而不改动原有提示内容。训练时冻结目标 LLM，仅用少量可学习参数在长文本和指令数据上进行监督微调。实验表明，SelfCP 可以用约 1/12 的提示长度替代原始长提示，同时降低内存成本、提升推理吞吐，并保持甚至改善回答质量。
classic:a038d6bd10d8.tldr: SelfCP 用冻结的 LLM 自己把超长提示压缩成稠密 token，在显著降本的同时还能保持甚至提升效果。
classic:a038d6bd10d8.simple_intro: 这篇工作适合关注高效推理和长上下文处理的读者，因为它给出了一个不需要重训大模型、就能压缩长提示的实用方案。它也很有经典参考价值，展示了“用模型自身来压缩模型输入”的思路。

classic:01637bfceb07.abstract: We formalize the problem of prompt compression for large language models (LLMs) and present a framework to unify token-level prompt compression methods which create hard prompts for black-box models. We derive the distortion-rate function for this setup as a linear program, and provide an efficient algorithm to compute this fundamental limit via the dual of the linear program. Using the distortion-rate function as the baseline, we study the performance of existing compression schemes on a synthetic dataset consisting of prompts generated from a Markov chain, natural language queries, and their respective answers. Our empirical analysis demonstrates the criticality of query-aware prompt compression, where the compressor has knowledge of the downstream task/query for the black-box LLM. We show that there is a large gap between the performance of current prompt compression methods and the optimal strategy, and propose Adaptive QuerySelect, a query-aware, variable-rate adaptation of a prior work to close the gap. We extend our experiments to a small natural language dataset to further confirm our findings on our synthetic dataset.
classic:01637bfceb07.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了黑盒大语言模型中的提示压缩问题，即如何在尽量保留信息的前提下，把长提示压缩成更短的硬提示。作者把这一问题形式化为一个率失真框架，并将其对应的失真-率函数推导为一个线性规划，从而给出可计算的理论下界。基于这个基线，论文系统比较了现有压缩方法在合成数据和自然语言数据上的表现。实验表明，了解下游查询任务的“查询感知”压缩非常关键，现有方法与最优策略之间仍有明显差距。
classic:01637bfceb07.tldr: 提出黑盒 LLM 提示压缩的率失真理论框架，揭示查询感知压缩的重要性，并指出现有方法与最优解之间存在较大差距。
classic:01637bfceb07.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为提示压缩方向的经典参考，因为它不只提出方法，还先给出了问题的理论极限。读它可以帮助你理解：在黑盒大模型场景下，压缩提示到底能做到什么程度，以及为什么查询信息会决定压缩效果。

classic:a73b3b92093f.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) capabilities are foundational to the success of large language models (LLMs). Recently, context compression has attracted growing interest since it can largely reduce reasoning complexities and computation costs of LLMs. In this paper, we introduce a novel Query-gUIded aTtention cOmpression (QUITO) method, which leverages attention of the question over the contexts to filter useless information. Specifically, we take a trigger token to calculate the attention distribution of the context in response to the question. Based on the distribution, we propose three different filtering methods to satisfy the budget constraints of the context length. We evaluate the QUITO using two widely-used datasets, namely, NaturalQuestions and ASQA. Experimental results demonstrate that QUITO significantly outperforms established baselines across various datasets and downstream LLMs, underscoring its effectiveness. Our code is available at https://github.com/Wenshansilvia/attention_compressor.
classic:a73b3b92093f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注长上下文推理中“上下文太长、计算太贵”的问题，目标是在不显著损失关键信息的前提下压缩提示内容。作者提出 QUITO（Query-gUIded aTtention cOmpression），利用问题对上下文的注意力分布来识别并过滤无关信息，并通过一个触发 token 计算这种相关性。基于注意力分布，论文设计了三种不同的过滤策略，以满足上下文长度预算约束。实验在 NaturalQuestions 和 ASQA 上验证了该方法在多个下游 LLM 上都优于现有基线，说明它能有效降低推理成本并保持效果。
classic:a73b3b92093f.tldr: QUITO 用“问题引导的注意力压缩”来删掉无关上下文，让长上下文推理更省算力、效果更稳。
classic:a73b3b92093f.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为长上下文压缩方向的经典参考，因为它把“相关信息应该保留什么”这个问题和查询本身直接绑定起来。它的方法简单直观，且在多个数据集和模型上都展示了稳定收益。

classic:93c86d6262b1.abstract: Prompt compression is crucial for enhancing inference speed, reducing costs, and improving user experience. However, current methods face challenges such as low compression ratios and potential data leakage during evaluation. To address these issues, we propose 500xCompressor, a method that compresses extensive natural language contexts into a minimum of one single special token. The 500xCompressor introduces approximately 0.3% additional parameters and achieves compression ratios ranging from 6x to 480x. It is designed to compress any text, answer various types of questions, and could be utilized by the original large language model (LLM) without requiring fine-tuning. Initially, 500xCompressor was pretrained on the Arxiv Corpus, followed by fine-tuning on the ArxivQA dataset, and subsequently evaluated on strictly unseen and classical question answering (QA) datasets. The results demonstrate that the LLM retained 62.26-72.89% of its capabilities compared to using non-compressed prompts. This study also shows that not all the compressed tokens are equally utilized and that K V values have significant advantages over embeddings in preserving information at high compression ratios. The highly compressive nature of natural language prompts, even for fine-grained complex information, suggests promising potential for future applications and further research into developing a new LLM language.
classic:93c86d6262b1.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理中的提示词过长、成本高和速度慢问题，提出了一种通用的提示压缩方法 500xCompressor。它可以把很长的自然语言上下文压缩到一个特殊 token，额外参数开销约为 0.3%，压缩率可达 6x 到 480x。作者先在 Arxiv 语料上预训练，再在 ArxivQA 上微调，并在严格未见过的数据集上验证了效果。结果表明，在高压缩率下模型仍能保留原始能力的 62.26% 到 72.89%，展示了提示压缩在高效推理中的潜力。
classic:93c86d6262b1.tldr: 500xCompressor 让长提示词可被压成一个 token，同时尽量保留大模型的问答能力。
classic:93c86d6262b1.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，是因为它把“提示词压缩”推进到了非常激进的程度，并且仍然能保持较强的任务性能。它适合作为高效提示和长上下文压缩方向的经典参考。

classic:a65b12074e0f.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have garnered widespread attention due to their remarkable performance across various tasks. However, to mitigate the issue of hallucinations, LLMs often incorporate retrieval-augmented pipeline to provide them with rich external knowledge and context. Nevertheless, challenges stem from inaccurate and coarse-grained context retrieved from the retriever. Supplying irrelevant context to the LLMs can result in poorer responses, increased inference latency, and higher costs. This paper introduces a method called Instruction-Aware Contextual Compression, which filters out less informative content, thereby accelerating and enhancing the use of LLMs. The experimental results demonstrate that Instruction-Aware Contextual Compression notably reduces memory consumption and minimizes generation latency while maintaining performance levels comparable to those achieved with the use of the full context. Specifically, we achieved a 50% reduction in context-related costs, resulting in a 5% reduction in inference memory usage and a 2.2-fold increase in inference speed, with only a minor drop of 0.047 in Rouge-1. These findings suggest that our method strikes an effective balance between efficiency and performance.
classic:a65b12074e0f.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注检索增强型大语言模型在实际应用中的一个关键问题：检索到的上下文往往粗糙且包含大量无关内容，不仅会拖慢推理速度，还会增加成本并影响回答质量。作者提出了 Instruction-Aware Contextual Compression 方法，根据用户指令对上下文进行压缩筛选，保留更有用的信息、过滤低价值内容。实验表明，该方法能在几乎不损失性能的前提下，显著降低上下文相关成本，并提升推理效率。具体而言，它实现了约 50% 的上下文成本下降、5% 的显存下降以及 2.2 倍的推理速度提升。
classic:a65b12074e0f.tldr: 一种面向指令的上下文压缩方法，在保留效果的同时显著降低 LLM 推理成本并加速生成。
classic:a65b12074e0f.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了检索增强大模型中“上下文太多、太杂、太慢”的现实痛点。作为高效提示与上下文压缩方向的经典参考，它展示了如何在效果和效率之间取得很好的平衡。

classic:a81a6758b12b.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have triggered a new stream of research focusing on compressing the context length to reduce the computational cost while ensuring the retention of helpful information for LLMs to answer the given question. Token-based removal methods are one of the most prominent approaches in this direction, but risk losing the semantics of the context caused by intermediate token removal, especially under high compression ratios, while also facing challenges in computational efficiency. In this work, we propose context-aware prompt compression (CPC), a sentence-level prompt compression technique where its key innovation is a novel context-aware sentence encoder that provides a relevance score for each sentence for a given question. To train this encoder, we generate a new dataset consisting of questions, positives, and negative pairs where positives are sentences relevant to the question, while negatives are irrelevant context sentences. We train the encoder in a contrastive setup to learn context-aware sentence representations. Our method considerably outperforms prior works on prompt compression on benchmark datasets and is up to 10.93x faster at inference compared to the best token-level compression method. We also find better improvement for shorter length constraints in most benchmarks, showing the effectiveness of our proposed solution in the compression of relevant information in a shorter context. Finally, we release the code and the dataset for quick reproducibility and further development: https://github.com/Workday/cpc.
classic:a81a6758b12b.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型推理时上下文过长、计算成本高的问题，目标是在尽量保留关键信息的同时压缩提示词。作者提出了上下文感知的提示压缩方法 CPC，以句子为单位而不是逐 token 删除，并设计了一个上下文感知句子编码器来为每个句子打相关性分数。为了训练这个编码器，论文构建了包含问题、正样本和负样本的新数据集，并用对比学习学习更适合压缩任务的句子表示。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上优于已有提示压缩方法，推理速度最高可提升 10.93 倍。
classic:a81a6758b12b.tldr: CPC 用上下文感知的句子级压缩替代 token 删除，在提升压缩质量的同时显著加速 LLM 推理。
classic:a81a6758b12b.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它直击 LLM 推理中“又长又贵”的核心痛点，并给出了一种简单直接但效果很强的句子级压缩方案。作为经典参考，它很适合用来理解高效提示与上下文压缩方向的设计思路。

classic:b9a6108d5f7c.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated great performance on visual question answering (VQA). When it comes to knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA), MLLMs may lack the specialized domain knowledge needed to answer questions, necessitating the retrieval of necessary information from external knowledge sources. Previous works like Retrival-Augmented VQA-v2 (RAVQA-v2) focus on utilizing as much input information, such as image-based textual descriptions and retrieved knowledge, as possible to improve performance, but they all overlook the issue that with the number of input tokens increasing, inference efficiency significantly decreases, which contradicts the demands of practical applications. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{R}etrieval-\textbf{A}ugmented MLLMs with Compressed Contexts (RACC). RACC learns to compress and aggregate retrieved knowledge for a given image-question pair, generating a compact modulation in the form of Key-Value (KV) cache to adapt the downstream frozen MLLM, thereby achieving effective and efficient inference. RACC achieves a state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance of 63.92\% on OK-VQA. Moreover, it significantly reduces inference latency by 22.0\%-59.7\% compared to the prominent RAVQA-v2. Abundant experiments show RACC's broad applicability. It is compatible with various off-the-shelf MLLMs and can also handle different knowledge sources including textual and multimodal documents.
classic:b9a6108d5f7c.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注知识增强视觉问答中的效率问题：现有方法虽然能通过检索外部知识提升回答准确率，但随着输入 token 增多，推理速度会明显下降，难以满足实际应用需求。为此，作者提出 RACC 方法，学习对检索到的知识进行压缩与聚合，并将其生成紧凑的 KV cache，用来调节冻结的下游多模态大模型。该方法在保留知识增强能力的同时显著降低了推理延迟，在 OK-VQA 上取得了 63.92% 的 SOTA 性能。实验还表明，RACC 具有较强通用性，可适配多种现成 MLLM 和不同类型的知识源。
classic:b9a6108d5f7c.tldr: RACC 通过压缩检索知识生成紧凑 KV cache，在提升 KB-VQA 性能的同时大幅降低推理开销。
classic:b9a6108d5f7c.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直面了“效果提升但推理变慢”的实际痛点，提出了一种很实用的压缩式知识注入方案。对于想了解高效提示、检索增强多模态模型和 KB-VQA 的读者来说，它是很好的经典参考。

classic:7efd3b08c168.abstract: Offering rich contexts to Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown to boost the performance in various tasks, but the resulting longer prompt would increase the computational cost and might exceed the input limit of LLMs. Recently, some prompt compression methods have been suggested to shorten the length of prompts by using language models to generate shorter prompts or by developing computational models to select important parts of original prompt. The generative compression methods would suffer from issues like hallucination, while the selective compression methods have not involved linguistic rules and overlook the global structure of prompt. To this end, we propose a novel selective compression method called PartPrompt. It first obtains a parse tree for each sentence based on linguistic rules, and calculates local information entropy for each node in a parse tree. These local parse trees are then organized into a global tree according to the hierarchical structure such as the dependency of sentences, paragraphs, and sections. After that, the root-ward propagation and leaf-ward propagation are proposed to adjust node values over the global tree. Finally, a recursive algorithm is developed to prune the global tree based on the adjusted node values. The experiments show that PartPrompt receives the state-of-the-art performance across various datasets, metrics, compression ratios, and target LLMs for inference. The in-depth ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of designs in PartPrompt, and other additional experiments also demonstrate its superiority in terms of the coherence of compressed prompts and in the extreme long prompt scenario.
classic:7efd3b08c168.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型提示词过长带来的计算开销和输入长度限制问题。作者指出，现有生成式压缩容易产生幻觉，而纯选择式压缩又常忽略语言结构和全局组织。为此，论文提出 PartPrompt：先基于句法分析树计算节点的信息熵，再把句子、段落、章节等局部树组织成全局树，并通过自底向上与自顶向下的传播调整节点权重。实验表明，该方法在多种数据集、压缩率和目标模型上都取得了很强的效果，且压缩后的提示更连贯。
classic:7efd3b08c168.tldr: PartPrompt 用句法树和全局树结构来做提示词压缩，在减少长度的同时尽量保留信息与连贯性。
classic:7efd3b08c168.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看在于它把语言学规则引入提示词压缩，避免了只靠模型打分时容易忽略结构的问题。作为经典参考，它展示了一种兼顾压缩效率、语义完整性和文本连贯性的实用思路。

classic:a26673367c21.abstract: Data compression continues to evolve, with traditional information theory methods being widely used for compressing text, images, and videos. Recently, there has been growing interest in leveraging Generative AI for predictive compression techniques. This paper introduces a lossless text compression approach using a Large Language Model (LLM). The method involves two key steps: first, prediction using a dense neural network architecture, such as a transformer block; second, compressing the predicted ranks with standard compression algorithms like Adaptive Huffman, LZ77, or Gzip. Extensive analysis and benchmarking against conventional information-theoretic baselines demonstrate that neural compression offers improved performance.
classic:a26673367c21.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注无损文本压缩问题，尝试用大语言模型来提升传统压缩方法的预测能力。作者先用神经网络/Transformer 结构预测文本的可能秩或分布，再将这些预测结果交给自适应 Huffman、LZ77 或 Gzip 等经典压缩算法处理。实验和基准对比表明，这种“神经网络预测 + 传统压缩”的混合方案能带来更好的压缩效果。它的价值在于把生成式 AI 引入信息论压缩流程，探索了神经压缩的可行性。
classic:a26673367c21.tldr: 用大语言模型先做预测、再配合传统压缩算法，AlphaZip 展示了无损文本压缩的新思路。
classic:a26673367c21.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，是因为它把 LLM 和经典压缩算法结合起来，给无损文本压缩提供了一个新方向。作为 2024 年的工作，它也很适合作为理解“神经压缩”与传统方法如何融合的参考。

classic:79588d68b644.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in handling long context inputs, but this comes at the cost of increased computational resources and latency. Our research introduces a novel approach for the long context bottleneck to accelerate LLM inference and reduce GPU memory consumption. Our research demonstrates that LLMs can identify relevant tokens in the early layers before generating answers to a query. Leveraging this insight, we propose an algorithm that uses early layers of an LLM as filters to select and compress input tokens, significantly reducing the context length for subsequent processing. Our method, GemFilter, demonstrates substantial improvements in both speed and memory efficiency compared to existing techniques, such as standard attention and SnapKV/H2O. Notably, it achieves a 2.4$\times$ speedup and 30\% reduction in GPU memory usage compared to SOTA methods. Evaluation on the Needle in a Haystack task shows that GemFilter significantly outperforms standard attention, SnapKV and demonstrates comparable performance on the LongBench challenge. GemFilter is simple, training-free, and broadly applicable across different LLMs. Crucially, it provides interpretability by allowing humans to inspect the selected input sequence. These findings not only offer practical benefits for LLM deployment, but also enhance our understanding of LLM internal mechanisms, paving the way for further optimizations in LLM design and inference. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/GemFilter}.
classic:79588d68b644.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注长上下文大语言模型推理时计算开销高、延迟大和显存占用大的问题。作者提出 GemFilter，利用模型早期层先筛选输入中的关键信息，再对压缩后的 token 序列继续推理，从而大幅减少后续处理的上下文长度。该方法无需训练，适配性强，并且还能保留可解释性，方便人类检查被保留的输入内容。实验表明，它在速度和显存效率上都优于多种现有方法，同时在长上下文任务上保持了有竞争力的效果。
classic:79588d68b644.tldr: GemFilter 利用 LLM 早期层先筛 token，再压缩长上下文输入，实现无需训练的高效推理加速。
classic:79588d68b644.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合作为长上下文高效推理的经典参考，因为它提出了一种简单、训练免费且易部署的思路。它不仅能显著降低计算和显存成本，还帮助理解模型在早期层中如何识别关键信息。

classic:1884a31c09fc.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate exceptional capabilities in various scenarios. However, they suffer from much redundant information and are sensitive to the position of key information in long context scenarios. To address these challenges, we present Perception Compressor, a training-free prompt compression framework. It includes a perception retriever that leverages guiding questions and instruction to retrieve the most relevant demonstrations, a dual-slope ratio allocator to dynamically allocate compression ratios and open-book ratios, and a semi-guided iterative compression that retains key information at the token level while removing tokens that distract the LLM. We conduct extensive experiments on long context benchmarks, i.e., NaturalQuestions, LongBench, and MuSiQue. Experiment results show that Perception Compressor outperforms existing methods by a large margin, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
classic:1884a31c09fc.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注长上下文场景下大语言模型容易被冗余信息干扰、且对关键信息位置敏感的问题。作者提出了无需训练的提示压缩框架 Perception Compressor，通过感知检索器、双斜率比例分配器和半引导迭代压缩，尽量保留对任务真正有用的 token。该方法可以在压缩提示的同时减少干扰信息，从而提升模型在长文本任务中的表现。论文在 NaturalQuestions、LongBench 和 MuSiQue 等基准上进行了实验，并取得了优于现有方法的结果。
classic:1884a31c09fc.tldr: Perception Compressor 是一种无需训练的长上下文提示压缩方法，能在保留关键信息的同时去掉干扰 token，并在多个基准上达到 SOTA。
classic:1884a31c09fc.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了长上下文里“信息太多但关键太少”的实际痛点，而且方法不需要额外训练，容易落地。作为经典参考，它展示了如何在压缩提示与保持效果之间取得更好的平衡。

classic:79d1b6d68d21.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved significant performance gains using advanced prompting techniques over various tasks. However, the increasing length of prompts leads to high computational costs and often obscures crucial information. Prompt compression has been proposed to alleviate these issues, but it faces challenges in (i) capturing the global context and (ii) training the compressor effectively. To tackle these challenges, we introduce a novel prompt compression method, namely Reading To Compressing (R2C), utilizing the Fusion-in-Decoder (FiD) architecture to identify the important information in the prompt. Specifically, the cross-attention scores of the FiD are used to discern essential chunks and sentences from the prompt. R2C effectively captures the global context without compromising semantic consistency while detouring the necessity of pseudo-labels for training the compressor. Empirical results show that R2C retains key contexts, enhancing the LLM performance by 6% in out-of-domain evaluations while reducing the prompt length by 80%.
classic:79d1b6d68d21.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型提示词过长带来的计算开销和关键信息淹没问题，核心目标是做高效的提示压缩。作者提出了 Reading To Compressing（R2C）方法，借助 Fusion-in-Decoder（FiD）架构读取整段提示，并通过交叉注意力分数识别重要的片段和句子。该方法能够在保持全局语境和语义一致性的同时完成压缩，且不依赖伪标签来训练压缩器。实验表明，R2C 在将提示长度减少 80% 的同时，还能在域外评测中提升 LLM 性能约 6%。
classic:79d1b6d68d21.tldr: R2C 用 FiD 的注意力机制做提示压缩，在大幅缩短 prompt 的同时尽量保留关键上下文并提升模型效果。
classic:79d1b6d68d21.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合想了解“如何把长提示压缩得更高效”的读者，因为它把信息筛选和模型推理结合得很自然。作为经典参考，它展示了一个不依赖伪标签、还能较好保留全局语境的实用方案。

classic:a3a8c3df710a.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in a wide range of natural language processing tasks when leveraging in-context learning. To mitigate the additional computational and financial costs associated with in-context learning, several prompt compression methods have been proposed to compress the in-context learning prompts. Despite their success, these methods face challenges with transferability due to model-specific compression, or rely on external training data, such as GPT-4. In this paper, we investigate the ability of LLMs to develop a unified compression method that discretizes uninformative tokens, utilizing a self-supervised pre-training technique. By introducing a small number of parameters during the continual pre-training, the proposed Selection-p produces a probability for each input token, indicating whether to preserve or discard it. Experiments show Selection-p achieves state-of-the-art performance across numerous classification tasks, achieving compression rates of up to 10 times while experiencing only a marginal 0.8% decrease in performance. Moreover, it exhibits superior transferability to different models compared to prior work. Additionally, we further analyze how Selection-p helps maintain performance on in-context learning with long contexts.
classic:a3a8c3df710a.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在 in-context learning 中提示词过长、带来计算和成本开销的问题。作者提出了 Selection-p，一种自监督、任务无关的提示压缩方法，通过在持续预训练中加入少量参数，为每个输入 token 预测保留或丢弃的概率，从而筛掉无信息内容。实验表明，该方法在多个分类任务上取得了很强的效果，最高可实现 10 倍压缩，而性能仅下降约 0.8%。相比以往方法，Selection-p 还表现出更好的跨模型迁移能力，并能较好维持长上下文 in-context learning 的性能。
classic:a3a8c3df710a.tldr: Selection-p 用自监督方式学会压缩提示词，在大幅缩短上下文的同时几乎不损失性能，还更容易迁移到不同模型。
classic:a3a8c3df710a.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接解决了大模型提示词太长、推理成本高的实际痛点，而且方法不依赖外部标注数据。作为经典参考，它展示了如何用轻量、可迁移的方式做 prompt 压缩。

classic:79f86a105966.abstract: Prompt compression condenses contexts while maintaining their informativeness for different usage scenarios. It not only shortens the inference time and reduces computational costs during the usage of large language models, but also lowers expenses when using closed-source models. In a preliminary study, we discover that when instructing language models to compress prompts, different compression styles (e.g., extractive or abstractive) impact performance of compressed prompts on downstream tasks. Building on this insight, we propose Style-Compress, a lightweight framework that adapts a smaller language model to compress prompts for a larger model on a new task without additional training. Our approach iteratively generates and selects effective compressed prompts as task-specific demonstrations through style variation and in-context learning, enabling smaller models to act as efficient compressors with task-specific examples. Style-Compress outperforms two baseline compression models in four tasks: original prompt reconstruction, text summarization, multi-hop QA, and CoT reasoning. In addition, with only 10 samples and 100 queries for adaptation, prompts compressed by Style-Compress achieve performance on par with or better than original prompts at a compression ratio of 0.25 or 0.5.
classic:79f86a105966.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注提示压缩中的一个核心问题：如何在尽量保留信息的同时，显著缩短输入上下文，从而降低大语言模型的推理成本与使用开销。作者发现，不同的压缩风格（如抽取式或生成式）会明显影响压缩后提示在下游任务中的表现。基于这一观察，论文提出 Style-Compress，一个轻量框架，利用较小模型通过风格变化与上下文学习来生成并筛选更适合特定任务的压缩提示。实验表明，它在原始提示重建、摘要、多跳问答和链式推理等任务上优于多个基线，并能在较高压缩率下保持接近甚至超过原始提示的效果。
classic:79f86a105966.tldr: Style-Compress 通过考虑任务特定的压缩风格，让小模型更高效地为大模型生成高质量压缩提示，并在多项任务上优于基线。
classic:79f86a105966.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它把“提示压缩”从单纯的缩短文本，推进到“按任务选择合适压缩风格”的层面。作为高效提示方向的经典参考，它展示了如何用很少的适配成本获得接近原始提示的效果。

classic:848926c37f61.abstract: Despite the recent success of Large Language Models (LLMs), it remains challenging to feed LLMs with long prompts due to the fixed size of LLM inputs. As a remedy, prompt compression becomes a promising solution by removing redundant tokens in the prompt. However, using LLM in the existing works requires additional computation resources and leads to memory overheads. To address it, we propose ICPC (In-context Prompt Compression), a novel and scalable prompt compression method that adaptively reduces the prompt length. The key idea of ICPC is to calculate the probability of each word appearing in the prompt using encoders and calculate information carried by each word through the information function, which effectively reduces the information loss during prompt compression and increases the speed of compression. Empirically, we demonstrate that ICPC can effectively compress long texts of different categories and thus achieve better performance and speed on different types of NLP tasks.
classic:848926c37f61.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在处理长提示词时受输入长度限制的问题，以及现有提示压缩方法往往需要额外计算资源和内存开销。作者提出 ICPC（In-context Prompt Compression），利用编码器估计词在提示中的出现概率，并结合信息函数衡量每个词携带的信息量，从而自适应地压缩提示。该方法的目标是在尽量减少信息损失的同时提升压缩速度。实验表明，ICPC 能有效压缩不同类型的长文本，并在多种 NLP 任务上同时带来性能和效率收益。
classic:848926c37f61.tldr: ICPC 用信息量评估和自适应压缩长提示，在减少损失的同时提升推理速度。
classic:848926c37f61.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对 LLM 长提示输入的实际瓶颈，给出了一个兼顾压缩质量和推理效率的方案。作为效率提示方向的参考，它很适合了解如何在不显著损伤任务性能的前提下减少上下文长度。

classic:d1a921aae48a.abstract: Although applications involving long-context inputs are crucial for the effective utilization of large language models (LLMs), they also result in increased computational costs and reduced performance. To address this challenge, we propose an efficient, training-free prompt compression method that retains key information within compressed prompts.
