classic:b0b22c5ce40c.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究大语言推理模型在压缩后的推理能力变化，重点比较了量化、蒸馏和剪枝三种方法对性能的影响。作者在 AIME 2024、FOLIO、Temporal Sequences 和 MuSiQue 四个推理数据集上，对 DeepSeek-R1 及相关模型进行系统评测，观察不同压缩策略如何损伤推理能力。除了性能对比，论文还结合 difference of means 和 attribution patching 等机制分析方法，定位哪些权重和模块对推理最关键。结果表明，合理的量化可以在较高压缩率下保留接近原模型的推理性能，但剪枝和蒸馏更容易削弱知识记忆与部分关键推理组件。
classic:b0b22c5ce40c.tldr: 系统比较量化、蒸馏和剪枝对大推理模型的影响，揭示哪些权重最关键，以及如何在压缩中尽量保住推理能力。
classic:b0b22c5ce40c.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不仅给出压缩后推理模型的性能基准，还进一步解释了“为什么会退化”。对于想理解大模型压缩、推理能力保持和关键权重定位的人来说，它是很有参考价值的经典材料。

classic:2c0e7ae7d56c.abstract: We introduce compression laws for language language models (LLMs). While recent scaling laws have sought to understand how LLMs scale with respect to model size, pre-training data, and computational resources, we focus on understanding how model compression affects the performance of a pre-trained LLM on downstream tasks. We empirically examine the effects of structured model compression on LLMs through over $1000$ experiments across eight models with sizes ranging from $0.5B$ to $14B$ parameters. Our findings indicate that the test cross-entropy loss increases quadratically with the compression ratio, whereas performance on downstream tasks declines only linearly. Our study emphasizes the importance of recovery fine-tuning in enhancing generation loss, showing that the test loss of compressed LLMs can improve by up to 55% with recovery fine-tuning. At higher compression ratios (up to 90%), compressed LLMs demonstrate a speed increase of 60% during inference compared to their uncompressed counterparts, compensating for the performance degradation at this level. However, for smaller models ($\le 7B$), the computational gains are limited, peaking at just 35%. We conclude that model compression can be highly beneficial for larger models, especially when a smaller model within the same computational budget is not available. These insights provide the practical guidelines for utilizing model compression techniques for adopting LLMs in real-life applications in resource-constrained settings.
classic:2c0e7ae7d56c.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究的是：大语言模型在被压缩之后，性能会如何变化，以及压缩是否值得。作者通过 1000 多组实验，覆盖 8 个不同规模的模型，系统分析了结构化压缩对测试损失和下游任务表现的影响。结果发现，测试交叉熵损失会随压缩率呈二次上升，而下游任务性能下降更接近线性；同时，恢复微调可以显著缓解压缩带来的损失。论文还指出，在高压缩率下推理速度能明显提升，因此在资源受限场景中，模型压缩对大模型尤其有实际价值。
classic:2c0e7ae7d56c.tldr: 大语言模型压缩后会变差多少、提速多少，这篇论文用大量实验给出了可操作的经验规律。
classic:2c0e7ae7d56c.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是只讨论“能不能压缩”，而是进一步回答“压缩到什么程度、代价有多大、怎么补救”。它为实际部署大模型时的压缩选择提供了经典参考和经验指导。

classic:4e5162b0e2cd.abstract: Extensive compute and memory requirements limit the deployment of large language models (LLMs) on any hardware. Compression methods, such as pruning, can reduce model size, which in turn reduces resource requirements. State-of-the-art pruning is based on coarse-grained methods. They are time-consuming and inherently remove critical model parameters, adversely impacting the quality of the pruned model. This paper introduces projection pruning, a novel fine-grained method for pruning LLMs. In addition, LLM projection pruning is enhanced by a new approach we refer to as composite projection pruning - the synergistic combination of unstructured pruning that retains accuracy and structured pruning that reduces model size. We develop Mosaic, a novel system to create and deploy pruned LLMs using composite projection pruning. Mosaic is evaluated using a range of performance and quality metrics on multiple hardware platforms, LLMs, and datasets. Mosaic is 7.19x faster in producing models than existing approaches. Mosaic models achieve up to 84.2% lower perplexity and 31.4% higher accuracy than models obtained from coarse-grained pruning. Up to 67% faster inference and 68% lower GPU memory use is noted for Mosaic models. Mosaic is available for public use from https://github.com/blessonvar/Mosaic
classic:4e5162b0e2cd.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在部署时面临的计算和显存开销过高问题，指出现有粗粒度剪枝方法不仅耗时，还容易误删关键参数，影响模型质量。作者提出了 projection pruning 这一细粒度剪枝思路，并进一步结合非结构化剪枝与结构化剪枝，形成 composite projection pruning。基于此，论文构建了 Mosaic 系统，用于高效生成和部署剪枝后的 LLM。实验表明，Mosaic 在模型生成速度、推理速度、GPU 显存占用以及困惑度和准确率方面都优于传统粗粒度剪枝方法。
classic:4e5162b0e2cd.tldr: Mosaic 通过复合投影剪枝，让大语言模型在更低算力和显存下仍能保持较好性能。
classic:4e5162b0e2cd.simple_intro: 如果你关心 LLM 如何在有限硬件上落地，这篇论文很值得看，因为它给出了一种兼顾压缩效率和模型质量的剪枝方案。它也适合作为理解“细粒度剪枝 + 结构/非结构组合优化”思路的经典参考。

classic:2f6408dd93f3.abstract: Speculative decoding is a powerful technique for reducing the latency of Large Language Models (LLMs), offering a fault-tolerant framework that enables the use of highly compressed draft models. In this work, we introduce Self-Distilled Sparse Drafters (SD$^2$), a novel methodology that leverages self-data distillation and fine-grained weight sparsity to produce highly efficient and well-aligned draft models. SD$^2$ systematically enhances draft token acceptance rates while significantly reducing Multiply-Accumulate operations (MACs), even in the Universal Assisted Generation (UAG) setting, where draft and target models originate from different model families. On a Llama-3.1-70B target model, SD$^2$ provides a 1.59$\times$ higher Mean Accepted Length (MAL) compared to layer-pruned draft models and reduces MACs by over 43.87% with a 8.36% reduction in MAL compared to a dense draft models. Our 1.5B and 3B unstructured sparse drafters outperform both dense and layer-pruned models in terms of end-to-end latency improvements; highlighting the potential of sparsity-aware fine-tuning and compression strategies to improve LLM inference efficiency while maintaining alignment with target models.
classic:2f6408dd93f3.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型中的 speculative decoding 低延迟推理问题，核心目标是让草稿模型既更快又更容易被目标模型接受。作者提出 Self-Distilled Sparse Drafters（SD^2），把自蒸馏与细粒度权重稀疏结合起来，训练出高效且对齐良好的草稿模型。方法不仅能提高 token 接受率，还能显著减少乘加运算量，在不同模型家族之间的 Universal Assisted Generation 场景下也有效。实验表明，SD^2 在端到端延迟和计算效率上都优于密集草稿模型和层剪枝草稿模型。
classic:2f6408dd93f3.tldr: SD^2 通过自蒸馏+稀疏化训练更高效的草稿模型，提升 speculative decoding 的接受率并显著降低推理开销。
classic:2f6408dd93f3.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它直接针对 LLM 推理加速中的关键瓶颈：如何让草稿模型更轻、更快，同时不牺牲与目标模型的匹配度。它为 speculative decoding 和模型压缩结合提供了一个很有代表性的经典思路。

classic:3a331dea0f6e.abstract: Large-scale AI models, such as Large Language Models (LLMs) and Diffusion Models (DMs), have grown rapidly in size, creating significant challenges for efficient deployment on resource-constrained hardware. In this paper, we introduce Dynamic-Length Float (DFloat11), a lossless compression framework that reduces LLM and DM size by 30% while preserving outputs that are bit-for-bit identical to the original model. DFloat11 is motivated by the low entropy in the BFloat16 weight representation of LLMs, which reveals significant inefficiency in the existing storage format. By applying entropy coding, DFloat11 assigns dynamic-length encodings to weights based on frequency, achieving near information-optimal compression without any loss of precision. To facilitate efficient inference with dynamic-length encodings, we develop a custom GPU kernel for fast online decompression. Our design incorporates the following: (i) compact, hierarchical lookup tables (LUTs) that fit within GPU SRAM for efficient decoding, (ii) a two-phase GPU kernel for coordinating thread read/write positions using lightweight auxiliary variables, and (iii) transformer-block-level decompression to minimize latency. Experiments on Llama 3.3, Qwen 3, Mistral 3, FLUX.1, and others validate our hypothesis that DFloat11 achieves around 30% model size reduction while preserving bit-for-bit identical outputs. Compared to a potential alternative of offloading parts of an uncompressed model to the CPU to meet memory constraints, DFloat11 achieves 2.3--46.2x higher throughput in token generation. With a fixed GPU memory budget, DFloat11 enables 5.7--14.9x longer generation lengths than uncompressed models. Notably, our method enables lossless inference of Llama 3.1 405B, an 810GB model, on a single node equipped wit…
classic:3a331dea0f6e.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是大模型部署时的显存和吞吐瓶颈：LLM 和扩散模型越来越大，传统存储格式带来了明显的空间浪费。作者提出 Dynamic-Length Float（DFloat11）这一无损压缩框架，利用 BFloat16 权重分布的低熵特性进行熵编码，把模型体积压缩约 30%，同时保证输出与原模型逐位一致。为了让动态长度编码不拖慢推理，论文还设计了专门的 GPU 在线解压 kernel，包括层次化查找表、两阶段调度和按 transformer block 解压等机制。实验表明，这种方法既能显著节省显存，又能在固定资源下提升生成吞吐和支持更长上下文，具有很强的工程落地价值。
classic:3a331dea0f6e.tldr: DFloat11 通过无损动态长度编码把大模型体积缩小约 30%，同时保持输出完全一致，并能在 GPU 上高效推理。
classic:3a331dea0f6e.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它解决了“大模型太大但又不能降精度”的现实部署难题，而且给出了真正无损的压缩方案。它适合作为经典参考，帮助理解如何把信息论压缩和 GPU 推理工程结合起来。

classic:c2de5acb6464.abstract: With the proliferation of task-specific large language models, delta compression has emerged as a method to mitigate the resource challenges of deploying numerous such models by effectively compressing the delta model parameters. Previous delta-sparsification methods either remove parameters randomly or truncate singular vectors directly after singular value decomposition (SVD). However, these methods either disregard parameter importance entirely or evaluate it with too coarse a granularity. In this work, we introduce ImPart, a novel importance-aware delta sparsification approach. Leveraging SVD, it dynamically adjusts sparsity ratios of different singular vectors based on their importance, effectively retaining crucial task-specific knowledge even at high sparsity ratios. Experiments show that ImPart achieves state-of-the-art delta sparsification performance, demonstrating $2\times$ higher compression ratio than baselines at the same performance level. When integrated with existing methods, ImPart sets a new state-of-the-art on delta quantization and model merging.
classic:c2de5acb6464.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注任务特定大语言模型数量不断增加后，如何更高效地压缩和部署它们的 delta 参数。作者指出，已有的 delta 稀疏化方法不是随机删参数，就是在 SVD 后粗粒度地截断奇异向量，往往忽略了参数的重要性差异。为此，论文提出 ImPart 方法，基于 SVD 按不同奇异向量的重要性动态调整稀疏率，从而在很高压缩率下仍能保留关键任务知识。实验表明，ImPart 在相同性能下可实现比基线高 2 倍的压缩率，并进一步提升了 delta 量化与模型合并的效果。
classic:c2de5acb6464.tldr: ImPart 通过按重要性自适应稀疏化 delta 参数，在高压缩率下仍能更好保留任务知识，并刷新了相关压缩与合并结果。
classic:c2de5acb6464.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合关注大模型压缩、模型合并和多任务部署的人阅读，因为它直接解决了“多个任务模型太占资源”的实际问题。它的方法思路清晰，实验结果也表明：只要更聪明地保留重要信息，就能在压缩和性能之间取得更好的平衡。

classic:f5e351f3bece.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced artificial intelligence by optimizing traditional Natural Language Processing (NLP) workflows, facilitating their integration into various systems. Many such NLP systems, including ours, directly incorporate LLMs. However, this approach either results in expensive costs or yields suboptimal performance after fine-tuning. In this paper, we introduce a three-stage cost-efficient end-to-end LLM deployment pipeline, comprising prototyping, knowledge transfer, and model compression, to effectively tackle the cost-performance dilemma in LLM-based frameworks. Its high cost-efficiency is manifested not only in simplifying system complexity and producing super-tiny online models with enhanced performance and reduced costs in the results, but also in addressing development cycle constraints, the lack of extensive high-quality data, and limited computational resources during the project development process. In the first stage, we construct an optimal performance prototype system by transforming complex tasks into a function call-based LLM-driven pipeline, which serves as a teacher model to generate high-quality data. In the second stage, we combine techniques like rejection sampling fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and knowledge distillation to transfer knowledge to 0.5B student models, delivering effective performance at minimal cost. In the final stage, we further compress models to 0.4B via quantization and pruning, achieving ultra-low latency and cost. Extensive experimental results and the framework's modular design suggest cross-domain capabilities and potential applicability in other NLP areas.
classic:f5e351f3bece.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是 LLM 落地时“效果好但成本太高”的问题，提出了一套端到端的三阶段低成本部署流程。第一阶段先把复杂任务重构为基于函数调用的 LLM 管线，构建高性能原型并作为教师模型生成高质量数据。第二阶段结合拒绝采样微调、强化学习和知识蒸馏，把知识迁移到 0.5B 的学生模型上，在较低成本下保持较强性能。第三阶段进一步通过量化和剪枝将模型压缩到 0.4B，实现超低延迟和更低推理成本，适合资源受限的实际系统。
classic:f5e351f3bece.tldr: 提出一套从原型、知识迁移到压缩部署的三阶段方案，把大模型能力以更低成本迁移到超小模型上。
classic:f5e351f3bece.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它不是只讨论“怎么做大模型”，而是系统解决“怎么把大模型做得又便宜又能用”的工程难题。对于需要把 LLM 真正部署到线上系统、但又受限于算力、数据和时延的场景，它是一篇很实用的经典参考。

classic:301524c104a1.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable performance across various natural language processing tasks but suffer from immense computational and memory demands, limiting their deployment in resource-constrained environments. To address this challenge, we propose NoWag (Normalized Weight and Activation Guided Compression), a unified framework for one-shot shape preserving compression algorithms. We apply NoWag to compress Llama-2 (7B, 13B, 70B) and Llama-3 (8B, 70B) models using two popular shape-preserving techniques: vector quantization (NoWag-VQ) and unstructured/semi-structured pruning (NoWag-P). Our results show that NoWag-VQ significantly outperforms state-of-the-art one-shot vector quantization methods, while NoWag-P performs competitively against leading pruning techniques. These findings highlight underlying commonalities between these compression paradigms and suggest promising directions for future research. Our code is available at https://github.com/LawrenceRLiu/NoWag
classic:301524c104a1.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大语言模型在实际部署中面临的高计算与高内存成本问题，提出了一种名为 NoWag（Normalized Weight and Activation Guided Compression）的统一压缩框架。作者将其用于一次性、形状保持的压缩方法，分别覆盖向量量化和非结构化/半结构化剪枝两类主流技术。实验在 Llama-2 和 Llama-3 的多个规模模型上进行，结果表明 NoWag-VQ 优于现有一流的一次性向量量化方法，NoWag-P 也能与领先剪枝方法保持有竞争力的表现。论文的价值在于揭示了不同压缩范式之间的共性，为后续 LLM 压缩研究提供了统一视角。
classic:301524c104a1.tldr: NoWag 提出统一框架，把大模型的向量量化和剪枝压缩放到同一思路下，并在 Llama 系列上取得了很强的效果。
classic:301524c104a1.simple_intro: 这篇论文适合想了解大语言模型压缩的人阅读，因为它把两类常见压缩方法放进了一个统一框架里，思路清晰。它不仅有较好的实验表现，也能帮助读者理解不同压缩技术之间的联系。

classic:6f05ce9cbe42.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized natural language understanding and generation but face significant memory bottlenecks during training. GaLore, Gradient Low-Rank Projection, addresses this issue by leveraging the inherent low-rank structure of weight gradients, enabling substantial memory savings without sacrificing performance. Recent works further extend GaLore from various aspects, including low-bit quantization and higher-order tensor structures. However, there are several remaining challenges for GaLore, such as the computational overhead of SVD for subspace updates and the integration with state-of-the-art training parallelization strategies (e.g., FSDP). In this paper, we present GaLore 2, an efficient and scalable GaLore framework that addresses these challenges and incorporates recent advancements. In addition, we demonstrate the scalability of GaLore 2 by pre-training Llama 7B from scratch using up to 500 billion training tokens, highlighting its potential impact on real LLM pre-training scenarios.

classic:296f38d3443c.abstract: As large language models increasingly gain popularity in real-world applications, processing extremely long contexts, often exceeding the model's pre-trained context limits, has emerged as a critical challenge. While existing approaches to efficient long-context processing show promise, recurrent compression-based methods struggle with information preservation, whereas random access approaches require substantial memory resources. We introduce REFORM, a novel inference framework that efficiently handles long contexts through a two-phase approach. First, it incrementally processes input chunks while maintaining a compressed KV cache, constructs cross-layer context embeddings, and utilizes early exit strategy for improved efficiency. Second, it identifies and gathers essential tokens via similarity matching and selectively recomputes the KV cache. Compared to baselines, REFORM achieves over 52% and 34% performance gains on RULER and BABILong respectively at 1M context length. It also outperforms baselines on Infinite-Bench, RepoEval, and MM-NIAH, demonstrating flexibility across diverse tasks and domains. Additionally, REFORM reduces inference time by 30% and peak memory usage by 5%, achieving both efficiency and superior performance.
classic:296f38d3443c.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大语言模型在超长上下文推理时遇到的效率和信息保留难题展开研究。作者指出，压缩式方法容易丢信息，而随机访问式方法又很耗内存，因此提出了 REFORM 这一新的推理框架。该方法采用“压缩、收集、重计算”的两阶段流程：先分块处理并维护压缩 KV cache，再通过相似度匹配找出关键 token 进行选择性重算。实验表明，REFORM 在多个长上下文基准上同时提升了性能，并显著降低了推理时间和峰值内存。
classic:296f38d3443c.tldr: REFORM 用“压缩 + 关键 token 收集 + 选择性重算”实现了更高效、也更强的超长上下文推理。
classic:296f38d3443c.simple_intro: 如果你关心大模型如何在百万级上下文里既省内存又尽量不丢信息，这篇论文很值得看。它代表了一类很实用的长上下文推理思路，适合作为研究和工程优化的经典参考。

classic:2083da2d05fc.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注如何在终端设备上高效运行 Qwen2.5 这类大语言模型，核心问题是如何在有限算力、内存和功耗条件下仍保持可用的推理质量。论文结合模型压缩与硬件加速两条路线，探索降低模型体积、减少计算开销并提升推理速度的方法。其价值在于面向真实端侧部署场景，帮助大模型从云端走向手机、边缘设备等资源受限环境。对需要做本地推理、隐私保护或低延迟交互的应用来说，这类工作具有很强的工程参考意义。
classic:2083da2d05fc.tldr: 面向端侧部署的 Qwen2.5 高效推理方案，结合模型压缩与硬件加速来降低资源消耗并提升运行效率。
classic:2083da2d05fc.simple_intro: 这篇论文值得看，因为它聚焦大模型落地时最实际的瓶颈：如何在手机和边缘设备上跑得动、跑得快。它适合作为端侧大模型优化与部署的经典参考。
